title.zh: MYCIN · 专家知识写成规则

body.zh: 这个系统把领域知识写成规则，能解释自己给出的建议，也能接收新规则。这里看的是知识工程的做法；它是一个研究系统，不是今天的临床工具。
body.en: The system wrote domain knowledge as rules, could explain its recommendations, and could take in new rules. What matters historically is the knowledge-engineering approach; this was a research system, not a clinical tool for today.

limit.zh: 1975 年是所引系统报告的年份，不是 MYCIN 项目开始的年份。知识怎么维护、规则没覆盖到的情况怎么办，都还是问题。
limit.en: 1975 dates the cited system report, not the start of the project. Keeping the knowledge maintained and handling cases the rules did not cover remained open problems.

body.zh: 它靠间隔、正则化和核方法来做分类。统计学习不是神经网络的过渡版本，而是另一套建模选择。
body.en: Classification here rests on margins, regularization, and kernels. Statistical learning is a different set of modeling choices, not a stopgap on the way to neural networks.

limit.zh: 这里标的是 1995 年处理不可分数据的代表作，不是所有核方法的起点。
limit.en: This marks the 1995 work on non-separable data, not the origin of every kernel method.

title.zh: Dartmouth · 把 AI 作为研究问题

body.zh: 1955 年的提案为 1956 年的 Dartmouth 项目列出了学习、语言、推理等问题。一群研究者从这时开始围绕 AI 这个名字组织研究；机器智能这个问题本身，并不是这时才有人想到。
body.en: The 1955 proposal laid out questions about learning, language, and reasoning for the 1956 Dartmouth project. A group of researchers began organizing their work under the name AI, though machine intelligence itself was not a new question.

limit.zh: 当时好几条路线并存，没有哪条注定通向 LLM。
limit.en: Several approaches existed side by side; none of them was bound to lead to LLMs.

title.zh: Logic Theory Machine · 启发式证明搜索
title.en: Logic Theory Machine · heuristic proof search

body.zh: Newell 和 Simon 在 1956 年的报告里给出了一个系统的规格，用来寻找符号逻辑的证明。它靠启发式方法决定往哪个方向搜，把推理写成计算机能实现的规则。
body.en: Newell and Simon's 1956 report specifies a system for finding proofs in symbolic logic. Heuristics decide where to search, and the reasoning is written as rules a computer could implement.

limit.zh: 这里标的是 1956 年的报告。报告讲的主要是系统规格，不是在计算机上的实现；它也不是整个符号 AI 的起点。
limit.en: This marks the 1956 report, which is mainly about the system's specification rather than its implementation on a computer. It is not the origin of symbolic AI as a whole.

sources: Newell & Simon · RAND P-868 (1956), original report and abstract

body.zh: 反向传播把输出端的误差一层层往回传，用来调整每层的权重。1986 年这篇代表作展示了网络怎样学到隐藏表示；反向微分并不是从它开始的。
body.en: Backpropagation uses output errors to adjust weights throughout a network. The 1986 work is a landmark in learning hidden representations, not the first appearance of reverse-mode differentiation.

limit.zh: 有了梯度，深网络也不见得好优化，更不保证能泛化。
limit.en: Having gradients does not make every deep network easy to optimize or ensure generalization.

body.zh: Q-learning 用眼前的奖励加上对后续价值的估计，来更新一个动作的估值。1992 年的论文给出了表格情形下的收敛分析；这个方法更早见于 Watkins 1989 年的博士论文。
body.en: Q-learning updates the value of an action from the immediate reward plus an estimate of what comes after. The 1992 paper analyzes convergence in the tabular case; the method had already appeared in Watkins’s 1989 thesis.

limit.zh: 表格情形下的收敛条件，不能直接搬到深度网络上。
limit.en: Tabular convergence conditions do not automatically carry over to neural networks.

body.zh: 循环网络处理序列时，前面的信息很难一直留住。LSTM 加入记忆状态和门控，让长距离的学习效果更好。
body.en: Recurrent networks can struggle to retain information across long sequences. LSTM introduces a memory state and gates to improve long-range learning.

limit.zh: 门控能缓解这个问题，但不是多长都能记住。
limit.en: Gating helps; it does not guarantee memory over arbitrary distances.

title.zh: AlexNet · 图像特征改由网络自己学
title.en: AlexNet · letting the network learn image features

body.zh: 2012 年以前，图像分类的常规做法分两步：先用人设计的方法提取特征（比如 SIFT），编码成 Fisher 向量这类表示，再交给分类器。卷积网络早就有，但要在上百万张高分辨率照片上训练，代价太大。AlexNet 把特征这一步交给网络自己学：5 个卷积层加 3 个全连接层，6000 万个参数，在 ImageNet 的 120 万张训练图上用两块 GTX 580 训练了五六天。ILSVRC-2012 上它的 top-5 错误率是 15.3%，用 SIFT 加 Fisher 向量的第二名是 26.2%。
body.en: Before 2012, image classification usually ran in two stages: hand-designed features such as SIFT were encoded into representations like Fisher vectors, then passed to a classifier. Convolutional networks already existed, but training them on millions of high-resolution photos was too expensive. AlexNet let the network learn the features itself: five convolutional and three fully connected layers, 60 million parameters, trained for five to six days on two GTX 580 GPUs over ImageNet's 1.2 million training images. Its ILSVRC-2012 entry reached 15.3% top-5 error; the runner-up, built on SIFT and Fisher vectors, had 26.2%.

limit.zh: 它解决的是从 1000 个固定类别里挑一个答案，不是看懂整张图：物体在哪、彼此什么关系、类别表以外的东西，都不在这个任务里。作者对原因说得也很实在：结果主要来自更大的网络、更多的数据和更长的训练，他们预计只要等更快的 GPU 和更大的数据集出现，结果还能再好。2012 年也不是卷积网络的起点，1998 年的 LeNet-5 早已用它识别手写数字。
limit.en: The task was choosing one of 1,000 fixed labels, not understanding a whole scene: where objects are, how they relate, and anything outside the label set lay beyond it. The authors were plain about where the gains came from: a bigger network, more data, and longer training, and they expected faster GPUs and larger datasets to improve results further. Nor was 2012 the start of convolutional networks; LeNet-5 had read handwritten digits with one in 1998.

detail.zh:
能训起来，靠的是几处具体的改动。激活函数用 ReLU 代替 tanh：论文里一个四层卷积网络在 CIFAR-10 上把训练误差降到 25%，ReLU 比 tanh 快六倍。参数太多、容易过拟合，就用 dropout，再从每张图里随机裁出 224×224 的小块、做水平翻转、调整颜色强度，多造出很多训练样本。显存也直接决定了结构：一块 GTX 580 只有 3GB，整个网络放不下，作者把它拆到两块卡上，只在部分层让两边交换数据。

15.3% 这个数要看清楚：它是 7 个网络取平均的结果，其中两个先在更大的 ImageNet 2011 秋季版（1500 万张图、2.2 万个类别）上预训练过。单个网络在验证集上是 18.2%，同样远好于 26.2%。论文还发现深度本身有用：去掉中间任何一个卷积层，top-1 准确率大约掉 2%。

之后几年，ImageNet 上继续往更深的网络走。2015 年的 ResNet 用残差连接把深度推到 152 层，集成模型在 ImageNet 测试集上的错误率是 3.57%。用 GPU 训练神经网络，也从这篇论文作者手写的 cuda-convnet，变成可以直接调用 2014 年 NVIDIA 推出的 cuDNN 这类现成的库。
detail.en:
A few concrete changes made the training practical. ReLUs replaced tanh: in the paper, a four-layer convolutional network reached 25% training error on CIFAR-10 six times faster with ReLUs. To fight overfitting in such a large model, the authors used dropout and generated extra training examples by cropping random 224×224 patches, flipping them horizontally, and shifting color intensities. Memory shaped the architecture too. One GTX 580 had only 3GB, so the network was split across two GPUs that exchanged data only at certain layers.

The 15.3% figure deserves a closer look. It averages seven networks, two of which were first pretrained on the larger Fall 2011 ImageNet release (15 million images, 22,000 categories). A single network scored 18.2% on the validation set, still far ahead of 26.2%. The paper also found that depth itself mattered: removing any one of the middle convolutional layers cost about 2% in top-1 accuracy.

In the following years, ImageNet results kept moving toward deeper networks. ResNet, in 2015, used residual connections to reach 152 layers, and an ensemble scored 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. GPU training also moved from the authors' hand-written cuda-convnet to ready-made libraries such as cuDNN, which NVIDIA presented in 2014.

body.zh: 用神经网络估计动作价值，让 RL 直接从 Atari 的游戏画面学起。经验回放把过去的交互存下来，反复拿来训练。
body.en: A neural network estimates action values straight from Atari pixels, and experience replay reuses past interactions for training.

limit.zh: 能反复重置的游戏，和真实机器人的试错成本不是一回事。
limit.en: A game can be reset; a physical robot pays a different price for failure.

body.zh: 先把输入编码，再生成输出，长度不一的序列就能用同一套流程来学，机器翻译就是一例。
body.en: Encode the input, then generate the output: sequences of different lengths, as in machine translation, can be learned in one shared setup.

limit.zh: 这是编码器—解码器思路的一项代表工作，后来的模型并不都只从它而来。
limit.en: This marks a representative encoder–decoder approach, not the sole origin of later models.

title.zh: Transformer · 只用 attention 做翻译

body.zh: 2017 年以前，机器翻译的主流是循环网络（RNN、LSTM）组成的编码器—解码器，中间再接 attention。循环网络按位置一步步算，第 t 步要等第 t−1 步算完，句子越长，越难在句子内部并行训练。Transformer 去掉了循环和卷积，只用 attention：每个位置直接按内容去看句中所有其他位置，任意两个词之间只隔一层。在 WMT 2014 英德翻译上，它拿到 28.4 BLEU，比之前最好的结果（包括多模型集成）高出 2 BLEU 以上；大模型在一台 8 块 P100 的机器上训练了 3.5 天。
body.en: Before 2017, the leading machine translation systems were encoder–decoders built from recurrent networks such as LSTMs, joined by attention. A recurrent network computes position by position: step t waits for step t−1, so longer sentences resist parallel training within a sentence. Transformer dropped recurrence and convolution and kept only attention. Each position looks directly at every other position by content, so any two words are one layer apart. On WMT 2014 English–German it reached 28.4 BLEU, more than 2 BLEU above the previous best results, ensembles included. The big model trained for 3.5 days on one machine with eight P100 GPUs.

limit.zh: attention 让训练时句子内部可以并行，但生成译文时，解码器仍然一个词一个词地输出，靠掩码挡住还没生成的部分；作者在结尾把“让生成不那么串行”列为下一个目标。计算量随长度平方增长的问题也留了下来，长文本、图像和音频怎么处理，原文只提了局部 attention 这个方向。日期：arXiv 初版是 2017 年 6 月 12 日，会议版收在 NIPS 2017；这里的数字取自初版。
limit.en: Attention made training parallel within a sentence, but the decoder still produced a translation one word at a time, with a mask hiding words not yet generated; the authors named less sequential generation as a next goal. Cost that grows with the square of length also remained, and for long text, images, and audio the paper only pointed toward local attention. Dates: the first arXiv version is June 12, 2017, and the conference paper appeared at NIPS 2017. Figures here come from the first version.

sources: Attention Is All You Need · arXiv v1, 2017-06-12, §§1–2, 4–5, 7 and Figures 3–5
Attention Is All You Need · NIPS 2017 proceedings
BERT · arXiv v1, 2018-10-11, §3 on encoder and left-to-right Transformers

detail.zh:
差别可以拿一句 50 个词的话来算。循环层要串行走 50 步，第 1 个词的信息传到第 50 个词，路上也要经过 50 步；self-attention 一层就把所有位置两两连起来，串行步数是常数。代价是每层要算 50×50 个位置对，计算量随句长平方增长。论文的判断是：句长小于表示维度时（翻译里很常见，比如 50 对 512），self-attention 反而比循环层省；序列很长时，可以只看附近一段窗口，作者把这留作以后的工作。

论文附录画出了模型实际学到的 attention。英文句子里的 making，好几个头都去看远处的 more difficult，把 making … more difficult 这个短语接了起来；另外两个头看起来在做指代消解，判断 its 指的是谁。作者认为，不同的头学会了做不同的事。

后来的模型各取所需。BERT 只用编码器，每个词同时看左右两边，用来做大规模预训练；OpenAI 的 GPT 用带掩码的那一侧，每个词只看前面，适合生成文字；2020 年的 ViT 把图像切成小块，当作序列交给 Transformer。
detail.en:
Take a 50-word sentence. A recurrent layer needs 50 sequential steps, and information from the first word passes through 50 steps to reach the last. One self-attention layer connects every pair of positions with a constant number of sequential steps. The price is 50×50 position pairs per layer, so cost grows with the square of sentence length. The paper argues that while a sentence is shorter than the representation size, as is common in translation (say 50 versus 512), self-attention is actually cheaper than recurrence. For very long sequences, attention could be restricted to a nearby window; the authors left that for future work.

The appendix shows attention the model actually learned. For the word “making”, several heads attend to the distant “more difficult”, completing the phrase “making … more difficult”. Two other heads appear to handle anaphora, working out what “its” refers to. The authors note that different heads learned different jobs.

Later models took different parts. BERT used only the encoder, letting each word see both sides, for large-scale pretraining. OpenAI's GPT used the masked side, where each word sees only what comes before, which suits text generation. ViT, in 2020, cut images into patches and fed them to a Transformer as a sequence.

body.zh: PPO 用裁剪等设计，限制策略大幅更新的动力，同时兼顾实现难度和训练效率。后来它也用在了人类反馈训练中。
body.en: Clipping and related design choices damp the incentive for large policy updates while keeping training practical. PPO was later used for learning from human feedback.

limit.zh: 裁剪并不能保证实际的 KL 始终受限。
limit.en: Clipping is not a hard guarantee on the actual KL divergence.

body.zh: 先用掩码语言建模学表示，再拿去适配下游任务。预训练出来的模型，不再只为原来的一个任务服务。
body.en: Masked language modeling first learns representations, which are then adapted to downstream tasks. A pretrained model is no longer tied to a single task.

limit.zh: 双向编码和自回归生成，能看到的信息不一样。
limit.en: Bidirectional encoding and autoregressive generation do not see the same context.

body.zh: 把最大熵目标和离策略的数据重用结合起来，学习连续动作。机器人和模拟控制里，样本效率很要紧；SAC 关注的正是这一点。
body.en: SAC pairs a maximum-entropy objective with off-policy data reuse to learn continuous actions, aiming at the sample efficiency that robotics and simulated control care about.

limit.zh: 模拟器里学会，不等于在真实硬件上安全可靠。
limit.en: Success in simulation does not establish safety on physical hardware.

body.zh: 普通的数据并行里，每张 GPU 都存一份训练状态，模型一大，显存就浪费得厉害。ZeRO 分阶段把优化器状态、梯度和参数切片，各张 GPU 分着存，用到时再通信。
body.en: Plain data parallelism keeps a copy of the training state on every GPU, which wastes a lot of memory once models get large. ZeRO progressively shards optimizer state, gradients, and parameters, spreading storage across GPUs and communicating when needed.

limit.zh: 分片并没有让通信变得免费，也替代不了所有其他并行方式。
limit.en: Sharding does not make communication free or replace every other form of parallelism.

detail.zh: 比如四张卡原本各存一份优化器状态，可以改成每张只管其中一部分。重复的副本省掉了，但计算用到的数据得及时交换。ZeRO 是换了一种组织状态的方式，并不会把所有训练内存都缩到四分之一。
detail.en: With four GPUs, optimizer state that was copied four times can instead be divided among them. This removes duplication but requires exchanging data when computation needs it. It does not make every component of training memory one quarter of its original size.

body.zh: 大规模自回归预训练显示，模型能靠上下文里的示例完成不同任务：先读提示和示例，再去做新任务，不用每次都重新微调。
body.en: Large-scale autoregressive pretraining showed that a model could pick up a task from examples in its context, without a separate fine-tuning run for each task.

limit.zh: 上下文学习不会改动模型权重，也不保证在所有任务上都能泛化。
limit.en: In-context learning does not update model weights or guarantee generalization to every task.

body.zh: 把图像切成 patch，排成序列交给 Transformer 编码。处理序列的结构搬到了视觉上，但训练规模和归纳偏置依然要紧。
body.en: ViT cuts an image into patches and feeds them to a Transformer as a sequence. The architecture carries over to vision, but training scale and inductive bias still matter.

limit.zh: 结构可以相同，图像和文字的数据特点却不一样。
limit.en: A shared architecture does not make images and text equivalent data.

body.zh: DDPM 学的是一步步去噪，成了生成建模的一条重要路线。它不是语言模型兴起之后才冒出来的附属分支。
body.en: DDPM learns to remove noise step by step, and it became an important route in generative modeling. It is not an offshoot that appeared only after language models took off.

limit.zh: 这里拿 DDPM 作代表，扩散的思想并不是它最先提出的。
limit.en: DDPM is a representative landmark, not the first proposal of diffusion-based modeling.

title.zh: CLIP · 把图像和文字接起来

body.zh: 一套固定的类别标签，很难覆盖所有想识别的东西。CLIP 用成对的图片和文字训练两个编码器，让配对的图文表示靠得更近；识别任务于是可以直接用自然语言描述来定义。
body.en: A fixed label set cannot cover everything people might want to recognize. CLIP trained image and text encoders on paired examples, pulling matching pairs closer together, so a recognition task can be defined in natural language.

limit.zh: 图文表示对齐了，不代表模型就能生成有依据的回答。
limit.en: Aligned representations do not by themselves generate grounded answers.

detail.zh: 比如要区分自行车和汽车，可以把“自行车的照片”和“汽车的照片”分别编码，再和图片的表示比一比。这样不用为这两个类别另训分类头；但描述换个说法，结果可能就变了。模型本身也不会生成解释。
detail.en: To tell a bicycle from a car, encode descriptions such as “a photo of a bicycle” and “a photo of a car,” then compare each with the image representation. No new classifier head is needed for those labels, but rewording the descriptions can change the result, and the model itself does not generate an explanation.

body.zh: 把示范、偏好标注、奖励模型和 PPO 串成一条流程，调整语言模型怎么回答。它是一次公开的 RLHF 实践，人类反馈学习并不是从它开始的。
body.en: InstructGPT chained demonstrations, preference labels, a reward model, and PPO to shape how a language model responds. It is a public RLHF landmark, not where learning from human feedback began.

limit.zh: 标注群体的偏好不能直接代表所有人的需要。
limit.en: Annotator preferences do not automatically represent everyone’s needs.

body.zh: FlashAttention 把计算分块，减少 attention 中间结果在 GPU 显存和片上 SRAM 之间来回读写。它算的仍是精确的 attention，前向和反向都支持，不只是给推理服务用的优化。
body.en: FlashAttention splits the attention computation into tiles to cut the traffic of intermediate results between GPU memory and on-chip SRAM. It still computes exact attention and works for both the forward and backward passes, so it is not just an inference-serving optimization.

limit.zh: 实际能快多少，还要看张量形状、硬件和实现版本。
limit.en: Gains still depend on shapes, hardware, and implementation.

detail.zh: 普通实现会把很大的 attention 分数矩阵写到显存里，再读回来做后续计算。FlashAttention 一块一块地算，同时记下归一化需要的统计量，这样就不必把整个中间矩阵存下来。省掉的是数据搬运和中间存储，并没有随意丢掉该关注的 token。
detail.en: A conventional implementation writes a large attention-score matrix to GPU memory and reads it back for later operations. FlashAttention works in tiles and maintains the statistics needed for normalization without storing the full intermediate matrix. It reduces movement and storage rather than discarding arbitrary tokens.

body.zh: 先收集偏好对：同一个问题，哪份回答更好。DPO 直接用这些数据更新语言模型。它的偏好损失由带 KL 约束的奖励优化目标推导而来；常规的离线流程里，不用另训一个显式的奖励模型，也不用边训练边采样。
body.en: DPO trains a language model directly on preferred and rejected responses to the same prompt. Its preference loss is derived from a KL-regularized reward objective. The ordinary offline workflow needs neither a separately trained reward model nor rollouts during training.

limit.zh: 离线 DPO 不是在线 RL，也不会自动消除偏好数据里的偏差。
limit.en: Offline DPO is not online RL and does not automatically fix preference-data bias.

detail.zh: 比如两份摘要，A 保留了关键事实，B 漏了一个重要条件。偏好标签告诉模型 A 更好；但训练时比较的是两份回答相对 reference model 的概率比，并没有把 A 当作唯一的正确答案。数据里的偏好靠不靠得住，还得另外检查。
detail.en: Suppose summary A preserves the key facts while B omits an important condition. A preference label favors A, but the loss compares each response's probability ratio against a reference model; it does not simply treat A as the one correct answer. Whether the preference itself is reliable still has to be checked separately.

body.zh: PagedAttention 借用分页式内存管理的思路，减少 KV cache 浪费的内存，让服务调度更有效率。
body.en: PagedAttention borrows the idea of paged memory management to cut wasted KV-cache memory, which makes serving more efficient.

limit.zh: 这里的 KV cache 存的是注意力的键和值张量，不是 CPU 的硬件缓存。内存浪费少了，也不保证每个请求的延迟都会下降。
limit.en: This KV cache stores attention key and value tensors, not CPU hardware cache lines; reducing memory waste does not guarantee lower latency for every request.

detail.zh: 有的请求生成几十个 token 就结束了，有的还要写很长。要是预先给每个请求留一大块连续空间，显存就容易浪费。PagedAttention 把 KV cache 切成块，通过映射表访问，用多少分多少。这和 CPU 的硬件缓存不是一回事。
detail.en: One request may finish after a few dozen tokens while another keeps growing. Reserving large contiguous buffers can waste memory. PagedAttention divides the KV cache into blocks accessed through a mapping, allocating as needed. This is distinct from a CPU's hardware cache.

title.zh: RT-2 · 视觉语言走向动作

body.zh: 机器人不仅要看懂画面和指令，还要输出动作。RT-2 把视觉语言预训练和机器人动作数据结合起来，尝试把已有的视觉语言能力用到控制任务里。
body.en: A robot needs to act, not just interpret images and instructions. RT-2 combines vision-language pretraining with robot-action data to transfer some of those capabilities into control.

limit.zh: VLA 不等于 RL；这一项也不能说明机器人训练已经有了统一配方。
limit.en: VLA is not synonymous with RL, nor does this establish a universal robotics recipe.

title.zh: GRPO · 用一组回答作比较

body.zh: 同一道题生成几份回答，用它们的奖励差异估计优势（advantage），不用另训价值模型。DeepSeekMath 提出后，R1 采用了它，TRL 和 verl 也提供了实现。
body.en: Generate several answers to a prompt and compare their rewards to estimate advantages, without training a separate value model. DeepSeekMath introduced GRPO; R1 used it, and TRL and verl provide implementations.

limit.zh: 2024 年是 DeepSeekMath 论文的年份。框架文档只能说明后来有了实现，不是 2024 年的发布记录。不用价值模型，奖励设计和采样成本也照样省不掉。
limit.en: 2024 is the year of the DeepSeekMath paper. The framework documentation shows later implementations, not 2024 releases. Dropping the value model does not remove the need for reward design or the cost of sampling.

detail.zh: 举个只看结果的简化例子：同一题的四个回答得分 1、1、0、0，组内平均 0.5，高于平均和低于平均的回答就分开了。要是四个全得 0，标准的组内相对奖励就给不出任何区分；多采样要花成本，也不一定换来有用的反馈。
detail.en: Take four answers with simple outcome rewards of 1, 1, 0, and 0. The mean is 0.5, so above-average answers can be told apart from below-average ones. If all four score zero, the standard group-relative reward has nothing to distinguish. Sampling more has a cost and does not necessarily yield useful feedback.

title.zh: 后训练配方 · 还在探索

body.zh: 模型有某种能力，不等于一次训练就能稳稳地把它调出来。SFT、DPO、PPO、GRPO 用的数据和反馈各不相同；这里列的报告给出了能用的配方，也摆明了在任务、预算和训练稳定性上的取舍。
body.en: Having a capability does not mean training will reliably bring it out. SFT, DPO, PPO, and GRPO use different data and feedback. The reports here describe working recipes along with trade-offs in task coverage, budget, and stability.

limit.zh: 2025 年是这组开放问题所依据材料的时间，不是后训练诞生的年份。Tülu 3 初稿发表于 2024 年，这里引用的是 2025 年的修订版。
limit.en: 2025 dates the material behind this open question, not the birth of post-training. Tülu 3 first appeared in 2024; the version cited here is the 2025 revision.

detail.zh: 比较方案时，先把任务和评估固定下来，再问几个问题：高质量示范够不够？奖励能不能核验？每次 rollout 要花多久？同样的预算，是多收数据、多采样，还是多更新几步？这些选择往往比算法叫什么更贴近实际工作。
detail.en: To compare approaches, fix the task and evaluation first. Then ask whether good demonstrations are available, rewards can be checked, and rollouts are affordable. A fixed budget could buy more data, more samples, or more updates. Those choices often say more about the work than the algorithm name alone.

title.zh: ResNet · 更深的网络也能训练

body.zh: 网络加深，表达能力更强，可连训练误差都可能变大。ResNet 用残差连接（residual connection）：一组层学 F(x)，输出时再加回原来的输入 x。预印本 2015 年公开，正式论文发表在 CVPR 2016。
body.en: A deeper network can express more, yet it may fit even its training set worse. ResNet added residual connections: a block learns F(x) and then adds back the original input x. The preprint came out in 2015; the paper appeared at CVPR 2016.

limit.zh: ResNet 不是 CNN 的起点；网络也不是越深就一定越好。
limit.en: It did not originate CNNs, and greater depth is not always better.

detail.zh: 假设网络某处的表示已经够好，后面几层暂时不用改它。输入输出维度相同的残差块，只要把 F(x) 学到接近零，就差不多原样保留了输入。这说明的是 shortcut 让优化更容易，不是说所有层最后都什么也不做。
detail.en: Suppose a representation is already good and the next few layers barely need to change it. A residual block whose input and output have the same dimensions can approximate the identity mapping simply by pushing F(x) toward zero. The point is that shortcuts make optimization easier, not that every block ends up doing nothing.

title.zh: 图卷积网络 GCN · 从邻居那里学信息
title.en: Graph convolutional networks · learning from neighbors

body.zh: 把节点特征和图的连接关系放在一起，在标签很少时给节点分类。它给图卷积找了一条简洁、可以直接实现的传播规则。预印本出自 2016 年，会议论文发表在 ICLR 2017。
body.en: GCN combines node features with graph structure to classify nodes when only a few labels are available, using a compact propagation rule. The preprint is from 2016; the conference paper appeared at ICLR 2017.

limit.zh: GNN 的研究早就有了。这里只是一项代表工作，2016 年不是这个领域诞生的年份。
limit.en: GNN research predates this work. This is a representative paper, not the birth of the field.

title.zh: GraphSAGE · 处理没见过的节点

body.zh: 不给每个节点单独存一份 embedding，而是学一个采样并聚合邻居特征的函数。遇到没见过的新节点，也能用这个函数算出表示。
body.en: Instead of storing an embedding for every node, GraphSAGE learns a function that samples and aggregates neighborhood features, so the same function can compute representations for unseen nodes.

limit.zh: 能不能泛化，仍要看节点特征、邻居信息和数据分布；不是任何新图都能直接套用。
limit.en: Generalization still depends on features, neighborhoods, and the data distribution.

title.zh: GAT · 邻居不必同样重要

body.zh: 先用 attention 学出每个邻居的权重，再按权重聚合信息。预印本 2017 年公开，论文发表在 ICLR 2018。把它和 GCN、GraphSAGE 放在一起看，就是当时图表示学习的几种不同做法。
body.en: Attention learns how much weight each of a node’s neighbors gets before their information is combined. Released in 2017 and published at ICLR 2018, GAT is one more design choice alongside GCN and GraphSAGE.

limit.zh: 这里只是按时间排在一起，GAT 并不是 GraphSAGE 的直接后继。
limit.en: They are grouped by date; GAT is not a direct successor to GraphSAGE.

title.zh: AlphaGo · 用神经网络给搜索减负
title.en: AlphaGo · neural networks that narrow the search

body.zh: 围棋难在两处：每步大约有 250 种走法、一盘约 150 步，没法穷举；局面好坏也很难写成公式。之前最强的程序用蒙特卡洛树搜索，靠大量随机模拟估计胜率，水平停在业余强手。AlphaGo 用两个神经网络给搜索减负：策略网络挑出值得考虑的几步，减少每层要展开的分支；价值网络直接估计局面胜率，不必每条线都模拟到终局。2015 年 10 月，它以 5:0 赢了欧洲冠军樊麾，这是程序第一次在全尺寸棋盘上赢职业棋手；2016 年 3 月又在首尔以 4:1 赢了李世石。
body.en: Go is hard in two ways. With about 250 legal moves per turn and games of about 150 moves, exhaustive search is out of the question, and a position's value is hard to capture in a formula. The strongest earlier programs used Monte Carlo tree search, estimating win rates from many random playouts, and played at a strong amateur level. AlphaGo added two neural networks to lighten the search: a policy network proposes the moves worth considering, narrowing each level of the tree, and a value network estimates who is winning, so not every line has to be played out to the end. In October 2015 it beat European champion Fan Hui 5–0, the first win by a program over a professional on a full-sized board. In March 2016 it beat Lee Sedol 4–1 in Seoul.

limit.zh: 围棋规则完全已知、局面全部可见、可以无限次模拟，这是搜索能起作用的前提；现实中的大多数决策没有这样现成的模拟器。另外，最初的 AlphaGo 先学了人类棋谱，不是从零自学，别和后来的 AlphaGo Zero 混在一起。日期：樊麾对局在 2015 年 10 月 5–9 日，论文 2015 年 11 月投稿、2016 年 1 月接收，同年发表于 Nature，李世石比赛在 2016 年 3 月；这里按论文和李世石比赛标在 2016 年。
limit.en: Go has fully known rules, a fully visible board, and unlimited simulation, which is what makes search work; most real-world decisions come without such a simulator. The original AlphaGo also learned from human games first, so it should not be confused with the later AlphaGo Zero. Dates: the Fan Hui match ran October 5–9, 2015; the paper was received in November 2015, accepted in January 2016, and published in Nature that year; the Lee Sedol match was in March 2016. The entry uses 2016 for the paper and the match.

sources: Silver et al. · Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search, Nature, 2016
Same paper · DeepMind-hosted PDF, introduction, value-network section and Methods
DeepMind · AlphaGo overview, Lee Sedol match in Seoul, March 2016
DeepMind · AlphaGo Zero: Starting from scratch, 2017-10-18

detail.zh:
训练分三步。先用 KGS 围棋服务器上的 3000 万个局面训练策略网络，模仿人类高手；它预测高手下一步的准确率是 57.0%，此前别的团队最好是 44.4%。再让策略网络和自己的旧版本对弈，用强化学习继续改进，这时不做任何搜索就能赢开源程序 Pachi 85% 的对局。最后用自我对弈生成 3000 万个局面训练价值网络，每盘棋只取一个：同一盘里相邻局面只差一颗子、结果却相同，直接拿整盘人类棋谱训练时，网络只是记住了胜负。

价值网络省下的计算很具体：评估一个局面时，算一次价值网络，准确度接近用强化学习策略网络模拟到终局的蒙特卡洛估计，计算量却少 15,000 倍。即便如此，和樊麾对弈的分布式版本仍然用了 1,202 个 CPU 和 176 个 GPU。

2017 年的 AlphaGo Zero 去掉了人类棋谱这一步，只靠规则和自我对弈学习，训练三天后，以 100:0 赢了战胜李世石的那个版本。DeepMind 后来的 AlphaZero、MuZero 也沿着这条线继续做。
detail.en:
Training had three stages. A policy network first learned to imitate experts from 30 million positions on the KGS Go Server; it predicted the expert's next move 57.0% of the time, against 44.4% for the best other group. Reinforcement learning then improved it through games against earlier versions of itself; with no search at all, it won 85% of games against the open-source program Pachi. Finally, a value network was trained on 30 million self-play positions, one per game. Neighboring positions in a game differ by a single stone but share the same result, and when trained on whole human games the network simply memorized outcomes.

The value network's saving was concrete. One evaluation came close to the accuracy of Monte Carlo playouts with the reinforcement-learning policy network while using 15,000 times less computation. Even so, the distributed version that played Fan Hui used 1,202 CPUs and 176 GPUs.

AlphaGo Zero, in 2017, dropped the human games and learned from the rules and self-play alone. After three days of training it beat the version that had defeated Lee Sedol 100–0. DeepMind's later AlphaZero and MuZero continued this line of work.

body.zh: 2020 年 CASP14 上的结果，让蛋白质结构预测有了重大进展。完整方法在 2021 年发表。它代表 AI 用在科学问题上的一条路线，而不只是聊天或识图。
body.en: Results at CASP14 in 2020 marked a major advance in protein structure prediction. The full method was published in 2021. It shows AI applied to scientific problems, not just chat or image recognition.

limit.zh: 预测出结构，不等于解释了蛋白质的全部功能和动态，也不能取代所有实验。
limit.en: A predicted structure does not explain all protein function or dynamics, nor replace every experiment.

title.zh: ChatGPT · 用对话接触语言模型

body.zh: 2022 年 11 月以研究预览的形式开放。用户可以在对话里追问、改要求，语言模型不再只是论文里的 benchmark 或开发者调用的接口。
body.en: The research preview opened in November 2022. A conversational interface let people follow up and revise requests, making language models accessible beyond benchmarks and developer APIs.

limit.zh: 这是一次产品发布，不是 Transformer、RLHF 或聊天机器人的起点。公告里也写明了它会给出错误答案等限制。
limit.en: This is a product launch, not the origin of Transformers, RLHF, or chatbots. The announcement also documents incorrect answers and other limitations.

detail.zh: 同样的模型能力，放进对话里，用起来就不一样了：先提要求，再追一句“短一点”，或者补充背景。要看的是交互方式和反馈怎样进入产品；一次产品发布，并不意味着底层技术都在这一刻诞生。
detail.en: Conversation changes how people use a model: a request can be followed by “make it shorter” or extra context. What matters is the interaction and feedback loop built around the model; one product launch did not invent all the underlying techniques at once.

title.zh: Stable Diffusion · 图像生成工具

body.zh: 2022 年公开了模型权重和代码，也提供了演示和工具入口。人们不再只能看论文里的结果，而是可以亲手试用、改造图像生成模型。
body.en: The 2022 public release provided weights, code, demonstrations, and tool access. Image generation became something people could try and adapt, not only inspect in a paper.

limit.zh: 权重公开了，许可证、内容安全和数据来源方面的限制依然存在。
limit.en: Available weights do not remove licensing, safety, or training-data concerns.

body.zh: 报告对比了两种设置：R1-Zero 直接在基座模型上做 RL；R1 加入了冷启动数据和多阶段训练。这里看的是 RL 怎样和数据、SFT、评估配合，不是把它当成通用解法。
body.en: The report compares R1-Zero, trained with RL directly from a base model, with R1, which adds cold-start data and multi-stage training. The point here is how RL fits together with data, SFT, and evaluation, not a universal recipe.

limit.zh: 2025 年指 1 月公开的首版报告。这里引用的是 v1，不是 2026 年修订的 v2。报告里的任务奖励和训练结果，不能直接推广到所有模型。
limit.en: The year marks the initial January 2025 report; this entry cites v1, not the 2026 v2 revision. Its task rewards and training results do not generalize automatically to every model.

detail.zh: R1-Zero 用来观察：直接在基座上做 RL，会出现哪些能力、哪些问题；R1 在此基础上加了冷启动数据等阶段。两者放在一起读就能看出，“奖励驱动的学习有效”和“完整产品不再需要数据准备”，是两个完全不同的判断。
detail.en: R1-Zero explored what emerged when RL was applied directly to the base model; R1 added stages including cold-start data. Reading them together separates evidence that reward-driven learning can work from the much stronger—and unsupported—claim that data preparation is no longer needed.

title.zh: 珍珠街电站 · 街区供电

body.zh: 1882 年，纽约珍珠街电站开始给曼哈顿下城的一个街区供电。电站通过地下线路，把多座建筑接进同一套直流供电系统。
body.en: In 1882, Pearl Street Station began supplying electricity to a district in Lower Manhattan. A central station and underground cables brought several buildings onto the same direct-current supply.

limit.zh: 这是一个街区范围的直流供电，不是世界上第一次发电，也不是现代跨区域交流电网的开端。
limit.en: This was local direct-current service. It was not the first time anyone generated electricity, nor the start of the modern interconnected AC grid.

sources: Con Edison corporate history (2023), September 4, 1882 entry
Thomas A. Edison Papers: Pearl Street archival headnote

body.zh: 1969 年 10 月 29 日，UCLA 的团队试着通过 ARPANET 登录斯坦福研究所的主机。远程登录让异地的计算机能实际交互起来，跨机构使用计算资源也就有了试验的条件。
body.en: On October 29, 1969, a UCLA team tried to log in to a Stanford Research Institute host over ARPANET. Remote login turned a link between distant computers into something people could actually interact with, and gave researchers a way to experiment with using computing resources across institutions.

limit.zh: 第一次尝试只传出“lo”就崩溃了，完整的登录是后来才成功的。这也还不是成熟的公众互联网。
limit.en: The first attempt got only “lo” through before it crashed; a full login succeeded later. This was not yet a mature public Internet.

sources: Leonard Kleinrock: UCLA IMP log and participant account of October 29, 1969

body.zh: 1969 年，贝尔实验室的一个团队想保住交互式的编程环境，就在 PDP-7 上做出了后来叫 Unix 的系统。文件系统、进程和命令解释器慢慢组成了一个能开发自身的环境，写程序和日常用工具，都在这同一套环境里。
body.en: In 1969, wanting to hold on to an interactive programming environment, a Bell Labs team built a system on the PDP-7 that would later be called Unix. Its filesystem, processes, and shell grew into an environment that could be used to develop itself, so writing programs and using everyday tools shared one foundation.

limit.zh: 1969 年是开始开发的年份，名字是 1970 年才起的；1974 年那篇介绍系统的论文也不是它的诞生日期。
limit.en: 1969 marks when work on the system began; the name came in 1970, and the 1974 paper describing it does not date its creation.

sources: Dennis Ritchie: Unix evolution, participant history presented 1979, published 1980, reprinted 1984

body.zh: 1976 年，Metcalfe 和 Boggs 发表论文，讲附近的计算机怎样共用同轴电缆收发数据包。接入由各台机器分散控制，碰撞了就重传，所以局域网不需要一个中央控制器来安排每一次发送。
body.en: In 1976, Metcalfe and Boggs published a paper on how nearby computers could share coaxial cable to exchange packets. With access control spread across the machines and retransmission after collisions, a local network needed no central controller to hand out every chance to transmit.

limit.zh: 1976 年是论文发表的年份，不是 1973 年那份备忘录的日期。论文描述的是一个实验性的共享电缆网络。
limit.en: 1976 is the paper's publication year, not the date of the 1973 memo; the paper describes an experimental shared-cable network.

sources: Metcalfe and Boggs: original CACM paper, July 1976 (Cambridge scan)
Computer History Museum: May 22, 1973 Ethernet memo archival account

body.zh: 为了把使用不同通信技术的网络连起来，ARPANET 把 1983 年 1 月 1 日定为从 NCP 切换到 TCP/IP 的目标日期。有了共同的协议，远程登录、文件传输和邮件就能跨过原来的网络边界；1983 年的主机调查记下了这些服务实际运行的情况。
body.en: To connect networks built on different communication technologies, ARPANET set January 1, 1983 as the target date for switching from NCP to TCP/IP. Shared protocols let remote login, file transfer, and mail cross network boundaries, and host surveys in 1983 recorded which services were actually running.

limit.zh: 这里标的是部署切换，不是协议发明的年份。2 月的调查里还有服务没有响应，可见到了目标日期，并不是所有主机都已就绪。
limit.en: This dates the deployment, not the invention of the protocols. Surveys in February still found services that did not respond, so the target date did not mean every host was ready.

sources: Jon Postel: RFC 801 transition plan, November 1981
David Smallberg: RFC 842 operational survey, February 1983

body.zh: 1983 年 9 月 27 日，Richard Stallman 宣布 GNU 计划，要做一套可以自由分享、和 Unix 兼容的系统。内核、编译器、编辑器和命令行工具都在计划之内，目的是让大家协作时不必再依赖禁止分享的软件。
body.en: On September 27, 1983, Richard Stallman announced GNU, a plan to build a Unix-compatible system that could be freely shared. It covered a kernel, compiler, editor, and shell tools in one effort, so that people could collaborate without depending on software that forbade sharing.

limit.zh: 1983 年是发公告的年份，真正动手是 1984 年 1 月。发公告时也没有发布完整的系统或编译器。
limit.en: 1983 dates the announcement; work started in January 1984. No complete system or compiler was released with the announcement.

sources: GNU: original September 27, 1983 announcement with project historical notes

title.zh: Web · 把分散的信息连起来

body.zh: 1989 年 3 月，Tim Berners-Lee 提出一个分布式超文本系统，想解决 CERN 因人员流动和资料分散而丢失信息的问题。文档和相关的人、项目、系统互相链接起来，跨团队找资料时，就不必受限于单一的目录层级。
body.en: In March 1989, Tim Berners-Lee proposed a distributed hypertext system to deal with the information CERN was losing to staff turnover and scattered records. Linking documents, people, projects, and systems would let people find knowledge across teams without forcing everything into a single directory hierarchy.

limit.zh: 1989 年是提案的年份，不是网站上线的年份。存档里的 1990 年 5 月是再次分发的日期，万维网这个名字也是 1990 年才定下来的。
limit.en: 1989 dates the proposal, not a website going live. May 1990 is when it was redistributed, and the name World Wide Web was settled in 1990.

sources: Tim Berners-Lee: original 1989 proposal, W3C transcription and author provenance note

title.zh: Linux · 一个谁都能改的内核
title.en: Linux · a kernel anyone could change

body.zh: 到 1990 年代初，GNU 计划已经写好了编译器、shell 等组成系统所需的大部分自由软件，唯独缺内核。1991 年，Linus Torvalds 公开了 Linux 0.01 的源代码，发布说明给它的定位是：一个给 386 电脑用的、类似 Minix 的免费内核。它很简陋，要借 Minix 来引导，shell 和编译器得另找，许可还禁止收费分发。变化在后面：源码谁都能看、能改，到 0.12 版又改用 GNU 的 copyleft 许可，Linux 和 GNU 的工具拼在一起，凑成了一套完整的自由操作系统。
body.en: By the early 1990s, the GNU project had written most of the free software a system needs, including compilers and a shell, but still lacked a kernel. In 1991 Linus Torvalds released the source of Linux 0.01, which its release notes described as a free Minix-like kernel for 386 machines. It was rough: it needed Minix to bootstrap, shells and compilers had to be obtained separately, and its license forbade distribution for a fee. What changed came next. Anyone could read and modify the source, and with version 0.12 the license moved to GNU's copyleft, so Linux and the GNU tools could be combined into a complete free operating system.

limit.zh: 0.01 不是完整的系统，也不是第一个类 Unix 系统。这里引用的 GNU 文章代表 GNU 一方的立场，它也主张把整个系统称为 GNU/Linux。Linux 后来能用起来，靠的是 GNU 工具链和许多贡献者，不是一个人一次发布就完成的。日期：这里按 0.01 源码公开标在 1991 年；许可变更见 0.12 版发布说明，GNU 的文章把 Linux 成为自由软件记在 1992 年。
limit.en: Version 0.01 was neither a complete system nor the first Unix-like one. The GNU article cited here presents the GNU project's own position, including its case for calling the whole system GNU/Linux. A usable Linux system depended on the GNU toolchain and many contributors, not on one person's single release. Dates: the entry uses 1991 for the release of the 0.01 source; the license change appears in the 0.12 release notes, and the GNU article dates Linux becoming free software to 1992.

sources: Linus Torvalds: original Linux 0.01 release notes, 1991, kernel.org archive
Linus Torvalds: Linux 0.12 release notes, license change, kernel.org archive
GNU Project · Linux and the GNU System (the GNU project's account)
Dean and Ghemawat · MapReduce, OSDI 2004, §3 execution environment
NVIDIA GeForce 8800 technical brief, 2006-11-08, p. 14 on the CUDA SDK

detail.zh:
这里要分清三样东西。内核管进程调度、内存和设备；shell、编译器、C 库在它上面；把内核和这些工具配好、能直接安装使用的，叫发行版。0.01 只是第一样，发布说明自己也写了：要得到一个能用的系统，还需要 shell、编译器和库，这些都不在发布包里。开发原则同样写得很直白：先让它跑起来。

0.12 版的发布说明宣布，许可改为 GNU copyleft，去掉“不得收费分发”的条件，但要等参与写代码的人同意。可见这时已经有别人一起写，不再是一个人的项目。GNU 一方的说法是，Torvalds 在 1992 年把 Linux 变成自由软件，正好填上了 GNU 系统最后一块大缺口。

后面几条历史线里都能看到它。2004 年的 MapReduce 论文描述 Google 的集群时写道，机器通常是运行 Linux 的双处理器 x86；2006 年公布的 CUDA 开发工具，也包含 Linux 和 Windows 两种驱动。
detail.en:
Three things are worth separating here. The kernel handles process scheduling, memory, and devices. Shells, compilers, and the C library run on top of it. A distribution packages a kernel and these tools so they can be installed and used. Version 0.01 was only the first; its release notes say a working system also needs a shell, compilers, and a library, none of which were included. They state the guiding rule just as plainly: get it working fast.

The 0.12 release notes announced that the license would change to the GNU copyleft, dropping the ban on distribution for a fee, pending approval from the people who had helped write code. Others were already contributing; it was no longer a one-person project. In the GNU project's account, Torvalds made Linux free software in 1992, filling the last major gap in the GNU system.

Linux shows up in several later histories. The 2004 MapReduce paper describes Google's cluster machines as typically dual-processor x86 machines running Linux, and the CUDA development tools announced in 2006 included drivers for Linux as well as Windows.

body.zh: 1994 年，MPI Forum 完成了 MPI 1.0，给并行程序一套共同的消息传递接口。它规定了点对点通信、集体操作，以及 C 和 Fortran 的绑定，程序不必再完全绑在某一家机器的通信接口上。
body.en: In 1994 the MPI Forum completed MPI 1.0, a common message-passing interface for parallel programs. Its point-to-point communication, collective operations, and C and Fortran bindings meant programs were less tied to any one machine's communication interface.

limit.zh: MPI 规定的是接口，不是统一的实现。早期标准不包括任务管理和 I/O。所引的 1995 年修订版明确写明，它的前一版是 1994 年的。
limit.en: MPI specifies interfaces, not one implementation; the early standard excluded task management and I/O, and the cited 1995 revision explicitly dates its predecessor to 1994.

sources: MPI Forum: MPI 1.1 (1995), foreword identifying MPI 1.0 (1994)
MPI Forum: early standard scope, included interfaces
MPI Forum: early standard scope, excluded facilities

body.zh: 2004 年，Dean 和 Ghemawat 发表 MapReduce 论文，把大规模数据处理写成映射和归约两类操作。数据划分、调度、通信和失败任务的重跑都由运行系统负责，应用作者就能少写重复的分布式协调代码。
body.en: In 2004, Dean and Ghemawat published MapReduce, which expresses large-scale data processing as map and reduce operations. The runtime takes care of partitioning, scheduling, communication, and rerunning failed tasks, so application authors write less repetitive distributed-coordination code.

limit.zh: 2004 年是论文发表的年份，论文里把第一版实现追溯到 2003 年 2 月。这种批处理模型也不能涵盖任意的交互式计算。
limit.en: 2004 dates the paper; it traces the first implementation to February 2003, and its batch model does not cover arbitrary interactive computation.

sources: Dean and Ghemawat: original OSDI 2004 paper, especially sections 1, 3 and 6

detail.zh: 用词频统计理解它最方便：map 为每个词发出一次计数，系统把相同词的记录汇在一起，reduce 再相加。分片、调度和失败重跑由运行系统负责；代价是计算要能表达成这种批处理流程。
detail.en: Word counting makes the division clear: map emits counts, the runtime groups records by word, and reduce adds them. Partitioning, scheduling, and retries belong to the runtime. The trade-off is that the computation must fit this batch-processing structure.

title.zh: 仓库级计算 · 机房也是系统
title.en: Warehouse-scale computing · the facility as a system

body.zh: 机房不只是把服务器放在一起。2009 年，Barroso 和 Hölzle 把整个数据中心视为一台计算机：服务器、网络、供电和冷却，需要一起设计。
body.en: A datacenter is more than a collection of servers. Barroso and Hölzle’s 2009 monograph treated it as one computer, bringing servers, networking, power, and cooling into the same design.

limit.zh: 2009 年是这本专著出版的年份，不是数据中心或冷却技术的起点。书里那种一体化的服务模型，也不能代表所有托管机房。
limit.en: 2009 dates the book, not the invention of datacenters or cooling; its integrated-service model does not describe every colocation facility.

sources: Barroso and Hölzle: original 2009 monograph, chapters 1, 4–6 (PDF mirror)

detail.zh: 放到今天的训练任务里想：加一批 GPU，除了买卡，还得确认机柜的供电、冷却和网络扛不扛得住。只要有一项没跟上，新卡就未必能发挥预期的能力。这个例子用来说明书里的整体设计视角，不是书里报告的 GPU 实验。
detail.en: For a present-day illustration, adding GPUs also requires checking rack power, cooling, and networking. If one cannot support the expansion, the new devices may not deliver the expected capacity. This illustrates the book's whole-facility perspective; it is not a GPU experiment reported in the book.

body.zh: 2015 年 7 月 21 日，Kubernetes 宣布推出 1.0 版，让跨主机运行的容器应用有了一套共同的管理系统。调度、扩缩容、服务发现和健康检查，把原本分散的运维工作集中到集群这一层，不用再一台台地管理应用。
body.en: On July 21, 2015, Kubernetes announced version 1.0, a common system for managing container applications across hosts. Scheduling, scaling, service discovery, and health checks pulled scattered operations work up to the cluster level, leaving less to manage machine by machine.

limit.zh: 2015 年是 1.0 发布的年份，项目在 2014 年 6 月就已公开。编排只是容器工具链的一部分，和底层计算资源也是两回事。
limit.en: 2015 is the 1.0 launch; the project had gone public in June 2014. Orchestration is only part of the container toolchain, and it is not the compute resources underneath.

sources: Google: original Kubernetes v1 announcement, July 21, 2015
Joe Beda: dated project history distinguishing June 6 commit and June 10, 2014 announcement

title.zh: 单晶体管 DRAM 存储单元

body.zh: Dennard 的专利用一个晶体管控制一个电容的充放电，电容里的电荷就表示一位信息。每个单元用的器件少了，同样一颗芯片就能放下更密的存储阵列。
body.en: Dennard's patent describes a cell in which one transistor controls a capacitor whose charge represents a bit. Fewer components per cell means denser memory arrays on a chip.

limit.zh: 1967 年指的是 7 月 14 日提交申请，专利到 1968 年 6 月 4 日才获授权。电荷会泄漏，所以要定期刷新。
limit.en: The year marks the filing on July 14, 1967, not the patent grant on June 4, 1968. Because the charge leaks away, the cell has to be refreshed periodically.

sources: Dennard, US3387286A: filing, abstract and claims

body.zh: Model 85 用一块小而快的缓存，存放主存里正在用的内容，让处理器少等慢速存储。装入和替换数据都由硬件自动完成，程序不用自己管这一层。
body.en: The Model 85 keeps the main-memory contents in active use in a small, fast cache, so the processor spends less time waiting on slower storage. Hardware loads and replaces the data on its own; programs do not have to manage this layer.

limit.zh: 1968 年是 Liptay 论文发表的年份，不是缓存这个想法出现的年份。缓存没命中时，还是得去访问主存。
limit.en: 1968 dates Liptay's paper, not the invention of caching; a miss still requires access to main memory.

sources: Liptay, IBM Systems Journal 7(1), 1968, pp. 15–21; original paper scan

body.zh: Intel 4004 把四位运算器、寄存器和执行程序的功能集成进一颗 CPU 芯片。接上外部的程序存储器，同一颗处理器换不同的程序，就能用在各种控制设备里。
body.en: Intel's 4004 integrates four-bit arithmetic, registers and program execution into one CPU chip. With external program memory, the same processor can serve different control devices by running different programs.

limit.zh: 1971 年 11 月 15 日是产品公开发布公告的日期。程序还得放在外部 ROM 里，所以它不是一台完整的单芯片计算机。
limit.en: November 15, 1971 is the date of the public product announcement. Programs still lived in external ROM, so it was not a complete single-chip computer.

sources: Intel MCS-4 announcement, 1971-11-15; original advertisement archive

title.zh: CUDA · 不用假装画图，也能让 GPU 计算
title.en: CUDA · GPU computing without pretending to draw

body.zh: GPU 本来是用来画图的。2000 年代初，已经有人用它的可编程着色器做线性代数、物理模拟和光线追踪，但只能借道图形接口：数据要打包成纹理，计算写成着色程序，再靠“画”一组几何图形来触发。程序能从显存任意位置读数据，却不能往任意位置写，带宽也常常不够用，基本只有熟悉图形编程的人才用得起来。2006 年 11 月，NVIDIA 随 GeForce 8800 公布 CUDA：用扩展过的 C 语言直接写 GPU 程序，大量线程分组运行，同组线程能通过片上的共享内存交换数据，显存也能像在 CPU 上一样任意读写。
body.en: GPUs were built to draw pictures. By the early 2000s, people were already using their programmable shaders for linear algebra, physics simulation, and ray tracing, but only by going through graphics interfaces. Data had to be packed into textures, computation written as shader programs, and work launched by “drawing” geometry. Programs could read from anywhere in GPU memory but could not write to arbitrary locations, bandwidth was often a bottleneck, and in practice only experienced graphics programmers could do it. In November 2006, NVIDIA announced CUDA alongside the GeForce 8800. GPU programs could be written in an extended C, large numbers of threads ran in groups, threads in a group shared data through on-chip shared memory, and GPU memory could be read and written anywhere, as on a CPU.

limit.zh: CUDA 当时只支持 NVIDIA 自家的 GeForce 8 系列、Quadro 和 Tesla 产品，写好的程序不能直接搬到别家的 GPU 上。发布材料里“比 CPU 快 100 倍”之类的说法是厂商宣传，实际快多少取决于问题和写法。日期：2006 年 11 月 8 日随 GeForce 8800 公布，SDK 先提供给注册开发者；公开测试版公告是 2007 年 2 月 16 日，1.0 版编程手册的日期是 2007 年 6 月 23 日。
limit.en: CUDA then ran only on NVIDIA's own GeForce 8 Series, Quadro, and Tesla products, so programs could not simply move to another vendor's GPUs. Launch claims such as “100× faster than CPUs” were marketing; real speedups depend on the problem and the code. Dates: CUDA was announced with the GeForce 8800 on November 8, 2006, with SDK access for registered developers; the public beta was announced on February 16, 2007, and the version 1.0 programming guide is dated June 23, 2007.

sources: Buck et al. · Brook for GPUs, SIGGRAPH 2004, §§1–2 on programming through graphics APIs
NVIDIA CUDA Programming Guide 1.0, 2007-06-23, §§1.1–1.2 and Appendix A

detail.zh:
拿最简单的向量相加 c = a + b 来比较。走图形接口时，要把 a 和 b 各装进一张纹理，写一个读两个纹素再相加的着色程序，设置一块和数组一样大的渲染目标，画一个铺满它的矩形，最后把结果从“画面”里读回来。用 CUDA 时，写一个核函数，让每个线程按自己的编号 i 算一次 c[i] = a[i] + b[i]，启动时告诉它要开多少个线程。算法没变，变的是程序员不用再把计算翻译成画图。

第一版的共享内存每个多处理器只有 16KB。想跑得快，程序员得自己把数据分块搬进来、安排线程怎样访问内存，这些细节和具体硬件密切相关。CUDA 1.0 的工具包里还带了 CUBLAS 和 CUFFT 两个数学库。

后来的深度学习训练也走上了这条路。2012 年 AlexNet 的作者自己写了 GPU 卷积代码 cuda-convnet；2014 年 NVIDIA 发表 cuDNN，理由是深度学习当时还没有像 BLAS 那样的标准运算库，把它接入 Caffe 后，一个标准模型快了 36%，内存也用得更少。
detail.en:
Compare the simplest case, vector addition c = a + b. Through a graphics interface, you load a and b into two textures, write a shader that reads two texels and adds them, set up a render target the size of the array, draw a rectangle that covers it, and read the result back from the “image”. With CUDA, you write a kernel in which each thread uses its index i to compute c[i] = a[i] + b[i], then launch as many threads as there are elements. The algorithm is the same; the programmer no longer has to translate it into drawing.

The first version gave each multiprocessor only 16KB of shared memory. Fast code meant staging data in blocks and arranging how threads accessed memory, details tied closely to the hardware. The CUDA 1.0 toolkit also shipped two math libraries, CUBLAS and CUFFT.

Deep learning training later took the same road. The AlexNet authors wrote their own GPU convolution code, cuda-convnet, in 2012. In 2014 NVIDIA presented cuDNN, arguing that deep learning still lacked a standard library like BLAS; plugged into Caffe, it made one standard model 36% faster while using less memory.

title.zh: AMD GCN：兼顾图形与通用计算
title.en: AMD Graphics Core Next: graphics and general-purpose computation

body.zh: AMD 的 GCN 用计算单元取代了之前的 VLIW 执行结构，每个计算单元里有标量单元和向量 SIMD 单元。这样就不那么依赖编译器去挖掘指令级并行，图形和通用计算都能兼顾。
body.en: AMD's GCN replaced its earlier VLIW design with compute units containing scalar units and vector SIMD units. That made it less dependent on the compiler finding instruction-level parallelism, while serving both graphics and general-purpose computation.

limit.zh: HD 7970 于 2011 年 12 月 22 日公布，零售定于 2012 年 1 月 9 日；所引白皮书发表于 2012 年 6 月。
limit.en: The HD 7970 announcement was December 22, 2011, with retail availability set for January 9, 2012; the cited whitepaper is dated June 2012.

sources: AMD GCN whitepaper, June 2012, pp. 3–6; CMU mirror

title.zh: HBM 进入 GPU 封装

body.zh: AMD 的 Fury X 用上 HBM，把堆叠 DRAM 带进了 GPU 产品。存储层之间用硅通孔相连，再通过中介层接到处理器上。带宽靠的是宽接口和短连线，而不只是把引脚速率提上去。
body.en: AMD's Fury X put stacked HBM DRAM into a GPU product. Through-silicon vias connect the memory layers, and an interposer links them to the processor. Bandwidth comes from wide interfaces and short connections, not just faster pins.

limit.zh: 2015 年指 6 月 16 日的产品公告，公告原文计划 6 月 24 日开始供货。HBM 不是这一年发明的。
limit.en: The year marks the June 16, 2015 product announcement, which set availability for June 24. HBM itself was not invented that year.

sources: SK hynix, Hot Chips 26, August 2014, slides 4–10

title.zh: Volta：Tensor Core 矩阵计算单元
title.en: Volta: Tensor Cores for matrix computation

body.zh: Volta V100 加入了 Tensor Core，用专门的单元做矩阵乘加。输入用 FP16，累加用 FP32，深度学习里的密集矩阵运算就有了一条混合精度的硬件路径。
body.en: Volta's V100 introduced Tensor Cores, units dedicated to matrix multiply-accumulate. With FP16 inputs and FP32 accumulation, they give dense matrix math in deep learning a mixed-precision path in hardware.

limit.zh: 架构和产品在 2017 年 5 月 10 日公布，这里引用的白皮书是 8 月的修订版。这一代 Tensor Core 不做 FP64 矩阵乘法。
limit.en: The architecture and product were announced on May 10, 2017; the whitepaper cited here is the August revision. This generation of Tensor Cores does not do FP64 matrix multiplication.

sources: NVIDIA V100 whitepaper v1.1, August 2017, pp. 14–16

detail.zh: 可以把它看成：通用计算单元旁边，多了一组专做矩阵乘加的硬件。神经网络里合适的运算能用上它，但数据照样要搬进搬出，其他算子也照样要跑，所以不能拿矩阵峰值直接推算整个程序有多快。
detail.en: Think of it as extra hardware, next to the general-purpose units, that does nothing but matrix multiply–accumulate. Suitable neural-network operations can use it, but data still has to move in and out and other operations still have to run, so peak matrix throughput does not tell you how fast a whole program will be.

title.zh: RDNA：重新组织图形计算单元

body.zh: RDNA 随 Radeon RX 5700 系列上市，重点是游戏图形的效率。它引入原生的 32 线程波前和 32 通道 SIMD，并重新设计了缓存层次，减少执行和访存的开销。
body.en: RDNA arrived with the Radeon RX 5700 series, aimed at efficient gaming graphics. It introduced native 32-thread wavefronts and 32-lane SIMD units and redesigned the cache hierarchy to cut execution and data-access overhead.

limit.zh: 2019 年 7 月 7 日是产品上市日。RDNA 照样支持通用计算，并不是只能画图。
limit.en: July 7, 2019 is the product-availability date; RDNA still supports general-purpose computation and is not graphics-only.

sources: AMD RDNA whitepaper, 2019, pp. 4–5 and 12–16; original PDF mirror

title.zh: Ampere A100：扩展矩阵精度与 GPU 分区
title.en: Ampere A100: broader matrix formats and GPU partitioning

body.zh: Ampere A100 的 Tensor Core 新增了 TF32、BF16 和 FP64，AI 和科学计算能用上的矩阵加速范围更广了。MIG 能把一颗 A100 切成最多七个独立实例，让不同任务共用一块硬件。
body.en: Ampere's A100 adds TF32, BF16 and FP64 Tensor Core support, broadening matrix acceleration for AI and scientific computing. MIG partitions one A100 into up to seven independent instances for separate workloads.

limit.zh: 2020 年 5 月 14 日的公告确认 A100 已经量产出货。TF32 保留了 FP32 的指数范围，尾数精度则更低。
limit.en: The May 14, 2020 release confirms A100 production and shipment; TF32 retains FP32's exponent range but uses lower mantissa precision.

sources: NVIDIA A100 architecture whitepaper, Tensor Core formats and MIG

body.zh: AMD 用 MI100 推出面向高性能计算和 AI 的 CDNA，和侧重图形的 RDNA 分成两条线。CDNA 在源自 GCN 的标量和向量单元旁边，加上了专做混合精度矩阵乘加的矩阵核心。
body.en: With MI100, AMD set up CDNA for HPC and AI as a line separate from the graphics-oriented RDNA. CDNA adds matrix cores for mixed-precision matrix multiply-accumulate next to its GCN-derived scalar and vector units.

limit.zh: 这里按 MI100 在 2020 年 11 月 16 日的发布来定年份。它去掉了光栅化和显示硬件，不是游戏显卡。
limit.en: Dated by the MI100 launch on November 16, 2020. MI100 drops rasterization and display hardware; it is not a gaming graphics card.

title.zh: Hopper：面向 Transformer 与多 GPU 扩展
title.en: Hopper: Transformer acceleration and multi-GPU scaling

body.zh: Hopper H100 加入了 Transformer Engine 和 FP8 计算，把加速 Transformer 模型明确定为架构目标。第四代 NVLink 加上外部交换系统，让高速 GPU 互连扩展到多台服务器。
body.en: Hopper's H100 adds a Transformer Engine and FP8 computation, making Transformer acceleration an explicit architectural focus. Fourth-generation NVLink and an external switch system extend high-speed GPU interconnection across multiple servers.

limit.zh: 架构公布于 2022 年 3 月 22 日；9 月 20 日才宣布全面量产，首批合作伙伴产品计划 10 月推出。
limit.en: The architecture announcement was March 22, 2022; full production was announced September 20, with initial partner offerings planned for October.

title.zh: CDNA 3 与 MI300：封装级异构集成
title.en: CDNA 3 and MI300: package-level heterogeneous integration

body.zh: MI300 系列把 CDNA 3、3D 封装和 HBM3 结合在一起，面向 AI 和科学计算。MI300A 在一个封装里放进 Zen 4 CPU 和 GPU，靠共享内存简化异构编程；MI300X 则不带 CPU。
body.en: The MI300 family combines CDNA 3, 3D packaging and HBM3 for AI and scientific computing. MI300A puts Zen 4 CPUs and GPUs in one package with shared memory, simplifying heterogeneous programming; MI300X has no integrated CPUs.

limit.zh: 这里按 2023 年 12 月 6 日开始供货的公告定年份。当时部分整机仍计划在 2024 年上市，并不是同时交付。
limit.en: Dated by the December 6, 2023 availability announcement. Some complete systems were still scheduled for 2024, so not everything was delivered at once.

title.zh: 图灵机 · 什么问题可以计算？
title.en: Turing machines · what can be computed?

body.zh: 用读写符号加上有限条规则，图灵给计算过程下了一个精确的定义。通用机器能模拟其他机器，但不是每个数学问题都有算法可解。
body.en: Turing pinned down what computation means using symbols that are read and written under a finite set of rules. A universal machine can simulate other machines, but not every mathematical problem can be solved by an algorithm.

limit.zh: 这里讲的是能不能算，不是算得多快。1936 年是论文收稿和宣读的年份，期刊出版记录写的是 1937 年。
limit.en: This is about what can be computed, not how fast. 1936 is when the paper was received and presented; the journal's publication record gives 1937.

title.zh: Dijkstra · 最短路也有计算顺序

body.zh: 每一步从还没处理的节点里挑出距离最短的那个定下来，再更新它的邻居，这样就不用把所有可能的路径都列一遍。另外要分清：图算法和从图中学习，是两类不同的问题。
body.en: At each step, settle the closest vertex not yet settled and update its neighbors; there is no need to enumerate every possible path. This is a graph algorithm, which is a different problem from learning representations of graphs.

limit.zh: 这个做法要求边权非负。1959 年的论文里还讨论了最小生成树，那是另一个问题，不能和最短路混在一起。
limit.en: The procedure requires nonnegative edge weights. The 1959 paper also discusses minimum spanning trees, a separate problem.

sources: Dijkstra · A Note on Two Problems in Connexion with Graphs (1959)

title.zh: ImageNet · 大规模图像数据集

body.zh: 这个数据集按 WordNet 的概念层次收集图像，再由人工核验候选图片。规模大不只是多下载些文件，背后还有类别设计、检索、标注和质量检查。
body.en: ImageNet organizes images by WordNet concepts and has people verify the collected candidates. Getting to that scale took category design, retrieval, annotation, and quality checks, not just downloading files.

limit.zh: 2009 年是数据集论文的年份。完整的 ImageNet 和后来 ILSVRC 竞赛用的子集不是一回事。
limit.en: 2009 dates the dataset paper. The full ImageNet collection is not the same as the later ILSVRC competition subsets.

title.zh: Datasheets · 数据也要有说明书

body.zh: 写清楚数据为什么收集、怎么标注、适合哪些用途、之后由谁维护。这样用的人就不必只凭文件名和一行下载说明，去猜这份数据能用在哪、不能用在哪。
body.en: Write down why the data was collected, how it was annotated, what uses it supports, and who maintains it, so users do not have to guess a dataset's limits from its filename and download link.

limit.zh: 2018 年首次公开，2021 年正式发表。说明书让人有据可查，但并不能证明数据就是公平、准确或适用的。
limit.en: First public in 2018 and published in 2021. Documentation supports scrutiny; it does not certify fairness, accuracy, or fitness for use.

sources: Gebru et al. · Datasheets for Datasets

title.zh: Model Cards · 发布模型时交代使用边界
title.en: Model Cards · reporting intended uses and limits

body.zh: 模型说明不能只给一个总分，还要写清用途、评估条件、在不同群体上的表现和已知限制。这样开发者、使用者和受影响的人，才能判断这个模型适不适合眼前的场景。
body.en: Model reports should include intended uses, evaluation conditions, disaggregated performance, and known limits, not just one aggregate score. Developers, users, and the people affected need that context to judge whether a model fits their situation.

limit.zh: 预印本发表于 2018 年，会议论文在 2019 年。填好一张卡片不等于做完了安全审计，也替代不了独立评估。
limit.en: The preprint appeared in 2018; the conference paper followed in 2019. A completed card is not a safety audit or a substitute for independent evaluation.

sources: Mitchell et al. · Model Cards for Model Reporting

title.zh: MMLU · 把评估扩展到多个学科

body.zh: 用 57 个学科的选择题，考模型在预训练中学到了多少知识，不再只看单一的语言任务。按学科拆开的成绩，还能暴露被总分盖住的短板。
body.en: Multiple-choice questions across 57 subjects probe knowledge acquired during pretraining, beyond a single language task. Subject-level results expose weaknesses hidden by an aggregate score.

limit.zh: 预印本在 2020 年，会议论文在 2021 年。选择题成绩代替不了对开放式生成、工具使用或真实部署的评估。
limit.en: The preprint dates to 2020 and the conference paper to 2021. Multiple-choice performance does not replace evaluation of open-ended generation, tool use, or deployment.

sources: Hendrycks et al. · Measuring Massive Multitask Language Understanding

title.zh: 晶体管 · 用半导体放大信号

body.zh: 1947 年，贝尔实验室做出点接触晶体管，用半导体器件放大电信号。当时要解决的是电话系统对可靠器件的需要，不是训练神经网络。
body.en: In 1947 Bell Labs demonstrated a point-contact transistor, which amplified electrical signals with a semiconductor device. The goal was reliable components for the telephone system, not training neural networks.

limit.zh: 1947 年是实验器件做出来的年份，Bardeen 和 Brattain 的论文 1948 年才发表。点接触器件和今天芯片里的 MOS 晶体管也不是一回事。
limit.en: 1947 dates the experimental device; Bardeen and Brattain's paper came out in 1948. A point-contact device is also not the same as the MOS transistors in today's chips.

sources: Bardeen & Brattain · Physical Review 74, 230 (1948), publication record

title.zh: 关系模型 · 数据含义与存放方式分开
title.en: The relational model · separating data from storage layout

body.zh: 1970 年 6 月，Codd 在论文里用“关系”来描述共享数据，主张应用不该依赖记录的物理顺序、索引或访问路径。所谓数据独立性，就是存储的组织方式变了，应用尽量不用跟着重写。
body.en: Codd's June 1970 paper described shared data in terms of relations and argued that applications should not depend on the physical order of records, indexes, or access paths. Data independence means that when storage is reorganized, applications should need as little rewriting as possible.

detail.zh: 和机器学习的一个具体交集，是 2012 年的 MADlib：它在 PostgreSQL 和 Greenplum 里面实现了回归、聚类等方法，让计算就在数据库里的数据旁边进行。这是后来数据库参与学习计算的一个例子，并不说明 Codd 当年在设计 AI 训练系统。
detail.en: A concrete later link to machine learning is MADlib: its 2012 paper implemented regression and clustering inside PostgreSQL and Greenplum. That is an example of learning inside a database, not evidence that Codd was designing an AI training system.

limit.zh: 1970 年标的是这篇论文，不是 SQL 或哪个数据库产品的发布。关系模型本身也没有规定分布式事务、物理执行计划或数据质量。
limit.en: 1970 dates the paper, not a SQL or database product release. The relational model alone does not specify distributed transactions, physical execution plans, or data quality.

sources: Codd · CACM, June 1970, original paper (university-hosted copy)
Hellerstein et al. · MADlib, PVLDB 2012, sections 3–4

title.zh: LLVM · 可复用的编译中间层

body.zh: 2004 年的 LLVM 论文介绍了一种带类型、采用静态单赋值形式的低层中间表示，以及围绕它搭起来的编译框架。程序在编译、链接、运行等阶段都能被分析和变换，优化也不必绑定在某一种源语言上。
body.en: The 2004 LLVM paper described a typed, low-level intermediate representation in static single-assignment form. Its compiler framework supported analysis and transformations at compilation, linking, and runtime without tying every optimization to one source language.

detail.zh: 2018 年 TVM 论文的系统图里，有一条经由 LLVM IR 的代码生成路径，同时把神经网络计算图和低层指令表示分开。AI 编译器可以复用通用工具，但张量布局、算子融合和硬件调度还是得专门处理。
detail.en: TVM's 2018 system diagram includes an LLVM IR code-generation path while distinguishing neural-network graphs from low-level instructions. AI compilers can reuse general infrastructure, but tensor layouts, operator fusion, and hardware scheduling still require specialized work.

limit.zh: 2004 年是 CGO 论文的年份，LLVM 1.0 在 2003 年就已公布。低层中间表示不是完整的模型编译器，光靠它也保证不了性能。
limit.en: 2004 dates the CGO paper; LLVM 1.0 was announced in 2003. A low-level IR is not a complete model compiler and does not guarantee performance by itself.

sources: Lattner & Adve · LLVM, CGO 2004, original paper
LLVM · project archive, November 18, 2003 release entry
Chen et al. · TVM, OSDI 2018, figure 2 and sections 3–4

title.zh: RDMAP · 远端内存读写的协议边界

body.zh: 2007 年 10 月发布的 RFC 5040 定义了 RDMAP：在保留内存保护语义的前提下，读写对端公布出来的缓冲区。它建立在直接数据放置协议 DDP 之上，目的是减少通信时的数据复制和 CPU 开销，不是让程序随意访问远端内存。
body.en: RFC 5040, published in October 2007, specifies RDMAP: reads and writes to buffers the remote side has advertised, with memory protection preserved. Built on Direct Data Placement, it aims to cut copying and CPU overhead, not to allow unrestricted access to remote memory.

detail.zh: 据 2016 年的 TensorFlow 系统论文，任务之间的通信支持 gRPC/TCP 和 RoCE。可见 RDMA 技术确实用进了机器学习系统；但 RoCE 走的是另一条协议路线，不能因此说 TensorFlow 用的是 RFC 5040 的 RDMAP。
detail.en: The 2016 TensorFlow system paper reported gRPC/TCP and RoCE for inter-task communication. That documents RDMA in a machine-learning system, but RoCE is a different protocol path: it does not establish TensorFlow's use of RFC 5040 RDMAP.

limit.zh: 这里标年的是一份协议标准，不是 RDMA 的发明，也不是 InfiniBand 或 RoCE 的起点。复制少了，通信、同步和缓冲区管理的成本也还在。
limit.en: This dates a protocol specification, not the invention of RDMA or the origins of InfiniBand and RoCE. Fewer copies do not eliminate communication, synchronization, or buffer-management costs.

sources: Recio et al. · RFC 5040, October 2007, sections 1–3
Abadi et al. · TensorFlow, OSDI 2016, section 5

title.zh: 能耗比例性 · 少做事时也要少耗电
title.en: Energy proportionality · power should follow work

body.zh: 服务器没干多少活，也可能一直耗电。2007 年，Barroso 和 Hölzle 提出：负载降下来时，整台服务器的功耗也应该跟着降，而不只是提高满载时的能效。
body.en: An almost-idle server can still draw substantial power. In 2007, Barroso and Hölzle argued that power use should fall with the workload across the whole server—not just become more efficient at full load.

detail.zh: 2017 年的 TPU 研究专门测了不同负载下的功耗，并把算上主机和不算主机的两种口径分开统计。AI 加速器满载时每瓦能算多少，和服务闲下来时能不能省电，是两回事。
detail.en: The 2017 TPU study measured power across offered loads and distinguished totals including the host from incremental accelerator power. High full-load performance per watt and low power during quiet service periods are different properties.

limit.zh: 这是 2007 年的设计主张，不是已经实现的行业定律。后来的 PowerNap 走了另一条节能路线；旧服务器或 TPU 的测量结果，也不能直接套到今天的设备上。
limit.en: This was a 2007 design goal, not an achieved industry-wide law. PowerNap later explored a different energy-saving approach; measurements of old servers or TPUs do not automatically describe today's devices.

sources: Barroso & Hölzle · IEEE Computer, December 2007, original article
Meisner, Gold & Wenisch · PowerNap, ASPLOS 2009, independent follow-up
Jouppi et al. · TPU study, April 2017 v1, sections 5–6

title.zh: Roofline · 算得快，还得供得上数据
title.en: Roofline · compute speed meets memory bandwidth

body.zh: 2008 年 Berkeley 的一份技术报告，用 Roofline 模型把多核处理器的计算上限、内存带宽和运算强度放在一起看。运算强度是指每从 DRAM 读写一个字节，能完成多少运算。同一颗 CPU 跑不同的程序，可能卡在计算上，也可能卡在数据供给上。
body.en: A 2008 Berkeley report used Roofline to relate multicore compute capacity, memory bandwidth, and operational intensity: operations per byte transferred to or from DRAM. Different programs on the same CPU can be limited by arithmetic or by data supply.

detail.zh: 基本的上限，就是计算峰值和“带宽 × 运算强度”两者中较小的那个。2017 年的 TPU 论文明确改造了这个模型，用来比较神经网络在 CPU、GPU 和 TPU 上的瓶颈，并针对量化计算调整了运算和字节的计算口径。
detail.en: The basic bound is the smaller of peak computation and bandwidth times operational intensity. The 2017 TPU paper explicitly adapted this model for neural-network workloads on CPUs, GPUs, and TPUs, adjusting the operation and byte counts for quantized computation.

limit.zh: 2008 年是技术报告公开的年份，期刊文章 2009 年才发表；这也不是多核 CPU 诞生的年份。Roofline 给的是上限，不保证实际能跑多快；延迟、依赖和并行度都还会限制性能。
limit.en: 2008 dates the public report; the journal article appeared in 2009. It does not date the birth of multicore CPUs. Roofline gives bounds, not guaranteed throughput; latency, dependencies, and available parallelism still matter.

sources: Williams, Waterman & Patterson · UCB/EECS-2008-134, original report
Berkeley Lab · publication list, April 2009 journal article
Jouppi et al. · TPU study, April 2017 v1, section 4

title.zh: HDFS · 大文件怎样跨机器保存
title.en: HDFS · storing large files across machines

body.zh: 2010 年的 HDFS 论文描述了大规模文件存储的分工：NameNode 管目录和块位置，DataNode 保存数据块，多副本用来应对机器故障。存储和计算放在同一批服务器上，任务也就能在靠近数据的地方运行。
body.en: The 2010 HDFS paper separated namespace and block-location management in the NameNode from block storage in DataNodes. Replicas helped tolerate failures, while colocated storage and computation allowed tasks to run near their data.

detail.zh: 2012 年 Spark 的 RDD 论文做逻辑回归和 k-means 实验时，先从 HDFS 读入初始数据，之后在迭代之间复用内存里的数据。可见可靠存储和训练时的内存复用分属不同的层，不能把分布式文件系统当成 GPU 显存或模型缓存。
detail.en: In the 2012 Spark RDD experiments, logistic regression and k-means read initial input from HDFS and reused data in memory across iterations. Durable storage and in-memory reuse serve different roles; a distributed file system is not GPU memory or a model cache.

limit.zh: 2010 年是 MSST 论文的年份，不是 HDFS 项目开始的年份。论文采用单写者、多读者的模型，这种为大文件吞吐设计的方案，替代不了关系数据库的事务语义。
limit.en: 2010 dates the MSST paper, not the project's start. Its single-writer, multiple-reader model targets large-file throughput rather than providing relational database transaction semantics.

sources: Shvachko et al. · HDFS, MSST 2010, original paper, sections II–III
Shvachko · author publication list, May 2010 entry
Zaharia et al. · RDDs, NSDI 2012, section 6.1

title.zh: HMM · 从声音推测隐藏状态
title.en: HMM · inferring hidden states from observations

body.zh: 语音长短不一，也有各种变化，不能把每一帧声音拆开来单独分类。Rabiner 1989 年的教程系统介绍了 HMM：隐藏状态按概率相互转移，每个状态产生声音特征之类的观测；有了整段观测，就能反推背后可能的过程。
body.en: Speech varies in length and form, so classifying each frame on its own misses the structure of the sequence. Rabiner's 1989 tutorial gave a systematic account of HMMs: hidden states change according to transition probabilities and produce observations, from which the underlying sequence can be inferred.

detail.zh: 三个问题要分清：这段观测有多大可能、哪条状态路径最可能、参数怎样从数据中学习。它们分别需要求和、找最优路径和参数估计，不是同一道题的不同叫法。
detail.en: Keep three problems apart: how likely an observation sequence is, which state path is most likely, and how to learn the parameters from data. Summing over paths, picking one path, and estimating parameters are different operations, not three names for the same task.

limit.zh: 1989 年是教程发表的年份，不是 HMM 或它在语音上的应用出现的年份。基本模型的 Markov 假设和条件独立假设让计算变简单，也限制了它能表达的依赖关系。
limit.en: 1989 dates the tutorial, not the arrival of HMMs or their first use in speech. The basic model's Markov and conditional-independence assumptions make computation easier but limit the dependencies it can express.

sources: Rabiner · HMM tutorial, IEEE 1989, sections II–III
CMU AI Repository · HMM speech implementation, 1994 release

title.zh: LeNet-5 · 让识别器自己学特征

body.zh: 手写数字的写法和位置都不固定。1998 年那篇文档识别论文用 LeNet-5 展示了卷积、权重共享和下采样怎样配合，参数靠梯度学出来，不用把识别规则全部手写。
body.en: Handwritten digits vary in shape and position. The 1998 document-recognition paper used LeNet-5 to show convolution, shared weights, and subsampling working together, with parameters learned through gradients instead of writing every recognition rule by hand.

detail.zh: 权重共享的意思是：同一组局部检测器在图像的每个位置都用，不用每个位置各学一套。后面的层再把这些局部特征组合起来。想弄懂 CNN 为什么适合图像，这是一个很具体的入口。
detail.en: Weight sharing means using the same local detectors everywhere in an image instead of learning a separate set for each position. Later layers combine those local features. This is a concrete entry point for understanding CNNs.

limit.zh: 1998 年是这篇论文的年份，CNN 不是从这一年开始的。LeNet-5 的下采样和输出层，也不能直接当成今天常见的 max pooling 加 softmax。
limit.en: 1998 dates this paper, not the origin of CNNs. Its subsampling and output layers are not today's familiar max pooling and softmax, and should not be read as if they were.

sources: LeCun et al. · Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition, 1998

title.zh: Google 原型 · 搜索不只是一条排序公式
title.en: Google prototype · beyond a ranking formula

body.zh: 1998 年的 Google 原型论文把抓取、存储、索引和排序放在同一个系统里讲。PageRank 利用网页链接关系，anchor text 则借用其他页面对目标的描述；排序不只看关键词出现几次。
body.en: The 1998 Google prototype paper described crawling, storage, indexing, and ranking as one system. PageRank used link structure, while anchor text supplied descriptions from other pages. Ranking went beyond counting query terms.

detail.zh: 链接数量相同，分数也未必一样：链接来自哪些页面、这些页面有多少出链都会影响传播的权重。它仍只是排序的一部分，不能替代文本匹配与索引。
detail.en: Two pages with the same number of incoming links need not score the same: which pages the links come from, and how many outgoing links those pages have, change how much weight passes along. It is still only one ranking signal, not a substitute for text matching or indexing.

limit.zh: 这里记录的是当时的原型，不是今天 Google 的内部架构。链接重要性也不等于事实正确，更不保证每次查询都相关。
limit.en: This is the historical prototype, not today's internal Google architecture. Link-based importance does not establish truth or relevance to every query.

sources: Brin & Page · The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine, 1998

title.zh: word2vec · 用上下文学词向量
title.en: word2vec · learning word vectors from context

body.zh: word2vec 的关键选择是把训练任务做简单，好高效地用上大量文本。CBOW 用周围的词猜中间的词；Skip-gram 反过来，用当前词猜附近的词。
body.en: word2vec simplified the prediction task to learn word vectors efficiently from large text collections. CBOW predicts a word from its surrounding words; Skip-gram predicts nearby words from the current one.

detail.zh: 一个词在不同上下文里反复出现，训练就不断调整它在词表里的那个向量。但查这个向量时，它不会因为当前句子不同而改变；这一点和后来模型的上下文化表示不同。
detail.en: Each time a word appears in a new context, training nudges its vector. But looking the vector up does not adapt it to the current sentence, unlike the contextual representations of later models.

limit.zh: 词向量在 2013 年以前就有。这里按 1 月的初稿介绍 CBOW 和 Skip-gram；后来关于 negative sampling 的工作，不算在这篇初稿头上。
limit.en: Word vectors predate 2013. CBOW and Skip-gram are described here from the January version; later work on negative sampling is not credited to that first paper.

sources: Mikolov et al. · Efficient Estimation of Word Representations, January 2013 v1

body.zh: 1997 年 7 月 4 日，Sojourner 随 Pathfinder 在火星着陆。它按照地面给的目标，结合对地形和自身位置的感知，自己绕开障碍；传感器、移动和通信都接在有限的机载计算上。
body.en: Sojourner landed with Pathfinder on July 4, 1997. Its navigation combined goals commanded from the ground with sensing of terrain and position, and its mobility and communication all ran on limited onboard computing.

limit.zh: 自主导航不等于 RL。资料里记的是导航行为和地面配合，不是强化学习训练。
limit.en: Autonomy is not RL: these sources describe navigation behaviors and ground support, not reinforcement-learning training.

sources: JPL Robotics · Sojourner software and electronics
JPL mission archive · rover description and navigation subsystem

title.zh: IBM 翻译模型 · 从双语句对里学词的对应
title.en: IBM translation models · learning word correspondences from paired sentences

body.zh: 按人的直觉，翻译是先读懂原文，再用另一种语言说出来，很多机器翻译系统也是照这个思路搭的。IBM 的四位作者换了个问法：看到一句法语，哪句英语最可能是它的“原文”？用贝叶斯公式拆开，就是两件事：语言模型管英语通不通顺，翻译模型管词和词怎么对应。翻译模型不靠人写规则，而是用 EM 算法从加拿大议会记录的约 178 万对英法句子里估计出来。论文给出 Model 1 到 Model 5，一个比一个细。
body.en: The intuitive picture of translation is to understand the source and then say it in another language, and many machine translation systems were built along those lines. The four IBM authors asked a different question: given a French sentence, which English sentence most likely produced it? Bayes' rule splits that into two jobs. A language model judges whether the English reads well, and a translation model says how words correspond. The translation model was not written as rules. Its parameters were estimated with the EM algorithm from about 1.78 million English–French sentence pairs taken from the Canadian parliamentary record. The paper presents five models, Model 1 through Model 5, each more detailed than the last.

detail.zh:
论文里有个好懂的例子。法语 Il me semble faire signe que oui，英语是 It seems to me that he is nodding。Model 1 到 3 只把 nodding 连到 signe 和 oui 两个词，到了 Model 5，它连上了整个短语 faire signe que oui。也有变差的地方：Model 1 把 Il 连到 he，这是对的；后面的模型嫌这两个词隔得太远，改连到 It。作者直说，模型的语言学知识还不够处理这种情况。

训练只取两边都不超过 30 个词的句对，共 1,778,620 对，英语词表 42,005 个词，法语 58,016 个。起点假设每个法语词都同样可能是任何英语词的译文，这张表有 24 亿多格；可真正在同一句对里一起出现过的词对只有约 2500 万，约占百分之一，所以用稀疏矩阵就能存下。EM 迭代了 12 轮，先用简单的模型给复杂的模型打底。Model 1 只有一个最优解，只要初值不取零，从哪里出发都会走到同一处。

后来的统计翻译常把词对齐当作中间一步。2003 年 Koehn、Och 和 Marcu 的短语翻译模型，先用训练 IBM 模型的工具 Giza++ 给语料做词对齐，再从对齐结果里抽出成对的短语；他们收集短语时用的，是把两个方向的 IBM Model 4 对齐合并后的结果。
detail.en:
The paper has an easy example to follow. For the French Il me semble faire signe que oui, rendered as It seems to me that he is nodding, Models 1 to 3 link nodding only to signe and oui; Model 5 links it to the whole phrase faire signe que oui. Something also got worse. Model 1 correctly links Il to he, but the later models consider the two words too far apart and link Il to It instead. The authors say plainly that the models lack the linguistic knowledge to handle this.

Training used only sentence pairs with 30 or fewer words on each side, 1,778,620 pairs in all, with an English vocabulary of 42,005 words and a French one of 58,016. The starting point treats every French word as an equally likely translation of every English word, a table of more than 2.4 billion entries. Only about 25 million word pairs ever appear together in a sentence pair, roughly one percent, so sparse matrices were enough. EM ran for 12 iterations, with simpler models setting up the more complex ones. Model 1 has a single optimum, so any starting point without zeros leads to the same place.

Later statistical translation systems often treated word alignment as an intermediate step. The 2003 phrase-based model of Koehn, Och, and Marcu first word-aligned a corpus with Giza++, a toolkit for training the IBM models, then extracted phrase pairs consistent with that alignment. The alignments they collected phrases from combined IBM Model 4 alignments run in both directions.

limit.zh: 这篇论文只讲翻译模型的参数估计，不讲搜索：怎样在所有英语句子里找出得分最高的那句，作者说留到以后的论文。第 6 节列了模型自己的毛病：不管词形变化，法语动词的几十种形式各学各的；英语一侧只能一个词一个词地对，几个词合成一个意思的情况处理得勉强；概率分配有缺陷，真用来翻译时会偏向短句。实验只做了英法一对语言。统计翻译的想法也不是从这里开始，作者提到 Weaver 1949 年就提过，他们自己 1988、1990 年也发表过早期版本。日期：1993 年是 Computational Linguistics 第 19 卷第 2 期的出版年。
limit.en: The paper covers estimating the translation model, not search: finding the highest-scoring English sentence among all candidates was left for a later paper. Section 6 lists the models' own weaknesses. They ignore morphology, so each of the dozens of forms of a French verb is learned separately; they align English one word at a time, which handles multi-word units poorly; and they are deficient, which would make a translator built on them favor short English sentences. Experiments covered only French and English. Statistical translation did not start here either: the authors cite Warren Weaver's 1949 suggestion and their own earlier papers from 1988 and 1990. Date: 1993 is the publication year of Computational Linguistics volume 19, issue 2.

sources: Brown et al. · The Mathematics of Statistical Machine Translation: Parameter Estimation, Computational Linguistics 19(2), 1993, §§1–2, 5–7 and Figure 5
Koehn, Och & Marcu · Statistical Phrase-Based Translation, HLT-NAACL 2003, §§3.1, 4.6

title.zh: SIFT · 换个角度也能对上的局部特征
title.en: SIFT · local features that survive a change of view

body.zh: 要在两张照片里找出同一个东西，难在拍法会变：远近、旋转、光照、视角一变，像素就全不一样了。当时常用的 Harris 角点对尺度变化很敏感，换个远近就对不上。SIFT 先在不同尺度上找出稳定的关键点，按周围梯度的主方向把它“摆正”，再把附近的梯度统计成一个 128 维的向量。一张 500×500 的图通常能取出大约 2000 个这样的特征，每个都可以拿去和数据库里的特征比对。
body.en: Finding the same thing in two photos is hard because the shot keeps changing: distance, rotation, lighting, and viewpoint all alter the pixels. The widely used Harris corner detector was very sensitive to scale, so the same spot seen from farther away often failed to match. SIFT finds keypoints that stay stable across scales, turns each one to the dominant direction of its local gradients, and summarizes the nearby gradients as a 128-dimensional vector. A typical 500×500 image yields about 2,000 such features, each of which can be compared against a database of features.

detail.zh:
128 是这么来的：在关键点周围取 16×16 的采样，分成 4×4 个小格，每格统计 8 个方向的梯度，4×4×8=128。比对时有条很实用的规矩：只看最近的匹配不够，要和第二近的比。最近的距离超过第二近的 0.8 倍，就扔掉。在一个 4 万个关键点的数据库上，这条规矩去掉了 90% 的错误匹配，误删的正确匹配不到 5%。

认物体时，单个匹配不可靠，背景里会冒出很多错配。论文让匹配投票：用 Hough 变换找出在位置、尺度和方向上意见一致的一组，至少 3 个特征一致才进入最后的几何验证。整个识别过程在 2GHz 的 Pentium 4 上不到 0.3 秒。作者也写明了范围：有纹理的平面物体，转动 50 度以内一般能认出来；立体物体只有 30 度左右。

到 2012 年的 ImageNet 比赛，SIFT 还在前列的方法里。AlexNet 论文的对比表中，ILSVRC-2010 和 2012 都有 SIFT 加 Fisher 向量的方法；2012 年那一支是第二名，测试集 top-5 错误率 26.2%，AlexNet 是 15.3%。OpenCV 4.x 的 features2d 模块里有一个 SIFT 类，注释写明按 Lowe 2004 年的论文实现。
detail.en:
The 128 comes from a 16×16 sample grid around the keypoint, split into 4×4 cells, each holding an 8-direction gradient histogram: 4×4×8 = 128. Matching uses a practical rule. The nearest match alone is not enough; compare it with the second nearest, and discard the match if the nearest distance is more than 0.8 times the second. On a database of 40,000 keypoints, this removed 90% of false matches while losing less than 5% of correct ones.

For object recognition a single match is unreliable, since background clutter produces many false ones. The paper lets matches vote: a Hough transform finds groups that agree on position, scale, and orientation, and only groups of at least 3 features go on to final geometric verification. The whole recognition step took under 0.3 seconds on a 2GHz Pentium 4. The author also stated the limits: textured flat objects were usually recognized within about 50 degrees of rotation in depth, 3D objects only within about 30.

SIFT was still among the leading entries at the 2012 ImageNet competition. The comparison tables in the AlexNet paper include SIFT plus Fisher vector methods for both ILSVRC-2010 and 2012; the 2012 one took second place with 26.2% top-5 test error, against AlexNet's 15.3%. OpenCV 4.x has a SIFT class in its features2d module whose documentation cites Lowe's 2004 paper.

limit.zh: SIFT 只用灰度图，不看颜色。论文里的识别是认出数据库里登记过的具体物体或地点，不是判断“这是一只猫”这种类别；作者也说，还缺带完整 3D 视角和光照变化的数据集来做系统测试。日期：2004 年是 IJCV 第 60 卷第 2 期（11 月）的出版年，作者网站上的稿子署 2004 年 1 月 5 日。尺度不变特征最早见于作者 1999 年的会议论文，这篇期刊长文是更完整的展开和改进。
limit.en: SIFT uses only grayscale intensity, not color. Recognition in the paper means finding specific objects or places already in a database, not deciding that something is a cat; the author also noted that systematic tests on data with full 3D viewpoint and lighting changes were still needed. Date: 2004 is the year of IJCV volume 60, issue 2 (November); the copy on the author's site is dated January 5, 2004. Scale-invariant features first appeared in the author's 1999 conference paper, and this journal article develops and improves that work.

sources: Lowe · Distinctive Image Features from Scale-Invariant Keypoints, author's copy dated 2004-01-05, §§1–2, 6–7, 9 and Figure 11
Same paper · IJCV 60(2), November 2004, DOI record
AlexNet · NeurIPS 2012 paper, Tables 1–2 with SIFT + FV entries
OpenCV 4.x · features2d.hpp, SIFT class documentation citing Lowe 2004

title.zh: 深度网络做声学模型 · 四个团队的共同结论
title.en: Deep networks for acoustic modeling · four groups' shared view

body.zh: 多年来，语音识别的标准做法是 GMM-HMM：HMM 处理语音在时间上的伸缩，高斯混合模型（GMM）判断每一帧声音像哪个状态。输入特征（如 MFCC）经过精心设计，GMM 也调得很成熟，新方法很难超过它。二十年前有人用单隐层神经网络做过同样的事，但当时的硬件和算法训不动更深的网络。这篇综述汇总了多伦多大学、微软研究院、谷歌和 IBM 的结果：把 GMM 换成多隐层的深度网络，直接输出 HMM 状态的概率，在多个大词汇量任务上都比调好的 GMM 系统准，有时差得很多。
