body.en: For years the standard speech recognizer was the GMM-HMM: hidden Markov models handled how speech stretches in time, and Gaussian mixture models scored how well each frame of sound fit each state. The input features, such as MFCCs, were carefully engineered, and GMMs were so well tuned that new methods struggled to beat them. Two decades earlier, networks with a single hidden layer had been tried for the same job, but neither hardware nor algorithms could train deeper ones. This review gathers results from the University of Toronto, Microsoft Research, Google, and IBM Research: replacing the GMM with a deep network that outputs probabilities over HMM states beat well-tuned GMM systems on several large-vocabulary tasks, sometimes by a wide margin.

detail.zh:
看一个具体配置。谷歌语音输入用的网络有 4 个隐层，每层 2560 个单元；输入是连续 11 帧，每帧 40 个对数滤波器组输出；输出层直接对应 7969 个 HMM 状态。网络给出的是“这一帧属于哪个状态”的概率，HMM 解码要的却是“这个状态发出这段声音”的可能性，做法是把网络输出除以各状态在训练对齐里出现的频率。训练用的帧标签，本身也是先用旧的 GMM-HMM 系统强制对齐得到的。

Switchboard 电话对话任务上，用同样 309 小时的训练数据，词错误率从 GMM-HMM 的 27.4% 降到 18.5%，相对降低 33%，和用了近七倍数据、多遍解码的自适应 GMM 系统（18.6%）相当。谷歌语音输入的线上测试集上，词错误率 12.3%，比最好的 GMM 系统相对低 23%。作者回头看也说得直白：大部分收益来自让深度网络利用相邻帧，以及直接预测上下文相关的绑定状态；逐层预训练能减少过拟合、缩短微调时间，但训练时间上的好处，仔细设置每层初始权重的尺度也能做到。

代价在计算上。GMM 可以只算一部分高斯，深度网络每一帧几乎要用上全部参数。论文给的数字是：识别 1 秒语音原本要 1.6 秒，把权重量化到 8 位、用 x86 CPU 的 SIMD 定点指令后降到 210 毫秒，用 GPU 是 66 毫秒。训练也不容易分到大集群上，作者把并行化微调列为当时的主要难题。
detail.en:
Take one concrete setup. Google's Voice Input network had 4 hidden layers of 2,560 units each; its input was 11 consecutive frames of 40 log filter-bank outputs, and its output layer covered 7,969 HMM states directly. The network gives the probability that a frame belongs to each state, while HMM decoding needs the likelihood of the sound given the state, so the outputs were divided by how often each state appeared in the training alignment. The frame labels themselves came from forced alignment with an existing GMM-HMM system.

On the Switchboard telephone conversation task, with the same 309 hours of training data, word error rate fell from 27.4% for the GMM-HMM to 18.5%, a 33% relative reduction, matching a speaker-adaptive, multi-pass GMM system trained on nearly seven times as much data (18.6%). On a test set from live Voice Input traffic the error rate was 12.3%, 23% lower in relative terms than the best GMM system. Looking back, the authors were direct: most of the gain came from letting deep networks use neighboring frames and from predicting tied context-dependent states. Layer-wise pre-training reduced overfitting and fine-tuning time, but similar savings in training time could come from carefully scaling each layer's initial random weights.

The cost was computation. A GMM system can evaluate only some of its Gaussians, while a deep network uses nearly all its parameters for every frame. The paper's figures: recognizing 1 second of speech took 1.6 seconds, dropping to 210 ms with weights quantized to 8 bits and fixed-point SIMD instructions on an x86 CPU, or 66 ms on a GPU. Training was also hard to spread across large clusters, and the authors named parallelizing fine-tuning as a major open issue.

limit.zh: 深度网络只替换了 GMM 这一块，HMM、语言模型和解码器都还在，帧标签也要靠旧系统先对齐，不是从声音直接输出文字。这是一篇综述，结果分别来自几个团队 2009 到 2012 年的工作，不是一次新实验；用神经网络预测 HMM 状态也不从这里开始。日期：正式版刊于 IEEE Signal Processing Magazine 2012 年 11 月刊；谷歌存档的稿子署 2012 年 4 月 27 日，这里引用的数字在两个版本里一致。
limit.en: The deep network replaced only the GMM. The HMM, language model, and decoder stayed, and frame labels still came from aligning with the old system, so this was not audio going straight to text. It is a review, summarizing several groups' work from 2009 to 2012 rather than reporting one new experiment, and predicting HMM states with neural networks did not begin here. Dates: the published version is in the November 2012 issue of IEEE Signal Processing Magazine; the draft archived by Google is dated April 27, 2012, and the figures cited here match in both.

sources: Hinton et al. · Deep Neural Networks for Acoustic Modeling in Speech Recognition, IEEE Signal Processing Magazine 29(6), November 2012, DOI record
Same article · author-hosted magazine proof, Switchboard, Voice Input and summary tables
Same article · Google-archived draft dated 2012-04-27, §§I, II.E, IV and VI

title.zh: Faster R-CNN · 候选框也交给网络
title.en: Faster R-CNN · letting the network propose the boxes

body.zh: 物体检测不光要说是什么，还要框出在哪。2015 年的主流做法分两步：先用 Selective Search 这类算法在图上提出约两千个候选框，再用卷积网络（Fast R-CNN）逐个判断。网络这边已经快到接近实时，候选框反而成了瓶颈：Selective Search 在 CPU 上每张图要约 2 秒。Faster R-CNN 加了一个区域建议网络（RPN），和检测网络共用同一套卷积特征，直接在特征图上预测候选框。提框的额外开销降到每张图约 10 毫秒，用 VGG-16 时整套系统每秒 5 帧。
body.en: Object detection has to say both what an object is and where it is. In 2015 the leading approach had two stages: an algorithm such as Selective Search proposed around two thousand candidate boxes, and a convolutional network (Fast R-CNN) classified each one. The network part had been sped up to near real time, which left the proposals as the bottleneck; Selective Search took about 2 seconds per image on a CPU. Faster R-CNN added a Region Proposal Network (RPN) that shares convolutional features with the detector and predicts candidate boxes directly from the feature map. Proposals then cost about 10 milliseconds extra per image, and the full system with VGG-16 ran at 5 frames per second.

detail.zh:
RPN 的关键是“锚框”。在卷积特征图的每个位置预先放 9 个参考框：3 种大小（面积约 128²、256²、512² 像素）乘 3 种长宽比（1:1、1:2、2:1）。网络对每个锚框回答两件事：里面是不是物体，框该怎么挪、怎么缩放。一张约 1000×600 的图大约有两万个锚框，按分数排序、去掉重叠的之后，测试时只取前 300 个交给检测网络。

论文的计时表把账算得很清楚（NVIDIA K40 GPU，VGG-16；Selective Search 在 CPU 上计时）：原来 Selective Search 加 Fast R-CNN 每张图共 1830 毫秒，提框占 1510 毫秒；换成 RPN 后共 196 毫秒，提框只占 10 毫秒。准确率也没掉：PASCAL VOC 2007 测试集上，用 2007 和 2012 两份训练数据时 mAP 是 73.2%，同样条件下 Selective Search 方案是 70.0%。换成更小的 ZF 网络，能到每秒 15 帧。

作者有重叠的 ResNet 论文在检测实验里直接用 Faster R-CNN，只把 VGG-16 换成 ResNet-101，COCO 的标准指标就提高了 6.0 个点。2017 年的 Mask R-CNN 在 Faster R-CNN 上加了一个预测物体掩码的分支，把检测扩展到逐个物体的分割，代码公开在 Detectron 项目里。
detail.en:
The key to the RPN is the anchor. Each position on the convolutional feature map gets 9 reference boxes: 3 sizes (areas of about 128², 256², and 512² pixels) times 3 aspect ratios (1:1, 1:2, 2:1). For every anchor the network answers two questions: does it contain an object, and how should the box shift and resize? A typical 1000×600 image has about 20,000 anchors; after ranking by score and removing overlaps, only the top 300 go to the detector at test time.

The paper's timing table makes the accounting plain (NVIDIA K40 GPU, VGG-16; Selective Search timed on a CPU). Selective Search plus Fast R-CNN took 1,830 ms per image, 1,510 of them for proposals; with the RPN the total was 196 ms, 10 of them for proposals. Accuracy held up too: on the PASCAL VOC 2007 test set, trained on VOC 2007 and 2012 data, mAP was 73.2% against 70.0% for the Selective Search version. The smaller ZF network reached 15 frames per second.

ResNet, by an overlapping group of authors, used Faster R-CNN for its detection experiments; swapping VGG-16 for ResNet-101 alone raised the standard COCO metric by 6.0 points. Mask R-CNN, in 2017, added a branch that predicts an object mask to Faster R-CNN, extending detection to per-object segmentation, with code released in the Detectron project.

limit.zh: 它仍是两阶段：先提框，再分类。标题说的是“走向实时”，VGG-16 版本每秒 5 帧。框都是矩形，物体的精确轮廓不在任务里。初版里 RPN 和检测网络靠交替训练来共享特征，联合优化被作者留作以后的问题。日期：arXiv 初版 2015 年 6 月 4 日，会议版收在 NIPS 2015；这里的数字取自初版，后来的扩展版报告了更新的结果。
limit.en: It is still a two-stage detector: propose, then classify. The title says “towards” real time; the VGG-16 version ran at 5 frames per second. Boxes are rectangles, so exact object outlines are outside the task. In the first version the RPN and detector shared features through alternating training, and the authors left joint optimization for future work. Dates: the first arXiv version is June 4, 2015, and the conference paper appeared at NIPS 2015. Figures here come from the first version; the later extended report has updated results.

sources: Faster R-CNN · arXiv v1, 2015-06-04, §§1, 3–5 and Tables 2–4
ResNet · arXiv v1, 2015-12-10, §4.3 on detection with Faster R-CNN

title.zh: WaveNet · 一个采样点一个采样点地生成声音
title.en: WaveNet · generating audio one sample at a time

body.zh: 2016 年的语音合成主要有两条路。拼接法从录音库里挑片段拼起来；统计参数法先预测声码器参数，再由声码器合成波形，灵活，但声音常常发闷、有杂音。WaveNet 直接对原始波形建模：每秒至少 16000 个采样点，每个点的分布都以前面所有点为条件。为了看得够远，它用了间隔逐层翻倍的“空洞因果卷积”。在谷歌的英语和普通话数据上，听众给它的自然度打分明显高于两种基线。
body.en: In 2016 speech synthesis mostly followed two routes. Concatenative systems stitched together pieces of recorded speech; statistical parametric systems predicted vocoder parameters and let a vocoder produce the waveform, which was flexible but often sounded muffled and carried artifacts. WaveNet modeled the raw waveform itself: at least 16,000 samples per second, each predicted from all the samples before it. To see far enough back, it stacked causal convolutions whose dilation doubled from layer to layer. On Google's English and Mandarin data, listeners rated its speech as clearly more natural than either baseline.

detail.zh:
原始音频一般存成 16 位整数，直接预测下一个值，要在 65536 个可能里选。WaveNet 先做 μ-law 压扩，把值量化成 256 档，再用 softmax 预测下一个采样点落在哪一档。空洞卷积的间隔是 1、2、4……512，然后重复；一组这样的层，感受野就有 1024 个采样点。训练时整段真实波形已知，所有位置可以并行算；生成时只能算完一个点，喂回网络，再算下一个。

合成实验用的是谷歌北美英语（24.6 小时）和普通话（34.8 小时）的单人录音。5 分制的自然度平均意见分（MOS）上，美式英语里以语言学特征加基频为条件的 WaveNet 得 4.21，统计参数法 3.67，拼接法 3.86，真人录音 4.55；普通话里 WaveNet 4.08，真人 4.21。论文也写了一个毛病：只用语言学特征做条件时，240 毫秒的感受野太短，有时会把重音放错词；再加上基频（F0）做条件，这个问题就没了。

逐点生成难以利用大规模并行的硬件，很难放进要求实时的产品。2017 年的 Parallel WaveNet 用“概率密度蒸馏”，从训练好的 WaveNet 教出一个可以并行生成的前馈网络，音质没有明显差别，速度超过实时 20 倍以上，已用于 Google Assistant 的多种英语和日语声音。
detail.en:
Raw audio is usually stored as 16-bit integers, so predicting the next value directly means choosing among 65,536 possibilities. WaveNet first applies μ-law companding and quantizes to 256 levels, then uses a softmax to predict which level the next sample falls in. Dilations run 1, 2, 4, … 512 and then repeat, so one such block sees 1,024 samples. During training the whole real waveform is known and every position can be computed in parallel; during generation each sample must be computed and fed back in before the next one.

The text-to-speech experiments used Google's single-speaker recordings in North American English (24.6 hours) and Mandarin (34.8 hours). On a five-point mean opinion score for naturalness, WaveNet conditioned on linguistic features and pitch scored 4.21 in US English, against 3.67 for the parametric system, 3.86 for the concatenative one, and 4.55 for real recordings; in Mandarin it scored 4.08 against 4.21 for real speech. The paper also reports a flaw: conditioned on linguistic features alone, its 240-millisecond receptive field was too short and it sometimes stressed the wrong word, which went away once pitch (F0) was added as a condition.

Sample-by-sample generation suited massively parallel hardware poorly and was hard to deploy in real-time products. Parallel WaveNet, in 2017, used “probability density distillation” to train a feed-forward network that generates in parallel from a trained WaveNet, with no significant difference in quality. It ran more than 20 times faster than real time and was deployed in Google Assistant for several English and Japanese voices.

limit.zh: WaveNet 管的是最后一步：把语言学特征（和基频）变成波形。从文字得到这些特征、预测音长和基频，仍然靠外部模型。不以文字为条件时，它能生成像人说话的声音，说的却是不存在的词，因为约 300 毫秒的感受野只记得住最近两三个音素。日期：这里按 arXiv 初版计，2016 年 9 月 12 日；一周后有修订的 v2。
limit.en: WaveNet handles the last step: turning linguistic features (and pitch) into a waveform. Getting those features from text and predicting durations and pitch still relied on separate models. Without text conditioning it produced speech-like sound made of nonexistent words, because its receptive field of about 300 milliseconds remembered only the last two or three phonemes. Date: the entry follows the first arXiv version, September 12, 2016; a revised v2 followed a week later.

sources: WaveNet · arXiv v1, 2016-09-12, §§1–2.2, 3.1–3.2, Table 1 and Appendix A

title.zh: 稀疏混合专家 · 参数很多，每次只用几个专家
title.en: Sparsely-gated mixture of experts · many parameters, few active at a time

body.zh: 普通神经网络里，每个样本都要经过全部参数；模型和数据一起变大，训练代价大约按平方增长。“条件计算”想让每个样本只激活网络的一部分，但一直没做出大效果：GPU 擅长算术、不擅长分支，分到每一块的批量会变小，门控还容易总选同几块。这篇论文的 MoE 层里有成百上千个前馈小网络（专家），由一个可训练的门控网络为每个位置挑出少数几个，比如 4 个。把它放在堆叠的 LSTM 层之间，语言建模和机器翻译都以更少的计算超过了当时发表过的最好结果。
body.en: In an ordinary neural network every example passes through every parameter, so as models and datasets grow together, training cost grows roughly quadratically. Conditional computation, activating only part of the network for each example, had been proposed to break this link, but it had not delivered large gains. GPUs are fast at arithmetic and slow at branching, each sub-network sees a smaller batch, and the gate tends to keep picking the same few pieces. This paper's MoE layer holds hundreds to thousands of small feed-forward networks, the experts, and a trainable gating network picks a few of them, such as four, for each position. Placed between stacked LSTM layers, it beat the best published language modeling and translation results at lower computational cost.

detail.zh:
门控的做法是“加噪声，取前 k 个”：先算每个专家的得分，加一点可调的高斯噪声，只保留最高的 k 个，其余设为负无穷，再做 softmax。没被选中的专家这一步完全不用算。有个现实问题：门控很快会偏向少数几个专家，被选得多的专家训练得更快，于是更容易被选中。作者加了一项额外的损失，让各专家在一个批次里得到的门控权重总和尽量接近，另有一项损失平衡每个专家实际收到的样本数。

在 10 亿词的语言建模基准上，作者让几组模型每步的计算量都保持在约 800 万次乘加，只改变专家数量。4 个专家全都参与时，效果和同等计算量的普通模型差不多；4096 个专家、每次选 4 个的模型，测试困惑度低了 24%。换到 1000 亿词的语料，专家加到 65536 个（680 亿参数）时，困惑度比同等计算的基线低 39%；再加到 131072 个反而变差，作者猜是太稀疏了。

翻译上，作者把 MoE 加进 GNMT 的结构，WMT'14 英法和英德的 BLEU 分别达到 40.56 和 26.03。2021 年的 Switch Transformer 接着这条路，简化了 MoE 的路由算法；它在摘要里也承认，MoE 虽有一些成功，复杂度、通信开销和训练不稳定一直妨碍它被广泛采用。
detail.en:
The gate works by “add noise, keep the top k”. It scores every expert, adds a little tunable Gaussian noise, keeps the k highest scores, sets the rest to negative infinity, and applies a softmax. Experts that are not chosen do no work for that input. One practical problem: the gate quickly favors a few experts, and since those train faster they get chosen even more. The authors added an extra loss that pushes every expert's total gate weight in a batch toward the same value, plus another that balances how many examples each expert actually receives.

On the 1-billion-word language modeling benchmark, the authors held several models at about 8 million multiply-adds per step and varied only the number of experts. With 4 experts always active, results matched computationally equal ordinary models; with 4,096 experts and 4 chosen at a time, test perplexity was 24% lower. On a 100-billion-word corpus, growing to 65,536 experts (68 billion parameters) cut perplexity 39% below a compute-matched baseline, while 131,072 experts did worse, possibly from too much sparsity.

For translation the authors added MoE layers to a modified GNMT model and reached 40.56 BLEU on WMT'14 English–French and 26.03 on English–German. The Switch Transformer, in 2021, continued this line and simplified MoE routing; its abstract also notes that despite some successes, complexity, communication costs, and training instability had held back wide adoption of MoE.

limit.zh: 计算省了，参数却实打实要放进显存、在网络上传：论文花了不少篇幅处理批量变小和带宽不够的问题。门控的离散选择会带来不连续，作者说实践中还没看到问题，但没有理论保证。实验里的模型是 LSTM，不是 Transformer。混合专家也不是新概念，可以追溯到 1991 年 Jacobs 等人；把它做成深层网络里的一层，Eigen 等人 2013 年也提过。这篇的贡献是稀疏门控，并在上千亿参数的规模上真正训了起来。日期：arXiv 初版 2017 年 1 月 23 日，当时标注为 ICLR 2017 投稿。
limit.en: Computation was saved, but the parameters still had to sit in memory and move over the network; much of the paper deals with shrinking batches and limited bandwidth. Discrete gating introduces discontinuities, which the authors had not seen cause trouble in practice, without a theoretical guarantee. The experiments used LSTMs, not Transformers. Mixtures of experts were not new either: they go back to Jacobs and colleagues in 1991, and Eigen and colleagues had proposed MoEs as layers inside deep networks in 2013. This paper's contribution was sparse gating that actually trained at the scale of over a hundred billion parameters. Date: the first arXiv version is January 23, 2017, then marked as under review for ICLR 2017.

sources: Shazeer et al. · Outrageously Large Neural Networks: The Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts Layer, arXiv v1, 2017-01-23, §§1–5

title.zh: ELMo · 同一个词，换个句子就换个向量
title.en: ELMo · word vectors that change with the sentence

body.zh: word2vec、GloVe 这类词向量给每个词一个固定的向量，不管它出现在哪句话里。play 在体育报道和戏剧评论里意思不同，向量却是同一个。ELMo 先在大约 3000 万个句子上训练一个双向 LSTM 语言模型：一个方向从左往右读、预测下一个词，另一个从右往左读、预测前一个词。用的时候，词的表示由整句话算出来，取模型各层状态的加权和，权重按任务学习。把它接进现有模型，论文试的六个任务都刷新了当时的最好成绩。
body.en: Word vectors such as word2vec and GloVe give each word one fixed vector wherever it appears. “Play” means different things in a sports report and a theater review, yet it gets the same vector. ELMo first trained a bidirectional LSTM language model on about 30 million sentences: one direction reads left to right and predicts the next word, the other reads right to left and predicts the previous one. In use, a word's representation is computed from the whole sentence as a weighted sum of the model's layers, with the weights learned for each task. Added to existing models, it set new state-of-the-art results on all six tasks the paper tried.

detail.zh:
论文拿 play 做了个对比。用 GloVe 查，离它最近的词是 playing、game、football 这些，几乎都是体育的意思。换成 ELMo 的上下文表示：棒球报道里“一次精彩的 play”，找到的最近句子也在夸球员打得好；“签约出演一部百老汇 play”，找到的最近句子讲的是演员在一部成功的戏里演出。词性和词义都分开了。

各层学到的东西也不一样。直接拿表示做词义消歧，第二层的 F1 是 69.0，比第一层的 67.4 好；做词性标注则反过来，第一层 97.0%，第二层 95.8%。所以 ELMo 不只用最上一层，而是让每个任务自己学怎么混合各层。接法也简单：训练任务模型时把语言模型的权重冻住，把 ELMo 向量拼到原来的词向量上。在 SQuAD 问答上，基线模型的 F1 从 81.1 提到 85.8。

同年 10 月的 BERT 论文把 ELMo 归为“基于特征”的方法：预训练的表示作为额外特征，接进各任务自己设计的模型；BERT 则改成整个预训练模型一起微调。BERT 还指出，ELMo 是把分别训练的从左到右、从右到左两个 LSTM 拼起来，不是每一层都同时看两边。
detail.en:
The paper compares neighbors of “play”. With GloVe, the closest words are playing, game, football and the like, almost all in the sports sense. With ELMo's contextual representation, “play” in a baseball sentence about a spectacular fielding play finds a nearest sentence that praises a player's all-round play, while “play” in a sentence about an actress signing for a Broadway production finds one about actors in a successful stage play. Part of speech and word sense are both pulled apart.

Different layers learn different things. Used directly for word sense disambiguation, the second layer scores 69.0 F1, ahead of the first layer's 67.4; for part-of-speech tagging it flips, with 97.0% for the first layer and 95.8% for the second. That is why ELMo does not take only the top layer but lets each task learn how to mix them. Plugging it in is simple: the language model's weights are frozen while the task model trains, and the ELMo vector is concatenated with the existing word vectors. On SQuAD question answering, the baseline's F1 rose from 81.1 to 85.8.

The BERT paper, that October, classed ELMo as a feature-based approach: pretrained representations enter each task's own architecture as extra features, whereas BERT fine-tunes the whole pretrained model. BERT also pointed out that ELMo concatenates separately trained left-to-right and right-to-left LSTMs, so no single layer sees both sides at once.

limit.zh: ELMo 给的是更好的输入特征，每个任务仍要自己设计模型。双向是两个单向模型拼起来的，每个方向内部仍只看一侧。它也不是最早的上下文词向量：论文自己就和用翻译编码器的 CoVe、作者 2017 年的工作做了比较。日期：arXiv 初版 2018 年 2 月 15 日，正式发表于 NAACL 2018（6 月）；arXiv 备注说论文 2017 年 10 月 27 日先发在 OpenReview 上。这里的数字取自 arXiv 初版。
limit.en: ELMo provides better input features; each task still needs its own model. Its bidirectionality comes from joining two one-directional models, each of which sees only one side. Nor was it the first contextual word vector: the paper itself compares against CoVe, built from a translation encoder, and the authors' own 2017 work. Dates: the first arXiv version is February 15, 2018, and the paper was published at NAACL 2018 in June; the arXiv note says it was first posted to OpenReview on October 27, 2017. Figures here come from the first arXiv version.

sources: Peters et al. · Deep contextualized word representations, arXiv v1, 2018-02-15, §§1–5 and Tables 1, 4–6
BERT · arXiv, §§1–2 and Figure 3 on ELMo as a feature-based approach

title.zh: 缩放定律 · 按规模预测语言模型的损失
title.en: Scaling laws · predicting language-model loss from scale

body.zh: 给定一笔算力，模型该多大、数据该多少？作者指出，受硬件限制，人们往往把较小的模型训得比最省算力的做法更久。Kaplan 等人训练了一批 Transformer 语言模型，参数从 768 到 15 亿（不计词嵌入），发现测试损失分别随参数量、数据量和训练算力按幂律下降，有的趋势跨了七个数量级以上；层数和宽度这类形状细节，在很大范围内影响很小。由此能算出最划算的分配：算力主要用来扩大模型，数据适度增加，而且不必训到收敛。
body.en: Given a compute budget, how large should a model be and how much data should it see? The authors observed that, because of hardware constraints, researchers typically trained smaller models for longer than was compute-efficient. Kaplan and colleagues trained a range of Transformer language models from 768 to 1.5 billion parameters, not counting embeddings, and found that test loss falls as a power law in parameters, data, and training compute, each taken separately, with some trends spanning more than seven orders of magnitude. Shape details such as depth versus width mattered little over a wide range. From this they worked out the most efficient split: spend compute mainly on a bigger model, add data only moderately, and stop well before convergence.

detail.zh:
有几条结论可以直接拿来用。模型每大 8 倍，数据只要多大约 5 倍，就不会因为数据不够而吃亏（损失的惩罚取决于 N^0.74/D）。算力增加时，最优模型大小约按算力的 0.73 次方增长，批量约按 0.24 次方，训练步数只按 0.03 次方。换句话说，多出来的算力主要该换成更大的模型，而不是训得更久。论文的图 3 用算力增加十亿倍来演示这种分配。

GPT-3 直接用了这些结论。它的论文说，依据这篇的分析，他们训练的模型比常见做法大得多，用的词元却少得多；大模型配更大的批量、更小的学习率，也引自这里。GPT-3 还把验证损失随算力的幂律趋势往外延了两个数量级，只看到很小的偏离。

2022 年 DeepMind 的 Chinchilla 论文得出了不同的分配。按他们的读法，Kaplan 等人的建议相当于算力涨 10 倍时，模型放大 5.5 倍，训练词元只多 1.8 倍；Chinchilla 的作者训练了 400 多个模型，认为两者应该同比例增长，模型大一倍，词元也多一倍。他们给的一个原因是：Kaplan 的实验让所有模型用相同的训练词元数和学习率计划，拿训练中途的损失来估计，会低估“数据较少、学习率计划与之匹配”的训练效果。按新结论训练的 Chinchilla 有 700 亿参数，和 2800 亿参数的 Gopher 用同样的算力、4 倍的数据，在大量下游任务上都超过了 Gopher。
detail.en:
Several results could be used directly. Each time the model grows 8 times, about 5 times more data avoids a penalty from too little data (the penalty depends on N^0.74/D). As compute grows, the best model size grows roughly as compute to the power 0.73, batch size as 0.24, and training steps as only 0.03. In other words, extra compute should mostly buy a larger model, not longer training. Figure 3 of the paper illustrates this split for a billion-fold increase in compute.

GPT-3 used these results directly. Its paper says that, based on this analysis, it trained much larger models on many fewer tokens than was typical, and its choice of larger batches with smaller learning rates for bigger models also cites this work. GPT-3 then extended the power-law trend of validation loss against compute by two more orders of magnitude and saw only small deviations.

In 2022, DeepMind's Chinchilla paper reached a different split. It reads Kaplan and colleagues as recommending that a 10× increase in compute go to a 5.5× larger model and only 1.8× more training tokens. After training more than 400 models, Chinchilla's authors concluded that the two should grow in equal proportion: double the model, double the tokens. One reason they give is that Kaplan's runs used the same number of training tokens and learning-rate schedule for every model, so losses read off midway underestimated what shorter training with a matching schedule could achieve. Chinchilla itself, with 70 billion parameters, used the same compute as the 280-billion-parameter Gopher with 4 times the data, and outperformed Gopher across a large range of downstream tasks.

limit.zh: 这些是针对 Transformer 语言模型、在一个训练集（WebText2）上做的经验拟合，不是推导出来的定律；作者也说，损失在降到零之前一定会变平。它预测的是交叉熵损失，不直接预测下游任务能力。最优分配的具体比例后来被 Chinchilla 修正，引用 0.73 这类指数时要说明出处和条件。日期：arXiv 初版 2020 年 1 月 23 日。
limit.en: These are empirical fits for Transformer language models trained on one dataset, WebText2, not derived laws, and the authors note that loss must flatten before it reaches zero. They predict cross-entropy loss, not downstream task ability directly. The specific compute-optimal split was later revised by Chinchilla, so exponents like 0.73 should be quoted with their source and conditions. Date: the first arXiv version is January 23, 2020.

sources: Kaplan et al. · Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models, arXiv v1, 2020-01-23, abstract, §1 and Figure 3
GPT-3 · arXiv, §2 and Figures 2.2, 3.1 citing this analysis
Chinchilla · Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models, arXiv v1, 2022-03-29, abstract, §§1–2 and Table 2

title.zh: Whisper · 不微调也能用的语音识别
title.en: Whisper · speech recognition that works without fine-tuning

body.zh: 此前语音识别的一条主线是自监督预训练：wav2vec 2.0 这类方法能用上百万小时没标注的语音，但只学到编码器，用之前还得在具体数据集上微调解码器。微调要有经验的人来做，模型还容易学到只在那个数据集里成立的规律，换个场景就出错。Whisper 反过来，直接用网上带文字稿的音频做有监督训练，共 68 万小时，其中 11.7 万小时是 96 种其他语言，12.5 万小时是译成英语的数据。模型不微调，直接拿去测别的数据集。
body.en: A main line of speech recognition research was self-supervised pre-training. Methods like wav2vec 2.0 could use up to a million hours of unlabeled speech, but they learned only an encoder, and a decoder still had to be fine-tuned on each target dataset. Fine-tuning takes a skilled practitioner, and a model can pick up patterns that hold only in that dataset and fail elsewhere. Whisper went the other way: supervised training on 680,000 hours of web audio paired with transcripts, including 117,000 hours in 96 other languages and 125,000 hours of translation into English. The models were then tested on other datasets with no fine-tuning at all.

detail.zh:
一个模型做好几件事，靠的是解码器开头的几个特殊词元。音频切成 30 秒一段，转成 80 通道的对数梅尔频谱，交给一个标准的编码器—解码器 Transformer。解码器先预测语种（共 99 种），没人说话就输出 <|nospeech|>；接着用 <|transcribe|> 或 <|translate|> 指定是转写还是译成英语，再决定要不要时间戳，然后才开始输出文字。原来语音处理流水线里分开做的语种识别、语音活动检测和翻译，都并进了同一个序列预测。

论文最想说明的是稳健性。挑一个在 LibriSpeech 上和 Whisper 成绩相差不到 0.1% 的有监督模型，换到其他数据集上测，Whisper 的错误平均少 55.2%：Common Voice 上是 9.0% 对 29.9%，嘈杂的 CHiME6 上是 25.5% 对 65.8%。作者因此提醒，只在一个数据集上拿模型和人比，容易高估模型的能力。

代码和模型权重一起公开，用 MIT 许可证，最小的 Tiny 只有 3900 万参数，最大的 Large 有 15.5 亿。2022 年 12 月的 arXiv 版本里，主要结果已换成发布后再训练的 Large V2：训练轮数多 2.5 倍，加了 SpecAugment 等正则化。
detail.en:
One model handles several jobs through a few special tokens at the start of the decoder. Audio is cut into 30-second segments, turned into an 80-channel log-Mel spectrogram, and fed to a standard encoder–decoder Transformer. The decoder first predicts the language (99 in all), or outputs <|nospeech|> if no one is talking; then <|transcribe|> or <|translate|> chooses between transcription and translation into English, a further token decides whether to predict timestamps, and only then does text begin. Language identification, voice activity detection, and translation, once separate stages of a speech pipeline, become one sequence prediction.

The paper's main point is robustness. Take a supervised model whose LibriSpeech score is within 0.1% of Whisper's and test both on other datasets: Whisper makes 55.2% fewer errors on average, with 9.0% against 29.9% on Common Voice and 25.5% against 65.8% on the noisy CHiME6. The authors warn that comparing models with humans on a single dataset can overstate what the models can do.

Code and model weights were released together under the MIT license, from Tiny at 39 million parameters to Large at 1.55 billion. In the December 2022 arXiv version, the main results use Large V2, trained after the release for 2.5 times as many epochs with added regularization such as SpecAugment.

limit.zh: 错误并没有消失。作者列了长音频转写里几类不像人会犯的错：陷入重复循环，漏掉一段开头或结尾的几个词，甚至输出和音频完全无关的文字。训练数据偏英语，大多数语言不到 1000 小时，这些语言的识别仍然很差。开发早期还发现模型会胡猜说话人的名字，因为不少网上文字稿里带着说话人姓名。日期：公开代码库的初次提交在 2022 年 9 月 21 日，arXiv 论文初版是 2022 年 12 月 6 日。
limit.en: Errors did not disappear. The authors list stubborn, non-human failure modes in long-form transcription: getting stuck in repeat loops, skipping the first or last words of a segment, and outright hallucinating text unrelated to the audio. The training data leans heavily toward English, most languages have under 1,000 hours, and recognition in many of them remains poor. Early in development the models also tended to guess speakers' names, because many web transcripts include them. Dates: the public repository's initial commit is September 21, 2022, and the first arXiv version of the paper is December 6, 2022.

sources: Radford et al. · Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision, arXiv v1, 2022-12-06, §§1–2, 3.3, 6 and Tables 1–2
openai/whisper · official code and model release, MIT license, initial commit 2022-09-21

title.zh: Segment Anything · 点一下，就把东西抠出来
title.en: Segment Anything · click once to cut out an object

body.zh: 图像分割要一个像素一个像素地标出物体的范围，标起来很费工夫，网上也没有大量现成的掩码可抓。以前的分割系统大多针对固定的一组任务训练，训练和测试做的是同一件事。SAM 定义了“可提示分割”：给一个点、一个框或一块粗略的掩码，模型都要返回合理的掩码。图像编码器每张图只跑一次，之后每个提示在浏览器里约 50 毫秒出结果。训练数据由模型和标注员一起滚出来，最终的 SA-1B 有 1100 万张图、11 亿个掩码。
body.en: Segmentation marks exactly which pixels belong to an object. Labeling it is slow, and unlike image–text pairs, masks are not available on the web in bulk. Earlier segmentation systems were mostly trained for a fixed set of tasks, with the same tasks at training and test time. SAM defined promptable segmentation: given a point, a box, or a rough mask, the model must return a sensible mask. The image encoder runs once per image, after which each prompt takes about 50 milliseconds in a web browser. The training data was built by the model and annotators together, and the final SA-1B dataset holds 11 million images and 1.1 billion masks.

detail.zh:
提示常常有歧义：在衬衫上点一下，指的可能是衬衫，也可能是穿衬衫的人。SAM 的办法是一次输出 3 个掩码，大致对应整体、部分和更小的部分；训练时只按最接近标注的那个计算损失，另有一个分支估计每个掩码的质量。结构分三块：经 MAE 预训练的 ViT-H 图像编码器，提示编码器（文字提示借用 CLIP 的文本编码器），以及一个轻量的掩码解码器。

数据分三个阶段攒起来。第一阶段，专业标注员在浏览器里点前景点和背景点，SAM 实时给出掩码，再用画笔修；模型随数据重训了 6 次，每个掩码的平均标注时间从 34 秒降到 14 秒，这一阶段在 12 万张图上收集了 430 万个掩码。第二阶段先自动填上有把握的掩码，标注员只补漏掉的。第三阶段完全自动：在图上撒 32×32 的网格点，每个点都让模型出掩码，再筛掉不可靠和重复的。SA-1B 里 99.1% 的掩码是这样自动生成的。

2024 年的 SAM 2 把这套思路扩展到视频：加入流式记忆来实时处理视频，也用数据引擎收集了视频分割数据。论文报告，它在图像分割上比 SAM 更准，也快 6 倍。
detail.en:
Prompts are often ambiguous: a click on a shirt might mean the shirt or the person wearing it. SAM outputs 3 masks at once, roughly the whole, a part, and a subpart; during training only the one closest to the label counts toward the loss, while a separate head estimates each mask's quality. The model has three parts: a ViT-H image encoder pre-trained with MAE, a prompt encoder (text prompts borrow CLIP's text encoder), and a lightweight mask decoder.

The data was gathered in three stages. First, professional annotators clicked foreground and background points in a browser while SAM produced masks in real time, then refined them with brush tools; as the model was retrained 6 times, average time per mask fell from 34 to 14 seconds, and this stage collected 4.3 million masks on 120,000 images. Second, confident masks were filled in automatically and annotators added what was missing. Third, the process was fully automatic: a 32×32 grid of points was laid over each image, the model produced masks for every point, and unreliable or duplicate masks were filtered out. 99.1% of the masks in SA-1B were generated this way.

SAM 2, in 2024, carried the approach to video, adding a streaming memory for real-time processing and again using a data engine to collect video segmentation data. Its paper reports that on images it is more accurate than SAM and 6 times faster.

limit.zh: SAM 给出掩码，却不知道掩码里是什么；语义分割、全景分割怎么用简单提示做出来，作者说还不清楚，文字提示也只是初步尝试，不够稳。作者列的其他毛病：会漏掉细小结构，偶尔冒出零碎的小块，边缘不如专门放大细看的方法清楚；用大图像编码器时，整体也算不上实时。日期：arXiv 初版 2023 年 4 月 5 日，会议版发表于 ICCV 2023；模型以 Apache 2.0 许可公开，SA-1B 按研究用途发布。
limit.en: SAM returns masks without knowing what is inside them, and the authors say it is unclear how to express semantic or panoptic segmentation with simple prompts; text prompts were an early, not entirely robust experiment. Other listed weaknesses: it can miss fine structures, sometimes produces small disconnected fragments, and gives less crisp edges than heavier methods that zoom in; with the large image encoder, the full pipeline is not real time. Dates: the first arXiv version is April 5, 2023, and the paper appeared at ICCV 2023. The model was released under the Apache 2.0 license and SA-1B for research use.

sources: Kirillov et al. · Segment Anything, arXiv v1, 2023-04-05, §§1–5, 8

title.zh: FORTRAN · 按公式写，由翻译程序生成机器码
title.en: FORTRAN · write the formula, let the translator code it

body.zh: 1950 年代给 IBM 704 编程，得一条条手写机器指令。FORTRAN 团队 1957 年的论文写道，解决一个科学计算问题，大约三分之二的成本花在准备程序上，九成以上的时间耗在规划、编写和调试。当时多数程序员也不信自动生成的代码能跟手写的一样快。FORTRAN 让人用接近数学的写法描述计算，由翻译程序生成 704 的程序，并把生成代码的效率当作核心目标。项目 1954 年夏天开始，1957 年 4 月正式分发。
body.en: Programming the IBM 704 in the 1950s meant writing machine instructions by hand. The FORTRAN team's 1957 paper notes that about two-thirds of the cost of solving a scientific problem went into preparing the program, and more than 90 percent of the elapsed time into planning, writing, and debugging it. Most programmers also doubted that automatically generated code could match hand-written code for speed. FORTRAN let people describe a computation in notation close to mathematics, and a translator produced the 704 program, with the efficiency of that output as a central goal. The project began in the summer of 1954, and the system was distributed in April 1957.

detail.zh:
论文第一个例子是求一元二次方程的一个根，在 FORTRAN 里只要一条赋值语句，读起来和公式差不多。翻译出来的代码只算一次 B/2.0，平方也用一次乘法完成，不去调用乘方子程序。循环用 DO 语句写，意思是“对 I 从 1 到 1000 重复下面这句”，下标和计数都交给翻译程序。语句一张卡片打一条，整叠卡片读进装着翻译程序的 704，出来的就是能直接运行的二进制程序。

作者举了个自己也说不能多说明问题的例子：一位程序员上了一天 FORTRAN 课，用四小时写出 47 条语句，704 花六分钟把它编译成大约 1000 条指令。第一次结果不对，他只看输出就找到写错的那条语句，改完重编，结果就对了。他估计手写要三天，调试另算，运行速度也不会明显更快。早期那批程序里，每条 FORTRAN 语句大约对应 4 到 20 条机器指令。

后来的数值计算一直给它留着位置。MPI 的早期标准列出了 Fortran 77 和 C 两种语言接口；2020 年的 NumPy 论文也写道，NumPy 数组可以按 C 或 Fortran 的内存顺序存放，这两种语言写的库能直接读取。
detail.en:
The paper's first example finds a root of a quadratic equation. In FORTRAN that is a single assignment statement that reads almost like the formula. The translated code computes B/2.0 only once and squares it with a multiplication instead of calling an exponentiation routine. Loops are written with a DO statement, meaning “repeat the following statement for I from 1 to 1000”, and the translator handles subscripts and counting. Statements were punched one per card; feeding the deck into a 704 loaded with the translator produced a ready-to-run binary program.

The authors offer a case they admit proves little on its own. A programmer took a one-day FORTRAN course, wrote a job in 47 statements in four hours, and the 704 compiled it in six minutes into about 1,000 instructions. The first output was wrong; reading the output alone, he found the faulty statement, fixed it, recompiled, and got a correct program. He estimated three days to code it by hand, plus debugging, with no real gain in speed. Across the early programs, each FORTRAN statement produced roughly 4 to 20 machine instructions.

Numerical computing kept a place for the language. The early MPI standard lists language bindings for Fortran 77 and C, and the 2020 NumPy paper explains that NumPy arrays can be stored in C or Fortran memory order, so libraries written in those languages can read the data directly.

limit.zh: FORTRAN 不是第一个把公式翻译成机器码的系统。Backus 1978 年回顾时承认，MIT 的 Laning 和 Zierler 早已有能跑的代数编译器；IT、MATH-MATIC、BACAIC 也在 FORTRAN 分发前就在运行，只是大多不追求优化。论文描述的系统针对 IBM 704，那个四小时的例子由作者自选，论文自己也提醒这种个案说明不了太多。日期：1954 年 11 月出初步规格，程序员参考手册的日期是 1956 年 10 月 15 日，论文收在 1957 年的西部计算机会议论文集，同年 4 月开始分发；这里标 1957 年。
limit.en: FORTRAN was not the first system to translate formulas into machine code. Looking back in 1978, Backus acknowledged that Laning and Zierler at MIT already had a working algebraic compiler, and that IT, MATH-MATIC, and BACAIC were running before FORTRAN was distributed, though mostly without trying to optimize their output. The system described here targeted the IBM 704, and the four-hour example was chosen by the authors, who themselves warn that such a case says little. Dates: a preliminary specification appeared in November 1954, the Programmer's Reference Manual is dated October 15, 1956, the paper appeared in the 1957 Western Computer Proceedings, and distribution began in April 1957. The entry uses 1957.

sources: Backus et al. · The FORTRAN Automatic Coding System, 1957 Western Computer Proceedings, pp. 188–198

title.zh: C · 用高级语言重写 Unix 内核
title.en: C · rewriting the Unix kernel in a high-level language

body.zh: Unix 最早用 PDP-7 汇编写成，搬到 PDP-11 上又用汇编重写了一遍。Ken Thompson 想用高级语言，1969–70 年做出了 B，但 B 和它的来源 BCPL 一样没有类型，所有数据都是一个“字”。到了按字节寻址的 PDP-11 上，处理字符、浮点数和指针都很别扭，B 的实现方式也让程序比汇编慢得多。Dennis Ritchie 从 1971 年起给 B 加字符类型，再加数组、指针，后来又加了结构，改名叫 C。到 1973 年初，现代 C 的要点已经齐备，同年夏天，PDP-11 上的 Unix 内核用 C 重写。
body.en: Unix was first written in PDP-7 assembler, then recoded in PDP-11 assembly. Ken Thompson wanted a higher-level language and created B in 1969–70, but B, like BCPL before it, was typeless: everything was a single machine word. On the byte-addressed PDP-11, that made characters, floating point, and pointers awkward, and the way B was implemented made programs much slower than assembly. In 1971 Dennis Ritchie began extending B with a character type, then arrays and pointers, later structures, and renamed the result C. By early 1973 the essentials of modern C were in place, and that summer the PDP-11 Unix kernel was rewritten in C.

detail.zh:
看一个字符串就能明白差别。B 只有“字”，几个字符被打包放进一个字里；想逐个处理字符，要调用库函数把它们拆进单独的格子，处理完再装回去。B 的指针是字的编号，每次经指针取数，都要在运行时换算成硬件要的字节地址。C 有了 char 类型和指向 char 的指针，第 i 个字符就是一个字节，可以直接读。

用 C 写内核让团队对这门语言有了信心，开始把工具程序也改写成 C、移到别的机器上。1977 到 1979 年演示 Unix 可移植性期间，Steve Johnson 写了容易移植到新机器的编译器 pcc，他和 Thompson、Ritchie 把 Unix 搬上了 Interdata 8/32。Kernighan 和 Ritchie 1978 年出版的《The C Programming Language》一直充当语言参考，直到 ANSI 的 X3J11 委员会在 1989 年底完成标准。

后来很多系统都留着 C 的接口。MPI 的早期标准规定了 Fortran 77 和 C 两种语言绑定；NumPy 的前身 Numeric 用 C 写成，NumPy 数组也能按 C 的内存顺序存放，C 写的库可以直接读。
detail.en:
A string shows the difference. B had only the word, so several characters were packed into one word; to work on them one at a time, a program called library routines to spread them into separate cells and then packed them back. A B pointer was a word index, so every access through a pointer needed a run-time conversion to the byte address the hardware expected. With a char type and pointers to char in C, the i-th character is simply a byte that can be read directly.

Writing the kernel in C gave the team enough confidence to recode utilities and move them to other machines. While Unix portability was being demonstrated, between 1977 and 1979, Steve Johnson wrote pcc, a C compiler meant to be easy to retarget, and he, Thompson, and Ritchie moved Unix to the Interdata 8/32. The book Kernighan and Ritchie published in 1978, The C Programming Language, served as the language reference until ANSI's X3J11 committee completed its standard at the end of 1989.

Later systems often kept a C interface. The early MPI standard specifies bindings for Fortran 77 and C. NumPy's predecessor Numeric was written in C, and NumPy arrays can be laid out in C memory order so that C libraries can read them directly.

limit.zh: C 不是凭空出现的，它从 BCPL 和 B 一步步改过来；Ritchie 自己的评价是古怪、有缺陷，却极其成功。他也点了名：声明要“由内向外”读，数组和指针的关系常让初学者卡住。用 C 重写内核也不等于 Unix 马上能到处跑，可移植性是在 1977 到 1979 年间才演示出来的。日期：C 成形于 1969–1973 年，Ritchie 说最有创造力的是 1972 年；这里取 1973 年，对应要点齐备、内核用 C 重写。
limit.en: C did not appear from nothing; it grew out of BCPL and B, and Ritchie himself called it quirky and flawed as well as an enormous success. He names the problems: declarations must be read inside out, and the relationship between arrays and pointers often trips up beginners. Rewriting the kernel in C also did not make Unix portable overnight; portability was demonstrated between 1977 and 1979. Dates: C took shape between 1969 and 1973, and Ritchie calls 1972 its most creative period. The entry uses 1973, when the essentials were complete and the kernel was rewritten.

title.zh: Python · 一门可以扩展的脚本语言

body.zh: 1980 年代末，Guido van Rossum 在荷兰 CWI 的 Amoeba 分布式操作系统组工作。Amoeba 有自己的系统调用接口，Bourne shell 不容易调到，做系统管理只能写 C 程序或 shell 脚本，都不顺手。他参与过 ABC 语言的实现，喜欢它的许多设计，可 ABC 没法扩展。他想要一门语法像 ABC、能调用系统接口、又能不断扩展的脚本语言。1989 年圣诞假期他开始动手，1991 年 2 月 20 日把 0.9.0 版发到 USENET 的 alt.sources 讨论组。
body.en: In the late 1980s, Guido van Rossum worked in the Amoeba distributed operating system group at CWI in the Netherlands. Amoeba had its own system-call interface that the Bourne shell could not easily reach, so system administration meant writing C programs or shell scripts, neither a good fit. Van Rossum had helped implement the ABC language and liked much of it, but ABC could not be extended. He wanted a scripting language with ABC-like syntax, access to system calls, and room to grow. He started over the 1989 Christmas holidays, and on February 20, 1991, posted version 0.9.0 to the USENET group alt.sources.

detail.zh:
Python 的不少特点能在这段经历里找到出处。用缩进表示语句分组、内置很高层的数据类型，来自 ABC，只是细节都不同；异常的语法和语义来自 Modula-3，他说 Amoeba 里处理错误的经验让他格外看重异常。他不想做一门只给 Amoeba 用的语言，而要一门普遍可扩展的语言，今天的官方 FAQ 仍把“可以用 C 或 C++ 扩展”列为它的基本特点。头一年，Python 在 Amoeba 项目里用得越来越多，同事的反馈带来了很多早期改进。

后来的科学计算和机器学习正是借了这种可扩展性。NumPy 论文写道，Python 本来就适合清理数据、解析文本，再加上快速的数组运算和线性代数，科学家就能在一门语言里完成全部工作。2019 年的 PyTorch 论文则说，从 2014 年起，大多数深度学习框架都把 Python 接口当作必备。
detail.en:
Several of Python's traits trace back to this history. Indentation for grouping statements and very-high-level built-in data types came from ABC, though the details differ. The syntax and semantics of exceptions came from Modula-3, and van Rossum says error handling in Amoeba taught him how much exceptions matter. Rather than an Amoeba-only language, he wanted one that was generally extensible; the official FAQ still lists extensibility in C or C++ among its basic traits. During its first year, Python was used in the Amoeba project with growing success, and feedback from colleagues drove many early improvements.

Scientific computing and machine learning later leaned on that extensibility. The NumPy paper notes that Python already handled data cleaning and text parsing well, and adding fast array operations and linear algebra let scientists do all their work in one language. The 2019 PyTorch paper observes that since 2014 most deep learning frameworks have treated a Python interface as essential.

limit.zh: 0.9.0 只是第一次公开发布，1.0 版要到 1994 年 1 月。Python 本身不是为数值计算设计的，快的数组运算靠 C 写的扩展，比如 Numeric 和后来的 NumPy；PyTorch 论文也提到，解释器的全局锁让同一时间只有一个线程在跑，框架得设法绕开。日期：Guido 记下的开工时间是 1989 年 12 月，他说最早的几个日期是估计的；0.9.0 于 1991 年 2 月 20 日发到 alt.sources。
limit.en: Version 0.9.0 was only the first public release; 1.0 came in January 1994. Python was not designed for numerical work, and fast array operations came from extensions written in C, such as Numeric and later NumPy. The PyTorch paper also notes that the interpreter's global lock lets only one thread run at a time, which frameworks have to work around. Dates: van Rossum gives December 1989 as the start of implementation and says the earliest dates are approximate; 0.9.0 was posted to alt.sources on February 20, 1991.

title.en: NumPy · one shared array for Python

body.zh: 1990 年代中期，Python 已经有了 Numeric：用 C 写的数组对象和配套函数，底下接现成的高速线性代数库。后来为了处理哈勃空间望远镜的大幅天文图像，又有人重写出 Numarray，加上结构化数组、内存映射等功能。两者大体兼容，但差别足以把社区分成两派。2005 年出现的 NumPy 把两边合在一起：保留 Numarray 的功能，也保留 Numeric 在小数组上的速度和丰富的 C 接口。
body.en: By the mid-1990s Python had Numeric, an array object and array-aware functions written in C on top of standard fast linear algebra libraries. To handle large astronomical images from the Hubble Space Telescope, a reimplementation called Numarray added structured arrays, memory mapping, and other features. The two packages were largely compatible, but different enough to divide the community. In 2005 NumPy brought them together, combining Numarray's features with Numeric's speed on small arrays and its rich C API.

detail.zh:
NumPy 数组其实是一块内存加几项说明：元素类型、形状和步长。比如一个 4×3 的浮点数组，每个数占 8 字节，往右挪一格跳 8 字节，换一行跳 24 字节，步长就是 (24, 8)。在这之上是向量化：对整个数组做加减、求和、三角函数，在 C 里可能要写几十行循环，在 Python 里常常一句就行，循环交给 NumPy。形状不同时还会“广播”，比如给每一列乘上各自的系数，小数组只是在逻辑上被复制，内存里并不真的拷贝。

到 2020 年，SciPy、Matplotlib、pandas、scikit-learn 都建在 NumPy 上，探测引力波、拍出第一张黑洞照片用到的软件里也有它。深度学习框架各自造了新的数组，但都留了和 NumPy 交换数据的办法：PyTorch 的 torch.from_numpy() 和 .numpy() 让两边共用同一块内存，不复制数据。
detail.en:
A NumPy array is a block of memory plus a few pieces of metadata: element type, shape, and strides. For a 4×3 array of 8-byte floats, moving one column jumps 8 bytes and moving one row jumps 24, so the strides are (24, 8). On top of this sits vectorization: arithmetic, sums, or trigonometry over a whole array, which might take tens of lines of loops in C, is often one Python expression, with NumPy running the loop. When shapes differ, broadcasting applies, for example to scale each column by its own factor; the smaller array is duplicated only logically, without copying memory.

By 2020, SciPy, Matplotlib, pandas, and scikit-learn were built on NumPy, and it was part of the software used to detect gravitational waves and to produce the first image of a black hole. Deep learning frameworks created their own arrays but offered ways to exchange data with NumPy; PyTorch's torch.from_numpy() and .numpy() share the same memory, with no copy.

limit.zh: NumPy 管的是单机内存里、用 CPU 计算的数组。论文自己承认，它没法直接用 GPU、TPU，也处理不了超出一台机器内存的数据，所以 PyTorch、TensorFlow、CuPy、Dask 各自造了数组，NumPy 后来改为提供协议，把调用转给这些库。它也不属于 Python 标准库。日期：论文和官网都说 NumPy 创建于 2005 年；论文为此引用的是 Oliphant 2006 年的《Guide to NumPy》，1.0 版的发布日期这里没有核对。
limit.en: NumPy handles in-memory arrays on the CPU. Its own paper says it cannot directly use GPUs or TPUs or data that exceeds one machine's memory, which is why PyTorch, TensorFlow, CuPy, Dask, and others built their own arrays; NumPy later added protocols that pass calls on to those libraries. It is also not part of Python's standard library. Dates: both the paper and the project site say NumPy was created in 2005; the paper cites Oliphant's 2006 Guide to NumPy for this, and the 1.0 release date was not checked here.

NumPy · About us, project history and governance
