title.zh: TensorFlow · 把计算和状态画进同一张图
title.en: TensorFlow · computation and state in one dataflow graph

body.zh: Google 从 2011 年起用 DistBelief 训练神经网络，它是参数服务器架构：层用 C++ 类实现，想试新层得换语言；换优化方法得改参数服务器；固定的“读数据、前向、反向、交梯度”流程，也容不下循环网络、对抗训练和强化学习。它还很重，难以缩到工作站或手机上。TensorFlow 把每个数学运算、模型参数和更新参数的操作都画成一张数据流图里的节点，运行时把图分到多台机器的 CPU、GPU 或 TPU 上，自动插入通信。2015 年 11 月 9 日，Google 以 Apache 2.0 许可开源了它。
body.en: From 2011, Google trained neural networks with DistBelief, a parameter server system. Layers were C++ classes, so trying a new layer meant switching languages; trying a new optimizer meant changing the parameter server; and the fixed cycle of reading data, running forward and backward passes, and sending gradients did not fit recurrent networks, adversarial training, or reinforcement learning. It was also hard to scale down to a workstation or a phone. TensorFlow represents each mathematical operation, the model's parameters, and the operations that update them as nodes in one dataflow graph; the runtime places the graph on CPUs, GPUs, or TPUs across machines and inserts the communication. Google open-sourced it under the Apache 2.0 license on November 9, 2015.

detail.zh:
论文用一个手写数字分类程序说明写法。程序分两段：先搭图，声明输入的占位符和权重变量，写出矩阵乘法、ReLU 和损失，再加一个 Adagrad 优化器节点，这时什么都还没算；然后开一个会话，循环把一批批数据喂进去，执行训练节点。整个程序写完才执行，运行时就能统筹安排，比如按图里的依赖关系连续向 GPU 发出计算，不必等中间结果。

在 TensorFlow 里，参数服务器不再是单独的系统：一部分任务担任这个角色，叫 PS 任务，但它们能运行任意计算图。论文的语言模型实验里，512×40,000 的输出矩阵切开放在几个 PS 任务上，乘法和梯度就在那里算；改用抽样 softmax 后，这一层要传的数据和计算量降到原来的 1/78。任务之间可以用 TCP 上的 gRPC 通信，也可以用 RoCE。

后来的不少工具是围着它做的。2018 年 Uber 的 Horovod 论文说，TensorFlow 是他们首选的框架，但自带的参数服务器式分布式训练概念太多、扩展也不够好，于是改用 ring-allreduce。2019 年的 PyTorch 论文把 TensorFlow 和 Caffe、CNTK、Theano 归为先建静态图的框架，用来对照自己边写边算的设计。
detail.en:
The paper illustrates the style with a handwritten-digit classifier. The program has two phases. First it builds the graph: placeholders for inputs, variables for weights, a matrix multiplication, ReLU, a loss, and an Adagrad optimizer node; nothing is computed yet. Then it opens a session and repeatedly feeds in batches, running the training node. Because execution waits until the whole program is known, the runtime can plan globally, for example issuing a sequence of GPU kernels from the graph's dependencies without waiting for intermediate results.

In TensorFlow, the parameter server is no longer a separate system. Some tasks take on that role and are called PS tasks, but they can run any graph. In the paper's language-model experiment, the 512 × 40,000 output matrix was sharded across PS tasks, and the multiplication and gradient were computed there; switching to sampled softmax cut that layer's data transfer and computation by a factor of 78. Tasks communicate over gRPC on TCP or over RoCE.

Many later tools were built around it. Uber's 2018 Horovod paper calls TensorFlow its preferred framework but found the built-in parameter-server style of distributed training full of new concepts and not scaling well enough, so it switched to ring-allreduce. The 2019 PyTorch paper groups TensorFlow with Caffe, CNTK, and Theano as frameworks that build a static graph first, the contrast for its own eager design.

limit.zh: 静态图换来了优化空间，也带来了限制：动态控制流得塞进图里；论文结尾承认，一些用户已经嫌静态数据流图束手束脚，深度强化学习这类结构在运行中才展开的算法尤其如此。当时的可变状态和容错只适合一致性要求弱的应用。用数据流图表达模型也不是它首创，论文说 Theano 的编程模型和它最接近，只是限于单机。日期：开源发布是 2015 年 11 月 9 日；系统论文发表于 2016 年 11 月的 OSDI，这里的细节取自那篇论文。
limit.en: A static graph creates room for optimization but also imposes limits. Dynamic control flow had to be built into the graph, and the paper ends by noting that some users chafe at the static dataflow graph, especially for algorithms such as deep reinforcement learning whose structure unfolds at run time. Its handling of mutable state and fault tolerance suited applications with weak consistency requirements. Expressing models as dataflow graphs was not new either; the paper says Theano's programming model was the closest to its own, on a single machine. Dates: the open-source release was November 9, 2015; the system paper appeared at OSDI in November 2016, and the details here come from it.

sources: Dean and Monga · Google Research blog, open-source release of TensorFlow, 2015-11-09
Abadi et al. · TensorFlow: A system for large-scale machine learning, OSDI 2016, §§2–3, 5–6 and Figure 1
Sergeev and Del Balso · Horovod, arXiv v1, 2018-02-15, §§1–3
Paszke et al. · PyTorch, NeurIPS 2019, arXiv v1, §1

title.zh: PyTorch · 模型就是普通的 Python 程序
title.en: PyTorch · models as ordinary Python programs

body.zh: 2010 年代中期的主流框架，像 Caffe、CNTK、TensorFlow 和 Theano，都要先搭出一张静态数据流图，再拿一批批数据反复去跑。事先看到整个计算便于优化，代价是难调试，能表达的计算也受限。Chainer 已经做到写一句算一句，却慢一些；Torch、DyNet 则用了表达力弱些但更快的语言。PyTorch 是一个 Python 库：张量运算写一句就执行一句，同时自动求导、用 GPU 加速，速度和当时最快的库相当。2019 年的论文说它在 2017 年 1 月首次发布。
body.en: Popular frameworks of the mid-2010s, such as Caffe, CNTK, TensorFlow, and Theano, first built a static dataflow graph and then ran it repeatedly on batches of data. Seeing the whole computation in advance helps optimization, but it makes debugging harder and limits what can be expressed. Chainer already ran code as it was written but paid in speed, while Torch and DyNet used less expressive, faster languages. PyTorch is a Python library that executes tensor operations immediately, with automatic differentiation and GPU acceleration, at speeds comparable to the fastest libraries of the time. Its 2019 paper dates the initial release to January 2017.

detail.zh:
论文里的例子很直白：一个层就是一个 Python 类，构造函数里建好权重参数，forward 方法里做矩阵乘法、加上偏置。训练对抗网络时，生成器和判别器是两个模型，配两个优化器，一步训练就是一个普通函数，先更新判别器，再更新生成器。因为每句都立刻执行，print、调试器和 matplotlib 都照常能用，中间结果随时能看。

要在 Python 里跑得快，活大多放在底下：核心库 libtorch 用 C++ 写，算子和自动求导都在里面执行，不必握着 Python 的全局锁；GPU 显存由自己的缓存分配器反复复用。在作者测的 6 个模型上，PyTorch 的训练速度都在最快框架的 17% 以内，论文把原因归于各家都把大部分计算交给同一版本的 cuDNN 和 cuBLAS。

后来不少训练系统直接写在 PyTorch 上。2019 年 NVIDIA 的 Megatron-LM 只在原生 PyTorch 里插入少量通信操作，就实现了层内模型并行；微软的 ZeRO 也用 PyTorch 实现，用户把现有模型包一层就能用。
detail.en:
The paper's examples are plain. A layer is a Python class whose constructor creates the weight parameters and whose forward method multiplies and adds a bias. Training a generative adversarial network uses two models with two optimizers, and one training step is an ordinary function that updates the discriminator and then the generator. Because each line runs immediately, print statements, standard debuggers, and matplotlib all work, and intermediate results can be inspected at any point.

Speed comes from what sits underneath. The core library, libtorch, is written in C++ and runs operators and automatic differentiation without holding Python's global interpreter lock, and a caching allocator reuses GPU memory. On the six models the authors measured, PyTorch trained within 17% of the fastest framework, which the paper attributes to every framework offloading most of the work to the same versions of cuDNN and cuBLAS.

Several later training systems were written directly on PyTorch. NVIDIA's Megatron-LM, in 2019, implemented intra-layer model parallelism by inserting a few communication operations into native PyTorch, and Microsoft's ZeRO was also implemented in PyTorch, used by wrapping an existing model.

limit.zh: 边写边算不是它首创，论文写明这种做法先由 Chainer 和 DyNet 用于写模型。立即执行也意味着放弃事先看到整个程序才有的优化机会；作者当时正在做 PyTorch JIT，让程序能离开 Python 解释器再优化，高效的分布式原语也还列在待办里。论文的普及程度用 arXiv 论文提及次数来估计，是作者自己的统计。日期：首次发布按论文写的 2017 年 1 月；论文发表于 NeurIPS 2019，arXiv 初版是 2019 年 12 月 3 日。
limit.en: Eager execution was not PyTorch's invention; the paper credits Chainer and DyNet with pioneering it for model authoring. Running immediately also gives up optimizations that come from seeing the whole program; the authors were building a PyTorch JIT to run and optimize programs outside the Python interpreter, and efficient distributed primitives were still on the to-do list. The paper's adoption evidence, counts of arXiv mentions, is the authors' own measure. Dates: the initial release is January 2017 as stated in the 2019 paper; the paper appeared at NeurIPS 2019, with arXiv v1 dated December 3, 2019.

sources: Paszke et al. · PyTorch: An Imperative Style, High-Performance Deep Learning Library, NeurIPS 2019, arXiv v1, §§1–7
Shoeybi et al. · Megatron-LM, arXiv v1, 2019-09-17, abstract and §3
Rajbhandari et al. · ZeRO, arXiv v3, 2020-05-13, §10.1

title.zh: Spark RDD · 把中间结果留在内存里
title.en: Spark RDDs · keeping intermediate results in memory

body.zh: MapReduce 和 Dryad 让人不用操心任务分配和容错，就能在集群上写并行计算。可两个作业之间要复用数据，只能先写进分布式文件系统再读出来，复制、磁盘读写和序列化都很费时。逻辑回归、k-means、PageRank 这类迭代算法，以及反复查询同一批数据的交互分析，都被拖慢。RDD 是只读、分区的数据集，只能由 map、filter、join 这样整批的变换生成。系统记下每个数据集是怎么算出来的，某个分区丢了就照着重算，不必为了容错复制整份数据。
body.en: MapReduce and Dryad let people write parallel computations on clusters without managing work distribution or fault tolerance. But to reuse data between two jobs, the data had to be written to a distributed file system and read back, paying for replication, disk I/O, and serialization. Iterative algorithms such as logistic regression, k-means, and PageRank suffered, as did interactive analysis that queries the same data again and again. An RDD is a read-only, partitioned dataset that can only be produced by bulk transformations such as map, filter, and join. The system records how each dataset was derived, its lineage, and recomputes a lost partition from that record instead of replicating the data for fault tolerance.

detail.zh:
论文的日志排查例子只有三行：从 HDFS 读入日志，筛出以 ERROR 开头的行，再要求把结果留在内存里。第一次计数时才真正执行，之后再查含 MySQL 或 HDFS 的错误，就直接在内存里算。原始日志不进内存，只留下小得多的错误行。如果存放部分错误行的机器坏了，Spark 只把对应那段原始日志重新筛一遍。

迭代算法的差距最明显。在最多 100 台 EC2 机器上对 100 GB 数据跑 10 轮，第一轮大家都要从 HDFS 读文本；之后各轮，逻辑回归比 Hadoop 快 25.3 倍，计算更重的 k-means 也快 1.9 到 3.2 倍。另一个 75 台机器的 k-means 实验里，作者在第 6 轮开始时杀掉一台机器：那一轮从约 58 秒变成 80 秒，丢失的分区按记录重算完，下一轮又回到 58 秒；这些来历记录不到 10 KB。

后来的系统常拿它作对照。2014 年的参数服务器论文提到建在 Spark 上的 MLI，认为在迭代之间保留状态是两者共同的目标。2016 年的 TensorFlow 论文认为，Spark 适合输入装得进内存的迭代算法，但输入必须不可变，更新模型就很贵，举的例子是 SparkNet 在 5 个 worker 之间广播权重、收集更新要 20 秒。
detail.en:
The paper's log-mining example takes three lines: read logs from HDFS, keep the lines that start with ERROR, and ask for the result to persist in memory. Nothing runs until the first count; later queries for errors mentioning MySQL or HDFS work on the in-memory data. The raw logs never enter memory, only the much smaller set of error lines. If a machine holding part of those error lines fails, Spark refilters just the corresponding part of the original logs.

Iterative algorithms show the largest gap. Running 10 iterations over 100 GB on up to 100 EC2 machines, all systems read text from HDFS in the first iteration; after that, logistic regression ran 25.3 times faster than Hadoop, and the more compute-heavy k-means 1.9 to 3.2 times faster. In a separate k-means run on 75 machines, the authors killed one machine at the start of the sixth iteration. That iteration rose from about 58 seconds to 80, and once the lost partitions were rebuilt from lineage, the next one was back to 58. The lineage records were under 10 KB.

Later systems often used it as a reference point. The 2014 parameter server paper mentions MLI, built on Spark, and calls preserving state between iterations a goal both share. The 2016 TensorFlow paper says Spark suits iterative algorithms whose input fits in memory, but that immutable inputs make updating a model expensive; its example is SparkNet taking 20 seconds to broadcast weights and collect updates from five workers.

limit.zh: 论文自己划了边界：RDD 适合对整批数据做同一种操作的批处理，不适合异步、细粒度地改共享状态，比如 Web 应用的存储或增量网页爬虫，这些仍交给数据库之类的系统。来历链太长时，还得靠检查点。20 倍以上的加速是和 Hadoop 0.20.2 比、在作者自己的测试里得到的。日期：这里按 NSDI 2012 会议论文标年；论文引用了 2011 年的同名技术报告。
limit.en: The paper draws its own boundary. RDDs suit batch work that applies the same operation across a dataset, not applications that make asynchronous fine-grained updates to shared state, such as storage for a web application or an incremental web crawler, which it leaves to databases and similar systems. Long lineage chains may still need checkpoints. The speedups of 20 times and more compare against Hadoop 0.20.2 in the authors' own benchmarks. Dates: the entry uses the NSDI 2012 conference paper, which cites a 2011 technical report of the same title.

sources: Zaharia et al. · Resilient Distributed Datasets, NSDI 2012, §§1–3, 6–7
Li et al. · Parameter Server, OSDI 2014, §1.3

title.zh: 参数服务器 · 让上千台机器共享一份模型
title.en: Parameter server · one model shared by a thousand machines

body.zh: 论文开头说，现实中的训练数据在 1 TB 到 1 PB 之间，模型参数可达十亿到万亿个，广告点击预测就是典型。每台机器只处理一部分数据，却要频繁读写共享的参数，于是有三个麻烦：网络带宽吃紧；很多算法按轮同步，一台机器慢，大家都得等；规模一大，机器故障和任务被抢占就成了常事。Li 等人在 OSDI 2014 描述的参数服务器把机器分成两种：服务器节点分片保存参数，工作节点读数据、算梯度，通过 push 和 pull 与服务器交换；同步要多严格，由算法设计者决定。
body.en: The paper opens by noting that realistic training data ranges from 1 TB to 1 PB and that models can have billions to trillions of parameters; ad click prediction is a typical case. Each machine processes part of the data but must keep reading and updating shared parameters, which raises three problems: network bandwidth runs short; many algorithms synchronize in rounds, so one slow machine holds up the rest; and at scale, failures and preempted jobs are routine. The parameter server that Li and colleagues described at OSDI 2014 splits machines into two roles. Server nodes hold shards of the parameters; worker nodes read data, compute gradients, and exchange them with the servers through push and pull. The algorithm designer chooses how strict synchronization should be.

detail.zh:
以分布式梯度下降为例：每个工作节点用自己的数据算出梯度，push 给服务器；服务器把梯度加总、更新权重；工作节点再 pull 回新权重。工作节点只拉自己数据里出现过的特征对应的参数：按论文的统计，100 个工作节点时每个只需要总参数的 7.8%，10,000 个时降到 0.15%。参数被当作有序的键值对，又能像稀疏向量那样整段收发，省掉一个键值一次通信的开销。

同步程度用最大延迟 τ 来调：τ=0 就是每轮都等齐，τ 无穷大就是从不等待。在 1000 台机器（800 个工作节点、200 个服务器）、1700 亿个样本、650 亿个特征的稀疏逻辑回归上，τ=0 时工作节点一半时间在空等，τ=16 时降到 1.7%，可数据不一致让收敛要多跑几轮，作者认为 τ=8 最划算。同样的算法，他们的系统只用 300 行代码，对照的专用系统都超过一万行。

2016 年的 TensorFlow 论文梳理过这条线：这种架构出现在可扩展主题模型的研究里，DistBelief 把它用到深度网络，Li 等人的系统又加上一致性模型、容错和弹性扩缩。TensorFlow 不再单设参数服务器，而让一部分任务承担这个角色。2018 年的 Horovod 论文则指出另一面：参数服务器少了会成为瓶颈，多了又变成所有节点互相通信，于是改用 ring-allreduce。
detail.en:
Take distributed gradient descent. Each worker computes a gradient on its own data and pushes it to the servers; the servers sum the gradients and update the weights; the workers then pull the new weights. A worker pulls only the parameters for features that appear in its data: in the paper's measurement, each of 100 workers needed 7.8% of the parameters, falling to 0.15% with 10,000 workers. Parameters are treated as ordered key-value pairs that can also be sent in ranges like sparse vectors, avoiding the overhead of sending each pair separately.

Synchronization is tuned with a maximum delay τ: τ = 0 waits for everyone every round, and an unbounded τ never waits. In sparse logistic regression on 1,000 machines (800 workers and 200 servers) with 170 billion examples and 65 billion features, workers sat idle half the time at τ = 0 and only 1.7% of the time at τ = 16, but stale data meant more iterations to converge, and the authors found τ = 8 the best trade-off. Their system needed 300 lines of code for an algorithm that took more than 10,000 lines in the special-purpose systems they compared against.

The 2016 TensorFlow paper traces this line: the architecture emerged in scalable topic modeling, DistBelief applied it to deep networks, and Li and colleagues added consistency models, fault tolerance, and elastic rescaling. TensorFlow dropped the separate parameter server and let some tasks play that role. The 2018 Horovod paper points to the other side: too few parameter servers become a bottleneck, and too many create all-to-all traffic, so it switched to ring-allreduce.

limit.zh: 这篇论文自称“第三代”参数服务器：第一代是 Smola 和 Narayanamurthy 2010 年的主题模型系统，借 memcached 做同步；YahooLDA、DistBelief 算第二代。所以 2014 年不是这个想法的起点。放宽一致性也不白来，等得少了，收敛要的轮数就多了。实验覆盖稀疏逻辑回归、主题模型和计数草图，用来对照的两个专用系统出自一家大型互联网公司，其中一个由论文作者之一开发。日期：按 2014 年 10 月的 OSDI 论文标年。
limit.en: The paper calls itself a third-generation parameter server. The first generation, Smola and Narayanamurthy's 2010 topic-model system, repurposed memcached for synchronization; YahooLDA and DistBelief represent the second. So 2014 is not where the idea began. Relaxed consistency is not free either: less waiting means more iterations. The experiments cover sparse logistic regression, topic models, and count sketches, and the two special-purpose systems compared against came from a large internet company, one of them written by an author of the paper. Dates: the entry uses the OSDI paper of October 2014.

sources: Li et al. · Scaling Distributed Machine Learning with the Parameter Server, OSDI 2014, §§1–5
Sergeev and Del Balso · Horovod, arXiv v1, 2018-02-15, §3

title.zh: Horovod · 改几行代码，从单卡扩到多机
title.en: Horovod · from one GPU to many in a few lines

body.zh: Uber 的模型大多装得进一张 GPU 或一台服务器里的几张卡，但数据越来越多，有的训练要跑一周以上。TensorFlow 自带的分布式训练采用参数服务器方式：要自己启动 worker 和参数服务器、传主机和端口，还得围着一堆新概念改程序；在 128 张 Pascal GPU 上，约一半算力耗在通信上。Horovod 改用数据并行加 ring-allreduce：每张卡跑同一份程序、算自己那批数据的梯度，再在卡之间直接求平均。它在百度公开的草稿实现上改写，底层通信换成 NVIDIA 的 NCCL，用 MPI 启动进程。
body.en: Most of Uber's models fit on one GPU or on the GPUs of a single server, but datasets kept growing and some training runs took a week or more. TensorFlow's standard distributed training used parameter servers: users had to start workers and parameter servers, pass around hosts and ports, and restructure their programs around many new concepts. On 128 Pascal GPUs, about half the capacity was lost to communication. Horovod switched to data parallelism with ring-allreduce: every GPU runs the same program on its own batch, and gradients are averaged directly among the GPUs. It was built from Baidu's draft implementation, replaced the communication layer with NVIDIA's NCCL, and uses MPI to launch processes.

detail.zh:
ring-allreduce 把 N 个节点连成一圈，每个节点只和两个邻居通信，一共 2(N−1) 次，每次收发缓冲区里的一块：前 N−1 次把收到的值加到自己的缓冲区上，后 N−1 次用收到的值覆盖。缓冲区足够大时，这种做法能把网络带宽用满。

改一个单卡 TensorFlow 程序只要四处：调用 hvd.init() 初始化；按本机编号给每个进程分一张 GPU；用 hvd.DistributedOptimizer 包住原来的优化器，由它负责求平均；开始时从 0 号进程广播变量，保证各卡初始值一致。然后用 mpirun 在 4 台服务器、每台 4 张卡上同时启动 16 份程序。ResNet-101 这类层多的模型会产生大量很小的 allreduce，Horovod 先把它们拼进一个默认 64 MB 的缓冲区再发，在普通 TCP 网络上最多快了 65%。

按 Uber 的测试，Inception V3 和 ResNet-101 的扩展效率达到 88%，大约是标准分布式 TensorFlow 的两倍。换成支持 RDMA 的网卡，这两个模型只多了 3% 到 4%；参数多、层数少的 VGG-16 却快了 30%，因为它的瓶颈已经从计算转到通信。
detail.en:
Ring-allreduce arranges N nodes in a ring. Each node talks only to its two neighbors, 2(N−1) times in all, sending and receiving one chunk of the buffer each time. In the first N−1 steps, received values are added to the local buffer; in the second N−1 steps, they replace it. With a large enough buffer, this makes full use of the available network bandwidth.

Converting a single-GPU TensorFlow program takes four changes: call hvd.init(); assign each process one GPU by its local rank; wrap the existing optimizer in hvd.DistributedOptimizer, which averages the gradients; and broadcast variables from process 0 at the start so every copy begins identically. Then mpirun starts 16 copies across four servers with four GPUs each. Models with many layers, such as ResNet-101, generate many tiny allreduce operations, so Horovod first packs them into a fusion buffer, 64 MB by default, which gave up to a 65% improvement on an ordinary TCP network.

In Uber's benchmarks, Inception V3 and ResNet-101 reached 88% scaling efficiency, about twice as fast as standard distributed TensorFlow. RDMA-capable network cards added only 3 to 4% for those two models but sped up VGG-16 by 30%: its many parameters and few layers shift the bottleneck from computation to communication.

limit.zh: ring-allreduce 不是 Horovod 发明的：论文写明算法来自 Patarasuk 和 Yuan 2009 年的工作，2017 年由百度推广并给出 TensorFlow 的草稿实现。当时 Horovod 只支持一台服务器装得下的模型；在集群上装 MPI 也不轻松，作者把它列为待改进项。所有加速数字都来自 Uber 自己在 Pascal GPU、25GbE 网络上的测试。日期：按 arXiv 初版 2018 年 2 月 15 日标年；代码最早何时开源，这里没有核对。
limit.en: Horovod did not invent ring-allreduce. The paper traces the algorithm to Patarasuk and Yuan's 2009 work and to Baidu, which promoted it in 2017 with a draft TensorFlow implementation. At the time Horovod supported only models that fit in one server, and installing MPI on a cluster still took effort, which the authors list as work to do. All speedups come from Uber's own tests on Pascal GPUs over 25GbE. Dates: the entry uses arXiv v1 of February 15, 2018; when the code was first released was not checked here.

sources: Sergeev and Del Balso · Horovod: fast and easy distributed deep learning in TensorFlow, arXiv v1, 2018-02-15

title.zh: Megatron-LM · 把一层 Transformer 拆到多张卡上
title.en: Megatron-LM · splitting each Transformer layer across GPUs

body.zh: 到 2019 年，语言模型越做越大，单张 GPU 的显存装不下，Adam 这类优化器还要给每个参数多存动量等状态。已有的模型并行框架，比如 GPipe 和 Mesh-TensorFlow，要重写模型，还依赖仍在开发中的专用编译器和框架。NVIDIA 的 Megatron-LM 换了做法：利用 Transformer 层内部的结构，把注意力和 MLP 里的矩阵乘法按列、按行切到同一台服务器的几张卡上，只在原生 PyTorch 里加几处通信操作。他们用 512 张 V100 训练了一个 83 亿参数的语言模型。
body.en: By 2019 language models were outgrowing the memory of a single GPU, and optimizers such as Adam store extra state, such as momentum, for every parameter. Existing model-parallel frameworks such as GPipe and Mesh-TensorFlow required rewriting the model and relied on custom compilers and frameworks still under development. NVIDIA's Megatron-LM took another route. It used the structure inside each Transformer layer to split the matrix multiplications in attention and the MLP by columns and rows across the GPUs of one server, adding only a few communication operations in native PyTorch. With it, the team trained an 8.3-billion-parameter language model on 512 V100 GPUs.

detail.zh:
以 MLP 为例：先乘矩阵 A，再过 GeLU。按行切 A，每张卡得到的只是部分和，要先加起来才能过 GeLU，中间得同步一次；按列切，每张卡各算一半输出、各自过 GeLU，不用通信。第二个矩阵再按行切，直接接住上一步各自的输出，最后一次 all-reduce 把结果加起来。注意力按头切，每张卡算自己那几个头。这样一层 Transformer 前向只要两次 all-reduce，反向也是两次。论文给出的通信算子 f 只有几行：前向原样返回，反向对梯度做 all-reduce。

实际训练时，一台 DGX-2H 服务器里经 NVSwitch 相连的 8 张卡组成一个模型并行组，64 个这样的组再做数据并行，一共 512 张卡。单卡基线每秒 39 万亿次浮点运算，是峰值的 30%；整套系统持续每秒 15.1 千万亿次，扩展效率 76%。83 亿参数的模型用 174 GB 文本训练了 9.2 天。

微软的 ZeRO 论文拿 NVIDIA 2019 年 9 月开源的 Megatron-LM 作对照，也把 ZeRO 的数据并行和 Megatron 的模型并行组合起来实验，报告在 400 张 V100 上能跑最多 1700 亿参数的模型。它也量出了单靠模型并行的边界：400 亿参数的模型用 Megatron-LM 跨两台 DGX-2 节点，每张卡只有约每秒 5 万亿次，不到峰值的 5%。
detail.en:
Take the MLP: multiply by a matrix A, then apply GeLU. Splitting A by rows leaves each GPU with a partial sum that must be added before GeLU, forcing a synchronization. Splitting A by columns lets each GPU compute half the outputs and apply GeLU on its own. The second matrix is then split by rows, consuming those outputs directly, and a single all-reduce sums the results. Attention is split by heads, with each GPU computing its own. A Transformer layer then needs only two all-reduces in the forward pass and two in the backward pass. The paper's communication operator f takes a few lines: the forward pass returns its input unchanged, and the backward pass all-reduces the gradient.

In training, the eight GPUs of one DGX-2H server, linked by NVSwitch, formed a model-parallel group, and 64 such groups ran data parallelism, 512 GPUs in all. The single-GPU baseline sustained 39 teraFLOPS, 30% of peak; the full system sustained 15.1 petaFLOPS, a scaling efficiency of 76%. The 8.3-billion-parameter model trained on 174 GB of text for 9.2 days.

Microsoft's ZeRO paper used the Megatron-LM code NVIDIA open-sourced in September 2019 as a baseline and also combined ZeRO's data parallelism with Megatron's model parallelism, reporting models of up to 170 billion parameters on 400 V100 GPUs. It also measured the limit of model parallelism alone: a 40-billion-parameter model spread across two DGX-2 nodes with Megatron-LM ran at about 5 teraFLOPS per GPU, under 5% of peak.

limit.zh: 层内切分要频繁通信，只在服务器内部的高速互连上划算，论文里的模型并行组都在一台机器内；跨节点后效率掉得很快，这也是 ZeRO 后来要解决的问题之一。它也没解决优化器状态占内存的问题，作者在结尾把更省内存的优化器列为继续扩大规模的前提。“迄今最大的 Transformer”是作者 2019 年 9 月时的说法。日期：数字取自 2019 年 9 月 17 日的 arXiv 初版。
limit.en: Intra-layer splitting communicates constantly and pays off only over fast links inside a server; the paper's model-parallel groups all sit within one machine, and efficiency drops quickly across nodes, one of the problems ZeRO later addressed. It also left optimizer memory unsolved; the authors name more memory-efficient optimizers as a requirement for further scaling. The claim of the largest Transformer ever trained was the authors' own as of September 2019. Dates: figures come from arXiv v1, dated September 17, 2019.

sources: Shoeybi et al. · Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism, arXiv v1, 2019-09-17, §§1–3, 5–6
Rajbhandari et al. · ZeRO, arXiv v3, 2020-05-13, §§1 and 10

title.zh: 感知机 · 让随机连线的网络学会分类
title.en: Perceptron · a randomly wired network that learns to classify

body.zh: 当时不少大脑模型借用开关电路和符号逻辑，把“回忆”“比较”写成事先设计好的线路。Rosenblatt 认为，这套语言不适合分析一个充满随机连接、元件也不完美的网络。1958 年他在 Psychological Review 上提出感知机：感光点接到一层随机连线的联想单元，联想单元再连到几个响应单元。某次刺激激活的联想单元如果得到强化，它们的“价值”就会升高，同一刺激再出现时，原来的响应更容易胜出。整套分析用的是概率论，不是布尔代数。
body.en: Many brain models of the time borrowed from switching circuits and symbolic logic, treating recall and comparison as wiring laid out in advance. Rosenblatt argued that this language was poorly suited to a network full of random connections and imperfect parts. In a 1958 Psychological Review article he proposed the perceptron: light-sensitive points feed a layer of randomly connected association units, which connect in turn to a few response units. When the association units activated by a stimulus are reinforced, their “value” rises, and the same stimulus becomes more likely to win the same response next time. The analysis used probability theory rather than Boolean algebra.

detail.zh:
设想一个只有两个响应的感知机，一个代表“方”，一个代表“圆”。一张图照到感光点上，会点亮一部分联想单元；两个响应各自汇总连到自己的那批单元，信号强的一方胜出，并通过抑制连接压住对方。强化胜出一方的活跃单元，同一张图再出现时，这个响应更容易再赢。论文的结论写得很具体：如果同一类刺激彼此相似、会点亮许多相同的单元，没见过的新图也能以高于随机的概率归对类；如果刺激完全随机，就谈不上推广，而且记住的东西越多，答对率越往随机水平回落。

理论之外，Rosenblatt 提到在康奈尔航空实验室的 IBM 704 上做了一系列模拟，结果符合理论的主要预测，细节另行发表。他也写明了边界：感知机能学会对具体刺激作出反应，连“在左边就说颜色、在右边就说形状”这种组合条件也能学；可一旦要判断刺激之间的关系，比如“说出方块左边那个东西”，问题就变得极难。他的结论是，光靠统计可分性不足以支撑更高层的抽象。

24 年后，Hopfield 1982 年的论文专门拿感知机作对照：感知机的连接主要是单向往前的，带强反馈的网络当时难以分析，而且模型假设所有单元同步更新。Hopfield 网络的结果恰恰来自强反馈和异步更新。
detail.en:
Picture a perceptron with two responses, one for “square” and one for “circle”. An image falling on the sensory points activates some of the association units. Each response sums the units wired to it; the stronger one wins and suppresses its rival through inhibitory connections. Reinforcing the winner's active units makes that response more likely to win again for the same image. The paper's conclusions are specific. If stimuli within a class resemble one another and activate many of the same units, an unseen image can be classified correctly with better-than-chance probability. If stimuli are purely random, there is no basis for generalization, and accuracy drifts back toward chance as more stimuli are learned.

Beyond the theory, Rosenblatt reported a series of simulations on an IBM 704 at the Cornell Aeronautical Laboratory, saying they bore out the main predictions and would be described separately. He also stated a boundary. A perceptron could learn responses to concrete stimuli, even with combined conditions such as naming the color if a shape is on the left and the shape if it is on the right. Once a response required a relation between stimuli, such as “name the object left of the square”, the problem became excessively difficult. Statistical separability alone, he concluded, was not a sufficient basis for higher-order abstraction.

Twenty-four years later, Hopfield's 1982 paper used the perceptron as its point of contrast. Perceptrons were modeled mainly with forward connections, networks with strong backward coupling had proved intractable to analyze, and the models assumed synchronous units. Hopfield's results came precisely from strong feedback and asynchronous updates.

limit.zh: 这里的感知机是一套关于大脑可能怎样储存信息的理论。论文用神经生理学的说法写学习规则：联想单元的“价值”随强化升降；分析的模型里，感光点到联想单元的随机连线是固定的。别把它直接等同于教科书里用向量和权重写成的版本。Rosenblatt 自己也承认它处理不了关系判断。它也不是最早的神经网络模型，作者就把 McCulloch 和 Pitts 等人的工作列为此前的逻辑式模型。日期：论文 1958 年 4 月 23 日收稿，刊于 Psychological Review 第 65 卷第 6 期第 386–408 页；作者注明它改写自同年康奈尔航空实验室的报告 VG-1196-G-1，研究由美国海军研究办公室资助。
limit.en: The perceptron here is a theory of how a brain might store information. The paper states its learning rules in neurophysiological terms, as association-unit “values” rising and falling with reinforcement; in the models analyzed, the random wiring from sensory points to association units stays fixed. It should not be equated directly with the textbook version written in vectors and weights. Rosenblatt himself admitted it could not handle relational judgments. Nor was it the earliest neural model: he lists the work of McCulloch and Pitts among earlier, logic-based models. Dates: received April 23, 1958, and published in Psychological Review, vol. 65, no. 6, pp. 386–408. The author notes that it adapts a Cornell Aeronautical Laboratory report of the same year (VG-1196-G-1); the work was sponsored by the Office of Naval Research.

sources: Rosenblatt · The Perceptron, Psychological Review 65(6), 1958, pp. 386–408 · DOI record
Same article · scan of the journal pages hosted at UIC; organization, learning rules, IBM 704 note, conclusions
Hopfield · PNAS 1982, p. 2555 comparison with perceptrons · CaltechAUTHORS PDF

title.zh: Hopfield 网络 · 从残缺线索回到完整记忆
title.en: Hopfield network · recovering a whole memory from a fragment

body.zh: 计算机按地址取数据；按内容取回，比如只给半条参考文献就找出整条，当时的硬件只做得出很简单的形式。线性联想网络还有个毛病：输入两种模式的混合，输出也是两个答案的混合。1982 年，任职于 Caltech 和贝尔实验室的 Hopfield 提出一种网络：N 个只有开、关两种状态的单元相互连接，连接强度由要存的模式算出，每个单元随机、异步地按阈值更新。连接对称时可以定义一个“能量”，每次更新只会让它下降，状态最后停在某个局部最低点，也就是某条存进去的记忆附近。
body.en: Computers fetch data by address. Retrieving by content, such as recovering a full reference from half of it, existed in hardware only in quite simple forms. Linear associative networks had another weakness: give them a blend of two input patterns and they returned a blend of two answers. In 1982 Hopfield, then at Caltech and Bell Laboratories, proposed a network of N interconnected units, each simply on or off. The connection strengths are computed from the patterns to be stored, and each unit updates itself against a threshold at random, asynchronous times. With symmetric connections one can define an “energy” that every update can only lower, so the state settles into a local minimum near one of the stored memories.

detail.zh:
论文开头的例子很好懂：存进去一条参考文献“H. A. Kramers & G. H. Wannier Phys. Rev. 60, 252 (1941)”，理想的内容寻址存储只凭“& Wannier, (1941)”就能取回整条，哪怕拼成“Vannier, (1941)”也行。在网络里，每条记忆是一串 0 和 1；从一个差了几位的状态出发，单元一个个翻转，能量一路往下走，最后落回那条记忆。模拟中 N = 30、存 5 条记忆时，起点离最近的记忆不超过 5 位，九成以上能回到这条记忆。

容量很有限。论文估计大约能同时存 0.15N 条记忆，再多就错得厉害：N = 100 时存 5 条几乎总能原样取回，存 15 条只有一半左右停在错误少于 5 位的状态。两条记忆只差 10 位时常常被融成一个；硬塞进 500 条，一条都稳不住。和线性网络相比，它的长处是会“做选择”：给 0.6 份 S1 加 0.4 份 S2 的混合输入，它多半直接给出 S1 对应的结果。

2024 年 10 月 8 日，瑞典皇家科学院把诺贝尔物理学奖授予 Hopfield 和 Hinton。公告介绍说，Hopfield 网络借用描述原子自旋的物理，让存好的图像处在能量低处；Hinton 则以 Hopfield 网络为基础，发展出另一种网络——玻尔兹曼机。
detail.en:
The paper opens with a clear example. Suppose the stored item is the reference “H. A. Kramers & G. H. Wannier Phys. Rev. 60, 252 (1941)”. An ideal content-addressable memory could retrieve the whole entry from “& Wannier, (1941)”, or even from the misspelled “Vannier, (1941)”. In the network, each memory is a string of 0s and 1s. Start from a state a few bits away, let units flip one at a time, and the energy keeps falling until the state lands back on that memory. In simulations with N = 30 and five stored memories, a start within 5 bits of the nearest memory reached it more than 90% of the time.

Capacity is limited. The paper estimates that about 0.15N memories can be held at once before recall errors become severe. With N = 100, five memories were almost always recalled exactly; with 15, only about half settled within 5 bits of the original. Memories only 10 bits apart were often fused into one, and with 500 stored, none remained stable. Compared with linear networks, its strength is that it makes choices: fed a mixture of 0.6 parts S1 and 0.4 parts S2, it usually returns the output for S1.

On October 8, 2024, the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics to Hopfield and Hinton. Its announcement explains that the Hopfield network borrows the physics of atomic spin and gives stored images low energy, and that Hinton built on the Hopfield network to develop a different kind of network, the Boltzmann machine.

limit.zh: 它是联想记忆，不会自己学出隐藏特征：论文假定连接强度已由此前的经验（或遗传）按类似 Hebb 规则的方式设好，存的模式也取随机的 0/1 串。除了存进去的记忆，网络还会停在一些没有明显意义的稳定状态；N = 30 的一组试验里约一成落在这种状态。论文还试过让网络依次走过一串状态，超过四个状态的序列做不出来。日期：1982 年 1 月 15 日提交，同年 4 月刊于 PNAS 第 79 卷第 8 期。
limit.en: This is an associative memory, not a network that learns hidden features. The paper assumes the connection strengths were already set by earlier experience (or inheritance) through a Hebb-like rule, and its stored patterns are random strings of 0s and 1s. Besides the stored memories, the network can settle into stable states with no obvious meaning; in one set of N = 30 trials, about one in ten ended there. Attempts to make the network step through a sequence of states failed beyond four states. Dates: contributed January 15, 1982, and published in PNAS, vol. 79, no. 8, in April 1982.

sources: Hopfield · Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities, PNAS 79(8), April 1982
Same paper · CaltechAUTHORS PDF; model, storage rule, energy function, simulations, Discussion
Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences · Nobel Prize in Physics 2024 press release, 2024-10-08

title.zh: 翻译里的 attention · 不再把整句压成一个向量
title.en: Attention for translation · no longer squeezing a sentence into one vector

body.zh: 2014 年的神经机器翻译多是编码器—解码器：一个循环网络读完原句，把它压成一个固定长度的向量，另一个网络再从这个向量生成译文。句子一长，这个向量就装不下，Cho 等人已经发现译文质量随句长迅速下降。Bahdanau、Cho 和 Bengio 换了做法：编码器给原句每个词都留一个向量，解码器每生成一个词，先给原句所有位置打分，再按权重取加权和。权重和整个翻译模型一起训练，作者说，这相当于让解码器有了 attention 机制。
body.en: Neural machine translation in 2014 mostly used an encoder–decoder: one recurrent network read the source sentence and compressed it into a fixed-length vector, and another generated the translation from that vector. Long sentences did not fit, and Cho and colleagues had already shown that quality dropped quickly with length. Bahdanau, Cho, and Bengio changed the arrangement. The encoder keeps a vector for every source word, and before producing each target word the decoder scores all source positions and takes a weighted sum. The weights are trained jointly with the rest of the translation model; the authors describe this as giving the decoder a mechanism of attention.

detail.zh:
论文的对齐图很直观。英文 European Economic Area 译成法文 zone économique européenne，词序是反的：模型生成 zone 时直接跳过前两个词去看 Area，接着再一个词一个词往回看。the man 译成 l' homme 时，硬对齐只会把 the 配给 l'，可法语冠词选 le、la、les 还是 l'，得看后面的名词；软对齐让模型同时看 the 和 man，选对了 l'。

在 WMT'14 英法测试集上，用 50 词以内句子训练的 RNNsearch-50 得到 26.75 BLEU，同样设置的编码器—解码器只有 17.82。句子越长，后者分数掉得越厉害，前者到 50 词以上也没有下滑。只看不含生僻词的句子，训练更久的版本（36.15）和短语翻译系统 Moses（35.63）相当，而 Moses 还额外用了 4.18 亿词的单语语料。

后来的系统沿用了这个想法。2016 年 Google 的 GNMT 写明自己的 attention 模块与这篇论文类似；2017 年的 Transformer 把它叫作加性 attention，列为当时最常用的两种 attention 之一，自己改用缩放点积，并且整个去掉了循环网络。
detail.en:
The paper's alignment plots make this concrete. “European Economic Area” becomes “zone économique européenne”, in reverse order: when producing “zone” the model skips the first two words to look at “Area”, then steps back one word at a time. For “the man” → “l' homme”, a hard alignment would pair “the” only with “l'”, yet choosing among le, la, les, and l' depends on the following noun. The soft alignment lets the model look at both “the” and “man”, and it chooses “l'” correctly.

On the WMT'14 English–French test set, RNNsearch-50, trained on sentences of up to 50 words, scored 26.75 BLEU against 17.82 for the encoder–decoder trained the same way. The longer the sentence, the further the latter fell; the former showed no drop even beyond 50 words. On sentences without unknown words, a longer-trained version (36.15) matched the phrase-based Moses system (35.63), even though Moses also used a separate 418-million-word monolingual corpus.

Later systems kept the idea. Google's GNMT in 2016 described its attention module as similar to this paper's. The 2017 Transformer called it additive attention and listed it as one of the two most commonly used attention functions, then used scaled dot-product attention instead and dropped recurrence altogether.

limit.zh: attention 要为译文的每个词把原句每个词的权重都算一遍。作者指出，翻译里的句子多在 15–40 词，这点开销还能接受，换到别的任务可能就成了限制。词表只有 3 万个常用词，其余一律记作 [UNK]，生僻词被列为留待解决的问题；在包含生僻词的全部测试句上，它的 BLEU 仍低于 Moses。它也不是第一个让输出对齐输入的神经网络：作者引用了 Graves 2013 年的手写合成工作，那里的对齐只能单调向前。日期：arXiv 初版是 2014 年 9 月 1 日，后来作为 ICLR 2015 口头报告；这里的数字取自初版。
limit.en: Attention computes a weight for every source word at every target word. The authors note that this is acceptable in translation, where most sentences run 15–40 words, but may limit other tasks. The vocabulary held only the 30,000 most frequent words, with the rest mapped to [UNK], and rare words were named as an open problem; on the full test set, unknown words included, BLEU stayed below Moses. Nor was this the first network to align outputs with inputs: the authors cite Graves's 2013 handwriting synthesis, whose alignment could only move forward. Dates: the first arXiv version is September 1, 2014, and the paper was later presented orally at ICLR 2015; figures here come from the first version.

arXiv · version history and ICLR 2015 note
GNMT · arXiv v1, 2016-09-26, §3 on the attention module
