title.zh: Deep Blue · 用专用芯片把棋搜得更深
title.en: Deep Blue · custom chips for deeper chess search

body.zh: 国际象棋程序早就靠搜博弈树下棋：往后推几步，用评估函数给局面打分。难处在于强手能算得比任何均匀展开的搜索都深，而评估做得越细，搜索就越慢。1996 年 2 月，第一版 Deep Blue 以 2:4 输给世界冠军卡斯帕罗夫。IBM 团队重新设计了芯片：1997 年的机器由 30 个节点的 IBM SP 计算机带 480 块象棋专用芯片，每块每秒搜 200 万到 250 万个局面；评估特征从约 6400 个增加到 8000 多个，搜索也刻意不均匀，在关键变化上走得更深。1997 年 5 月，它以 3.5:2.5 赢下重赛。
body.en: Chess programs had long played by searching the game tree: look a few moves ahead and score positions with an evaluation function. The hard part was that strong players can calculate deeper than any uniform search, while a richer evaluation slows the search down. In February 1996 the first Deep Blue lost to world champion Garry Kasparov 4–2. The IBM team redesigned the chip. The 1997 machine paired a 30-node IBM SP computer with 480 custom chess chips, each searching 2 to 2.5 million positions per second; its evaluation grew from about 6,400 features to over 8,000, and its search was deliberately uneven, going deeper on critical lines. In May 1997 it won the rematch 3.5–2.5.

detail.zh:
一步棋是这样定的：一个 SP 节点当总管，搜博弈树最上面几层，把末端局面分给其余节点；这些节点再往下搜几层，把局面交给各自挂着的 16 块芯片，由芯片搜最后几层，并用硬件评估打分。速度随局面变化很大：战术复杂的局面平均每秒约 1 亿个，平静的局面接近 2 亿；1997 年比赛中，超过一分钟的搜索平均每秒 1.26 亿个。IBM 介绍里的“每秒 2 亿个局面”，和平静局面的典型速度相当，整场比赛的平均要低一些。

棋的知识大多是人放进去的。开局库约 4000 个局面，主要由特级大师 Joel Benjamin 手工整理；库外则参考 70 万盘特级大师对局，给常见走法加一点分：比如开局给 d4 加 10 分，它照常搜索，只要 d4 不比最好的着法差 10 分以上就选它。8000 多个评估特征的权重也大多手调，只有少数地方用了自动工具；一个比较训练工具发现兵阵掩护的手调权重系统性偏低，1997 年赛前因此调高。

2016 年 AlphaGo 的论文拿它作对照：对樊麾时，AlphaGo 评估的局面比 Deep Blue 对卡斯帕罗夫时少几千倍，靠策略网络把局面挑得更准、价值网络把局面评得更准来弥补；Deep Blue 依赖手写的评估函数，AlphaGo 的网络则直接从对局中训练。
detail.en:
Here is how a move was chosen. One SP node acted as master, searching the top levels of the tree and handing leaf positions to the other nodes. These searched a few more levels and passed positions to their 16 chips each, which searched the last levels and scored positions with hardware evaluation. Speed varied with the position: about 100 million positions per second in tactical positions, close to 200 million in quiet ones, and an average of 126 million in searches longer than a minute during the 1997 match. The “200 million positions per second” in IBM's description matches the typical quiet-position speed; the match average was lower.

Most of the chess knowledge was put in by people. The opening book, about 4,000 positions, was prepared by hand, mainly by grandmaster Joel Benjamin. Beyond the book, a summary of 700,000 grandmaster games nudged the search toward common moves: give d4 a 10-point bonus in the opening position, and Deep Blue searches as usual but picks d4 unless it is more than 10 points worse than the best alternative. The weights of the 8,000-plus evaluation features were also mostly tuned by hand, with automated tools in only a few places. One comparison-training tool found the hand-tuned pawn-shelter weights systematically too low, and they were raised before the 1997 match.

The 2016 AlphaGo paper used Deep Blue as a contrast. Against Fan Hui, AlphaGo evaluated thousands of times fewer positions than Deep Blue had against Kasparov, compensating by selecting positions more intelligently with its policy network and evaluating them more precisely with its value network. Deep Blue relied on a handcrafted evaluation function, whereas AlphaGo's networks were trained directly from games.

limit.zh: 这是一台只会下国际象棋的机器。走子生成和评估都固化在芯片里，评估特征加不进新的。作者写道，调参远没有完成，加入剪枝也许能明显改进搜索。它主要靠搜索和人放进去的知识，学习只用在少数权重的调整上。IBM 称它是第一台在标准比赛时限的对抗赛中击败在任世界冠军的计算机，这是 IBM 的表述。日期：首赛 1996 年 2 月在费城，重赛 1997 年 5 月在纽约；系统论文 2002 年 1 月发表于 Artificial Intelligence 第 134 卷。
limit.en: This was a machine for chess and nothing else. Move generation and evaluation were fixed in the chip, so no new evaluation features could be added. The authors wrote that tuning was far from complete and that adding pruning might have improved the search significantly. It relied mainly on search and human-supplied knowledge; learning entered only in tuning a few weights. IBM describes it as the first computer system to defeat a reigning world champion in a match under standard tournament time controls; that is IBM's wording. Dates: the first match was in Philadelphia in February 1996 and the rematch in New York in May 1997; the system paper appeared in Artificial Intelligence, vol. 134, in January 2002.

sources: Campbell, Hoane & Hsu · Deep Blue, Artificial Intelligence 134 (2002) 57–83 · DOI record
IBM Heritage · Deep Blue, 1996 and 1997 matches
Silver et al. · AlphaGo, Nature 2016 · DeepMind-hosted PDF, Discussion

title.zh: GNMT · 神经翻译进入 Google 翻译
title.en: GNMT · neural translation in Google Translate

body.zh: 到 2016 年，带 attention 的神经机器翻译在研究基准上已追近短语翻译系统，但要上线还卡在三处：训练和翻译都慢，生僻词处理不好，有时还会漏译原句的一部分。Google 的 GNMT 逐项处理：编码器和解码器各 8 层 LSTM，层间加残差连接；attention 从解码器底层接到编码器顶层，方便多块 GPU 并行；词被切成 8000 到 32000 个“词片”；推理用低精度运算，放在 TPU 上跑。2016 年 9 月 27 日，Google 翻译网页版和手机应用的中译英全部改用 GNMT，每天约 1800 万次翻译。
body.en: By 2016, neural machine translation with attention was closing in on phrase-based systems on research benchmarks, but deployment was held back in three ways: training and translation were slow, rare words were handled poorly, and the output sometimes left parts of the source untranslated. Google's GNMT tackled each one. Its encoder and decoder each had eight LSTM layers with residual connections between them; attention linked the bottom decoder layer to the top encoder layer so the work could be spread across GPUs; words were split into a vocabulary of 8,000 to 32,000 “wordpieces”; and inference used low-precision arithmetic on TPUs. On September 27, 2016, the Google Translate web and mobile apps switched all Chinese-to-English machine translation to GNMT, about 18 million translations a day.

detail.zh:
词片的例子来自论文：Jet makers feud over seat width with big orders at stake 被切成 _J et _makers _fe ud _over _seat _width _with _big _orders _at _stake。不常见的 Jet 和 feud 各拆成两块，常见词保持完整，下划线标出词的开头。这样既不用专门处理词表外的词，序列也不会像逐字符建模那样拉得很长；原文和译文共用一套词片，人名、数字这类该照抄的内容也容易直接抄过去。

除了 BLEU，论文还请双语评分员按 0 到 6 分给译文打分。英译中上，旧的短语系统平均 4.035 分，GNMT 4.594 分，人工译文 4.987 分；表中的“相对提升”58%，与 GNMT 补上的那段分差所占的比例相符，摘要里“错误减少约 60%”说的就是这类数字。用强化学习直接优化 BLEU 能提高分数，人工评分却看不出差别，所以生产数据上的实验没有用它。

第二年的 Transformer 论文把 GNMT 列为对照基线（加强化学习的单模型，英德 24.6 BLEU），英法实验还沿用了 GNMT 的 32000 词片词表。
detail.en:
The paper's wordpiece example: “Jet makers feud over seat width with big orders at stake” becomes “_J et _makers _fe ud _over _seat _width _with _big _orders _at _stake”. The less common “Jet” and “feud” each split in two, common words stay whole, and the underscore marks the start of a word. No special handling is needed for out-of-vocabulary words, and sequences stay far shorter than with character-by-character modeling. Because source and target share one wordpiece vocabulary, names and numbers that should simply be copied can pass straight through.

Besides BLEU, bilingual raters scored translations from 0 to 6. For English to Chinese, the old phrase-based system averaged 4.035, GNMT 4.594, and human translation 4.987. The table's “relative improvement” of 58% matches the share of that gap GNMT closed, and the abstract's “about 60% fewer errors” refers to figures of this kind. Reinforcement learning aimed directly at BLEU raised the scores but made no difference to human ratings, so it was left out of the production-data experiments.

The following year, the Transformer paper listed GNMT as a baseline (24.6 BLEU on English–German for a single model with RL), and its English–French experiments reused GNMT's 32,000-wordpiece vocabulary.

limit.zh: Google 自己的博客也写明，GNMT 仍会犯人类译者不会犯的大错：漏词，把人名和生僻术语译错，而且一句一句孤立地翻，不看段落和页面的上下文。人工评测用的是从维基百科和新闻网站抽出的 500 个较简单的单句，作者把更难的句子和更长的输入留待以后测试；“接近普通双语译者”只在这些测试集上成立。日期：arXiv 初版 2016 年 9 月 26 日，上线公告次日发布；当时上线的只有中译英一个方向。
limit.en: Google's own blog post said GNMT could still make significant errors a human translator never would, such as dropping words and mistranslating proper names or rare terms, and that it translated sentences in isolation, without the context of the paragraph or page. The human evaluation used 500 relatively simple, isolated sentences sampled from Wikipedia and news sites, and the authors left harder cases and longer inputs for future work. The claim of approaching average bilingual translators holds only for those test sets. Dates: the first arXiv version is September 26, 2016, and the launch post followed a day later; only the Chinese-to-English direction went live then.

sources: Wu et al. · Google's Neural Machine Translation System, arXiv v1, 2016-09-26, §§1, 3–4, 6, 8 and Table 10
Google Research blog · A Neural Network for Machine Translation, at Production Scale, 2016-09-27
Attention Is All You Need · arXiv v1, 2017-06-12, Table 2 and §5.1

title.zh: YouTube 深度推荐 · 先召回几百个，再排序
title.en: YouTube recommendations · retrieve hundreds, then rank

body.zh: YouTube 的视频有几百万个，每秒还有好几小时的新视频上传，系统要从中给每个用户挑出几十个；用户到底满不满意几乎无从得知，只能看观看记录这类带噪声的隐式反馈。之前的推荐系统用矩阵分解。2016 年 Google 的这篇论文介绍了换成深度网络后的两段式系统：候选生成网络把用户的观看和搜索历史压成一个向量，在几十毫秒内从几百万个视频里找出几百个；排序网络再用几百个特征给它们打分，目标是预计观看时长，而不是点击率。
body.en: YouTube has to pick a few dozen videos for each user from millions, with many hours more uploaded every second, and it almost never learns how satisfied users really are, only noisy implicit signals such as watch histories. The previous recommender used matrix factorization. This 2016 Google paper described the two-stage system that replaced it with deep networks. A candidate-generation network compresses a user's watch and search history into a vector and, within tens of milliseconds, pulls a few hundred videos out of millions. A ranking network then scores those with hundreds of features, aiming at expected watch time rather than click-through rate.

detail.zh:
候选生成被写成一个超大的分类问题：在几百万个视频里，预测这个用户下一个会看完哪个。最近 50 次观看的视频向量取平均，最近 50 次搜索的词向量也取平均，再拼上地区、设备、性别等特征，送进几层 ReLU。训练时每个样本只抽几千个负类，比完整的 softmax 快 100 倍以上；上线时不算概率，直接在点积空间里做近似最近邻查找。作者说，学视频向量的做法受了连续词袋（CBOW）语言模型的启发。

论文还记下了几条踩过的坑。用户刚搜了“taylor swift”，模型如果知道这次搜索，就会把搜索结果页原样搬到首页，效果很差，所以搜索词被打散成无序的词袋。按“预测下一次观看”构造样本，比从历史里随机挖掉一条再去猜要好，后者会把未来的信息漏给模型。新视频则靠“样本年龄”这个特征处理，上线时设为 0，免得模型偏向过去。按点击率排序会抬高用户点进去却不看完的“标题党”视频，所以排序改用按观看时长加权的逻辑回归。

层数有用，但要付服务器的账。排序网络不加隐藏层时，按观看时长加权的误排比例是 41.6%；1024→512→256 三层降到 34.6%，这也是 CPU 预算之内效果最好的配置。如果去掉观看时长加权、让正负样本一视同仁，这项损失会增加 4.1%。
detail.en:
Candidate generation is posed as an enormous classification problem: among millions of videos, which one will this user watch to completion next? The embeddings of the 50 most recent watches are averaged, as are those of the 50 most recent search tokens, and the results are concatenated with features such as region, device, and gender before passing through several ReLU layers. Training samples only several thousand negative classes per example, more than 100 times faster than a full softmax. At serving time no probabilities are computed; the system runs an approximate nearest-neighbor search in dot-product space. The authors say the video embeddings were inspired by continuous bag-of-words language models.

The paper also records several hard-won lessons. If the model sees that a user just searched for “taylor swift”, it reproduces that search results page as homepage recommendations, which performs poorly, so searches enter as an unordered bag of tokens. Building examples that predict the next watch works better than holding out a random watch from the history, which leaks future information. Fresh videos are handled with an “example age” feature, set to zero at serving time so the model does not lean toward the past. Ranking by click-through rate promotes “clickbait” that users click but do not finish, so the ranker uses logistic regression weighted by watch time.

Depth helped, at a cost in server time. With no hidden layer, the ranker's watch-time-weighted misprediction was 41.6%; three layers of 1,024, 512, and 256 units brought it to 34.6%, the best configuration within the serving CPU budget. Weighting positive and negative examples equally instead of by watch time increased this loss by 4.1%.

limit.zh: 离线指标和线上 A/B 结果并不总是一致，作者说替代目标的选择“艺术多于科学”，论文也没有给出线上实验的绝对提升。观看时长本身是个代理指标，作者明说几乎拿不到用户满意度的真值。深度网络也没省掉特征工程，排序仍用几百个人工整理的特征。这里记录的是 2016 年的系统，不代表 YouTube 现在的做法。日期：RecSys 2016 于 9 月在波士顿举行，ACM 记录的出版日期是 2016 年 9 月 7 日。
limit.en: Offline metrics and live A/B results did not always agree, the authors call the choice of surrogate problem more art than science, and the paper gives no absolute figures for its live gains. Watch time is itself a proxy, and the authors say they rarely obtain ground truth for user satisfaction. Deep learning did not remove feature engineering either: the ranker still used hundreds of engineered features. This entry describes the 2016 system, not how YouTube works today. Dates: RecSys 2016 took place in Boston in September, and the ACM record gives September 7, 2016 as the publication date.

sources: Covington, Adams & Sargin · Deep Neural Networks for YouTube Recommendations, RecSys 2016 · Google-hosted PDF, §§1–5

title.zh: Codex 与 Copilot · 在编辑器里续写代码
title.en: Codex and Copilot · code suggestions inside the editor

body.zh: OpenAI 早先发现，GPT-3 能照着 Python 文档字符串写出一些简单程序，可它没专门学过代码，在后来的 HumanEval 测试上一题也没做对。当时衡量代码生成，多半是拿结果和参考答案比相似度，比如 BLEU，写法不同、功能相同的程序会吃亏。2021 年，OpenAI 用 GitHub 上的公开代码微调 GPT，得到 Codex，并用单元测试检查程序是否真的跑对；6 月 29 日，GitHub 推出由 Codex 驱动的 Copilot 技术预览，在编辑器里根据上下文建议整行或整个函数。
body.en: OpenAI had found that GPT-3 could write some simple programs from Python docstrings, but it had never been trained specifically on code and solved none of the problems in the later HumanEval test. Code generation was then usually judged by matching output against a reference solution, for example with BLEU, which shortchanges programs that are written differently but behave the same. In 2021 OpenAI fine-tuned GPT on public code from GitHub to make Codex and checked with unit tests whether its programs actually worked. On June 29, GitHub launched a technical preview of Copilot, powered by Codex, which suggests whole lines or entire functions in the editor based on the surrounding code.

detail.zh:
HumanEval 有 164 道手写的题，每题给出函数签名和文档字符串，平均配 7.7 个单元测试；之所以手写，是因为现成题目的答案早已在 GitHub 上，也就在训练数据里。120 亿参数的 Codex 每题只生成一次，能做对 28.8%，GPT-J 是 11.4%。每题采样 100 次、只要有一个通过测试就算对，再在正确的独立函数上微调过的 Codex-S 能做到 77.5%；没有测试可用时，挑平均对数概率最高的那个，也能做对 44.5%。

训练数据是 2020 年 5 月从 5400 万个公开仓库收集的 Python 文件，去重后 179GB，过滤后 159GB。论文直接写了它的毛病：文档字符串里串起的操作越多越容易错，每多一步，通过率大约降为原来的二分之一到三分之一；变量和操作也会对错位。比如要求“y 加 3，x 和 w 各减 4，返回四个数的乘积”，Codex 没给 w 减 4，最后也没返回乘积。

Copilot 的技术预览名额有限，GitHub 说它对 Python、JavaScript、TypeScript、Ruby 和 Go 效果尤其好。2022 年 6 月 21 日正式向所有开发者开放，收费每月 10 美元或每年 100 美元；GitHub 当时说，过去一年有超过 120 万开发者用过预览版。
detail.en:
HumanEval contains 164 hand-written problems, each with a function signature, a docstring, and an average of 7.7 unit tests; they were written by hand because solutions to existing problems were already on GitHub, and therefore in the training data. With one sample per problem, the 12-billion-parameter Codex solved 28.8%, against 11.4% for GPT-J. Allowing 100 samples per problem and counting a problem as solved if any sample passes, Codex-S, further fine-tuned on correct standalone functions, reached 77.5%. Without tests to filter samples, picking the one with the highest mean log-probability still solved 44.5%.

The training data came from 54 million public repositories collected in May 2020: 179 GB of unique Python files, 159 GB after filtering. The paper is direct about failures. The more operations a docstring chains together, the worse Codex does; each additional step cut the pass rate by a factor of roughly two to three. It also mixes up which operation applies to which variable. Asked to add 3 to y, subtract 4 from both x and w, and return the product of the four numbers, Codex did not subtract 4 from w and did not return the product.

Spots in Copilot's technical preview were limited, and GitHub said it worked especially well for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Ruby, and Go. It became generally available to all developers on June 21, 2022, for $10 a month or $100 a year; GitHub said then that more than 1.2 million developers had used the preview over the previous twelve months.

limit.zh: 论文提醒，生成的代码可能看上去对、实际没做到要求，也可能不安全，新手尤其容易过度依赖，必须有人审查；论文还说，一个修完计算机入门课的好学生，能做对的题应当比 Codex-12B 多。一项研究中，和训练数据完全相同的输出不到 0.1%；训练数据涉及的法律问题，论文另有一节讨论。GitHub 说在启用 Copilot 的文件里近 40% 的代码由它写出，这是厂商自报的数字。日期：Copilot 预览 2021 年 6 月 29 日公布，Codex 论文的 arXiv 初版是 7 月 7 日；论文研究的是研究版模型，产品用的是另一个生产版本。
limit.en: The paper warns that generated code can look right without doing what was intended, can be insecure, and invites over-reliance, especially among beginners, so human review is required; it adds that a strong student who has finished an introductory computer science course would be expected to solve more of its problems than Codex-12B. In one study, outputs identical to training data occurred less than 0.1% of the time; the legal questions around training data are discussed in a separate section of the paper. GitHub's statement that nearly 40% of the code in files where Copilot was enabled was written by it is a vendor figure. Dates: Copilot's preview was announced on June 29, 2021, and the first arXiv version of the Codex paper is July 7, 2021. The paper studies research models; the product used a distinct production version.

sources: Chen et al. · Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code, arXiv v1, 2021-07-07, §§1–3, 6–7
GitHub blog · Introducing GitHub Copilot: your AI pair programmer, 2021-06-29
GitHub blog · GitHub Copilot is generally available to all developers, 2022-06-21

title.zh: arXiv · 预印本不再靠邮寄复印件

body.zh: 1980 年代末，高能物理学者写完论文，通常只把复印件寄给一小批同行；其他人要靠名单上的人转手，非名校的年轻研究者常常完全接触不到。改用电子邮件群发后，全文直接塞进别人的邮箱，有位物理学家担心出差时这些邮件会占满他的磁盘配额。1991 年，在 Los Alamos 国家实验室工作的物理学家 Ginsparg 用一组脚本搭起一个自动的电子邮件服务器：作者把论文投给它，它统一存放并通知订阅者，想看全文再去取。8 月 14 日它收到第一篇投稿，这个服务后来改名为 arXiv。
body.en: In the late 1980s, high-energy physicists usually mailed photocopies of a new paper to only a small number of colleagues. Everyone else depended on those on the list, and young researchers at less prominent institutions were often left out entirely. Email lists spread full texts more widely, but the texts landed in recipients' mailboxes, and one physicist worried that emailed papers would overrun his disk allocation while he traveled. In 1991 Paul Ginsparg, a physicist at Los Alamos National Laboratory, used a set of scripts to build an automated email server: authors submitted papers to it, it stored them and alerted subscribers, and full texts were sent only on request. It received its first submission on August 14; the service was later renamed arXiv.

detail.zh:
一开始的规模很小：原本预计是高能物理一个小分支每年约 100 篇，结果头半年就收到 400 篇。稿件编号用年月加序号，第一篇是 9108001。原计划三个月后自动删除旧稿，等纸质渠道赶上；可大家发现查它比在办公室翻复印件方便，删除的定时任务一直没装，稿件从来没删过。

它跟着网络一起变：几个月后加了 FTP，1993 年 Mosaic 浏览器出现后不久又成了 Web 服务器，1998 年底改名 arXiv.org。同一年，ACM 等机构与 arXiv 合作建立了计算机科学分区。Ginsparg 还写到，欠发达国家的物理学者很快觉得自己终于“在圈里”了：新想法能及时读到，自己的论文也能被平等地读到。

机器学习研究后来也用上了它。比如 Bahdanau 等人的 attention 论文，2014 年 9 月 1 日在这里上传初版，后来才作为 ICLR 2015 的口头报告发表。
detail.en:
It started small. The plan was about 100 submissions a year from one small corner of high-energy physics; it received 400 in its first half year. Papers were numbered by year, month, and sequence, so the first was 9108001. Old submissions were supposed to be deleted automatically after three months, once the paper system caught up, but people found it easier than hunting for a photocopy in the office, so the deletion job was never installed and nothing was ever deleted.

It changed along with the network. An FTP server followed within months, and not long after the Mosaic browser appeared in 1993 it became a Web server too; it was renamed arXiv.org in late 1998. That same year, a partnership including the ACM established its computer science section. Ginsparg also recalls that physicists in less developed countries soon reported feeling finally in the loop, receiving new ideas promptly and having their own work read on equal terms.

Machine learning research later came to use it as well. Bahdanau and colleagues' attention paper, for example, was first posted there on September 1, 2014, and only later presented orally at ICLR 2015.

limit.zh: arXiv 有审核，但审核不是同行评审：审核员只看稿件是否切题、有没有学术价值，内容由投稿人自己负责，贴在上面不等于已被验证。这里的早期经过主要来自 Ginsparg 本人 2011 年的文章，是创办者自己的回忆。日期：这里按 1991 年 8 月 14 日第一篇投稿标年；服务最初叫 xxx.lanl.gov，1998 年底才改名 arXiv.org。arXiv 介绍页写明，它在康奈尔大学托管几十年之后，于 2026 年成为独立的非营利机构。
limit.en: arXiv moderates submissions, but moderation is not peer review: moderators check whether material is on topic and of scholarly value, the contents are the submitter's responsibility, and posting there does not mean a paper has been validated. The early history here comes mainly from Ginsparg's own 2011 article, the founder's recollection. Dates: the entry uses August 14, 1991, the date of the first submission; the service began as xxx.lanl.gov and was renamed arXiv.org in late 1998. arXiv's about page says that after decades hosted at Cornell University, it became an independent nonprofit in 2026.

sources: Ginsparg · It was twenty years ago today..., arXiv v2, 2011-09-13
arXiv · Content moderation is not peer review
arXiv · Bahdanau et al. version history, v1 2014-09-01

title.zh: GPL 第 1 版 · 用版权保证改过的程序还能分享
title.en: GPL version 1 · copyright that keeps modified programs shareable

body.zh: 自由软件如果放进公有领域，或用很宽松的许可发布，别人就可以改一改、只发二进制，再附上不许分享的条款。GNU 一方举过 X Window System 的例子：MIT 用宽松许可发布了它，后来大多数用户用的却是各家 Unix 自带的专有版本。1989 年 2 月，自由软件基金会发布 GNU 通用公共许可证第 1 版：谁都可以复制、修改、分发，甚至收费；但分发这个程序或包含它的作品时，要附上源代码或提供源代码的书面承诺，并按同样的条款把整个作品授权给所有人。
body.en: Free software placed in the public domain, or released under a very permissive license, could be modified, shipped as binaries only, and wrapped in terms that forbade sharing. The GNU project points to the X Window System: MIT released it under a permissive license, yet most users ended up running proprietary versions bundled with Unix systems. In February 1989 the Free Software Foundation published version 1 of the GNU General Public License. Anyone could copy, modify, and distribute the program, even for a fee, but whoever distributed it, or a work containing it, had to provide the source code or a written offer of it, and license the whole work to everyone under the same terms.

detail.zh:
条款写得很具体。原样复制要保留版权声明和“无担保”说明，并附一份许可证；转交拷贝这个动作本身可以收费。改过的文件要醒目地注明已被修改，以及修改日期。发二进制时，要么附上完整源代码，要么附一份至少三年有效的书面承诺，除象征性的分发成本外免费提供源代码；所谓源代码，指的是修改这个作品时首选的那种形式。

它也划了边界。和别的独立作品放在同一张存储或分发介质上，只算“单纯聚合”，不会把对方也拉进这份许可。第 7 条为修订留了口子：程序写明适用“某版或任何更新版本”的，使用者可以选择按更新的版本办。这一条很快用上了：1991 年 6 月就出了第 2 版。

Linux 0.12 的发布说明宣布，许可要改成与 GNU copyleft 相容，去掉“不得收费分发”的限制。按 GNU 一方的说法，Torvalds 在 1992 年把 Linux 变成了自由软件，Linux 和 GNU 系统合在一起，才成了一套完整的自由操作系统。
detail.en:
The terms are concrete. Verbatim copies must keep the copyright notice and the disclaimer of warranty and come with a copy of the license; a fee may be charged for the physical act of transferring a copy. Modified files must carry prominent notices that they were changed, and when. Distributing a binary requires either the complete source code or a written offer, valid for at least three years, to supply it free of charge apart from a nominal fee for the cost of distribution. Source code is defined as the preferred form of the work for making modifications.

It also set limits. Putting another, independent work on the same storage or distribution medium is mere aggregation and does not bring that work under the license. Section 7 provided for revisions: if a program says it is covered by a given version “and any later version”, users may follow the terms of any later version. That clause soon mattered, since version 2 appeared in June 1991.

The Linux 0.12 release notes announced a change to a license compatible with the GNU copyleft, dropping the ban on distributing Linux for money. In the GNU project's account, Torvalds made Linux free software in 1992, and Linux combined with the GNU system produced a complete free operating system.

limit.zh: 提供源代码的义务挂在分发上：把程序或改过的版本交给别人时才适用。许可证也写明不提供任何担保，它保证的是分享和修改的权利，不是代码质量。它表达的是自由软件基金会对“自由”的主张，这里引用的 GNU 文章也是 GNU 一方自己的叙述。日期：第 1 版标注为 1989 年 2 月；第 2 版 1991 年 6 月，第 3 版 2007 年 6 月 29 日。
limit.en: The obligation to provide source is tied to distribution: it applies when the program, or a modified version, is passed to others. The license also states plainly that there is no warranty; it protects the rights to share and modify, not the quality of the code. It expresses the Free Software Foundation's view of freedom, and the GNU essay cited here is the GNU project's own account. Dates: version 1 is dated February 1989; version 2 followed in June 1991 and version 3 on June 29, 2007.

sources: GNU General Public License, version 1, February 1989 (gnu.org), preamble and §§0–7
Stallman · The GNU Project, sections on the X Window System and copyleft (the GNU project's account)
GNU General Public License, version 2, June 1991 (header)
GNU General Public License, version 3, 29 June 2007 (header)
Linus Torvalds: Linux 0.12 release notes, license change, kernel.org archive

title.zh: Hugging Face Transformers · 预训练模型的公共工具箱
title.en: Hugging Face Transformers · a shared toolkit for pretrained models

body.zh: BERT、GPT-2 之后，NLP 的常规做法变成先拿一个大型预训练模型，再在自己的任务上微调。可预训练越来越贵：论文举例，RoBERTa 用 1024 块 32GB 的 V100 在 160GB 文本上训练，按 AWS 的价格约合 10 万美元；各家模型的代码和权重又散在不同的仓库和框架里。Hugging Face 把这些模型收进一个库，统一成配置、模型、分词器三个类，都用一个 from_pretrained() 调用加载，PyTorch 和 TensorFlow 都能用，以 Apache 2.0 许可开源。
body.en: After BERT and GPT-2, the usual NLP workflow became: take a large pretrained model and fine-tune it on your own task. Pretraining kept getting more expensive; the paper notes that RoBERTa was trained on 160 GB of text with 1,024 32GB V100 GPUs, roughly 100,000 US dollars at AWS prices. Model code and weights were also scattered across repositories and frameworks. Hugging Face gathered these models into one library built on three classes, configuration, model, and tokenizer, each loaded with a single from_pretrained() call, usable from both PyTorch and TensorFlow, and released under the Apache 2.0 license.

detail.zh:
2020 年的会议版举了个例子：要用在法语语料上预训练的 BERT 模型 FlauBERT，只要两行，AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("flaubert/flaubert_base_uncased")，再用同一个名字调 AutoModel.from_pretrained。库按名字找到对应的类，下载并缓存权重。同一个模型换上不同的“头”，比如 XXXForSequenceClassification 这一类，就能做分类、问答等下游任务；库里还附带 GLUE、SQuAD 等基准的微调脚本。

它从内部工具长出来，改过两次名：pytorch-pretrained-bert、pytorch-transformers，最后叫 Transformers。2019 年论文写作时，这个库才存在约十个月，已有 200 多篇论文用到它，外部贡献者 120 多人。到 2020 年，模型中心里有 2,097 个社区上传的模型，外部贡献者超过 400 人。

共享也带来了要交代什么的问题。2020 年的版本写道，上传到模型中心的每个模型都有自己的页面，作者可以附一份模型卡，说明训练情况、预训练用了哪些数据，以及已知的偏差。AllenAI 就通过这里发布了用 PubMed 数据训练的 SciBERT。
detail.en:
The 2020 conference version gives an example. Using FlauBERT, a BERT model pretrained on French, takes two lines: AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("flaubert/flaubert_base_uncased"), then AutoModel.from_pretrained with the same name. From the name, the library finds the right classes and downloads and caches the weights. Putting a different “head” on the same model, as in the XXXForSequenceClassification classes, adapts it to tasks such as classification or question answering, and the library ships fine-tuning scripts for benchmarks such as GLUE and SQuAD.

It grew out of internal tools and was renamed twice, from pytorch-pretrained-bert to pytorch-transformers to Transformers. When the 2019 paper was written, the library was about ten months old, more than 200 research papers reported using it, and it had over 120 external contributors. By 2020 its model hub held 2,097 community-uploaded models, and external contributors numbered over 400.

Sharing raised the question of what to disclose. The 2020 version says every model uploaded to the hub gets its own page, and authors can add a model card describing training, the pretraining data, and known biases. AllenAI, for example, distributed SciBERT, trained on PubMed text, through the hub.

limit.zh: 库降低的是复用的门槛，不是训练的门槛：从头预训练依旧昂贵。模型卡在这里是作者“可以提供”的附加说明，写得全不全取决于上传者。文中的论文数、贡献者数和模型数是作者写作时的自报快照；“成为标准库”是他们的目标，不是测量结果。日期：arXiv 初版 2019 年 10 月 9 日；会议版 2020 年 11 月发表于 EMNLP 系统演示，作者更多，内容也有扩充。
limit.en: The library lowered the barrier to reuse, not to training: pretraining from scratch stayed expensive. Model cards on the hub are something authors can provide, so how complete they are depends on whoever uploads the model. The paper, contributor, and model counts are the authors' snapshots at the time of writing, and becoming “the standard library” was their stated aim, not a measurement. Dates: the first arXiv version is October 9, 2019; the EMNLP 2020 system demonstration appeared in November 2020 with more authors and new material.

sources: Wolf et al. · Transformers: State-of-the-art Natural Language Processing, arXiv v1, 2019-10-09, §§1–3, 5
Wolf et al. · Transformers: State-of-the-Art Natural Language Processing, EMNLP 2020 System Demonstrations, pp. 38–45, §§1, 4

title.zh: Xen · 一台服务器分给好几个操作系统
title.en: Xen · one server, several operating systems

body.zh: 想让很多人共用一台服务器，最省事的办法是大家装在同一个操作系统里，各跑各的进程。可配置一多就互相打架，一个人占满内存、网络或磁盘，别人也跟着变慢。用虚拟机隔开更干净，但 x86 本来没为虚拟化设计：有些特权指令权限不够时不报错，悄悄失败，VMware ESX 只好边运行边改写客户系统的机器码。2003 年的 Xen 论文换了条路：把客户操作系统稍微改一改，让它遇到特权操作就主动发“超级调用”请 Xen 代办，上面的应用程序一行不用改。
body.en: The easiest way to share a server among many people is to put them all on one operating system, each running their own processes. But their configurations collide, and one user who fills memory, the network, or the disk slows everyone else down. Virtual machines separate users more cleanly, yet x86 was not designed to be virtualized: some privileged instructions fail silently instead of trapping when run without enough privilege, so VMware ESX Server rewrote parts of the guest's machine code as it ran. The 2003 Xen paper took another route. It modified the guest operating system slightly so that the guest asks Xen to perform privileged operations through hypercalls, while applications above it run unchanged.

detail.zh:
拿改页表来说。完全虚拟化时，客户系统以为自己在直接写页表，监控程序得在背后另维护一份“影子页表”。在 Xen 上，客户系统可以直接读硬件页表，要改的时候就把一批更新攒起来，用一次超级调用交给 Xen，Xen 检查无误再写进去。客户内核从 x86 的 0 环挪到 1 环运行，自己直接执行特权指令会失败，只能走这条路。

代价是得改操作系统。论文统计，把 Linux 2.4 移植过去，改动和新增的代码约 3000 行，占 x86 相关代码的 1.36%；Windows XP 的移植还没做完。管理功能也不塞进 Xen 本身：开机时先建一个叫 Domain0 的特权域，管理软件跑在里面，负责创建和销毁其他虚拟机，分配内存、磁盘和网络。设计目标是一台服务器同时跑大约 100 个虚拟机。

后来的云服务用上了它。2006 年亚马逊发布 EC2 测试版时，AWS 的 Jeff Barr 在发布博客里写明，EC2 是用 Xen 这个虚拟机监控程序搭起来的。
detail.en:
Take page-table updates. Under full virtualization the guest believes it writes page tables directly, so the monitor maintains separate shadow page tables behind its back. On Xen the guest may read the hardware page tables directly, but to change them it batches updates and hands them to Xen in a single hypercall; Xen validates them before applying them. The guest kernel moves from x86 ring 0 to ring 1, so any attempt to execute a privileged instruction itself fails, and this is the only way through.

The price is a modified operating system. The paper counts about 3,000 lines changed or added to port Linux 2.4, 1.36% of its x86-specific code; the Windows XP port was still unfinished. Management stays out of Xen itself. A privileged domain called Domain0 is created at boot, and management software running there creates and destroys other virtual machines and assigns memory, disks, and network access. The design target was about 100 virtual machines on one server.

Cloud services later built on it. When Amazon released the EC2 beta in 2006, AWS's Jeff Barr wrote in the launch post that EC2 was built on the Xen virtual machine monitor.

limit.zh: Xen 的高性能有前提：客户操作系统要改源码。论文写成时 Linux 已经能跑，Windows XP 只能跑一些简单程序。“开销最多几个百分点”是作者在自己选的基准测试里得到的结果。它也不是第一个虚拟机监控程序，论文本身就和 VMware、User-mode Linux、Denali 做了比较。日期：这里按 SOSP 2003 会议论文定年（会议于 2003 年 10 月 19–22 日举行）；论文说当时 beta 版只交给少数合作方试用，公开发布还在计划中。
limit.en: Xen's performance came with a condition: guest operating systems had to be modified. When the paper was written Linux ran fully, while Windows XP could run only simple user programs. The claim of at most a few percent overhead comes from the authors' own benchmarks. Xen was not the first virtual machine monitor either; the paper itself compares it with VMware, User-mode Linux, and Denali. Dates: the entry uses the SOSP 2003 paper, presented at the conference held October 19–22, 2003. The paper says a beta was then being evaluated by selected parties and a public release was still planned.

sources: Barham et al. · Xen and the Art of Virtualization, SOSP 2003, §§1–3 and Table 2, Cambridge author copy
Jeff Barr · Amazon EC2 Beta, AWS News Blog, 2006-08-25 (EC2 built on Xen)

title.zh: Amazon EC2 · 服务器按小时租
title.en: Amazon EC2 · servers by the hour

body.zh: 以前要上线一个网站，得先买服务器，或者签下按月按年的租约，还要提前猜流量会涨多少。猜多了，机器闲着；猜少了，用户看到的是“网站太忙”。2006 年 8 月，亚马逊推出 EC2 的有限测试版：调用 Web 服务接口就能要一台虚拟服务器，几分钟开起来，用多少付多少，不用了就关掉。当时只有一种规格，大约相当于一颗 1.7 GHz 的 Xeon 处理器、1.75 GB 内存和 160 GB 本地硬盘，每小时 10 美分。
body.en: Putting a website online used to mean buying servers or signing monthly or yearly rental terms, then guessing in advance how much traffic would grow. Guess high and machines sat idle; guess low and users saw a “site too busy” message. In August 2006 Amazon opened a limited beta of EC2. A call to a web service interface brought up a virtual server within minutes, customers paid only for what they used, and they could shut it down when done. There was a single configuration, roughly a 1.7 GHz Xeon processor, 1.75 GB of memory, and 160 GB of local disk, for 10 cents an hour.

detail.zh:
Barr 的发布博客引了论坛里的两个例子。一个团队做功能性磁共振分析，每隔几周才需要 15–20 台机器跑几个小时；自己买一整套，大部分时间都在闲着。另一个是只在早 7 点到晚 7 点使用的内部库存系统，晚上把实例关掉，服务器费用就能省下一半左右。

用法也变了。系统盘打包成 AMI 镜像，作为对象存在 S3 里；调用接口就能用镜像启动实例。测试期每个账户最多同时开 20 台，特殊安排可以更多。刚上线时只有一个区域，没有持久的块存储，实例一关，本地数据也跟着没了；EBS 块存储 2008 年才推出，负载均衡、自动扩缩和监控是 2009 年的事。

底层虚拟化用的是 Xen，这一点 Barr 在发布博客里就写明了。十五年后他回顾说，这台后来叫 m1.small 的实例，当时只说“相当于 1.7 GHz 的 Xeon”，没公布具体型号；2017 年 AWS 推出 Nitro 系统，重做了这套虚拟化基础设施。
detail.en:
Barr's launch post quoted two examples from the forums. One team doing functional MRI analysis needed 15–20 machines for a couple of hours every few weeks; owning that cluster meant it sat idle most of the time. Another described an internal inventory application used only from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.; shutting the instance down at night would cut server costs by about half.

The workflow changed too. A boot disk was packaged as an AMI, stored as an object in S3, and web service calls launched instances from it. During the beta an account could run up to 20 servers at once, more by special arrangement. At launch there was one region and no persistent block storage, so local data disappeared when an instance stopped. EBS block storage arrived in 2008, and load balancing, Auto Scaling, and CloudWatch monitoring in 2009.

Underneath, the virtualization was Xen, as Barr stated in the launch post. Fifteen years later he recalled that the instance, later named m1.small, had been described only as equivalent to a 1.7 GHz Xeon, without a model number. In 2017 AWS introduced the Nitro System, a rebuild of that virtualization infrastructure.

limit.zh: 租服务器以前就有，Barr 的博客也写到过去“买或租”服务器；EC2 的变化在于用接口几分钟开机、按小时计费。发布时它只是有限测试版，负载均衡和自动扩缩到 2009 年才作为单独的服务推出。几分钟启动、按用量付费，都是 AWS 自己的描述。日期：AWS What's New 公告的日期是 2006 年 8 月 24 日，Jeff Barr 的发布博客页面显示 8 月 25 日；这里按测试版公布定年，不是正式商用的时间。
limit.en: Renting servers was not new; Barr's post itself mentions buying or renting servers before EC2. What changed was starting machines through an interface within minutes and paying by the hour. At launch it was a limited beta; load balancing and Auto Scaling arrived only in 2009, as separate services. Minutes to boot and pay-per-use are AWS's own descriptions. Dates: the AWS What's New notice is dated August 24, 2006, and Jeff Barr's launch post shows August 25; the entry dates the beta announcement, not general availability.

sources: AWS What's New · Announcing Amazon EC2 (beta), 2006-08-24
Jeff Barr · Amazon EC2 Beta, AWS News Blog, 2006-08-25
Jeff Barr · Happy 15th Birthday Amazon EC2, AWS News Blog, 2021-08-23

title.zh: Borg · 在线服务和批处理挤在同一批机器上
title.en: Borg · services and batch jobs on the same machines

body.zh: 不少公司把面向用户的在线服务和批处理作业放在不同的集群里。麻烦在于，在线服务要为少见的流量高峰预留资源，平时大多用不上，机器就这么空着。Google 的集群管理系统 Borg 在内部用了十多年，2015 年的论文公开了它的做法：一个“单元”的中位数规模约一万台机器，在线服务和批处理混着跑；Borg 负责接纳、调度、启动、重启和监控任务，还会估计每个任务实际要用多少资源，把多出来的部分回收给批处理。
body.en: Many organizations kept user-facing services and batch jobs in separate clusters. The trouble is that services reserve resources for rare traffic spikes and leave most of them unused, so machines sit idle. Google had run its cluster manager, Borg, internally for more than a decade when a 2015 paper described how it works. A median cell held about 10,000 machines, with services and batch work mixed together. Borg admitted, scheduled, started, restarted, and monitored tasks, and it estimated how much each task would actually use so the rest could be reclaimed for batch work.

detail.zh:
具体怎么回收：作业申请资源时给出一个上限，Borg 用它判断配额够不够、机器放不放得下。之后 Borg 每隔几秒按实际用量估一个“预留”，上限和预留之间的差额，拿去跑能接受资源质量差一点的批处理。论文统计，在中位数大小的单元里，约 20% 的工作负载跑在这样回收来的资源上；要是把在线和离线作业拆进不同单元，中位数单元得多用 20–30% 的机器。

Borg 的任务大多不跑在虚拟机里，而是 Linux 容器里的一组进程，用 cgroup 隔离资源。论文给的理由是不想付虚拟化的开销，而且设计这套系统时，手上有大量不支持硬件虚拟化的处理器。对外提供的 Google Compute Engine 虚拟机反过来跑在 Borg 上：每台虚拟机是一个 KVM 进程，作为 Borg 任务运行。

论文最后一节讲 Borg 的经验怎样用到 Kubernetes 上。比如 Borg 的 alloc，在 Kubernetes 里对应 pod：几个总被调度到同一台机器、可以共享资源的容器。Borg 只能用作业来分组，用户只好把服务结构编进作业名里；Kubernetes 不再用作业，改用可以随意附加的标签来挑选对象。
detail.en:
Here is how reclamation worked. A job states an upper limit on resources, which Borg uses to check quota and whether a machine has room. Every few seconds Borg then estimates a reservation from actual usage, and the gap between limit and reservation runs batch work that can tolerate lower-quality resources. In a median cell, the paper reports, about 20% of the workload ran in reclaimed resources, and splitting production and non-production work into separate cells would have needed 20–30% more machines.

Most Borg tasks did not run in virtual machines. A task was a set of Linux processes in a container, isolated with cgroups. The paper gives two reasons: Google did not want to pay the cost of virtualization, and the system was designed when it owned many processors without hardware virtualization support. The virtual machines Google Compute Engine sold ran the other way round, each as a KVM process inside a Borg task.

The paper's last section describes how Borg's lessons were applied to Kubernetes. Borg's alloc became the Kubernetes pod, a group of containers always scheduled onto the same machine and able to share resources. Borg grouped tasks only by job, so users encoded service structure in job names; Kubernetes dropped jobs and selects objects with labels that can be attached freely.

limit.zh: 这是 Google 对自家系统的经验总结，利用率等数字来自他们的集群和工作负载，换一家公司未必一样。Borg 是内部系统；Kubernetes 是另外写的新系统，按 Joe Beda 的回忆是把 Borg 的好想法带到公开项目里，不是 Borg 本身的公开版。日期：2015 年是 EuroSys 论文的发表时间（会议 4 月 21–24 日），不是 Borg 投入使用的年份，论文说它已在生产环境运行十多年。
limit.en: This is Google's account of its own system, and figures such as utilization come from its clusters and workloads; another company's numbers could differ. Borg is an internal system. Kubernetes is a separately written system that, in Joe Beda's account, brought the best ideas from Borg into an open project; it is not Borg itself released publicly. Dates: 2015 is the EuroSys paper, presented at the conference held April 21–24, not the year Borg entered service; the paper says it had run in production for more than a decade.

sources: Verma et al. · Large-scale cluster management at Google with Borg, EuroSys 2015, §§2, 5–6 and 8
Joe Beda · 4 Years of K8s, Kubernetes blog, 2018-06-06

title.zh: TVM · 把模型编译到各种硬件上
title.en: TVM · compiling models for many kinds of hardware

body.zh: 2018 年前后，主流框架把模型表示成计算图，真正干活的算子交给厂商写好的库，比如 cuDNN。这些库主要照顾服务器 GPU，换到手机、嵌入式设备或 FPGA 加速器上，就得大量手工调。框架也两头为难：把几个算子融合成一个能少读写内存，可融合出来的新算子库里没有。TVM 把这件事当成编译问题：从框架导入模型，先在图上做融合等优化，再为每个算子自动生成目标硬件的代码，用机器学习训练的代价模型挑出更快的写法。
body.en: Around 2018, mainstream frameworks represented models as computation graphs and handed the actual operators to vendor libraries such as cuDNN. Those libraries focused on server GPUs; moving to phones, embedded devices, or FPGA accelerators took a lot of manual tuning. Frameworks were also stuck: fusing several operators into one saves memory traffic, but the fused operator is not in the library. TVM treated this as a compiler problem. It imports a model from a framework, optimizes the graph with steps such as fusion, then generates code for each operator on the target hardware, using a learned cost model to pick faster versions.

detail.zh:
举个小例子：卷积后面跟一个逐元素加法。不融合时，卷积先把结果写回显存，加法再读回来；融合成一个内核，中间结果就不用来回搬。TVM 把算子分成几类：逐元素的、求和这类归约、像卷积这样输出后面可以接逐元素运算的、像排序这样没法融合的，再按规则自动融合。论文在 Titan X 上测到，融合后的算子快 1.2–2 倍。

每个算子先用张量表达式写“算什么”，再用一组调度原语决定“怎么算”：怎么分块、循环按什么顺序、数据放在哪层缓存、用不用加速器的专用指令。这借用了 Halide 把计算和调度分开的思路。可选组合太多，TVM 就一边在目标硬件上实测候选代码，一边用测到的运行时间训练代价模型，让它预测哪种写法更快。生成的代码可以走 LLVM IR，也可以输出 CUDA、Metal 或 OpenCL。

论文说 TVM 已经开源，并在几家大公司内部使用。2019 年 3 月项目进入 Apache 孵化器，2020 年 11 月成为 Apache 顶级项目；Apache 的公告列出的使用机构包括 AMD、ARM、AWS、微软和 NVIDIA。
detail.en:
A small example: a convolution followed by an element-wise addition. Unfused, the convolution writes its result back to GPU memory and the addition reads it again; fused into one kernel, the intermediate never makes the round trip. TVM sorts operators into kinds, namely element-wise ones, reductions such as sums, ones like convolution whose output can absorb element-wise work, and ones like sorting that cannot be fused, then fuses them by rule. On a Titan X the paper measured fused operators running 1.2–2× faster.

Each operator is first written as a tensor expression that says what to compute, then a set of schedule primitives decides how: how to tile, which loop order to use, which cache level holds the data, and whether to use an accelerator's special instructions. This borrows Halide's separation of computation from schedule. The choices multiply quickly, so TVM measures candidate code on the target hardware and trains a cost model on those running times to predict which version is faster. Generated code can go through LLVM IR or come out as CUDA, Metal, or OpenCL.

The paper says TVM was open source and in production use inside several major companies. The project entered the Apache Incubator in March 2019 and became an Apache top-level project in November 2020; the Apache announcement lists users including AMD, ARM, AWS, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

limit.zh: 论文里 1.2–3.8 倍的端到端加速，是在几种特定的 GPU、CPU 和 FPGA 上、对几种推理模型测出来的，对比的是当时版本的 MXNet、TensorFlow 等框架，不代表在任何硬件上都比厂商库快。论文的评测都是推理任务；代价模型还得靠在目标硬件上实测来训练，每次测量可能要几秒。TVM 也不是第一个深度学习编译器，论文就拿 TensorFlow XLA、Tensor Comprehensions 做了对比。日期：arXiv 初稿是 2018 年 2 月 12 日，OSDI 会议是 2018 年 10 月；Apache 的使用名单是 2020 年公告里的说法。
limit.en: The paper's 1.2–3.8× end-to-end speedups were measured on a few specific GPUs, CPUs, and an FPGA, for a handful of inference models, against the versions of MXNet, TensorFlow, and other frameworks of the time; they do not mean TVM beats vendor libraries on every device. All of the paper's evaluations are inference workloads, and the cost model still has to be trained by measuring on the target hardware, where one measurement can take seconds. TVM was not the first deep learning compiler; the paper compares it with TensorFlow XLA and Tensor Comprehensions. Dates: the arXiv draft is from February 12, 2018, and the OSDI conference was in October 2018; the list of Apache users comes from the 2020 announcement.

sources: Chen et al. · TVM, OSDI 2018, abstract, §§1–5, figure 2 and §6
Chen et al. · TVM: End-to-End Optimization Stack for Deep Learning, arXiv v1, 2018-02-12
Apache Software Foundation · Apache TVM becomes a Top-Level Project, 2020-11-30

title.zh: Triton · 按“块”写 GPU 内核
title.en: Triton · writing GPU kernels in tiles

body.zh: 常用的深度学习运算有 cuBLAS、cuDNN 这些厂商库撑着。研究者想试库里没有的新运算，比如一种新卷积，就得请专家手写内核，写完还难移植；已有的编译器方案又常常比厂商库慢得多。2019 年，哈佛的 Tillet、Kung 和 Cox 在 MAPL 研讨会上提出 Triton：程序员按“块”写计算，块是形状固定的小多维数组；线程怎么分工、数据怎么搬进共享内存，交给建在 LLVM 上的编译器，块多大由自动调优来挑。
body.en: Common deep learning operations were backed by vendor libraries such as cuBLAS and cuDNN. As soon as researchers wanted an operation the libraries lacked, such as a new kind of convolution, an expert had to write a custom kernel, usually at the cost of portability, and existing compiler approaches were often much slower than the libraries. In 2019 Tillet, Kung, and Cox at Harvard presented Triton at the MAPL workshop. Programmers write computations on tiles, statically shaped multi-dimensional sub-arrays. How threads share the work inside a tile and how data moves into shared memory are left to a compiler built on LLVM, and auto-tuning picks the tile sizes.

detail.zh:
论文的第一个例子是矩阵乘法 C = A × Bᵀ。用 Triton-C 写，核心循环每次取 A 的一块和 B 的一块，做一次 dot，加到 C 的那一块上；块的长宽只写几个候选值，比如 16、32、64、128，让自动调优去试。至于线程怎样分到块里的元素、访问显存怎样合并、共享内存怎样分配和同步，都由编译器的优化步骤处理。

测试用的是一块 NVIDIA GTX 1070。矩阵乘法能和 cuBLAS 打平，在循环网络和 Transformer 的矩阵形状上，比其他编译器方案最多快 3 倍；不过在较浅的 Transformer 形状上，cuBLAS 仍然更快。论文还用 Triton 重写了 cuDNN 的 IMPLICIT_GEMM 卷积算法，性能没有损失，又为 shift 卷积写了融合内核。

今天的 Triton 仓库仍把这篇 MAPL 2019 论文列为项目的基础，只是写法已经从论文里类 C 的语言变成主要在 Python 里写内核。2023 年 3 月发布的 PyTorch 2.0 里，编译后端 TorchInductor 在 NVIDIA 和 AMD GPU 上靠 OpenAI Triton 生成内核。
detail.en:
The paper's first example is matrix multiplication, C = A × Bᵀ. In Triton-C the main loop loads a tile of A and a tile of B, takes a dot product, and adds it into a tile of C. Tile sizes are given as a few candidates, such as 16, 32, 64, and 128, for the auto-tuner to try. How threads are assigned to elements of a tile, how memory accesses are coalesced, and how shared memory is allocated and synchronized are handled by compiler passes.

The experiments used one NVIDIA GTX 1070. Matrix multiplication matched cuBLAS and ran up to 3× faster than other compiler approaches on recurrent-network and Transformer shapes, though cuBLAS stayed faster on shallow Transformer shapes. The authors also reimplemented cuDNN's IMPLICIT_GEMM convolution algorithm in Triton without losing performance and wrote a fused kernel for shift convolutions.

The current Triton repository still names this MAPL 2019 paper as the project's foundation, although kernels are now written mainly in Python rather than the paper's C-like language. In PyTorch 2.0, released in March 2023, the TorchInductor compiler backend relies on OpenAI Triton to generate kernels for NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

limit.zh: 2019 年的 Triton 只生成 GPU 代码，论文测试也只用了一块 NVIDIA 消费级显卡，结论不能直接推到所有 GPU 和所有运算上；“和 cuBLAS 打平”指的是论文测过的那些矩阵形状。Triton 降低了写内核的门槛，但块大小、内存访问这些性能问题并没有消失，只是交给了编译器和自动调优。日期：这里按 MAPL 2019 研讨会论文（2019 年 6 月 22 日）定年；Python 写法和 PyTorch 2.0 的使用都是后来的事，不能倒填到 2019 年。
limit.en: Triton in 2019 generated GPU code only, and the paper tested a single NVIDIA consumer card, so its results do not carry over automatically to every GPU or operation; matching cuBLAS refers to the matrix shapes the paper measured. Triton made kernels easier to write, but performance questions such as tile size and memory access did not disappear; they moved to the compiler and the auto-tuner. Dates: the entry uses the MAPL 2019 workshop paper of June 22, 2019. The Python interface and the use in PyTorch 2.0 came later and should not be read back into 2019.

sources: Tillet, Kung & Cox · Triton, MAPL 2019, §§1–2 and 5–7, Harvard author copy
triton-lang/triton · repository README (current), citing the MAPL 2019 paper as its foundation
PyTorch · PyTorch 2.0 release blog, 2023-03-15, TorchInductor and Triton

title.zh: 差分隐私 · 按一行数据的影响来加噪声
title.en: Differential privacy · noise sized to one record's influence

body.zh: 统计机构想公布汇总数字，又不想暴露其中某个人。只公布汇总也不保险：Dinur 和 Nissim 证明过，如果能不限次数地问“这些记录里有几个 1”，回答又只加一点点噪声，攻击者几乎能还原整个数据库。2006 年，Dwork、McSherry、Nissim 和 Smith 在 TCC 会议上给出更一般的做法：先规定任意一行换掉，回答的概率分布只能变一点点；再证明按查询的“敏感度”，也就是一行数据最多能让结果变多少，来定拉普拉斯噪声的大小，就能做到。
body.en: A statistics office wants to publish totals without exposing any one person in them. Totals alone are not automatically safe: Dinur and Nissim had shown that if anyone may ask without limit how many records in a subset are 1, and answers carry only a little noise, an attacker can rebuild almost the whole database. In 2006 Dwork, McSherry, Nissim, and Smith gave a more general method at the TCC conference. First, privacy becomes a mathematical condition: changing any single row may shift the probability of each answer only slightly. Then they proved the condition holds if Laplace noise is scaled to the query's sensitivity, the most one row can change the result.

detail.zh:
最简单的例子是计数：每人一行，取值 0 或 1，问一共有几个 1。换掉一个人，答案最多变 1，所以敏感度是 1；在真实答案上加一个尺度为 1/ε 的拉普拉斯噪声，就满足论文的定义。直方图也一样：把每个人分进若干个格子，一个人换格子，最多让两个格子各变 1，敏感度是 2，和格子有多少个无关。以前的分析里，加的噪声要随维数增长。

ε 由政策来选：ε 越小，换掉任何一行对结果的影响越难看出来，要加的噪声也越大。敏感度则只由查询本身决定，和数据库里装的是什么、装了多少都无关。论文把这个定义叫作 ε-indistinguishability；后来通行的名字是“差分隐私”，美国人口普查局的说明页就用这个名字，并把这篇论文列在参考文献里。

人口普查局说，从 1990 年普查开始，它就在发布的数据里加入噪声；2020 年普查改用基于差分隐私的保护框架。
detail.en:
The simplest case is a count. Each person is one row with value 0 or 1, and the query asks how many 1s there are. Replacing one person changes the answer by at most 1, so the sensitivity is 1, and adding Laplace noise of scale 1/ε to the true answer meets the paper's definition. Histograms work the same way. When people are sorted into bins, moving one person changes at most two bins by 1 each, so the sensitivity is 2 no matter how many bins there are. Earlier analyses added noise that grew with the dimension.

ε is a policy choice. A smaller ε makes the effect of any single row harder to detect and requires more noise. Sensitivity depends only on the query, not on what or how much the database holds. The paper called its definition ε-indistinguishability; the name that later became standard is differential privacy, which the U.S. Census Bureau uses on its overview page while citing this paper.

The Census Bureau says it has added noise to published data since the 1990 Census, and that for the 2020 Census it moved to a protection framework based on differential privacy.

limit.zh: 差分隐私管的是“换掉任何一行”对结果的影响，不保证统计结果推不出群体层面的结论。论文自己举例：数据库显示吸烟和心脏病有关，让人更能猜中某个吸烟者的风险，这不算侵犯隐私。多个问题要合在一起算敏感度，问得越多，要保持同样的 ε 就得加更多噪声，或者干脆拒答。论文还假设有一个可信的服务器保管原始数据。日期：按 TCC 2006 会议论文定年（会议在 2006 年 3 月）；论文里的名字是 ε-indistinguishability。
limit.en: Differential privacy limits how much replacing any one row can affect a result; it does not stop statistics from revealing facts about groups. The paper's own example: if the data show that smoking correlates with heart disease, guessing a smoker's risk becomes easier, and that is not a privacy violation. Several queries must be counted together, so asking more questions means adding more noise for the same ε, or refusing to answer. The model also assumes a trusted server holds the raw data. Dates: the entry uses the TCC 2006 conference paper, from March 2006; the paper's own term is ε-indistinguishability.

sources: Dwork, McSherry, Nissim & Smith · Calibrating Noise to Sensitivity in Private Data Analysis, TCC 2006, author copy, §§1–3
U.S. Census Bureau · Differential privacy and the 2020 Census, overview page with references

title.zh: 联邦学习 · 数据留在手机上，只传模型更新
title.en: Federated learning · data stays on the phone, updates travel

body.zh: 手机上有大量能改进输入法、语音识别和相册的数据，可里面有你打过的字、拍过的照片，往往很私密，量也大，不适合全部传到数据中心再训练。常见的分布式训练又默认数据都在机房里，网络够快，各台机器上的数据分布也差不多。2016 年 2 月，Google 的 McMahan 等人提出联邦学习：训练数据留在设备上，服务器每轮挑一部分设备，各自用本地数据训练几轮，只把模型更新传回来，服务器再按各自的数据量加权平均。
body.en: Phones hold plenty of data that could improve keyboards, speech recognition, and photo apps, but it includes what people type and the pictures they take. It is often private and large, a poor fit for uploading everything to a data center for training. Standard distributed training, meanwhile, assumed the data sat in a data center with a fast network and similar distributions on every machine. In February 2016, McMahan and colleagues at Google proposed federated learning. Training data stays on the devices. Each round the server picks some devices, each trains on its local data for a few passes and sends back only a model update, and the server averages the updates weighted by data size.

detail.zh:
论文用《莎士比亚全集》做了个接近真实的实验：每部剧里每个说话的角色算一个“客户端”，共 1146 个，台词多的多、少的少，内容也各不相同。训练字符级 LSTM 时，让客户端在本地多跑几轮再上传，和每轮只算一次梯度的基线相比，达到同样准确率所需的通信轮数，在这种不均衡的数据上少了 95 倍，在打散后的均衡版本上少了 13 倍。

论文也写清了隐私上的边界。上传的只是改进模型所需的最少信息，用完就可以删；但更新本身仍可能泄露东西，比如特征是稀疏词袋时，非零的梯度会直接暴露用户打过哪些词。要更强的保证，可以再叠加差分隐私或安全多方计算。

2017 年 4 月，Google 研究博客说正在 Android 的 Gboard 输入法里测试联邦学习，用来改进搜索建议模型；手机只在空闲、充电并连着免费无线网时参与训练。2019 年 Bonawitz 等人的系统设计论文说，他们已经建成一套基于 TensorFlow、面向移动设备的生产系统。
detail.en:
The paper built a realistic test from the complete works of Shakespeare. Every speaking role in every play became a client, 1,146 in all, with very different amounts and kinds of text. When clients training a character-level LSTM ran several local passes before uploading, the rounds of communication needed to reach the same accuracy fell 95-fold on this unbalanced data and 13-fold on a shuffled, balanced version, compared with a baseline that computes one gradient per round.

The paper is clear about the privacy limits. An update is the minimum information needed to improve the model and can be discarded once applied. Updates can still leak, though: with sparse bag-of-words features, the nonzero gradients show exactly which words a user typed. Stronger guarantees can be layered on with differential privacy or secure multiparty computation.

In April 2017 Google's research blog said federated learning was being tested in Gboard on Android to improve its query-suggestion model, with phones taking part only when idle, charging, and on a free wireless connection. A 2019 system-design paper by Bonawitz and colleagues reported a production system for mobile devices built on TensorFlow.

limit.zh: 联邦学习不等于自动保护了隐私：原始数据不出设备，但更新仍可能泄露信息，服务器也得被信任，或者再配上安全聚合、差分隐私。论文的实验在模拟环境里做，设备随时掉线、本地数据不断变化这些部署问题，作者明确说不在这篇论文里解决。在多台机器上训练模型再取平均也不是从这里开始的，论文自己就引用了更早的平均算法。日期：按 arXiv 初稿定年（2016 年 2 月 17 日，题为 Federated Learning of Deep Networks using Model Averaging）；改了标题的会议版发表在 AISTATS 2017。
limit.en: Federated learning does not guarantee privacy by itself. Raw data stays on the device, but updates can still leak information, and the server must be trusted unless secure aggregation or differential privacy is added. The experiments ran in a simulated environment; the authors state that deployment problems such as devices dropping out and local data changing are outside this paper. Averaging models trained on separate machines did not start here either; the paper cites earlier averaging algorithms. Dates: the entry uses the arXiv draft of February 17, 2016, titled Federated Learning of Deep Networks using Model Averaging; a retitled conference version appeared at AISTATS 2017.

sources: McMahan et al. · Federated Learning of Deep Networks using Model Averaging, arXiv v1, 2016-02-17
McMahan et al. · Communication-Efficient Learning of Deep Networks from Decentralized Data, AISTATS 2017, PMLR 54
McMahan & Ramage · Federated Learning: Collaborative Machine Learning without Centralized Training Data, Google Research blog, 2017-04-06
Bonawitz et al. · Towards Federated Learning at Scale: System Design, arXiv v1, 2019-02-04, abstract

title.zh: 22 纳米三栅晶体管 · 晶体管立起来了
title.en: 22 nm Tri-Gate · the transistor stands up

body.zh: 几十年来，芯片里的晶体管都是平的，栅极只从上面一侧控制电流。Intel 说，到 22 纳米这一代，再照摩尔定律缩小变得更难，器件小到一定程度，物理规律就成了障碍。2011 年 5 月 4 日，Intel 宣布将把 2002 年就披露过的三栅（Tri-Gate）晶体管用于 22 纳米的大规模制造：电流通道做成一条从硅片上竖起的薄“鳍”，栅极从两侧和顶上三面包住它。Intel 称，这样能在更低电压下工作，漏电也更少。
body.en: For decades the transistors on a chip were flat, with the gate controlling current from the top side only. Intel said that keeping pace with Moore's Law grew more complex at the 22 nm generation, as devices became so small that physical laws themselves turned into barriers. On May 4, 2011, Intel announced that it would put its Tri-Gate transistor, first disclosed in 2002, into high-volume manufacturing at 22 nm. The channel becomes a thin fin rising vertically from the silicon, and the gate wraps it on both sides and across the top. Intel said this let transistors run at lower voltage with less leakage.

detail.zh:
可以把平面晶体管想成一条平铺在地上的水渠，闸门只从上面压下来；三栅晶体管把水渠竖成一道薄墙，闸门从左、右、上三面卡住。Intel 的解释是：三面一起控制，导通时能通过尽量多的电流，关断时电流尽量接近零，开关也更快。鳍是竖着的，晶体管还能排得更密。

Intel 给的数字是：和自家 32 纳米平面晶体管相比，低电压下性能最多提高 37%；性能相同时，功耗不到一半。当天 Intel 还展示了代号 Ivy Bridge 的 22 纳米处理器在笔记本、服务器和台式机上运行，并说它要在年底前做好大规模生产的准备。

这批处理器在 2012 年 4 月 23 日作为第三代酷睿上市，先推出的是四核型号。Intel 的发布稿称，它们是世界上最早用 22 纳米三栅晶体管做成的芯片。
detail.en:
Picture a planar transistor as a channel laid flat on the ground, with a sluice gate pressing down from above. The Tri-Gate design stands the channel up as a thin wall and clamps it from left, right, and top. In Intel's explanation, control from three sides lets as much current as possible flow when the transistor is on, brings it as close to zero as possible when off, and speeds up switching. Because the fins are vertical, transistors can also be packed more tightly.

Intel's figures: compared with its own 32 nm planar transistors, up to 37% more performance at low voltage, or less than half the power at the same performance. The same day Intel showed a 22 nm processor code-named Ivy Bridge running in a laptop, a server, and a desktop, and said it was slated for high-volume production readiness by the end of the year.

The processors went on sale on April 23, 2012, as the third-generation Core family, starting with quad-core models. Intel's release called them the first chips in the world made with its 22 nm 3-D Tri-Gate transistors.

limit.zh: 37%、功耗减半这些都是 Intel 发布的数字，比较对象是它自家的 32 纳米工艺，不是独立测试；“最早”的说法也来自 Intel。三栅结构改进的是栅极对电流的控制，并不单独决定整颗芯片的性能。别的厂商也有鳍式晶体管，常以 FinFET 为名，比如三星把自家 10 纳米工艺称作 10nm FinFET；这里只记 Intel 这一次。日期：2011 年 5 月 4 日是宣布和演示的日子，当时产品还没上市；首批产品是 2012 年 4 月 23 日上市的。
limit.en: The 37% and half-power figures are Intel's own, measured against its own 32 nm process, not independent tests; the claim of being first is also Intel's. The Tri-Gate structure improves the gate's control over current; it does not by itself decide a chip's overall performance. Other manufacturers have fin-shaped transistors too, usually under the name FinFET, as in Samsung's reference to its 10nm FinFET process; this entry covers only Intel's announcement. Dates: May 4, 2011 was the announcement and demonstration, before any product shipped; the first products went on sale on April 23, 2012.

sources: Intel · Intel Reinvents Transistors Using New 3-D Structure, press release, 2011-05-04
Intel · 3rd Generation Intel Core processors, launch press release, 2012-04-23
Samsung · EUV-based 7nm LPP production release, 2018-10-18, naming its earlier 10nm FinFET process

title.zh: EUV 光刻 · 用 13.5 纳米的光印芯片
title.en: EUV lithography · printing chips with 13.5 nm light

body.zh: 芯片上的图形是用光“印”上去的，波长越短，印得越细。EUV 之前的常规做法是 193 纳米的氟化氩浸没式光刻，线条太细时一层要分几次曝光，三星说最多要用 4 张掩模，又贵又费工序。EUV 用 13.5 纳米的极紫外光，同样一层一张掩模就够。这条路走得很慢：1980 年代就有人做实验，ASML 1997 年启动 EUV 项目，2010 年交付第一台预生产机型，直到 2019 年，才有用 EUV 做的芯片进入商用产品。
body.en: Chip patterns are printed with light, and shorter wavelengths print finer features. Before EUV, the conventional method was 193 nm argon fluoride immersion lithography; very fine lines meant splitting one layer into several exposures, which Samsung said could take up to four masks, adding cost and steps. EUV uses 13.5 nm extreme ultraviolet light and needs a single mask for that layer. The road was long. Experiments began in the 1980s, ASML started its EUV program in 1997 and shipped its first pre-production system in 2010, and only in 2019 did chips made with EUV reach commercial products.

detail.zh:
EUV 难在这种光几乎会被所有东西吸收，所以光要在高真空里产生和传播，也不能用透镜，只能靠多层膜反射镜把掩模上的图形缩小四倍，投到硅片上。光源的做法是：用二氧化碳激光先后两次打中高速飞过的小锡滴，把锡打成等离子体发出 EUV，每秒最多五万次。ASML 回顾说，2010 年交付时机器的基本功能已经有了，难在把产能做到芯片厂用得起。

2018 年 10 月 18 日，三星宣布用 EUV 的 7LPP 工艺开始晶圆生产，并说总的掩模数能比不用 EUV 的工艺少约 20%。2019 年 10 月 7 日，台积电宣布 N7+ 工艺已在大批量给客户出货：它从 2019 年第二季度开始量产，良率接近量产一年多的 N7，密度提高 15–20%，EUV 机台日常输出功率超过 250 瓦。ASML 则把 2019 年的三星 Galaxy Note10 记为第一款用上 EUV 的商用产品。

EUV 没有取代全部光刻。ASML 的产品页写明，EUV 用来印芯片上最复杂的几层，其余各层仍用 DUV 光刻机。ASML 说，到 2021 年底，客户工厂里在用的新一代 EUV 机器有 127 台。
detail.en:
The difficulty is that almost everything absorbs EUV light, so it must be produced and used in a high vacuum. Lenses are out; multilayer mirrors carry the light and shrink the mask pattern fourfold onto the wafer. To make the light, a CO2 laser hits a fast-moving droplet of tin with two pulses, turning it into a plasma that emits EUV, up to 50,000 times a second. ASML recalls that the basics of the machine were in place by the 2010 shipment; the hard part was reaching the productivity that made EUV affordable for chipmakers.

On October 18, 2018, Samsung announced it had started wafer production on its EUV-based 7LPP process and said the total mask count could drop by about 20% compared with a process without EUV. On October 7, 2019, TSMC announced that its N7+ process was delivering customer products in high volume. Volume production had begun in the second quarter of 2019, yields were close to those of N7, which had been in volume production for over a year, density was 15–20% higher, and the EUV tools ran above 250 watts in daily operation. ASML counts Samsung's Galaxy Note10, released in 2019, as the first commercial product made with EUV.

EUV did not replace all lithography. ASML's product page says EUV prints the most intricate layers of a chip while the remaining layers still use DUV systems. By the end of 2021, according to ASML, 127 of its latest-generation EUV machines were in use at customer sites.

limit.zh: “第一”的说法各家不同：台积电说 N7+ 是业界第一个商用 EUV 工艺，三星 2018 年就宣布开始 EUV 晶圆生产，ASML 又把三星手机记为第一款 EUV 商用产品。这些都是厂商自己的说法，这里不替谁定“第一”；15–20% 的密度、掩模少约 20% 等数字也来自厂商。EUV 让更细的图形能一次印出来，但 ASML 也说，芯片厂还得一起调好掩模、光刻胶和设计工具。日期：2019 年指 EUV 芯片进入商用产品、台积电宣布大批量交付；三星宣布开始生产是 2018 年 10 月，ASML 交付第一台预生产机型是 2010 年。
limit.en: Claims of being first differ. TSMC called N7+ the industry's first commercially available EUV process, Samsung had announced EUV wafer production in 2018, and ASML names a Samsung phone as the first commercial EUV product. These are all vendor statements, and the entry does not pick a winner; figures such as 15–20% more density and about 20% fewer masks are vendor figures too. EUV prints finer patterns in one exposure, but ASML notes that chipmakers also had to tune masks, photoresists, and design software around it. Dates: 2019 marks EUV chips reaching commercial products and TSMC's high-volume announcement; Samsung announced the start of production in October 2018, and ASML shipped its first pre-production system in 2010.

sources: TSMC · N7+ is first EUV process delivering customer products in high volume, press release, 2019-10-07
Samsung · Starts production of EUV-based 7nm LPP process, press release, 2018-10-18
ASML · Making EUV: from lab to fab, company story, 2022-03-30
