title.zh: 信息论 · 有噪声的线路能传多少
title.en: Information theory · how much a noisy channel can carry

body.zh: 1940 年代，PCM 这类调制方式已经能用更宽的频带换更好的信噪比，但还缺一把共同的尺子：有噪声的线路到底能传多少信息？直觉上，想少出错只能多重复几遍，速度越来越慢。Shannon 把信息量定义为从一组可能的消息中做选择时的不确定性，称为熵，用比特计；再证明每条有噪声的信道都有一个容量 C：速率低于 C，编码得当就能让错误率任意小；高于 C，怎么编码都做不到。
body.en: In the 1940s, modulation schemes such as PCM could already trade bandwidth for signal-to-noise ratio, but there was no common yardstick for how much information a noisy line could carry. Intuition said fewer errors meant more repetition and an ever slower rate. Shannon defined information as the uncertainty in choosing one message from a set of possibilities, called it entropy, and measured it in bits. He then proved that every noisy channel has a capacity C: below that rate, suitable coding can make errors as rare as desired; above it, no coding can.

detail.zh:
Shannon 自己举过一个例子。每秒发 1000 个符号，0 和 1 各占一半，噪声让平均每 100 个错 1 个。直觉上的答案是每秒传了 990 比特，可接收方并不知道错在哪里。按他的算法，每个符号还剩 0.081 比特的不确定性，实际传输率是 1000 − 81 = 919 比特每秒。噪声再大，大到收到什么都和发了什么无关时，仍有一半符号碰巧是对的，传输率却是 0，跟在接收端抛硬币没有区别。顺带一提，“比特”这个词是 J. W. Tukey 建议的。

同一篇论文还估了英语本身的冗余。只看相距八个字母以内的统计规律，英语的冗余大约是 50%：写下的内容约一半由语言结构决定，另一半才是自由选择。电报本可以靠更好的编码省下约一半时间，没这么做也有好处：错掉不少字母，读者还能靠上下文补回来。1951 年，Shannon 又让人根据前文猜下一个字母，估计长距离的上下文能把英语的熵降到每个字母 1 比特左右，冗余约 75%。

容量定理只证明了好编码存在，没有给出造法；Shannon 在讨论部分就说，照着证明的思路去构造编码一般不现实。后来的编码慢慢逼近这个界限。Gallager 在 1962 年提出低密度奇偶校验码（LDPC），之后长期被冷落；1993 年，Turbo 码论文以“接近 Shannon 极限”为题发表；1996 年，MacKay 和 Neal 重新发现 LDPC，在高斯信道的模拟中，它离 Shannon 极限几乎和 Turbo 码一样近。
detail.en:
Shannon gives his own example. Send 1,000 symbols per second, 0 and 1 equally likely, and let noise corrupt one in a hundred. The tempting answer is 990 bits per second, but the receiver does not know which symbols are wrong. By Shannon's measure, 0.081 bits of uncertainty remain per symbol, so the actual rate is 1,000 − 81 = 919 bits per second. Push the noise until what arrives is independent of what was sent: half the symbols are still right by chance, yet the rate is zero, no better than flipping a coin at the receiver. The word “bit”, incidentally, was suggested by J. W. Tukey.

The same paper estimated the redundancy of English. Counting only statistical structure within about eight letters, English is roughly 50% redundant: about half of what we write is fixed by the language and half is chosen freely. A telegraph could save about half its time with better encoding, but keeping the redundancy has a benefit: many letters can be garbled and still recovered from context. In 1951 Shannon had people guess the next letter of a text from what came before, and estimated that long-range context brings English down to about one bit per letter, a redundancy of roughly 75%.

The capacity theorem shows that good codes exist without saying how to build them; in the paper's own discussion, Shannon notes that constructing codes by following the proof is generally impractical. Later codes closed in on the limit. Gallager described low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes in 1962, and they were then largely forgotten. A 1993 paper presented turbo codes under the title “near Shannon limit”. In 1996 MacKay and Neal rediscovered LDPC codes and showed in simulations on Gaussian channels that they came almost as close to the Shannon limit as turbo codes.

limit.zh: Shannon 开篇就说明，消息的意义与这里的工程问题无关：熵衡量的是从多少种可能里做选择，不衡量内容真不真、有没有用。容量也是针对具体统计特性的信源和信道算出来的，噪声的性质变了，就得重算。日期：论文分两部分刊于《贝尔系统技术期刊》1948 年 7 月号和 10 月号；这里读的是带勘误的重印本。
limit.en: Shannon says at the outset that meaning is irrelevant to the engineering problem: entropy measures how many possibilities a choice is made from, not whether a message is true or useful. Capacity is also computed for a source and channel with particular statistics; different noise calls for a new calculation. Dates: the paper appeared in two parts in the Bell System Technical Journal, in the July and October 1948 issues; the text read here is a reprint with corrections.

sources: Shannon · A Mathematical Theory of Communication, Bell System Technical Journal, July and October 1948 (reprint with corrections), Introduction, §§6–7, 9, 12–14
Shannon · Prediction and Entropy of Printed English, Bell System Technical Journal, January 1951, §1
MacKay and Neal · Near Shannon Limit Performance of Low Density Parity Check Codes, 1996 preprint for Electronics Letters, abstract and results

title.zh: 随机逼近 · 测量有噪声，也能一步步逼近
title.en: Stochastic approximation · converging through noisy trials

body.zh: 有些实验只能一次次去试。比如想找让一半受试对象出现反应的剂量：每次结果都带随机性，反应随剂量变化的曲线 M(x) 也不知道长什么样。经典的逐次逼近方法要用到准确的函数值，有时还要导数，这里都拿不到。Robbins 和 Monro 给了一个很简单的规则：根据上一次的观测，把下一次的试验水平往目标方向调一点，调整幅度 a_n 逐次变小，比如取 1/n。他们证明，在观测值有界、M(x) 单调等条件下，x_n 会在概率意义下收敛到要找的点，不必知道曲线的具体形式。
body.en: Some experiments can only be run one trial at a time. Suppose you want the dose at which half of the subjects respond: every outcome is random, and the shape of the response curve M(x) is unknown. Classical successive-approximation methods need exact function values, sometimes derivatives, and neither is available. Robbins and Monro proposed a simple rule: use the last observation to nudge the next trial level toward the target, with adjustments a_n that shrink over time, such as 1/n. They proved that, under conditions such as bounded observations and a monotone M(x), the levels x_n converge in probability to the target, with no assumption about the curve's form.

detail.zh:
以“半数反应剂量”为例。第 n 次给剂量 x_n，有反应记 y_n = 1，没有记 0，下一次取 x_{n+1} = x_n + a_n(0.5 − y_n)：有反应就把剂量降 a_n/2，没反应就升 a_n/2。这正是论文第 4 节讨论的情形：只知道每次有没有反应，作者提到的应用场景是生物检定和灵敏度试验。对步长，论文要求 a_n 的平方和有限，同时 a_n 本身的和是无穷大；1/n 两条都满足。

作者说得很克制：不声称这个方法最有效率，只证明它一致、不依赖分布，认为随机逼近值得继续研究。后来机器学习里的随机梯度下降面对的是同一类问题：每一步只用一个随机样本估计梯度，方向带噪声。Bottou 2010 年的文章写道，SGD 的收敛在随机逼近文献里已有大量研究，常见条件正是步长平方和有限、步长之和无穷；步长降得太慢，估计值的抖动迟迟不消，降得太快，又要很久才能靠近最优点。他在 RCV1 文本分类（78 万多篇训练文档）上训练线性 SVM，SGD 用 1.4 秒就达到 6.02% 的测试错误率，SVMLight 达到同样结果用了 23,642 秒。
detail.en:
Take the half-response dose. On trial n, give dose x_n, record y_n = 1 for a response and 0 otherwise, and set x_{n+1} = x_n + a_n(0.5 − y_n): a response lowers the dose by a_n/2, no response raises it by a_n/2. This is the situation in the paper's Section 4, where only response or no response is observed; the authors mention bioassay and sensitivity testing. For the step sizes, the paper requires the squares of a_n to have a finite sum while the a_n themselves sum to infinity; 1/n satisfies both.

The authors were modest. They claimed no optimality, only that the procedure is consistent and distribution-free, and that stochastic approximation deserved further study. Stochastic gradient descent in machine learning later faced the same kind of problem: each step estimates the gradient from one random example, so the direction is noisy. Bottou's 2010 paper notes that SGD's convergence had been studied extensively in the stochastic approximation literature, usually under exactly these conditions on the step sizes. Steps that shrink too slowly leave the estimate jittering; steps that shrink too fast take a long time to approach the optimum. Training a linear SVM on the RCV1 text task, with over 780,000 training documents, SGD reached 6.02% test error in 1.4 seconds; SVMLight took 23,642 seconds to reach the same error.

limit.zh: 收敛定理带着条件：观测值必须有界，M(x) 要单调，并在目标点处斜率为正。作者认为这些条件还能放宽，但当时没有证明。结论只保证最终收敛，不告诉你试多少次才够，效率还取决于起点和 a_n 的选法。思路也不是凭空出现：论文注明，在这个问题里使用收敛的序贯过程，最早由 Anderson、McCarthy 和 Tukey 在 1946 年的海军军械报告中提到。日期：刊于《数理统计年刊》1951 年 9 月号。
limit.en: The convergence theorems come with conditions: observations must be bounded, and M(x) must be monotone with a positive slope at the target. The authors thought these could be relaxed but did not prove it. The result guarantees eventual convergence, not how many trials are enough; efficiency depends on the starting point and the choice of a_n. Nor did the idea come from nowhere: the paper credits a 1946 Naval Ordnance report by Anderson, McCarthy, and Tukey with first mentioning a convergent sequential process for this problem. Date: Annals of Mathematical Statistics, September 1951.

sources: Robbins and Monro · A Stochastic Approximation Method, Annals of Mathematical Statistics 22(3), September 1951, §§1–5
Bottou · Large-Scale Machine Learning with Stochastic Gradient Descent, 2010, author's PDF, §§2.2, 5 and Figure 1

title.zh: Metropolis 方法 · 按概率接受随机的一步
title.en: The Metropolis method · accepting random moves by probability

body.zh: 想从分子间的作用力算出一种物质的压强，要对所有分子的位置做积分。平面上几百个粒子，就是几百维的积分，按网格逐点计算根本不可能。随机撒点也不行：在密集的系统里，随手摆出的构型权重 exp(−E/kT) 几乎都小到可以忽略。Metropolis 等五位作者换了个做法：每次随机挪动一个粒子，能量降低就接受；能量升高，就以 exp(−ΔE/kT) 的概率接受，否则退回原位，并把原构型再记一次。这样走下去，各构型出现的频率趋向 exp(−E/kT) 给出的分布，直接求平均就行。
body.en: Computing a substance's pressure from the forces between its molecules means integrating over every molecule's position. A few hundred particles in a plane make an integral over hundreds of dimensions, hopeless for grid-based methods. Random sampling fails too: in a dense system, almost every randomly placed configuration has a negligible weight exp(−E/kT). Metropolis and his four coauthors changed the procedure. Move one particle at random. If the energy falls, accept the move; if it rises, accept it with probability exp(−ΔE/kT), and otherwise put the particle back and count the old configuration again. Repeated, this makes configurations appear with frequencies approaching exp(−E/kT), so plain averages give the answer.

detail.zh:
接受规则可以拿几个数感受一下：能量升高 1 个 kT，接受的概率是 e⁻¹，约 37%；升高 3 个 kT，约 5%。所以系统多半往低能量走，偶尔也会爬坡。论文特别强调两处细节。一是被拒绝的那一步也要计数，把原构型再记一次，否则会无端压低某些状态所占的比例。二是每步最大挪动距离要选好：太大，多数移动会被拒绝；太小，构型几乎不变；两种情况都要更久才能达到平衡。

实际计算在 Los Alamos 的 MANIAC 计算机上进行：224 个硬圆盘放在单位正方形里，每个粒子各挪一次算一个循环，一个循环约 3 分钟，压强曲线上的一个点要跑四五个小时，平均误差约 3%。56 个和 224 个粒子的结果在统计误差内一致。随机数用的是“平方取中”法：把一个 m 位数平方，取中间的 m 位作为下一个。

1983 年，Kirkpatrick、Gelatt 和 Vecchi 把这个过程搬到优化问题上：用成本函数代替能量，温度只当作控制参数，先在高温下“熔化”，再慢慢降温，这就是模拟退火。他们的理由是，只接受下坡改进的搜索很容易困在局部最优，Metropolis 规则允许有控制地往上走几步。文中的应用来自计算机设计，包括电路划分、元件布置和布线，也讨论了旅行商问题。
detail.en:
A few numbers make the rule concrete. A move that raises the energy by one kT is accepted with probability e⁻¹, about 37%; by three kT, about 5%. The system mostly drifts downhill but sometimes climbs. The paper stresses two details. A rejected move still counts: the old configuration is recorded again, or some states would be unjustifiably underweighted. And the maximum step size needs care: too large and most moves are rejected, too small and the configuration barely changes; either way, equilibrium takes longer.

The calculation ran on the MANIAC at Los Alamos: 224 hard disks in a unit square, with one cycle meaning one attempted move per particle. A cycle took about three minutes, each point on the pressure curve took four to five hours, and the average error was about 3%. Runs with 56 and 224 particles agreed within statistical error. Random numbers came from the middle-square method: square an m-digit number and keep the middle m digits as the next one.

In 1983 Kirkpatrick, Gelatt, and Vecchi carried the procedure over to optimization. A cost function replaces the energy, temperature becomes a control parameter, and the system is first “melted” at high temperature and then cooled slowly: simulated annealing. Their argument was that a search accepting only downhill improvements gets stuck in local optima, while the Metropolis rule allows controlled uphill steps. Their applications came from computer design, including partitioning, component placement, and wiring, alongside the traveling salesman problem.

limit.zh: 论文证明了这个过程最终会趋向正确的分布，但作者明说，这个论证没有回答要多快才能接近。结果也只针对二维硬圆盘，Lennard-Jones 势和三维的情形当时还在计算。它也不是蒙特卡洛方法的起点：论文脚注写明，Mayer 和 Ulam 各自独立提出过这种方法，Alder、Kirkwood 等人也讨论过非常相近的应用。日期：1953 年 3 月 6 日收稿，刊于《化学物理杂志》1953 年 6 月号。
limit.en: The paper proves that the process tends to the right distribution, but the authors say plainly that the argument does not tell how fast. Results covered only two-dimensional hard disks; the Lennard-Jones and three-dimensional cases were still in progress. Nor was this the start of Monte Carlo methods: a footnote says Mayer and Ulam each proposed the method independently, and that Alder, Kirkwood, and others had discussed a very similar application. Dates: received March 6, 1953, and published in the Journal of Chemical Physics, June 1953.

sources: Metropolis, Rosenbluth, Rosenbluth, Teller and Teller · Equation of State Calculations by Fast Computing Machines, Journal of Chemical Physics 21(6), June 1953, §§I–IV, VI
Kirkpatrick, Gelatt and Vecchi · Optimization by Simulated Annealing, Science 220, 13 May 1983, introduction and statistical-mechanics section

title.zh: 动态规划 · 每个状态下该怎么做
title.en: Dynamic programming · deciding from the current state

body.zh: 工厂排产、库存采购、设备什么时候换，这类问题要连续做很多步决策，每一步都会改变后面的局面。传统做法是列出所有可能的决策序列，逐个算收益再取最好；阶段和选择稍微一多，维数就高得有时连当时的计算机都吃不消。Bellman 的出发点是：不必事先排好整串决策，只要有一条规则说清每个状态下该怎么做。由最优性原理——不论起点和最初几步怎样，剩下的决策对由此到达的状态也必须是最优的——可以写出递推方程，把大问题拆成一步一步的小问题。
body.en: Planning a production line, buying inventory, or deciding when to replace machinery takes a long series of decisions, each changing the situation for the next. The classical approach listed every possible sequence of decisions, computed the return of each, and kept the best; with even moderate numbers of stages and choices, the dimension could grow too high even for the computing machines of the day. Bellman's starting point was that no complete sequence needs to be planned in advance, only a rule for what to do in each state. From the principle of optimality, that whatever the initial state and first decisions, the remaining decisions must be optimal for the state they lead to, he wrote recursive equations that break a large problem into one step at a time.

detail.zh:
差别可以数出来。10 个阶段、每步 10 种选择，完整的决策序列有 10¹⁰ 种。按 Bellman 的写法，记 f_N(p) 为从状态 p 出发、还剩 N 步时按最优策略能得到的收益。第一步一旦走到某个新状态，接下来能拿到的最好结果就是 f_{N−1}(新状态)，所以只需在第一步的几种选择里比较。随机的情形把后面的收益换成期望值。方程一般解不出解析解，Bellman 建议逐次逼近：要么反复代入方程去逼近收益函数，要么从一个简单策略出发不断改进，后一种做法的收益每轮只增不减。

论文里有个采金的例子。两座金矿 A 和 B，只有一台采矿机：用在 A 矿，有一定概率采走那里剩余黄金的固定比例，机器完好；否则什么也没采到，机器报废。B 矿的概率和比例不同。每一步该去哪座矿，才能让机器报废前的期望总产量最大？解的结构很简单：比较两座矿“这一步的期望收获”与“这一步的期望损失”之比，选比值大的那座。Bellman 也提醒，有反例表明，这种直观规则在更复杂的决策过程里并不普遍成立。

后来的强化学习直接借用了这套框架。Watkins 和 Dayan 1992 年的 Q-learning 论文开头就说，Q-learning 可以看作一种异步的动态规划：动态规划的理论保证存在最优的平稳策略，但计算时要知道奖励和状态转移概率；Q-learning 不先学这些，而是在一次次尝试中逐步改进每个状态下每个动作的估值，Watkins 因此称它为“增量式动态规划”。
detail.en:
The difference can be counted. With 10 stages and 10 choices per stage, there are 10¹⁰ complete decision sequences. In Bellman's notation, let f_N(p) be the return from state p with N stages left under an optimal policy. Once the first decision leads to some new state, the best that can follow is f_{N−1} of that state, so only the first decision's options need comparing. In the stochastic case, the later return is replaced by its expected value. The equations rarely have closed-form solutions, so Bellman recommended successive approximation: either substitute repeatedly into the equation to approximate the return function, or start from a simple policy and keep improving it, in which case the return never decreases from one round to the next.

The paper includes a gold-mining example. There are two mines, A and B, and a single mining machine. Used in mine A, it extracts a fixed fraction of the remaining gold with some probability and stays intact; otherwise it mines nothing and is ruined. Mine B has its own probability and fraction. Which mine should be worked at each step to maximize the expected total before the machine breaks? The solution has a simple structure: compare, for each mine, the ratio of immediate expected gain to immediate expected loss, and pick the larger. Bellman also notes that a counterexample shows this intuitive rule does not hold in general for more complicated processes.

Later reinforcement learning borrowed this framework directly. Watkins and Dayan's 1992 Q-learning paper opens by describing Q-learning as a form of asynchronous dynamic programming. Dynamic programming guarantees an optimal stationary policy but needs the rewards and transition probabilities to compute it. Q-learning does not learn those first; it improves its estimate of each action in each state through repeated trials, which is why Watkins called it incremental dynamic programming.

limit.zh: 它把问题降到“这一步怎么选”的规模，但收益函数 f 要对每一个可能的状态都有值；描述状态的变量一多，要算、要存的东西也随之增多。Bellman 自己也说这些函数方程在分析上很难对付。名字里的 programming 指的是安排计划，文中“安排培训政策”就是这个用法，与写程序无关。日期：1953 年 9 月 3 日在美国数学会夏季会议上的邀请报告，1954 年 11 月刊于《美国数学会通报》；文末书目已列有他 1952 年的 PNAS 短文和 1953 年的 RAND 报告。
limit.en: The method shrinks the problem to the size of one decision, but the return function f needs a value for every possible state; as the variables describing a state multiply, so does what must be computed and stored. Bellman himself called these functional equations analytically intransigent. The “programming” in the name means planning, as in the paper's own phrase about programming training policies; it has nothing to do with writing code. Dates: an invited address at the American Mathematical Society's summer meeting on September 3, 1953, published in the Bulletin of the AMS in November 1954; its bibliography already lists his 1952 PNAS note and a 1953 RAND report.

sources: Bellman · The Theory of Dynamic Programming, Bulletin of the AMS 60(6), November 1954, §§1–5, 7–8, 12 and bibliography
Watkins and Dayan · Q-learning, Machine Learning 8, 1992, abstract and §1

title.zh: FFT · 傅里叶变换不必做 N² 次运算
title.en: The FFT · Fourier sums without N² operations

body.zh: 从 N 个复数系数算出 N 点傅里叶级数，直接按定义要做 N² 次运算，每次是一次复数乘法加一次复数加法。点数一多，计算量涨得很快：4096 个点就要 1600 多万次。Cooley 和 Tukey 沿用了 Yates、Box 等人和 Good 的思路：N 能分解成很多因子时，大变换可以拆成一串小变换，运算量降到与 N log N 成正比。N 取 2 的幂时，只需不到 2N log₂N 次运算，而且能在原数组里就地完成，不必另开存储空间。
body.en: Computing an N-point Fourier series from N complex coefficients directly takes N² operations, each a complex multiplication followed by a complex addition. The count grows fast: 4,096 points need more than 16 million. Cooley and Tukey built on ideas from Yates, Box and colleagues, and Good: when N factors into many parts, one large transform can be split into a chain of small ones, bringing the work down to something proportional to N log N. When N is a power of 2, fewer than 2N log₂N operations suffice, and the computation runs in place within the original array, with no extra storage.

detail.zh:
拿 N = 1024 算一下：直接计算要约 105 万次运算，新方法不到 2 × 1024 × 10 = 20,480 次，差了约五十倍，N 越大差得越多。代价是结果的顺序被打乱：算完后，第 j 个结果放在“把 j 的二进制位倒过来”的位置上。比如 N = 8 时，X(1) 的下标 001 倒过来是 100，它就存在 4 号位置，需要时再做一次重排。论文还算过，按 3 来拆在形式上最省，但只比按 2 或 4 拆省约 6%，而 2 和 4 在二进制计算机上寻址和乘法都更方便。

作者在 IBM 7094 上写了计算三维傅里叶和的程序，2¹³ = 8192 个数据点用时 0.10 到 0.13 分钟，视三个维度怎样分配而定。四十年后，FFTW 的作者在 2005 年的论文里写道，这个广泛使用的自由软件库主要用的仍是 Cooley–Tukey 算法，但难点换了地方：拆分带来跳跃式的内存访问和数据重排，会妨碍缓存发挥作用。所以 FFTW 不固定一种拆法，而是实际测量多种方案的运行时间，挑最快的那个。
detail.en:
Try N = 1,024. Direct computation takes about 1.05 million operations; the new method needs fewer than 2 × 1,024 × 10 = 20,480, roughly fifty times fewer, and the gap widens as N grows. The price is scrambled output: result j ends up at the position given by reversing the binary digits of j. With N = 8, X(1) has index 001, reversed to 100, so it sits in position 4 until the array is reordered. The paper also works out that splitting by 3 is formally the cheapest, but only about 6% better than splitting by 2 or 4, which are more convenient for addressing and multiplication on binary computers.

The authors wrote a program for the IBM 7094 that computed three-dimensional Fourier sums; 2¹³ = 8,192 data points took 0.10 to 0.13 minutes, depending on how they were split across the three dimensions. Forty years later, the authors of FFTW wrote in a 2005 paper that their widely used free library still relies mainly on the Cooley–Tukey algorithm, but the hard part has moved. The splitting causes scattered memory access and data reordering, which work against caches. So FFTW does not fix one way of splitting; it measures the actual run time of many plans and picks the fastest.

limit.zh: Cooley 和 Tukey 不是最早想到这种拆法的人。论文自己就从 Yates、Box 等人和 Good 的工作讲起；FFTW 论文说，他们在 1965 年“重新发现并推广”了这个算法，Gauss 早在 1805 年就已知道，此后也有人重新发明过。方法要求 N 能分解成较多的小因子；N 是质数时这种拆法帮不上忙，要用 Rader、Bluestein 等其他算法。省下的是乘加次数，在今天的机器上，内存访问方式同样决定速度。日期：1964 年 8 月 17 日收稿，刊于《计算数学》1965 年第 19 卷。
limit.en: Cooley and Tukey were not the first to find this kind of splitting. Their paper starts from work by Yates, Box and colleagues, and Good, and the FFTW paper says they “rediscovered and popularized” the algorithm in 1965, after Gauss had known it as early as 1805 and others had reinvented it. The method needs N to factor into many small parts; for prime N it does not help, and other algorithms such as Rader's and Bluestein's are used. What it saves is multiply-adds; on today's machines, memory access matters just as much. Dates: received August 17, 1964, and published in Mathematics of Computation, volume 19, 1965.

sources: Cooley and Tukey · An Algorithm for the Machine Calculation of Complex Fourier Series, Mathematics of Computation 19 (1965), pp. 297–301
Frigo and Johnson · The Design and Implementation of FFTW3, Proceedings of the IEEE 93(2), 2005, §§I–II

title.zh: Adam · 每个参数各自调步长
title.en: Adam · a step size for every parameter

body.zh: 训练神经网络常用随机梯度下降：每次用一小批数据估计梯度，再用一个全局学习率更新所有参数。梯度带噪声，有的很稀疏，训练目标也可能不断变化，一个学习率很难同时照顾好。此前，AdaGrad 擅长稀疏梯度，RMSProp 适合在线、目标会变的情形。Adam 想把两者的长处合起来：给每个参数分别记录梯度和梯度平方的滑动平均，用前者除以后者的平方根决定这一步走多远，并修正两者从零起步带来的偏差。这样每步的幅度大致被学习率 α 限住，把梯度整体放大缩小也不影响结果。
body.en: Neural networks are usually trained with stochastic gradient descent: estimate the gradient from a small batch of data, then update every parameter with one global learning rate. Gradients are noisy, some are sparse, and the objective may keep shifting, so a single rate struggles to suit everything. AdaGrad handled sparse gradients well, and RMSProp suited online, changing objectives. Adam set out to combine the two. For each parameter it keeps moving averages of the gradient and of the squared gradient, divides the first by the square root of the second to set the step, and corrects both for starting at zero. Each step's size is then roughly bounded by the learning rate α, and rescaling all gradients leaves the updates unchanged.

detail.zh:
设想两个参数，一个的梯度总在 1000 上下，另一个只有 0.001。用学习率 0.001 的 SGD，前者每步挪 1，后者每步只挪百万分之一。Adam 的更新量是 α·m̂/√v̂：梯度方向稳定时，m̂/√v̂ 接近 ±1，两个参数每步都挪大约 α。偏差修正处理的是起步：按后来版本的写法（β1 = 0.9，β2 = 0.999），第一步的两个滑动平均只有 0.1g 和 0.001g²，不修正的话，第一步会是 α 的 3 倍多。论文指出，二阶矩的平均窗口越长（稀疏梯度时正需要这样），这个问题越严重；RMSProp 没有这项修正，开头的步子可能很大，常常发散。

论文在 MNIST 和 IMDB 的逻辑回归、MNIST 上的多层全连接网络和 CIFAR-10 卷积网络上做了比较。后来的模型直接拿来用：2017 年的 Transformer 用 Adam（β1 = 0.9，β2 = 0.98，ε = 10⁻⁹），学习率先在 4000 步内线性升高，再按步数的平方根倒数下降；2018 年 BERT 预训练用的是学习率 10⁻⁴、β1 = 0.9、β2 = 0.999 的 Adam，加上 0.01 的 L2 权重衰减和 1 万步预热。
detail.en:
Picture two parameters, one with gradients around 1,000 and one with gradients around 0.001. SGD with a learning rate of 0.001 moves the first by 1 per step and the second by a millionth. Adam's update is α·m̂/√v̂: when a gradient's direction is steady, m̂/√v̂ is close to ±1, so both parameters move by about α. Bias correction handles the start. In the later versions' notation (β1 = 0.9, β2 = 0.999), the two averages after one step are only 0.1g and 0.001g², and without correction the first step would be more than three times α. The paper notes that the problem grows when the second-moment average spans a long window, which sparse gradients require; RMSProp lacks the correction, so its early steps can be very large and often diverge.

The paper compared optimizers on logistic regression for MNIST and IMDB, a multilayer fully connected network on MNIST, and a convolutional network on CIFAR-10. Later models simply adopted it. The 2017 Transformer used Adam with β1 = 0.9, β2 = 0.98 and ε = 10⁻⁹, raising the learning rate linearly for 4,000 steps and then decaying it with the inverse square root of the step number. BERT's 2018 pretraining used Adam with a learning rate of 10⁻⁴, β1 = 0.9 and β2 = 0.999, plus L2 weight decay of 0.01 and 10,000 warmup steps.

limit.zh: 收敛分析只针对在线凸优化，作者也写明它不适用于非凸的神经网络。这个分析后来还被指出有漏洞：Reddi、Kale 和 Kumar 在 ICLR 2018 给出一个简单的凸问题，Adam 在上面不收敛到最优解；他们认为原因之一是指数滑动平均让少见但重要的大梯度影响消失得太快。日期：arXiv 初版 2014 年 12 月 22 日，会议版收在 ICLR 2015。初版把衰减系数写成新梯度的权重（β1 = 0.1，β2 = 0.001），默认学习率 0.0002；2017 年的最终版写成 β1 = 0.9、β2 = 0.999，默认学习率 0.001。
limit.en: The convergence analysis covers only online convex optimization, and the authors state that it does not apply to non-convex neural networks. The analysis was later found to have gaps: Reddi, Kale, and Kumar's ICLR 2018 paper gives a simple convex problem on which Adam fails to converge to the optimum, and names the exponential moving average as one cause, since it lets rare but informative large gradients fade too quickly. Dates: the first arXiv version is December 22, 2014, and the conference paper appeared at ICLR 2015. The first version wrote the decay rates as weights on the new gradient (β1 = 0.1, β2 = 0.001) with a default learning rate of 0.0002; the final 2017 version writes β1 = 0.9, β2 = 0.999 and a default of 0.001.

sources: Adam · arXiv v9, 2017-01-30, ICLR 2015 conference version, Algorithm 1 defaults
Attention Is All You Need · arXiv v1, 2017-06-12, §5.3
Reddi, Kale and Kumar · On the Convergence of Adam and Beyond, ICLR 2018 (arXiv posting 2019), abstract and §1

title.zh: Penn Treebank · 程序先标，人再改
title.en: Penn Treebank · machines annotate, people correct

body.zh: 统计方法要从大量真实文本里学语言规律，就得先有标好词性、最好还标好句法结构的语料。更早的 Brown 语料库有 87 个基本词性标签，算上组合标签共 187 个，分得很细，纯人工标注却又慢又难统一。Penn Treebank 让程序先标、人再改：词性先由 PARTS 等标注器给出，句法先由 Fidditch 分析器搭出片段，标注员只负责纠错和拼接。到 1992 年 11 月，词性标注达到约 489 万词次，其中约 288 万词次有简化的句法树，通过语言数据联盟（LDC）提供给会员。
body.en: Statistical methods that learn language from large amounts of real text need corpora annotated with parts of speech, and ideally with syntax. The earlier Brown Corpus had 87 basic part-of-speech tags, 187 counting compound tags; the detail was rich, but annotating entirely by hand was slow and hard to keep consistent. The Penn Treebank had programs annotate first and people correct: taggers such as PARTS proposed parts of speech, the Fidditch parser built partial syntactic structure, and annotators fixed errors and joined the pieces. By November 1992 it held about 4.89 million tokens tagged for part of speech, about 2.88 million of them with simplified syntactic trees, distributed to members of the Linguistic Data Consortium.

detail.zh:
论文做过一个对照实验：四位受过语言学研究生训练的标注员，各自从头手工标四篇文本，再校对四篇机器预标的文本。校对平均每千词 20 分钟，手标要 44 分钟；标注员之间的分歧率，手标是 7.2%，校对是 4.1%。标签集也为此做了减法：能从词形或句法位置推出来的区别，不再单设标签，比如 be、do、have 不再各有一套动词标签。最后定下 36 个词性标签，外加 12 个标点和货币符号标签。

句法更难标。论文的例句大意是：经理们常拿一个故事给新来的人打气，讲他们第一批到墨西哥的同胞：“a boatload of warriors blown ashore 375 years ago”。Fidditch 只把有把握的部分连起来，其余片段标上“?”，留给人挂到正确位置。blown ashore 375 years ago 修饰 warriors 还是 boatload，两种理解意思一样，标注员就用“伪挂接”同时记下。实验发现，标注员很难一致地区分动词的论元和附加语，于是干脆不强制区分；即便如此，熟练后校对句法的速度也只有每小时 750 到 1000 多词，而词性校对一个月后就能超过每小时 3000 词。

后来的句法分析研究常拿它当标准的训练和测试集。Collins 1997 年的分析器用树库《华尔街日报》部分的第 02–21 节（约 4 万句）训练，在第 23 节（2416 句）上测试，成分精确率和召回率分别是 88.1% 和 87.5%。语言模型也用它：2014 年 Zaremba 等人的 LSTM 正则化论文在 PTB 上做词级预测，训练集 92.9 万词，词表 1 万词。
detail.en:
The paper reports a controlled comparison. Four annotators with graduate training in linguistics each tagged four texts from scratch and corrected four machine-tagged texts. Correcting averaged 20 minutes per 1,000 words against 44 for tagging by hand, and disagreement between annotators was 4.1% for correcting against 7.2% for hand tagging. The tagset was trimmed with the same goal: distinctions recoverable from the word itself or its syntactic position got no separate tags, so be, do, and have lost their own verb tags. The final set had 36 part-of-speech tags plus 12 for punctuation and currency symbols.

Syntax was harder. The paper's example sentence has managers cheering up newcomers with a story about the first of their compatriots to reach Mexico: “a boatload of warriors blown ashore 375 years ago”. Fidditch connected only the parts it was sure of and marked the remaining chunks with “?” for people to attach. Whether “blown ashore 375 years ago” modifies the warriors or the boatload makes no difference to the meaning, so annotators recorded both through pseudo-attachment. Annotators could not consistently separate a verb's arguments from its adjuncts, so the distinction was dropped; even then, experienced annotators corrected syntax at only about 750 to over 1,000 words an hour, while part-of-speech correction passed 3,000 words an hour within a month.

Later parsing research used it as a standard training and test set. Collins's 1997 parser trained on sections 02–21 of the treebank's Wall Street Journal portion, about 40,000 sentences, and was tested on section 23, 2,416 sentences, reaching 88.1% constituent precision and 87.5% recall. Language modeling used it too: Zaremba and colleagues' 2014 paper on regularizing LSTMs ran word-level prediction on PTB, with 929,000 training words and a 10,000-word vocabulary.

limit.zh: 它只给“骨架式”的句法结构：名词短语内部基本不分析，论元和附加语也不区分。材料以美式英语为主，词性部分最大的一块是 300 多万词次的道琼斯新闻稿；作者在脚注里也承认，这些原材料更像“有什么收什么”的集合，而不是按设计原则组织的语料。当时词性标注的估计错误率约 3%。日期：论文刊于《计算语言学》1993 年第 19 卷第 2 期，描述的是 1989–1992 年第一阶段、截至 1992 年 11 月的状态。
limit.en: Its syntax is skeletal: the internal structure of noun phrases is mostly left out, and arguments are not distinguished from adjuncts. The material is mainly American English, and the largest block of tagged text is over 3 million tokens of Dow Jones newswire stories; a footnote concedes that the raw materials form an opportunistic collection rather than a carefully structured corpus built to design principles. The estimated part-of-speech error rate at the time was about 3%. Dates: the paper appeared in Computational Linguistics 19(2), 1993, and describes the first phase, 1989–1992, as of November 1992.

sources: Marcus, Santorini and Marcinkiewicz · Building a Large Annotated Corpus of English: The Penn Treebank, Computational Linguistics 19(2), 1993, §§1–5 and Table 4
Collins · Three Generative, Lexicalised Models for Statistical Parsing, ACL 1997, abstract and §4
Zaremba, Sutskever and Vinyals · Recurrent Neural Network Regularization, arXiv v1, 2014-09-08, §4.1

title.zh: SQuAD · 答案必须是原文里的一段
title.en: SQuAD · answers taken from the passage

body.zh: 2016 年以前的阅读理解数据集有两种：MCTest 这类质量高，但只有几千道题，不够训练现代模型；CNN/Daily Mail 这类有上百万题，却是把摘要里的实体挖空自动生成的，答案只是一个词或实体，已有研究发现它们需要的推理比预想的少。SQuAD 请众包工作者针对 536 篇维基百科文章写了 107,785 个问题，答案必须是段落里的一段原文，不给选项。题目由人来写，评分又能自动完成。论文的逻辑回归模型 F1 为 51.0%，人类为 86.8%。
body.en: Before 2016, reading comprehension datasets came in two kinds. Some, such as MCTest, were high quality but had only a few thousand questions, too few to train modern models. Others, such as CNN/Daily Mail, had over a million questions but were generated automatically by blanking out entities in summaries; the answers were single words or entities, and later analysis found they needed less reasoning than expected. SQuAD had crowdworkers write 107,785 questions on 536 Wikipedia articles, and every answer had to be a span of the passage, with no answer choices. People wrote the questions, yet scoring stayed automatic. The paper's logistic regression model reached 51.0% F1, against 86.8% for humans.

detail.zh:
论文的第一个例子是一段讲降水的文字。问“什么让降水落下”，答案是 gravity：要先找到原文里 falls under gravity 那句，再明白 under 在这里表示原因而不是位置。问“水滴在哪里与冰晶碰撞形成降水”，答案是 within a cloud。评分看两个数：预测是否与某个标准答案完全一致（EM），以及词语重合有多少（F1）。为了不让题目照抄原文，网页禁用了复制粘贴，并提醒工作者用自己的话提问；每段要求花 4 分钟，按每小时 9 美元付酬。

两年后，BERT 在 SQuAD 1.1 上只新增预测答案起点和终点的两个向量，集成模型加上 TriviaQA 数据后，测试集 F1 达到 93.2，排行榜上的人类成绩是 91.2。但“超过人类”要打折扣。Jia 和 Liang 2017 年在段落里自动插入一句不改变答案、也不会误导人、却能干扰模型的话，16 个已发表模型的平均 F1 从 75% 跌到 36%。2018 年的 SQuAD 2.0 又加入 5 万多个众包写的不可回答问题，它们看上去和可答的问题很像，一个在 SQuAD 1.1 上 F1 为 86% 的强模型，在 2.0 上只有 66%。
detail.en:
The paper's first example is a passage about precipitation. Asked what causes precipitation to fall, the answer is “gravity”: a system must find the sentence saying precipitation falls under gravity and realize that “under” marks a cause, not a location. Asked where water droplets collide with ice crystals to form precipitation, the answer is “within a cloud”. Scoring uses two numbers: whether a prediction exactly matches one of the reference answers (EM), and how much the words overlap (F1). To keep workers from copying the passage, the interface disabled copy and paste and reminded them to use their own words; they were asked to spend four minutes per paragraph and paid $9 an hour.

Two years later, BERT added only two vectors for SQuAD 1.1, one predicting where the answer starts and one where it ends. An ensemble trained with extra TriviaQA data reached 93.2 F1 on the test set, where the leaderboard's human score was 91.2. But “beating humans” needs qualification. In 2017 Jia and Liang automatically inserted a sentence that left the answer unchanged and would not mislead people but distracted models, and the average F1 of sixteen published models dropped from 75% to 36%. SQuAD 2.0, in 2018, added over 50,000 unanswerable questions written by crowdworkers to look like answerable ones; a strong model with 86% F1 on SQuAD 1.1 scored only 66% on 2.0.

limit.zh: SQuAD 1.x 的每个问题在段落里都有答案，模型只要挑出最像答案的那一段，不必判断“原文没说”；把答案限定为原文片段，论文也承认会排除需要大量解读的问题。所谓人类成绩，是把第二位众包工作者的答案当作“预测”与其余答案比对得出的，分歧多出在要不要带上无关紧要的修饰语。论文报告的是 1.0 版测试集（人类 F1 86.8%），BERT 对照的是 1.1 版排行榜（91.2），两者不能直接相比。日期：arXiv 初版 2016 年 6 月 16 日，正式发表于 2016 年 11 月的 EMNLP。
limit.en: Every SQuAD 1.x question has an answer in the passage, so a model only has to pick the most plausible span and never has to decide that the text does not say. Restricting answers to spans, as the paper admits, also rules out highly interpretive questions. The human score treats the second crowdworker's answer as a prediction and compares it with the others; most mismatches concern whether to include non-essential phrases. The paper reports version 1.0 of the test set (86.8% human F1), while BERT compared against the version 1.1 leaderboard (91.2), so the two are not directly comparable. Dates: the first arXiv version is June 16, 2016, and the paper was published at EMNLP in November 2016.

sources: Jia and Liang · Adversarial Examples for Evaluating Reading Comprehension Systems, arXiv v1, 2017-07-23, abstract
Rajpurkar, Jia and Liang · Know What You Don't Know: Unanswerable Questions for SQuAD, arXiv v1, 2018-06-11, abstract

title.zh: GLUE · 九个任务，一个总分

body.zh: 到 2018 年，语言理解模型大多为单个任务设计，换个领域的文本就表现吃力；已有的 SentEval 也只评估“先把句子编成向量、再接简单分类器”这一种用法。GLUE 收集了九个现成的句子或句对任务，包括语法可接受性、情感、复述、语义相似度和文本蕴含，训练数据从 706 条到 40 万条不等。测试集标签不公开，统一在网站上打分，取各任务平均作为总分。它不限制模型结构，但有的任务训练数据很少，于是奖励能在任务之间共享知识的方法。作者还编写了一套诊断集，按语言现象分析模型的错误。
body.en: By 2018, most language understanding models were built for a single task and struggled with text from other domains. The existing SentEval evaluated only one usage: encode a sentence as a vector, then attach a simple classifier. GLUE gathered nine existing sentence and sentence-pair tasks, covering grammatical acceptability, sentiment, paraphrase, semantic similarity, and entailment, with training sets ranging from 706 to 400,000 examples. Test labels stay private; systems are scored on a website and ranked by the average across tasks. GLUE places no constraint on model architecture, but some tasks have very little training data, which rewards methods that share knowledge across tasks. The authors also built a diagnostic set for analyzing errors by linguistic phenomenon.

detail.zh:
总分是这样算的：九个任务各用各的指标，比如 CoLA 用 Matthews 相关系数，MRPC 和 QQP 取准确率与 F1 的平均，然后九个数再平均。初版论文的基线里，最高的平均分是 60.3（BiLSTM 加 ELMo，逐个任务单独训练）；简单的多任务训练总体上并不比给每个任务单独训一个模型好，只在训练数据少的任务上有帮助。诊断集显示，当时的模型能抓住强烈的词汇线索，碰到逻辑就吃力。总分也掩盖了差别：CoLA 上不少基线接近 0，SST-2 上却都在 80 以上。

分数涨得比预想快。2018 年 10 月，BERT 初版报告 GLUE 80.4，比此前最好成绩高 7.6；WNLI 一项它一律预测多数类，并在比较中剔除，因为 GLUE 网站说明这个数据集的构造有问题，提交过的系统都不如一律猜多数类的 65.1。2019 年 5 月，部分相同的作者推出 SuperGLUE：当时 GLUE 最高分 83.8，只比他们估计的人类水平 87.1 低 3.3，在 QQP、MRPC 和 QNLI 三个任务上已超过人类估计。新基准只保留了原来九个任务中的两个，其余换成更难的任务。
detail.en:
The score works like this. Each of the nine tasks uses its own metric, such as Matthews correlation for CoLA and the average of accuracy and F1 for MRPC and QQP, and the nine numbers are then averaged. Among the first version's baselines, the best average was 60.3, from a BiLSTM with ELMo trained separately on each task. Simple multi-task training was, overall, no better than one model per task, helping only on tasks with little data. The diagnostic set showed that models of the time handled strong lexical cues but struggled with logic. The average also hid large differences: many baselines scored near 0 on CoLA but above 80 on SST-2.

Scores rose faster than expected. In October 2018 the first version of the BERT paper reported 80.4 on GLUE, 7.6 points above the previous best. For WNLI it always predicted the majority class and left the task out of its comparison, because the GLUE site noted problems with how the dataset was built and every submitted system had scored below the 65.1 majority baseline. In May 2019, some of the same authors introduced SuperGLUE. By then the top GLUE score, 83.8, was only 3.3 points below their estimate of human performance, 87.1, and above it on three tasks: QQP, MRPC, and QNLI. The new benchmark kept only two of the nine GLUE tasks and replaced the rest with harder ones.

limit.zh: 作者一开始就承认，无法完全排除靠表面技巧解出某些任务的可能。QNLI 就出过问题：它由 SQuAD 自动改造而来，早期版本有一个漏洞，能把任务当成更容易的问题解掉，后来换成了修正版；所以不同时期的 GLUE 分数不一定能直接比较。总分是简单平均，不代表各类语言能力都一样好。日期：arXiv 初版 2018 年 4 月 20 日，2019 年发表于 ICLR；这里的基线数字取自初版。
limit.en: The authors admitted from the start that simple superficial strategies could not be ruled out for some tasks. QNLI proved the point: it was converted automatically from SQuAD, an early release had an artifact that let it be solved as an easier task, and an updated version replaced it, so GLUE scores from different periods are not necessarily comparable. The total is a plain average and does not mean every kind of language ability is equally strong. Dates: the first arXiv version is April 20, 2018, and the paper was published at ICLR 2019; baseline figures here come from the first version.

sources: GLUE · arXiv v3, 2019-02-22 (ICLR 2019), footnote on the updated QNLI

title.zh: LAION-5B · 公开 58 亿对网络图文

body.zh: CLIP 用 4 亿对图文训练，ALIGN 用 18 亿对，BASIC 用 66 亿对，这些数据都没有公开；公开的英文图文数据集里，最大的 YFCC100M 有 1 亿对，其余都不超过 1200 万对。大规模图文模型的研究，于是集中在少数几家公司的实验室里。LAION-5B 从 Common Crawl 的网页里找出带 alt 文本的图片，用 CLIP 计算图片与文字的相似度来筛选，最后公开了 58.5 亿对，其中 23.2 亿对是英文。发布的只是图片链接、文字和相似度、NSFW、水印分数等元数据，图片要使用者自己下载。
body.en: CLIP was trained on 400 million image–text pairs, ALIGN on 1.8 billion, and BASIC on 6.6 billion, none of them public. Among public English image–text datasets, the largest, YFCC100M, had 100 million pairs, and the rest at most 12 million. Research on large image–text models had therefore pooled in a few industrial labs. LAION-5B took images with alt text from Common Crawl web pages, filtered them by CLIP similarity between image and text, and released 5.85 billion pairs, 2.32 billion of them in English. The release contains only image links, text, and metadata such as similarity, NSFW, and watermark scores; users download the images themselves.

detail.zh:
一对图文要经过这几步才能进来：从 Common Crawl 的元数据里找出带 alt 文本的图片标签，下载图片，去掉文字不足 5 个字符或图片小于 5KB 的样本，再用 OpenAI 的 ViT-B/32 CLIP 计算图文相似度，英文样本低于 0.28、其他语言低于 0.26 的一律删掉。这一步删掉了原来约 500 亿张图片中的九成左右，剩下近 60 亿个样本。因为只给链接，网页一变图片就可能失效，数据说明里写明无法保证样本仍然存在；按作者的估计，用 10 台机器大约 7 天能下载完整个数据集。

论文用其中 4 亿对的子集 LAION-400M 训练 CLIP，在 ImageNet 零样本分类等测试上与 OpenAI 的原版持平或接近，用 OpenCLIP 训练的 ViT-L/14 是 OpenAI 最大 CLIP 模型的第一个开源复现。论文还写道，Stable Diffusion 用 LAION-2B-en、laion-high-resolution 和 laion-aesthetics 这几个子集训练。附录 A 按 Datasheets 的问答格式写了一份数据说明。
detail.en:
A pair got in through these steps: find image tags with alt text in Common Crawl's metadata, download the image, drop samples with fewer than 5 characters of text or less than 5 KB of image data, then compute image–text similarity with OpenAI's ViT-B/32 CLIP and discard English pairs below 0.28 and other pairs below 0.26. That last step removed about 90% of the roughly 50 billion original images, leaving just under 6 billion. Because only links are provided, images can vanish when pages change, and the datasheet says the samples' continued existence cannot be guaranteed; the authors estimate the full dataset can be downloaded in about 7 days on 10 nodes.

The paper trained CLIP on LAION-400M, a 400-million-pair subset, matching or approaching OpenAI's original models on tests such as zero-shot ImageNet classification, and its ViT-L/14 trained with OpenCLIP was the first open-source reproduction of OpenAI's largest CLIP model. The paper also reports that Stable Diffusion was trained on the LAION-2B-en, laion-high-resolution, and laion-aesthetics subsets. Appendix A documents the dataset in the question-and-answer format of Datasheets.

limit.zh: 作者明说，自动过滤远不完美，有害图片很可能漏进来；他们选择给可能冒犯的样本打标签，而不是删除，并强烈建议只用于学术研究，不要直接用在部署的系统里。alt 文本本来也不一定是对图片的好描述。2023 年 12 月，斯坦福互联网观察站报告发现数据集里有指向疑似儿童性虐待材料的链接，LAION 随即下架了数据集；2024 年 8 月发布的 Re-LAION-5B 按合作机构提供的链接和图像哈希名单删去 2236 个链接，剩约 55 亿对。日期：arXiv 初版 2022 年 10 月 16 日，发表于 NeurIPS 2022 数据集与基准赛道。
limit.en: The authors say automatic filtering is far from perfect and harmful images are likely to get through. They chose to tag potentially offensive samples rather than remove them, and strongly recommended academic research use only, not deployed systems. Alt text is not necessarily a good description of an image in the first place. In December 2023 the Stanford Internet Observatory reported links to suspected child sexual abuse material in the dataset, and LAION withdrew it. Re-LAION-5B, released in August 2024, removed 2,236 links matched against link and image-hash lists from partner organizations, leaving about 5.5 billion pairs. Dates: the first arXiv version is October 16, 2022, and the paper appeared in the NeurIPS 2022 Datasets and Benchmarks track.

sources: LAION-5B · arXiv v1, 2022-10-16, §§1, 3, 5–7 and Appendix A

title.zh: 磁芯存储 · Whirlwind 换掉静电存储管
title.en: Magnetic-core memory · Whirlwind retires its storage tubes

body.zh: 1950 年代初，MIT 的 Whirlwind I 用静电存储管做高速内存，二进制位存成管内的电荷。这种管子很难伺候，1953 年的项目季报说，偏转漂移等毛病反复出现，一直找不到根治办法。磁芯存储改用铁磁小磁芯的磁化方向来存一位，靠横竖导线按坐标选中要读写的那一个。1953 年 8 月 8 日，Whirlwind 换上一组在 Memory Test Computer 上试过的磁芯存储，9 月 5 日又换上第二组。季报记录的存取时间从约 25 微秒降到 9 微秒，花在存储维护上的时间也少了。
body.en: In the early 1950s, MIT's Whirlwind I used electrostatic storage tubes as its fast memory, holding binary digits as charges inside the tubes. They were hard to keep running: the project's 1953 quarterly report describes recurring troubles such as deflection shift, with no permanent cure in sight. Magnetic-core storage held each bit as the direction of magnetization in a small ferromagnetic core, with wires running in two directions picking out the core to read or write. On August 8, 1953, Whirlwind received a bank of core storage that had already run in the Memory Test Computer, and a second bank followed on September 5. The report records access time falling from about 25 microseconds to 9, along with less time spent maintaining storage.

detail.zh:
按坐标选中是关键。Forrester 1951 年提交的专利里，每根导线只通翻转所需电流的一半：只在一根通电导线上的磁芯，收到的电流不够改变状态；横竖两根导线交叉处的那个磁芯同时收到两份，才会翻转。专利把同样的办法推广到三维：三组电路同时通电，只有三者共同经过的那一个磁芯被选中，只碰上其中两份电流的磁芯不受影响。

代价是读出会毁掉内容。An Wang 1949 年提交的专利已经写到，读一个磁芯要把它翻转，原来的信息除非转存到别处，否则就丢了。Whirlwind 的做法是读完马上写回：1954 年第一季度的季报说，读出一个寄存器后必须重写，重写及随后的操作产生的瞬态电流会干扰读出放大器，于是另外设计了恢复更快的放大器。同一份季报介绍机器时，已改称磁芯内存，容量 32,768 个二进制位。

后来的大型机继续用磁芯。1964 年 IBM System/360 的设计论文写到，程序用的通用寄存器在小型号上就放在磁芯存储里；1968 年 Model 85 的缓存论文则说，快速的单片存储负责速度，大容量的磁芯主存负责容量。
detail.en:
Coordinate selection was the key. In Forrester's patent application of 1951, each wire carries half the current needed to switch a core. A core on only one energized wire does not receive enough to change state; only the core where the energized horizontal and vertical wires cross receives both halves and switches. The patent extends the idea to three dimensions: three circuits are energized together, only the one core they all share is selected, and cores that see just two of the currents are left alone.

The price was that reading destroyed the contents. An Wang's patent application of 1949 already notes that reading a core flips it, so the information is lost unless it is passed on somewhere else. Whirlwind simply wrote the data back after every read. Its first-quarter 1954 report explains that after a register is read out it must be rewritten, and that transients from the rewrite and the step after it reached the sense amplifiers, so a faster-recovering amplifier was designed. The same report now describes the machine with magnetic-core memory holding 32,768 binary digits.

Later mainframes kept using cores. The 1964 design paper for IBM System/360 says that on small models the general registers programs use are physically held in core storage. The 1968 paper on the Model 85 cache describes fast monolithic storage supplying speed while large core main storage supplied capacity.

limit.zh: 1953 年是 Whirlwind 换装磁芯存储的时间，不是磁芯存储的发明年份，这里也不判断谁最先发明：An Wang 的专利 1949 年提交、1955 年授权，Forrester 的专利 1951 年提交、1956 年授权，两份专利描述的装置并不相同。9 微秒、25 微秒和可靠性的说法都来自 MIT 项目自己的季报。磁芯也没有消除读出后必须重写的麻烦，读写电路的干扰还要靠改进放大器来处理。
limit.en: 1953 dates Whirlwind's switch to core storage, not the invention of core memory, and this entry does not judge who invented it first: An Wang's patent was filed in 1949 and granted in 1955, Forrester's was filed in 1951 and granted in 1956, and the two describe different devices. The 9- and 25-microsecond figures and the reliability claims come from the MIT project's own quarterly reports. Cores did not remove the need to rewrite after every read, and interference in the read and write circuits still had to be handled with better amplifiers.

Project Whirlwind Summary Report No. 37, first quarter 1954, introduction and §3.1 (bitsavers scan)
An Wang · US Patent 2,708,722, filed 1949-10-21, granted 1955-05-17
Amdahl, Blaauw & Brooks · Architecture of the IBM System/360, April 1964, p. 96 and Figure 1
