title.zh: RAMAC 磁盘 · 不排序也能直接找到一条记录
title.en: RAMAC disk storage · reaching a record without sorting first

body.zh: 穿孔卡片会计要先把交易卡片人工分拣、插到对应的余额卡后面，再成批过机器；IBM 1957 年手册里的库存例子，卡片要经过七台不同的机器。难处在于，自动系统很难在大文件里直接找到并改动单独一条记录。IBM 305 RAMAC 配的 350 磁盘，把 50 张直径约两英尺的金属盘叠在竖轴上，每分钟 1200 转，存取臂在电子控制下移到任意一张盘的任意一道磁道。500 万个字符分成 5 万条记录，机器能直接取出其中任何一条，交易来一笔就能记一笔。
body.en: Punched-card accounting meant sorting transaction cards by hand, filing them behind the matching balance cards, and then running batches through the machines; in the inventory example in IBM's 1957 manual, the cards pass through seven different machines. The difficulty was that automatic systems could not easily reach and change a single record in a large file. The 350 disk storage of the IBM 305 RAMAC stacked 50 metal disks about two feet across on a vertical shaft, turning at 1,200 rpm, while an access arm moved under electronic control to any track on any disk. Five million characters were organized as 50,000 records, any of which the machine could fetch directly, so each transaction could be posted as it arrived.

detail.zh:
容量是这样算出来的：每张盘有 100 道同心磁道（手册把一道磁道看作同时在盘的上面和下面），每道分 10 个扇区，上下各 5 个，每个扇区存一条 100 字符的记录，50 × 100 × 10 × 100 = 500 万。手册把它换算成 62,500 张 80 列的卡片。磁道只占盘面外圈约 5 英寸；叉形的存取臂伸进两张盘之间，盘的上下两面都能读写。

速度也有具体数字。手册的开票示例按每次读盘约 600 毫秒估算，并说相关记录分组存放时实际会更快；平均每张发票三项商品，一小时约处理 450 张，同时更新所有相关记录。卡片可以随时放进机器，不用先分拣；操作员还能在控制台用键盘查询任一账户，几乎立刻拿到当前余额。
detail.en:
The capacity works out like this. Each disk has 100 concentric tracks, which the manual treats as lying on both the top and bottom surfaces; each track has ten sectors, five on each side, and each sector holds one 100-character record: 50 × 100 × 10 × 100 = 5 million. The manual equates this to 62,500 eighty-column cards. The tracks occupy only the outer five inches of each disk, and the forked access arm slides between two disks so that either surface can be read or written.

The manual also gives timing. Its invoicing example assumes an access time of about 600 milliseconds per disk read, noting that grouped records should do better; with an average of three items per invoice, the machine handles about 450 invoices an hour while keeping every related record up to date. Cards can be fed in at any time without sorting, and an operator can query any account from the console keyboard and get its current balance almost at once.

limit.zh: 找记录从翻卡片变成了机械寻道，但仍是机械动作：600 毫秒是手册估时用的近似值；IBM 历史页引述工程师回忆，设计目标是半秒，实际约 800 毫秒。容量别直接写成“5 MB”：手册只说 500 万个字符，每个字符按几位算各方说法不同，IEEE 里程碑记录按 6 位计，IBM 历史页写每字符 7 位。日期：IEEE 里程碑记录写 IBM 1955 年 5 月 6 日公布磁盘存储技术，第一台 350 在 1956 年 9 月 4 日成为可供应的产品；这里按 1956 年标注，引用的手册是 1957 年 4 月的修订版。
limit.en: Finding a record changed from searching cards to a mechanical seek, but it was still mechanical: 600 milliseconds is the manual's planning estimate, and IBM's history page quotes an engineer recalling a goal of half a second and a result of about 800 milliseconds. Do not simply convert the capacity to "5 MB": the manual gives five million characters, and sources count bits per character differently, six in the IEEE Milestone record and seven on IBM's history page. Dates: the IEEE Milestone record says IBM announced its disk storage technology on May 6, 1955, and that the first 350 became a commercially available product on September 4, 1956. The entry uses 1956; the manual cited is the April 1957 revision.

sources: IBM 305 RAMAC Manual of Operation, Form 22-6264-1, April 1957, pp. 5–13 and 59 (bitsavers scan)
IEEE Milestone · RAMAC, 1956 (ETHW record: dates and capacity)
IBM History · RAMAC (IBM's account, access-time recollection)

title.zh: System/360 · 大小机器跑同一套程序
title.en: System/360 · one instruction set from small machines to large

body.zh: 1950 年代的计算机大多沿着各自的产品线改进，IBM 自己就有 701 到 7094、650 到 7074、1401 到 7010 等好几条，字符位数、字长、十进制运算方式各不相同。1964 年 4 月公布的 System/360 把程序员看到的机器（论文称为 architecture）和具体实现分开：六个型号性能相差约 50 倍，数据通路宽度、存储速度和控制方式都不同，指令集却严格一致。按手册写的有效程序，只要内存、外设和选配功能够用，在小型号和大型号上都能运行。IBM 用这一个家族取代了原有的五条产品线。
body.en: Computers of the 1950s mostly improved along separate product lines. IBM alone had several, from the 701 to the 7094, the 650 to the 7074, and the 1401 to the 7010, differing in character size, word length, and decimal arithmetic. System/360, announced in April 1964, separated the machine as the programmer sees it, which the paper calls the architecture, from its implementation. Its six models spanned about a fiftyfold performance range with different data-path widths, storage speeds, and control methods, yet shared one strictly defined instruction set. A valid program written to the manual would run on small and large models alike, given enough storage, the required I/O devices, and any optional features it used. IBM replaced its five existing product lines with this one family.

detail.zh:
论文的 Figure 1 把差别列得很清楚。最小的 Model 30，主存 8–64K 字节，每次存取 8 位，周期 2.0 微秒，内部数据通路也是 8 位，由只读存储里的微程序控制；最大的 Model 70，主存 256–512K 字节，每次存取 64 位，周期 1.0 微秒，数据通路 64 位，用常规电路控制。程序里的 16 个 32 位通用寄存器，在 Model 30 上直接放在主存里，在 Model 40、50 上是单独的磁芯阵列，到 Model 60 以上才是晶体管寄存器。程序员看到的始终是同一组寄存器。

许多格式上的决定，也是为了同时照顾大小型号。字符用 8 位还是 6 位，论文选了 8 位：商业记录里数字出现的次数是字母数字的两倍多，十进制数字每个只占 4 位，存储、磁带和磁盘都更省。这个决定 1961 年就做了。浮点同时提供 32 位和 64 位两种长度，大型号用户多用 64 位，小型号用户多用 32 位，所有带浮点的型号都支持两种长度，运算结果一样。

实现可以变、程序看到的结构不变，后来的型号就靠这一点加新东西。1968 年的 Model 85 在磁芯主存前加了一层缓存，Liptay 的论文写明，缓存的装入和替换必须不靠程序帮忙完成，因为 Model 85 要和 System/360 的其他型号兼容。
detail.en:
Figure 1 of the paper lays out the differences. The smallest, the Model 30, had 8K to 64K bytes of main storage accessed 8 bits at a time with a 2.0-microsecond cycle, an 8-bit internal data path, and microprogrammed control from read-only storage. The largest, the Model 70, had 256K to 512K bytes accessed 64 bits at a time with a 1.0-microsecond cycle, a 64-bit data path, and control built from conventional circuits. The sixteen 32-bit general registers lived in main storage on the Model 30, in separate core arrays on the Models 40 and 50, and in transistor registers from the Model 60 up. Programmers always saw the same set of registers.

Many format decisions were also made with both ends of the line in mind. Choosing between 8-bit and 6-bit characters, the designers took 8 bits: numeric data appears in business records more than twice as often as alphanumeric data, and packing each decimal digit into 4 bits makes better use of storage, tapes, and disks. That decision was made in 1961. Floating point came in both 32-bit and 64-bit lengths; large-model users were expected to use 64 bits most of the time and small-model users 32 bits, and every floating-point model supported both lengths with identical results.

Because implementations could change while the programmer's view stayed fixed, later models could add hardware underneath it. The 1968 Model 85 placed a cache in front of core main storage, and Liptay's paper states that the cache had to be loaded and replaced without program assistance because the Model 85 had to stay compatible with the rest of the System/360 line.

limit.zh: 兼容是有条件的：论文只保证不依赖执行时间的有效程序在不同配置上结果一致；违反编程手册的程序不受约束，依赖时间的程序要显式检查 I/O 是否完成或读计时器。兼容也不等于一样快，型号之间性能差约 50 倍。和 IBM 旧机器兼容并不在目标之内，论文说必要时可以与现有产品不兼容。IBM 历史页称这是第一次让一台机器上写的软件能在整条产品线上运行，这是 IBM 自己的说法。日期：IBM 把发布日记为 1964 年 4 月 7 日，论文刊于同月的 IBM Journal；首批交付日期这里没有核对。
limit.en: Compatibility had conditions. The paper guarantees identical results only for valid programs that do not depend on execution time; programs that violate the manual are not constrained, and timing-dependent programs must explicitly test I/O completion or the timer. Compatibility did not mean equal speed either, since the models spanned about a fiftyfold performance range. Compatibility with IBM's older machines was not a goal; the paper says the design could, if necessary, be incompatible with existing products. IBM's history page calls this the first time software written for one machine could run on any other in the line; that is IBM's own claim. Dates: IBM gives April 7, 1964 as the launch date, and the paper appeared in the IBM Journal that same month; first shipment dates were not checked for this entry.

sources: Amdahl, Blaauw & Brooks · Architecture of the IBM System/360, IBM J. Res. Dev. 8(2), April 1964, pp. 87–96 and Figure 1 (course-hosted scan)
Same paper · IEEE Xplore record, pp. 87–101
IBM History · System/360 (launch date, product lines, IBM's account)
Liptay · System/360 Model 85 cache, IBM Systems Journal 7(1), 1968, p. 15

title.zh: Moore 1965 · 一块电路放多少元件最省钱
title.en: Moore, 1965 · the cheapest number of components per circuit

body.zh: 1965 年，集成电路刚开始用进商用计算机。把更多元件做进同一块电路，每个元件分摊的成本会降；可元件太多，成品率下降，单个元件的成本又会回升，所以每个时期都有一个“最省钱的元件数”。Gordon Moore 在《Electronics》杂志上指出，这个数大约每年翻一倍：当时是每块电路约 50 个元件，他估计 1970 年单个元件的制造成本只剩当时的十分之一，到 1975 年最省钱的复杂度会达到 65,000 个元件。文章还预言，集成电路会带来家用计算机和便携通信设备。
body.en: In 1965, integrated circuits were just entering commercial computers. Putting more components on one circuit spreads the cost, but past a point falling yields push the cost per component back up, so at any given time there is a complexity with the lowest cost per component. Writing in Electronics, Gordon Moore observed that this minimum-cost complexity had been rising by roughly a factor of two per year. It then stood at about 50 components per circuit; he expected the cost per component in 1970 to fall to a tenth of the 1965 level and the minimum-cost complexity to reach 65,000 components by 1975. He also predicted that integrated circuits would bring home computers and personal portable communications equipment.

detail.zh:
65,000 个元件放得下吗？Moore 算了一笔账：按当时已有的尺寸公差，高性能晶体管可以每隔千分之二英寸放一个，这样一个“两密耳见方”的格子也能放几千欧的电阻或几个二极管。一英寸排 500 个，一平方英寸 25 万个，65,000 个元件只占约四分之一平方英寸。当时常用的硅片直径一英寸多，放得下，用现有的光学工艺就行，不必用电子束这类更特殊的方法。这里的“元件”包括晶体管、电阻和二极管，不只是晶体管。

文章也想到了后面的麻烦。成千上万个元件挤在一块硅片上，热量怎么散？Moore 的回答是，集成电路是平面结构，每个发热点附近都有散热的表面；尺寸缩小后要驱动的电容变小，同样的单位面积功率下还能跑得更快。他还提醒，造大系统未必要做成一整块：用较小的功能块分别封装再连起来，可能更划算。
detail.en:
Would 65,000 components fit? Moore did the arithmetic. With the tolerances already in use, high-performance transistors could sit two thousandths of an inch apart, and such a two-mil square could instead hold several kilohms of resistance or a few diodes. That gives 500 components per linear inch, a quarter million per square inch, so 65,000 components need only about a quarter of a square inch. The wafers then in use, an inch or more across, had room, and existing optical techniques were enough, without more exotic methods such as electron beams. Note that "components" here include resistors and diodes as well as transistors.

The article also anticipated trouble. Could the heat from tens of thousands of components on one chip be removed? Moore argued that integrated structures are flat, so every source of heat has a cooling surface close by, and that shrinking dimensions reduce the capacitance to be driven, allowing higher speed at the same power per unit area. He also noted that large systems need not be built as one piece: smaller functions, packaged separately and interconnected, might prove more economical.

limit.zh: 这是用几年数据画出的外推。Moore 自己说短期内这个速度会保持，长期“有点不确定”，但没有理由认为十年内会变。原文说的是最省钱的复杂度每年约翻一倍；文中没有“每两年翻一倍”或“性能每 18 个月翻倍”的说法，“摩尔定律”这个名字也不出自这篇文章。它是对成本曲线的观察，不是物理定律。日期：原文刊于 1965 年 4 月 19 日《Electronics》第 114–117 页；这里读的是 1998 年《Proceedings of the IEEE》的重印本。
limit.en: This was an extrapolation from a few years of data. Moore expected the rate to hold over the short term and called the longer term "a bit more uncertain", though he saw no reason it would change for at least ten years. The article speaks of minimum-cost complexity doubling roughly every year; it says nothing about doubling every two years or performance doubling every 18 months, and the name "Moore's Law" does not appear in it. It is an observation about a cost curve, not a physical law. Dates: the original appeared in Electronics on April 19, 1965, pp. 114–117; the text read here is the 1998 reprint in Proceedings of the IEEE.

sources: Moore · Cramming more components onto integrated circuits, Electronics, 1965-04-19; Proc. IEEE 86(1) reprint, 1998
Same reprint · full text, course-hosted copy, pp. 82–85

title.zh: PUE · 机房的电有多少到了计算设备
title.en: PUE · how much facility energy reaches IT equipment

body.zh: 一座机房用的电，不只供给服务器、存储和网络设备，配电损耗和冷却设备也在耗电。运营者想知道：送进来的电里，有多少真正到了 IT 设备，又有多少花在支撑它们的设施上？2007 年，行业联盟 The Green Grid 发布了两个指标：PUE，等于机房总能耗除以 IT 设备能耗；DCiE，是 PUE 的倒数。PUE 最小是 1.0，越接近 1.0，设施本身多耗的电越少。2009 年起，美、欧、日的多家机构在联合工作组里确认，把 PUE 作为机房基础设施能效的首选指标。
body.en: A datacenter's electricity does not all go to servers, storage, and network equipment; power distribution losses and cooling equipment draw from it as well. Operators wanted to know how much of the incoming energy actually reached the IT equipment and how much went to the facility supporting it. In 2007 the industry consortium The Green Grid published two metrics: PUE, total facility energy divided by IT equipment energy, and DCiE, its inverse. PUE cannot go below 1.0, and the closer it gets, the less extra energy the facility itself consumes. Starting in 2009, joint task forces of U.S., European, and Japanese organizations affirmed PUE as the preferred metric for datacenter infrastructure efficiency.

detail.zh:
举个算例：一座机房一年从电网取电 1,500 万千瓦时，其中 1,000 万千瓦时送到了 IT 设备，PUE 就是 1.5，DCiE 约 67%。总能耗在电网电表处或附近测，同一栋楼里办公区的用电要扣掉；IT 能耗在机房配电单元（PDU）的输出端测，也就是电力经过所有转换和调节、刚要进 IT 设备的地方。The Green Grid 2012 年的整合版白皮书提到，伯克利国家实验室测过的 22 座机房，PUE 在 1.3 到 3.0 之间；正式报给 The Green Grid 的结果若低于 1.0，会被直接退回。

最早的 PUE 用的是功率（千瓦），后来的报告规则把它定为能量指标（千瓦时）。差别在于：每天只读一次功率，得到的是那一刻的 PUE；累计一天的能量，得到的是全天的平均。室外昼夜温差大、IT 负载起伏大，或者机房会随天气切换到借用室外冷空气的冷却模式时，两种算法的结果就会不同。

数字本身也要看口径。Google 公开报告整个机队的 PUE，并说明把变电站、变压器、水处理厂等开销都算了进去，2025 年全年平均为 1.09；它同时引用 Uptime Institute 2025 年的调查，受访机房的全球平均是 1.54。这些是 Google 自己的测量与对比。
detail.en:
A worked example: if a facility draws 15 million kWh from the grid in a year and 10 million kWh reaches the IT equipment, its PUE is 1.5 and its DCiE about 67%. Total facility energy is measured at or near the utility meter, minus any office space in the same building; IT energy is measured at the output of the computer-room power distribution units, after all conversion and conditioning and just before the equipment. The Green Grid's consolidated 2012 white paper cites Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory measurements of 22 datacenters with PUE between 1.3 and 3.0, and says official reports of PUE below 1.0 are rejected outright.

The original PUE was defined with power in kilowatts; later reporting rules made it an energy metric in kilowatt-hours. The difference matters. A single daily power reading gives PUE at that moment, while a day's accumulated energy gives the average for the whole day. The two diverge when outdoor temperatures swing between day and night, when IT load varies widely, or when the facility switches to economizer cooling with the weather.

The boundary of the measurement matters too. Google publicly reports PUE across its fleet, says it includes overhead such as substations, transformers, and water treatment plants, and gives an annual average of 1.09 for 2025. It compares this with an average of 1.54 among respondents to the Uptime Institute's 2025 survey. These are Google's own measurements and comparisons.

limit.zh: PUE 只看基础设施，不看计算本身：服务器空转的电照样算作 IT 能耗。把部分工作虚拟化、减少了 IT 负载，配电和冷却的固定开销没变，PUE 反而可能变差。余热再利用也不能在 PUE 里抵扣，The Green Grid 另设了指标。它最初并不建议拿公开的 PUE 直接比较两座机房，因为设计、气候和负载都会影响结果。日期：2007 年是 The Green Grid 首次发布 PUE 和 DCiE 的年份；这里没有读到 2007 年的原始白皮书，定义与测量方法引自其 2012 年的 White Paper #49，该文件声明取代此前所有相关白皮书。
limit.en: PUE describes the infrastructure, not the computing: energy drawn by idle servers still counts as IT energy. Virtualizing work to cut IT load can make PUE look worse, because the fixed overhead of power distribution and cooling stays the same. Reused waste heat earns no credit in PUE; The Green Grid defined a separate metric for that. The Green Grid initially did not recommend comparing two facilities by their published PUE, since design, climate, and load all affect the result. Dates: 2007 is when The Green Grid first published PUE and DCiE. The original 2007 white paper was not read for this entry; the definitions and measurement rules here come from the 2012 White Paper #49, which states that it supersedes the earlier PUE papers.

sources: The Green Grid · White Paper #49, PUE: A Comprehensive Examination of the Metric, 2012, executive summary, §§I–II, 4, 4.10, 6.6 (LBNL-hosted copy)
Google Data Centers · Efficiency: fleet PUE and measurement notes (Google's own reporting)

title.zh: Fat-tree · 用普通交换机搭出满带宽的机房网络
title.en: Fat-tree · full-bandwidth datacenter networks from commodity switches

body.zh: 2008 年前后，大型机房的网络通常是两三层交换机组成的树，越往上交换机越大越贵，整个集群的带宽还受限于树根。为了省钱，设计上常做“超额订阅”：论文调查的典型值在 2.5:1 到 8:1 之间，按千兆网卡算，最坏时每台机器只能用到 400 Mbps 到 125 Mbps。Al-Fares 等人改用许多同样规格的普通以太网交换机，按 fat-tree（一种 Clos 拓扑）连接：用 48 口交换机，可以让 27,648 台主机彼此以网卡全速通信，成本还比用高端交换机低得多。主机、操作系统和应用都不用改。
body.en: Around 2008, large datacenter networks were usually trees of two or three switch tiers, with bigger and more expensive switches toward the top, and the bandwidth of the whole cluster was capped at the root. To save money, designs were often oversubscribed: the typical ratios the paper found ran from 2.5:1 to 8:1, meaning that in the worst case a host with a gigabit interface could use only 400 Mbps down to 125 Mbps. Al-Fares and colleagues instead wired many identical commodity Ethernet switches into a fat-tree, a form of Clos topology. With 48-port switches, 27,648 hosts could all talk to each other at the full speed of their interfaces, at far lower cost than with high-end switches. Hosts, operating systems, and applications needed no changes.

detail.zh:
结构可以从小例子看起。由 k 口交换机组成的 fat-tree 有 k 个 pod，每个 pod 上下两层各 k/2 台交换机，顶上再放 (k/2)² 台核心交换机，总共能接 k³/4 台主机。k = 4 时是 4 个 pod、16 台主机、20 台交换机。k = 48 时有 48 个 pod，每个 pod 里 24 台边缘交换机和 24 台汇聚交换机，每台边缘交换机接 24 台主机，合计 27,648 台；不同 pod 的两台主机之间有 576 条等长路径。所有交换机都一样，所以都能用便宜的通用产品；论文估算这套网络的交换设备约 864 万美元，而用高端交换机给 2 万台主机做到满带宽约需 3,700 万美元。

路径多了，难处在于怎么用上。普通 IP 路由在等长路径里只挑一条，流量会挤到少数核心交换机上。论文给交换机加了两级路由表：先按目的网段匹配，跨 pod 的流量再按目的地址的最后一个字节分散到不同的上行口；发往同一台主机的包始终走同一条路，避免 TCP 乱序。作者在 10 台机器上用 Click 软件路由器模拟一个 4 口 fat-tree，随机通信时两级路由表达到理想对分带宽的 75%，加上掌握全局大流的中央调度器能到 93.5%，而超额订阅 3.6:1 的传统树只有 53.4%。

工业界也在往这个方向走。Google 2015 年的论文回顾了十年里的五代自研机房网络，都用通用交换芯片搭成多级 Clos 拓扑，容量扩大约 100 倍，对分带宽超过 1 Pbps；它把 Al-Fares 等人的论文列为 Clos 方面的参考之一。
detail.en:
A small case shows the structure. A fat-tree built from k-port switches has k pods, each with two layers of k/2 switches, plus (k/2)² core switches on top, and supports k³/4 hosts. With k = 4 that is four pods, 16 hosts, and 20 switches. With k = 48 there are 48 pods, each with 24 edge and 24 aggregation switches, and each edge switch serves 24 hosts, for 27,648 in all; any two hosts in different pods have 576 equal-cost paths between them. Because every switch is identical, all of them can be cheap commodity parts; the paper estimates the switching hardware for this network at $8.64 million, against about $37 million for full bandwidth among 20,000 hosts with high-end switches.

The hard part is using all those paths. Ordinary IP routing picks one of several equal-cost paths, so traffic piles onto a few core switches. The paper adds a two-level routing table to each switch: packets are first matched by destination subnet, and traffic leaving the pod is then spread across uplinks by the last byte of the destination address. Packets for the same host always take the same path, which avoids TCP reordering. The authors emulated a 4-port fat-tree with the Click software router on ten machines. Under random traffic the two-level tables reached 75% of the ideal bisection bandwidth and a central scheduler that tracked large flows reached 93.5%, against 53.4% for a conventional tree oversubscribed 3.6:1.

Industry was moving the same way. Google's 2015 paper reviews five generations of its own datacenter networks over a decade, all multi-stage Clos topologies built from commodity switch silicon, growing about 100-fold in capacity to more than 1 Pbps of bisection bandwidth. It lists the Al-Fares paper among its references on Clos topologies.

limit.zh: 拓扑本身不是这篇论文发明的：论文自己说，Clos 拓扑五十多年前就为电话交换设计出来，fat-tree 也引自 Leiserson 的早期工作。它的贡献是把这种结构用在普通以太网交换机上，并解决多路径路由。实验规模很小，只模拟了 16 台主机，链路限速 96 Mbit/s；大规模的成本和功耗是按产品价格与资料估算的，成本不含布线。fat-tree 要的线缆多得多，论文专门讨论了布线和机柜摆放。也别以为工业界是照着它做的：Google 2015 年的论文说，它第一个投入生产的 Clos 网络 Firehose 1.1 在 2006 年部署，早于这篇论文。日期：SIGCOMM 2008，会议在 2008 年 8 月 17–22 日。
limit.en: The paper did not invent the topology: it notes that Clos designed the structure for telephone switching more than fifty years earlier, and it takes the fat-tree from Leiserson's earlier work. Its contribution was applying the structure to commodity Ethernet switches and solving multipath routing for it. The experiment was small, emulating 16 hosts on links limited to 96 Mbit/s; costs and power at scale were estimated from product prices and data sheets, and the cost figures leave out cabling. A fat-tree needs far more cables, and the paper devotes a section to wiring and rack placement. Nor did industry simply follow it: Google's 2015 paper says its first production Clos fabric, Firehose 1.1, was deployed in 2006, before this paper. Dates: SIGCOMM 2008, held August 17–22, 2008.

sources: Al-Fares, Loukissas & Vahdat · A Scalable, Commodity Data Center Network Architecture, SIGCOMM 2008, §§1–3, 5–6 (author copy)
Same paper · ACM Digital Library record
Singh et al. · Jupiter Rising, SIGCOMM 2015, abstract, §§1–3.2 and Table 2

title.zh: NVLink · GPU 之间不再都挤在 PCIe 上
title.en: NVLink · GPU traffic moves off PCIe

body.zh: 到 2016 年，一台服务器装 4 块或 8 块 GPU 已经常见，一个 CPU 配两块以上 GPU 也越来越普遍。GPU 之间交换数据、GPU 读主机内存，都要走 PCIe，按 NVIDIA 的说法，这在多 GPU 系统里成了越来越大的瓶颈。2016 年 4 月，NVIDIA 随 Tesla P100 公布 NVLink：P100 有 4 条链路，每条双向 40 GB/s，合计最多 160 GB/s，NVIDIA 称是 PCIe 3.0 x16 的 5 倍。连在一起的 GPU 能直接读写对方的显存，原子操作也照样正确。
body.en: By 2016, servers with four or eight GPUs were common, and pairing two or more GPUs with each CPU was becoming the norm. Data moving between GPUs, and GPUs reading host memory, all went over PCIe, which NVIDIA described as a growing bottleneck in multi-GPU systems. In April 2016, NVIDIA announced NVLink with the Tesla P100: four links of 40 GB/s bidirectional each, up to 160 GB/s in total, which NVIDIA called five times PCIe 3.0 x16. GPUs connected this way can operate directly on each other's memory, with atomic operations still correct.

detail.zh:
4 条链路连不满 7 个邻居，所以 8 卡服务器 DGX-1 用的是“混合立方网格”：8 块 GPU 分成两组，每组 4 块两两用 NVLink 直连，两组之间再用额外的 NVLink 相连；每组 GPU 通过 PCIe 接到各自的 CPU。GPU 之间的流量全走 NVLink，PCIe 就空出来接网卡、访问主机内存。NVLink 也能连 CPU：IBM 的 POWER8 with NVLink 支持 4 条链路，单块 GPU 读主机内存最高也是双向 160 GB/s。

它也不只是更宽的线。每条链路由收发两组、每组 8 对差分线组成，每对每秒 20 Gb。控制器分物理层、数据链路层和事务层；数据链路层给每个包加 25 位 CRC，发出的包先存在重放缓冲区里，收到确认才删，出错就重发。包长从 1 到 18 个 128 位的 flit 不等，比如带地址扩展、写 256 字节数据的请求是 18 个。

后来的几代沿用了这条路。2017 年的 Volta V100 换上第二代 NVLink：每对线速从 20 Gb/s 提到 25 Gb/s，链路从 4 条增到 6 条，总带宽 300 GB/s，CPU 也能直接对 GPU 的 HBM2 读写和做原子操作。2022 年的 Hopper 是第四代，NVIDIA 称 DGX H100 里每块 GPU 有 900 GB/s 的 NVLink 带宽，外接 NVLink Switch 最多能把 256 块 H100 连起来。
detail.en:
Four links cannot reach seven neighbors, so the eight-GPU DGX-1 server used a "hybrid cube mesh": two groups of four GPUs, each group fully connected by NVLink, with extra NVLink connections between the groups and each group attached to its own CPU over PCIe. All GPU-to-GPU traffic went over NVLink, leaving PCIe free for network cards and host memory. NVLink could also connect a CPU: IBM's POWER8 with NVLink supported four links, letting a single GPU reach host memory at up to 160 GB/s bidirectional.

It was more than a wider wire. Each link pairs two sub-links, one per direction, of eight differential pairs running at 20 Gb/s each. The controller has physical, data link, and transaction layers. The data link layer adds a 25-bit CRC to each packet and keeps sent packets in a replay buffer until they are acknowledged, retransmitting on error. Packets range from 1 to 18 flits of 128 bits; a write request carrying 256 bytes of data with an address extension takes 18.

Later generations continued the line. The 2017 Volta V100 introduced second-generation NVLink, raising the per-pair rate from 20 to 25 Gb/s and the link count from four to six, for 300 GB/s in total, and letting the CPU load, store, and perform atomics directly on GPU HBM2 memory. Hopper, in 2022, used the fourth generation; NVIDIA cited 900 GB/s of NVLink bandwidth per GPU in DGX H100 and an external NVLink Switch connecting up to 256 H100 GPUs.

limit.zh: NVLink 是 NVIDIA 自家的互连，只连 NVIDIA GPU 和支持它的 CPU（当时是 IBM POWER8），不能替代机器之间的网络；白皮书也写到，多台多 GPU 系统之间仍靠 InfiniBand 和 100Gb 以太网连接。160 GB/s 是 4 条链路双向带宽之和，单方向是 80 GB/s；“5 倍”是厂商拿它和 PCIe 3.0 x16 比的结果，白皮书里的多 GPU 性能图用的是预生产的 P100。日期：2016 年 4 月 5 日公布；新闻稿说装在 DGX-1 里的 P100 6 月全面供货，服务器厂商的产品预计 2017 年初上市，这些都是当时的计划。
limit.en: NVLink is NVIDIA's own interconnect, linking NVIDIA GPUs and CPUs that support it (IBM POWER8 at the time); it does not replace networking between machines, and the whitepaper notes that multi-GPU systems were still joined by InfiniBand and 100 Gb Ethernet. The 160 GB/s figure sums both directions across four links, or 80 GB/s each way, and "five times" is NVIDIA's comparison with PCIe 3.0 x16; the whitepaper's multi-GPU performance chart used pre-production P100s. Dates: announced April 5, 2016. The press release scheduled general availability of the P100 in the DGX-1 for June and expected server makers' systems in early 2017; those were plans at the time.

sources: NVIDIA Tesla P100 whitepaper WP-08019-001_v01.1, 2016, pp. 7–8, 20–24, 35–36
NVIDIA V100 whitepaper v1.1, August 2017, p. 19 on second-generation NVLink

title.zh: TPU v1 · 为数据中心推理专门做一颗芯片
title.en: TPU v1 · a custom chip for datacenter inference

body.zh: 2013 年，Google 估算：如果每人每天用三分钟语音搜索，语音识别神经网络的计算量会让数据中心规模翻倍，用普通 CPU 满足太贵。团队随后用 15 个月设计、验证、制造并部署了一颗专做推理的 ASIC，2015 年起在数据中心使用。它像 GPU 一样插在 PCIe 上，核心是 256×256 个 8 位乘加单元，峰值每秒 92 万亿次运算，配 28 MiB 由软件管理的片上存储，去掉了缓存、乱序执行等功能。2017 年的论文用 Google 六个生产应用测量，它平均比同期的 Haswell CPU 和 K80 GPU 快 15–30 倍，每瓦性能高 30–80 倍。
body.en: In 2013, Google projected that if people used voice search for three minutes a day, the speech-recognition neural networks would double the computation its datacenters needed, which would be very expensive to meet with conventional CPUs. A team then designed, verified, built, and deployed an inference-only ASIC in 15 months, running in datacenters from 2015. It plugged into PCIe like a GPU; its core was a 256×256 array of 8-bit multiply-accumulate units with a peak of 92 trillion operations per second, alongside 28 MiB of software-managed on-chip memory, and it left out caches, out-of-order execution, and similar features. Measured on six of Google's production applications, the 2017 paper reports it was on average 15 to 30 times faster than a contemporary Haswell CPU and K80 GPU, with 30 to 80 times higher performance per watt.

detail.zh:
关键约束是响应时间。论文里的 MLP0 要求 99% 的请求在 7 毫秒内返回。在这条限制下，CPU 和 K80 的批大小只能开到 16，分别只跑到各自最高吞吐的 42% 和 37%（每秒约 5,500 和 13,500 次推理）；TPU 用 200 的批大小仍在 7 毫秒内，每秒 225,000 次，达到自身最高吞吐的 80%。没有缓存和乱序执行，执行时间更可预测，作者认为这正适合对尾部延迟有硬要求的应用。

瓶颈常在内存，不在算力。作者把 Roofline 模型改成“每读一字节权重做多少次整数运算”，发现六个应用里两个 MLP 和两个 LSTM 受内存带宽限制，只有两个 CNN 受算力限制；而 CNN 只占 Google 推理负载的约 5%，MLP 占 61%，LSTM 占 29%。性能模型估计，若改用 K80 那样的 GDDR5 显存，TPU 还能再快两到三倍。它也不省电：负载只有 10% 时，功耗仍是满载的 88%，作者说是开发周期太短，没来得及加节能功能。

这颗芯片只做推理。Google 后来的 TPU v2 改为训练和推理都做，并加了芯片间互连，最多 256 颗组成一台超级计算机；ISCA 2021 的论文把 v2 的首次部署记为 2017 年第三季度。
detail.en:
The binding constraint was response time. The paper's MLP0 must answer 99% of requests within 7 milliseconds. To stay near that limit, the CPU and K80 could run batches of only 16, reaching 42% and 37% of their maximum throughput, about 5,500 and 13,500 inferences per second. The TPU stayed within 7 milliseconds at a batch size of 200, delivering 225,000 inferences per second, 80% of its maximum. With no caches or out-of-order execution, its timing was more predictable, which the authors argue suits applications with hard tail-latency limits.

The bottleneck was often memory rather than arithmetic. Adapting the Roofline model to count integer operations per byte of weights read, the authors found that the two MLPs and two LSTMs were limited by memory bandwidth and only the two CNNs by compute, while CNNs made up only about 5% of Google's inference workload, against 61% for MLPs and 29% for LSTMs. Their performance model estimated that GDDR5 memory like the K80's would make the TPU two to three times faster. Nor was it frugal at low load: at 10% load it drew 88% of its full-load power, which the authors attribute to a schedule too short for energy-saving features.

The chip did inference only. Google's next design, TPU v2, handled both training and inference and added a chip-to-chip interconnect for supercomputers of up to 256 chips; the ISCA 2021 paper gives the third quarter of 2017 as its first deployment.

limit.zh: 比较对象是 2015 年部署时的同代产品：作者说，更新的 P40 GPU 在 2015 年初还买不到，所以没有比；这些倍数不能直接推到后来的芯片上。15–30 倍、30–80 倍是 Google 在自家六个应用上测的，CPU 结果用的是浮点；作者估算，如果 CPU 全部改用 8 位整数，TPU 相对 CPU 的增量每瓦性能会从 41–83 倍降到 12–24 倍。训练仍用现成的 GPU。日期：论文说芯片 2015 年部署；Google 2016 年 5 月公开宣布 TPU；论文 arXiv 初版是 2017 年 4 月 16 日，会议版发表于 2017 年 6 月的 ISCA；这里按论文标在 2017 年。
limit.en: The comparison is with hardware contemporary to the 2015 deployment: the authors note that the newer P40 GPU was not available in early 2015, so it was not compared, and the ratios should not be carried over to later chips. The 15–30× and 30–80× figures are Google's measurements on its own six applications, with CPU results in floating point; the authors estimate that if every application ran in 8-bit integers on the CPU, the TPU's incremental performance-per-watt advantage over the CPU would fall from 41–83× to 12–24×. Training still ran on off-the-shelf GPUs. Dates: the paper says the chip was deployed in 2015; Google announced the TPU publicly in May 2016; the first arXiv version is dated April 16, 2017, and the conference paper appeared at ISCA in June 2017. The entry uses 2017 for the paper.

sources: Jouppi et al. · In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit, arXiv v1, 2017-04-16, §§1–8 and 10
Jouppi et al. · Ten Lessons From Three Generations Shaped Google's TPUv4i, ISCA 2021, Table 1
Jouppi et al. · Google's Training Supercomputers from TPU v2 to Ironwood, arXiv v1, 2026-06-14, introduction

title.zh: TPU v3 液冷 · 风扇带不走的热
title.en: TPU v3 liquid cooling · heat that fans could not carry away

body.zh: Google 的前两代 TPU 都用风冷，TPU v1 的热设计功耗是 75 W，v2 是 280 W。2018 年的 TPU v3 升到每颗 450 W，Google 改用液冷：铜冷板压在芯片封装上，几块冷板串联成一条回路，流过的冷却液把热量带走。2018 年 5 月的 I/O 大会上，Google 宣布第三代 TPU 采用液冷。按 Google 后来的说法，这让部署的芯片密度翻了一倍：风冷的 TPU v2 超级计算机是 256 颗芯片占 4 个机柜，液冷的 v3 是 1024 颗占 8 个机柜，规模是前者的四倍。
body.en: Google's first two TPU generations were air-cooled, with thermal design power of 75 W for TPU v1 and 280 W for v2. TPU v3, in 2018, rose to 450 W per chip, and Google switched to liquid cooling: copper cold plates are mounted on the chip packages and connected in series in one loop, and coolant flowing through them carries the heat away. At its I/O conference in May 2018, Google announced that its third-generation TPUs were liquid-cooled. According to Google's later accounts, this doubled the density of deployed chips: an air-cooled TPU v2 supercomputer had 256 chips in four racks, while a liquid-cooled v3 had 1,024 chips in eight racks, four times as many.

detail.zh:
液冷首先改变的是机房布局。Google 2021 年的论文写道，液冷要把 TPU 集中放在几个相邻机柜里，才能分摊冷却设施的成本。训练用的超级计算机本来就占好几个相邻机柜，也只需放在少数有空间的数据中心，这不成问题；面向用户的推理要靠近各地用户，有些数据中心已经塞满，很难再找出成排的相邻机柜。所以 2020 年的推理芯片 TPUv4i 把热设计功耗压到 175 W，又回到风冷。

冷却本身花多少电，也有数字。Google 工程师在 2025 年 Hot Chips 的报告里说，TPU v3 的热设计功耗是风冷 v2 的 1.6 倍，频率高 30%；每颗液冷 TPU v3 分摊的泵功率，不到同等热设计功耗下风冷所需风扇功率的 5%。热量最终经冷却液分配单元里的换热器，排到数据中心的冷却水里。

后来的训练芯片没有回到风冷。Google 2026 年的论文说，从 2018 年的 TPU v3 起，它的训练系统只用液冷，TPU v4、v5p 和 Ironwood 都是如此。2025 年 Google 又介绍了放在机柜排内的冷却液分配单元，把机柜里的液体回路和设施侧的水路隔开，并称自 2020 年起这些单元的可用性约为 99.999%。
detail.en:
Liquid cooling changed facility layout first. Google's 2021 paper explains that liquid-cooled TPUs must be placed in several adjacent racks to amortize the cooling infrastructure. That suits training supercomputers, which already span adjacent racks and need only a few datacenters with space. User-facing inference, however, needs a worldwide footprint, and some datacenters are already too full to find several adjacent racks. So TPUv4i, the 2020 inference chip, held its thermal design power to 175 W and went back to air cooling.

The energy cost of cooling itself was also measured. Google engineers reported at Hot Chips 2025 that TPU v3's thermal design power was 1.6 times that of the air-cooled v2 and its clock 30% higher, and that pump power per liquid-cooled TPU v3 was less than 5% of the fan power per chip that air cooling would need at a comparable thermal design power. The heat ultimately passes through heat exchangers in the coolant distribution units into the datacenter's water.

Later training chips stayed liquid-cooled. Google's 2026 paper says it has used liquid cooling exclusively for training since TPU v3 in 2018, through TPU v4, v5p, and Ironwood. In 2025 Google described in-row coolant distribution units that separate each rack's liquid loop from the facility loop, and reported their availability at about 99.999% since 2020.

limit.zh: Google 说的是自家数据中心从 TPU v3 起第一次用液冷，不是计算机液冷的起点；同一份 Hot Chips 报告也把 1960 到 1990 年代列为业界已经用液冷的时期。液冷解决的是芯片发热太集中、风扇带不走的问题，机房照样要把这些热量排出去，代价是机柜要成组摆放，还要配套水路和给冷却设备的备用电源。密度翻倍、可用性 99.999% 都是 Google 自己的数字。日期：2018 年 5 月 10 日 I/O 发布；Google 说 TPU v3 于 2018 年部署，ISCA 2021 论文把 v3 的首次部署（GA）记为 2018 年第四季度。
limit.en: Google is describing the first use of liquid cooling in its own datacenters, starting with TPU v3, not the start of liquid cooling in computing; the same Hot Chips talk marks 1960 to 1990 as a period when the industry already used liquid cooling. Liquid cooling solves heat too concentrated for fans to remove, but the facility still has to reject that heat, and the price is grouping racks together, adding plumbing, and backing up power for the cooling equipment. The doubled density and 99.999% availability are Google's own figures. Dates: announced at I/O on May 10, 2018; Google says TPU v3 was deployed in 2018, and the ISCA 2021 paper lists its first general availability in the fourth quarter of 2018.

sources: Google · 100 things we announced at I/O '18, 2018-05-10, item 19
Jouppi et al. · Ten Lessons From Three Generations Shaped Google's TPUv4i, ISCA 2021, Table 1 and lesson 5
Padilla & Iyengar (Google) · Evolution of Google's IT Liquid Cooling, Hot Chips 2025 tutorial, slides 4–10
Iyengar & Huffman · Enabling 1 MW IT racks and liquid cooling at OCP EMEA Summit, Google Cloud blog, 2025-04-29
Jouppi et al. · Google's Training Supercomputers from TPU v2 to Ironwood, arXiv v1, 2026-06-14, Table 1 and conclusion

title.zh: Heuristic DENDRAL · 从质谱推断分子结构
title.en: Heuristic DENDRAL · inferring molecular structure from mass spectra

body.zh: 化学家拿到一张质谱图，要倒推出未知有机物的分子结构。Lederberg 1964 年的 DENDRAL 算法已经能把一个分子式所有可能的无环结构不重不漏地列出来，可它不懂化学，只按原子价拼图，也完全不用实测数据。Heuristic DENDRAL 把化学家看谱的经验写进程序：先根据特征峰判断该有哪些结构片段、不该有哪些，只生成符合条件的结构；再用一个粗略的质谱模型给每个候选预测谱图，和实测谱比较后排序。
body.en: A chemist holding a mass spectrum wants to work back to the structure of an unknown organic compound. Lederberg's 1964 DENDRAL algorithm could already list every possible acyclic structure for a formula without repeats, but it knew no chemistry beyond valences and made no use of measured data. Heuristic DENDRAL built chemists' rules for reading spectra into the program. It first used characteristic peaks to decide which structural fragments must appear and which must not, generated only structures that fit, then ran a rough model of the mass spectrometer to predict each candidate's spectrum and ranked the candidates by how well they matched the measured one.

detail.zh:
论文举的例子是 3-辛酮，分子式 C8H16O。光按原子价能连出 790 种图，化学上稳定的无环结构有 698 种。程序先看谱峰，判断这是乙基酮，于是把乙基酮放进“必须有”的清单，把醇、醚、醛和其他几种酮放进“不能有”的清单。生成器最后只给出 3 个结构，正确的那个就在其中，另外两个也都是乙基酮。另一张 4-辛酮的谱图，则只剩 1 个结构。

论文对这些规则说得很实在：它们更像建议，不是硬性规定，也不能保证正确结构不被提前排除。测试失败时，就请合作的化学家看输出、回想自己是怎么判断的，再改程序。程序还带一个叫 QUEST 的小例程，在控制台上一问一答，让化学家补充新的官能团，论文里的例子是酯基。整个程序用 Lisp 写成，跑在斯坦福人工智能实验室的 PDP-6 上，占用约 8 万个机器字的内存。

1984 年 Buchanan 和 Shortliffe 回顾 MYCIN 时写道：到 70 年代中期，DENDRAL 已经是好几个协同工作的大程序，帮化学家确定分子结构；MYCIN 在某种意义上是从 DENDRAL 长出来的，从 DENDRAL 学到的头一条，就是产生式规则好用。
detail.en:
The paper's example is 3-octanone, formula C8H16O. Valences alone allow 790 graphs, and 698 acyclic structures are chemically stable. The program read the peaks, concluded the compound was an ethyl ketone, put ethyl ketone on its must-have list, and put alcohols, ethers, aldehydes, and the other ketone types on its must-not list. The generator then produced only three structures. The correct one was among them, and the other two were also ethyl ketones. For a second spectrum, of 4-octanone, a single structure remained.

The authors were candid about these rules: they were closer to suggestions than to fixed laws, and nothing guaranteed that the right structure would not be pruned early. When a test failed, the collaborating chemists studied the output, reflected on how they themselves had decided, and the program was revised. A small routine called QUEST let a chemist at the console add knowledge about a new functional group through a question-and-answer dialogue; the paper's example is the ester group. The program was written in Lisp and ran on the PDP-6 at the Stanford Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, using about eighty thousand words of memory.

Looking back in 1984, Buchanan and Shortliffe wrote that by the mid-1970s DENDRAL had become several large interacting programs that helped chemists determine molecular structures. MYCIN, they wrote, grew out of DENDRAL in the sense that it reused DENDRAL's lessons, foremost the power of production rules.

limit.zh: 它只在很窄的范围里接近化学家的水平：作者说只对少数几类分子如此，处理环状结构是当时最大的短板。规则是启发式的，程序常给出几个候选，而不是唯一答案。它靠的是特征峰表和一套还很粗略的质谱理论，不是通用的科学发现程序。日期：1969 年是这篇论文收入《Machine Intelligence 4》出版的年份；文中的程序输出标着 1968 年 7 月 4 日的版本；DENDRAL 算法是 Lederberg 1964 年提出的，项目本身始于 60 年代中期。
limit.en: It approached a chemist's skill only in a narrow area: the authors said so for just a few classes of molecules, and named its poor handling of ring structures as the main weakness. Its rules were heuristic, and it usually returned several candidates rather than a single answer. It relied on tables of characteristic peaks and a still rough theory of mass spectrometry; it was not a general engine for scientific discovery. Dates: 1969 is when this paper appeared in Machine Intelligence 4. The program output printed in it is labeled as the July 4, 1968 version, the DENDRAL algorithm itself dates from Lederberg's 1964 work, and the project began in the mid-1960s.

sources: Buchanan, Sutherland & Feigenbaum · Heuristic DENDRAL, Machine Intelligence 4 (Edinburgh University Press, 1969), pp. 209–254 · scan in the NLM Joshua Lederberg Papers, introduction and §§1, 3.5, 6
NLM catalog record for the same paper
Buchanan & Shortliffe (eds.) · Rule-Based Expert Systems, 1984, chapter 1 (author-hosted)

title.zh: Shakey · 感知、规划和执行接成一个系统
title.en: Shakey · perception, planning, and action in one system

body.zh: 1966 年 SRI 立项时，已有的自动机大多靠几块简单的板载逻辑电路控制。SRI 想让一台大型通用计算机通过无线电实时指挥一辆移动机器人，在真实环境里完成只给目标、不给步骤的任务。Shakey 的做法是分层：世界模型是一组谓词逻辑公式，STRIPS 据此排出动作顺序，PLANEX 负责执行和监控，最底下是“推箱子”“走到门边”这类预先写好、自带感知和纠错的动作程序。
body.en: When SRI began the project in 1966, most automata built so far ran on a few simple onboard logic circuits. SRI wanted a full-scale programmable computer to direct a mobile robot in real time over a radio link, carrying out tasks in a realistic environment that named a goal but not the steps. Shakey was built in layers. Its world model was a set of predicate-calculus formulas. STRIPS used them to plan a sequence of actions, PLANEX carried out and monitored the plan, and at the bottom sat preprogrammed actions such as pushing a box or going to a doorway, each with its own sensing and error recovery.

detail.zh:
1971 年的一份报告设计了一组实验，后来照着做了，还拍成影片。操作员用电传打字机输入英语任务：在 RCLK 房间里，用 2 号箱子把 DPDPCLK 门堵上。系统把这句话转成逻辑式 BLOCKED(DPDPCLK, RCLK, BOX2)。初始模型有 170 条公理，记着房间、门、箱子的位置和机器人自己的状态。STRIPS 排出的计划是：从所在房间出发，穿过一个中间房间，进入放箱子的房间，再把箱子推到门前。

走到半路，实验者在 Shakey 要经过的门前放了一只它不知道的箱子。摄像机拍到路被挡住，视觉程序估出箱子的大小和位置，给它起名 BOX3，记进模型。PLANEX 没有从头重新规划，而是在同一个计划里换了一组房间，从另一个房间绕进去，照样把门堵上。能这样做，是因为 STRIPS 存下的是带参数的计划（MACROP）：不是“经过这几个房间”，而是“从某个房间穿过某个中间房间进入第三个房间，再堵住那里的门”。第二个任务是把 BOX3 推开，STRIPS 直接借用了这个计划的前四步。报告把这种存下计划再用的做法看作一种学习。

算力不在机器人身上。车上的传感器和电机经无线电、微波链路连到一台 PDP-15，再连到运行 LISP 程序的 PDP-10。房间内找路的程序 FINDPATH 选的是拐弯最少的路线，而不是最短的路线，报告说这样是为了减少机器人随后思考和执行的时间。
detail.en:
A 1971 report laid out a set of experiments that were later carried out and filmed. An operator typed a task in English at a teletype: in room RCLK, use box 2 to block door DPDPCLK. The system turned the sentence into the formula BLOCKED(DPDPCLK, RCLK, BOX2). The initial model held 170 axioms recording the positions of rooms, doors, and boxes and the robot's own state. STRIPS produced a plan: leave the current room, pass through an intermediate room, enter the room with the box, and push the box in front of the door.

Partway through, the experimenters placed a box Shakey did not know about in front of a door on its route. The camera saw that the way was blocked, a vision routine estimated the box's size and position, named it BOX3, and added it to the model. PLANEX did not replan from scratch. It found another set of rooms that fit the same plan, went around through a different room, and still blocked the door. This worked because STRIPS stored plans with parameters, called MACROPs: not "go through these rooms" but "go from some room through some intermediate room into a third room, then block a door there." The second task was to push BOX3 out of the way, and STRIPS reused the first four steps of the stored plan. The report treated saving plans for reuse as a form of learning.

The computing lived off the robot. Sensors and motors on the vehicle connected by radio and microwave links to a PDP-15, which in turn connected to a PDP-10 running the LISP programs. FINDPATH, the routine for paths within a room, chose the route with the fewest legs rather than the shortest distance; the report says this was to cut the robot's later thinking and execution time.

limit.zh: Shakey 只在专门布置的几个房间里活动：里面是大箱子和楔形物，门和墙的位置事先写进模型；除了内容不明的 RMYS 房间，各房间里有什么也都假定已知。视觉只用来定位、找物体、看路通不通，项目一开始就决定不在视觉模式识别上做深入研究。STRIPS 还要求每个动作的前提和效果都能写成增删公式的清单。日期：项目从 1966 年做到 1972 年，第一套系统 1969 年完成，第二套 1971 年完成；这里按第二套系统和 1971 年 12 月的报告标为 1971 年。引文来自 1984 年 SRI 把这些报告摘编成册的技术说明 323。
limit.en: Shakey worked only in a few specially arranged rooms holding large boxes and wedges, with door and wall positions written into its model in advance; apart from one room, RMYS, the contents of every room were assumed known. Vision was used only to fix the robot's position, find objects, and check whether a path was clear, because the project decided from the start not to do extensive research on visual pattern recognition. STRIPS also required every action's preconditions and effects to be written as lists of formulas to add and delete. Dates: the project ran from 1966 to 1972; the first system was completed in 1969 and the second in 1971. The entry uses 1971 for the second system and the December 1971 report. Quotations come from SRI Technical Note 323, a 1984 compilation of those reports.

sources: Nilsson (ed.) · Shakey the Robot, SRI Technical Note 323, April 1984 · chapters 1, 3, 5, 8 and 9
SRI International · publication record for Technical Note 323

title.zh: ALVINN · 让神经网络看路开车
title.en: ALVINN · a neural network that steers along the road

body.zh: 当时的自动导航系统，靠的是人写的图像处理和模式识别程序。它们在某些条件下好用，换了条件就出问题，一个原因是处理流程固定不变。CMU 的 Pomerleau 换了个思路：把摄像机和激光测距仪的低分辨率图像直接送进一个三层的反向传播网络，让它输出车该往哪个方向转。网络用 1200 张模拟道路图训练，装上 NAVLAB 试验车后，在校园林间小路上以每秒半米的速度开过 400 米。
body.en: Autonomous navigation systems of the time relied on hand-built image processing and pattern recognition. They worked under some conditions and failed under others, partly because their processing stayed fixed whatever the situation. Dean Pomerleau at CMU tried something different: feed low-resolution images from a camera and a laser range finder straight into a three-layer backpropagation network and have it output the direction to steer. Trained on 1,200 simulated road images, the network drove CMU's NAVLAB test vehicle at half a meter per second along a 400-meter path through a wooded part of campus.

detail.zh:
输入很小：视频图只有 30×32 个点，取蓝色通道，因为路和路外在蓝色上反差最大；再加 8×32 的测距图，和一个记录“上一帧路比路外亮还是暗”的反馈单元，一共 1217 个输入，接 29 个隐藏单元。输出是排成一排的 45 个单元，中间代表直走，越往两边转得越急。训练目标不是只点亮一个单元，而是以正确转向为中心的一个小山包：0.10、0.32、0.61、0.89、1.00，再对称地降下去。训练 40 轮后，在没见过的模拟图上，约 90% 的输出离正确答案不超过两格。

作者还看了网络学到了什么。用宽度固定的路训练，隐藏单元像是“路在稍左或稍右”的滤波器；路宽变化大时，有的单元只盯住路的左边缘。作者的结论是：该看哪些图像特征，由数据决定，而不是由程序员决定。有了逼真的模拟道路生成器之后，反向传播半小时就得到一个还不错的跟路系统，而 CMU 的视觉和导航小组用传统方法调了好几个月，才到相近的水平。

1990 年会议上的后续论文改成边看人开车边学。只看人开，网络学不到车偏了以后怎么拉回来，所以每张实时图像都在软件里平移、旋转出 14 张，模拟车偏离路中的样子。在 Sun-4 上训练约 5 分钟；网络每秒能处理 25 张图，车速可以开到 NAVLAB 的上限，每小时 20 英里。2006 年 Stanley 的论文用人开过的地面给地形打标签，并说这和 Pomerleau 的做法思路相近。
detail.en:
The input was tiny. The video image had just 30×32 points, taken from the blue channel because road and non-road contrast most there. Add an 8×32 range image and one feedback unit recording whether the road was lighter or darker than its surroundings in the previous frame, and there were 1,217 inputs feeding 29 hidden units. The output was a row of 45 units: the middle one meant straight ahead, and units farther out meant sharper turns. The training target was not a single active unit but a small hill centered on the correct turn: 0.10, 0.32, 0.61, 0.89, 1.00, then back down symmetrically. After 40 epochs, about 90% of outputs on unseen simulated images were within two units of the correct answer.

Pomerleau also looked at what the network had learned. Trained on roads of fixed width, hidden units acted like filters for a road slightly left or slightly right. When road widths varied widely, some units watched only the road's left edge. His conclusion was that the data, not the programmer, decided which image features mattered. Once a realistic road-image generator existed, backpropagation produced a fairly successful road follower in half an hour, while CMU's vision and navigation groups had spent many months tuning traditional methods to reach a similar level.

A follow-up paper at the 1990 conference switched to learning while watching a person drive. A network that only sees good driving never learns how to recover after drifting, so each live image was shifted and rotated in software into 14 more, showing the vehicle off center. Training took about five minutes on a Sun-4, and the network processed 25 images a second, enough to drive at the NAVLAB's top speed of 20 miles per hour. In 2006 the Stanley paper labeled terrain using ground a person had driven over and called the idea similar in spirit to Pomerleau's.

limit.zh: 1988 年的网络是在模拟图上训练的，实车只在晴朗秋日的一条 400 米校园小路上测过；作者说，要在更多天气和光照下测试，才谈得上和其他方法公平比较。遇到岔路，网络会同时给出两个相差很远的方向，结果来回摆动；停车、绕开障碍和按地图规划路线都还没有做。日期：NeurIPS 档案把论文归在 NIPS 1988，CMU 的出版记录写的是 1989 年 12 月出版的论文集；这里按 1988 年的会议论文标年。看人开车学习的实车版本出自 1990 年的后续论文，别和 1988 年的模拟训练混在一起。
limit.en: The 1988 network was trained on simulated images and tested on the vehicle only along one 400-meter campus path on sunny fall days; the author said wider tests in different weather and lighting were needed before a fair comparison with other methods. At a fork the network could output two widely different directions, and the steering oscillated. Stopping, avoiding obstacles, and planning routes from a map were left for future work. Dates: the NeurIPS archive places the paper in NIPS 1988, while CMU's publication record lists the proceedings as published in December 1989; this entry uses 1988 for the conference paper. The on-vehicle version that learned by watching a driver comes from the 1990 follow-up and should not be merged with the 1988 simulated training.

sources: Pomerleau · ALVINN: An Autonomous Land Vehicle in a Neural Network, NIPS 1988 proceedings record
Same paper · PDF, architecture, training and performance, network representation, discussion
CMU Robotics Institute · publication record (proceedings dated December 1989)
Pomerleau · Rapidly Adapting Artificial Neural Networks for Autonomous Navigation, NIPS 1990, §§2–4

title.zh: Stanley · 赢下 2005 年 DARPA 沙漠无人车赛

body.zh: 2004 年 3 月的第一届 DARPA 大挑战，15 辆参赛车没有一辆跑完全程的 5%。2005 年 10 月 8 日的第二届，规则照旧：全程不准人工干预，10 小时内跑完沙漠赛道，路线点位赛前两小时才发。斯坦福的 Stanley 用 6 小时 53 分 58 秒最先跑完。难点是又快又准：激光只能可靠地看清前方约 22 米，Stanley 用概率模型过滤定位误差，用人开车的数据调参数，再让摄像机学会激光认出的路面颜色，往更远处找路。
body.en: At the first DARPA Grand Challenge in March 2004, none of the 15 vehicles that raced covered more than 5% of the course. The second race, on October 8, 2005, kept the rules: no human intervention, a desert course to finish within 10 hours, and route waypoints handed out only two hours before the start. Stanford's Stanley finished first, in 6 hours, 53 minutes, and 58 seconds. The hard part was being fast and accurate at once. Its lasers reliably saw only about 22 meters ahead, so Stanley filtered pose errors with a probabilistic model, tuned parameters on data from human driving, and had its camera learn the color of road the lasers had already confirmed in order to find drivable ground farther out.

detail.zh:
一个具体问题是：定位上的小误差会被放大。激光打在前方最远约 30 米的地面上，车身俯仰、侧倾的估计哪怕差不到 0.5 度，算出的地面高度也会大错，平地上冒出“幻影障碍”。在团队标注的数据里，按 15 厘米的高度阈值，有 12.6% 的可行驶区域被当成障碍。能消除这种误差的定位系统要几十万美元，团队负担不起，于是改成概率判断：两次扫描隔得越久，允许的高度差越大。

参数怎么定？让人只在没有障碍的地面上开，车轮压过的格子标成“可行驶”，两侧一定距离外的带子标成“障碍”。这些标签很粗糙，路外大多其实也能开，但足够用来自动调参数。在独立的测试数据上，可行驶区域被误判为障碍的比例从 12.6% 降到 0.002%。

比赛数据也说明了这些设计的作用。全程有 31.8% 的路段是 Stanley 根据传感器自己减速，其中占全程 18.1% 的路段是因为地形颠簸或陡峭。摄像机在 40 米内看不到可行驶的路时，车就降到每小时 25 英里；论文估计，如果没有视觉、全程限在这个速度，用时约 7 小时 5 分，可能落到 CMU 的 Sandstorm 之后。在最难的 Beer Bottle Pass 山口，DARPA 给的 GPS 走廊和实际地形对不齐，论文认为只按 GPS 点走很可能过不去。
detail.en:
One concrete problem was that small pose errors got magnified. The lasers hit the ground up to about 30 meters ahead, so an error of less than half a degree in estimated pitch or roll badly distorted computed ground heights and created phantom obstacles on flat terrain. In the team's labeled data, with a height threshold of 15 centimeters, 12.6% of drivable area was classified as obstacle. Pose systems that could avoid such errors cost hundreds of thousands of dollars, more than the team could spend, so it switched to a probabilistic test: the longer the time between two scans, the larger the height difference allowed.

How were the parameters set? A person drove only over obstacle-free ground. Grid cells under the wheels were labeled drivable, and strips at a fixed distance on either side were labeled obstacles. The labels were rough, since most of the ground beside the road was drivable too, but good enough for automatic tuning. On independent test data, the share of drivable area misclassified as obstacle fell from 12.6% to 0.002%.

The race data show what these choices did. Over 31.8% of the course Stanley slowed down on its own because of sensor readings, and over 18.1% of the course the cause was rough or steep terrain. When the camera found no drivable corridor within 40 meters, the vehicle dropped to 25 miles per hour. The paper estimates that without vision, capped at that speed the whole way, Stanley would have taken about 7 hours and 5 minutes and possibly finished behind CMU's Sandstorm. At Beer Bottle Pass, the hardest section, DARPA's GPS corridor lined up poorly with the actual terrain, and the paper judges that a robot following the GPS points blindly would likely have failed there.

limit.zh: 这是一场静态环境里的比赛：快车追上慢车时由 DARPA 暂停慢车，路线和限速事先给定，不需要全局路径规划。作者明说 Stanley 不能在车流中行驶，也分不清高草和石头。比赛中激光数据流卡顿过 17 次，其中 4 次让车为“幻影障碍”明显急转，所幸没有撞车。这些数字是这一台车、这一场比赛的结果。日期：比赛在 2005 年 10 月 8 日；论文 2006 年 4 月收稿，发表在《Journal of Field Robotics》2006 年第 23 卷第 9 期；这里按比赛标为 2005 年。
limit.en: This was a race in a static environment. When a faster robot caught a slower one, DARPA paused the slower one, and the route and speed limits were given in advance, so no global path planning was needed. The authors state that Stanley could not drive in traffic and could not tell tall grass from rocks. During the race its laser data stream stalled 17 times, and four of those stalls made it swerve noticeably around phantom obstacles, without a collision. These figures describe one vehicle in one race. Dates: the race was on October 8, 2005; the paper was received in April 2006 and published in the Journal of Field Robotics, volume 23, issue 9, 2006. The entry uses 2005 for the race.

sources: Thrun et al. · Stanley: The Robot that Won the DARPA Grand Challenge, Journal of Field Robotics 23(9), 2006 · author PDF, §§1, 5–6, 10–11

title.zh: GroupLens · 让口味相近的人互相推荐

body.zh: 1994 年前后，Usenet 有 8000 多个新闻组，每天流量超过 100MB。读者手里的办法，要么按内容和作者筛（分组、杀词文件、字符串搜索），要么靠一个版主替所有人把关。GroupLens 改看别人的评价：读者读完给帖子打 1 到 5 分，评分服务器（叫 Better Bit Bureau）先算谁和谁过去的打分相关，再用口味相近的人的评分，预测你会给新帖打几分。评分可以用化名，评分本身也当成帖子在 Usenet 上传播。
body.en: Around 1994, Usenet carried more than 8,000 newsgroups and over 100 MB of traffic a day. Readers could filter by content or author, through newsgroups, kill files, and string search, or rely on a single moderator to judge for everyone. GroupLens used other readers' opinions instead. After reading an article, people rated it from 1 to 5. Rating servers, called Better Bit Bureaus, worked out whose past ratings correlated with whose, then predicted how much you would like a new article from the ratings of people with similar taste. Ratings could be entered under pseudonyms, and they traveled over Usenet as articles themselves.

detail.zh:
论文用一个 6 篇帖子、4 个读者的小表格举例。在共同读过的帖子上，Ken 和 Meg 打分高低完全同步，相关系数是 +1；和 Lee 大体相反，是 −0.8；和 Nan 不相关，是 0。第 6 篇帖子，Meg 打了 5 分，Lee 打了 2 分。按加权公式，Ken 的预测分是 4.56：喜欢这篇的人和他口味一致，不喜欢的人和他口味相反。同样两条评分算到 Nan 身上只有 3.75，因为 Nan 和 Lee 有一部分口味相同，Lee 的低分抵掉了 Meg 的一些高分。

这套算法不太在乎各人打分的习惯。两个人走势完全一致，一个只打 3 到 5 分，另一个只打 1 到 3 分，前者的 5 分就会变成给后者预测的 3 分。所以论文给用户的建议很简单：你希望 GroupLens 预测几分，就打几分。

作者也想好了怎么比较算法：请下一轮试用者把训练集里的帖子全部读完打分，公开这批化名数据，看算法能不能猜回矩阵里被删掉的评分。2006 年起的 Netflix Prize 同样是藏起一部分已知评分，比谁猜得准。2009 年 Koren 等人的文章把“先找口味相近的用户、再看他们喜欢什么”称为面向用户的邻域方法，并说在 Netflix Prize 这类数据上，矩阵分解比经典的最近邻方法更准。
detail.en:
The paper works through a small table of six articles and four readers. On the articles they had both rated, Ken's and Meg's ratings rose and fell together, a correlation of +1; Ken and Lee mostly disagreed, at −0.8; Ken and Nan were uncorrelated, at 0. Meg gave article 6 a 5 and Lee gave it a 2. The weighted formula predicts 4.56 for Ken, because the person who liked the article shares his taste and the person who disliked it has the opposite taste. The same two ratings give Nan only 3.75: she partly agreed with Lee in the past, so his low rating cancels some of Meg's high one.

The method is fairly indifferent to rating habits. If two people move in perfect step but one uses only 3 to 5 and the other only 1 to 3, the first person's 5 becomes a predicted 3 for the second. So the paper's advice to users was simple: give the rating you wish GroupLens had predicted.

The authors also planned how to compare algorithms. Participants in the next pilot would read and rate every article in a training set, the pseudonymous ratings would be shared, and an algorithm would be judged by how well it recovered ratings deleted from the matrix. The Netflix Prize, from 2006, likewise hid known ratings and compared predictions. A 2009 article by Koren and colleagues called the approach of finding like-minded users and seeing what they liked a user-oriented neighborhood method, and reported that on data like the Netflix Prize's, matrix factorization was more accurate than classic nearest-neighbor techniques.

limit.zh: 它预测的是“你会给这篇打几分”，不读帖子内容；没人评过的帖子，它给不出预测。新用户要先攒一阵评分，预测才开始有用，明尼苏达四人试用时就碰到了这个起步期。打分要花力气又没有直接回报，大家都有等别人先评的动机。论文里的试用只有几个人，作者也说即将进行的大规模测试不是为了证明读者更喜欢用它。推荐也不是从它开始的，论文把 Tapestry 列为思路相近的前作。日期：1994 年，ACM CSCW '94 会议论文集第 175–186 页。
limit.en: It predicts how much you will like an article, not what the article says, and it cannot predict anything for an article nobody has rated. New users need to build up ratings before predictions help, a start-up period the four-person Minnesota pilot already noticed. Rating takes effort with no direct reward, so everyone has a reason to wait for others to rate first. The pilots involved only a handful of people, and the authors said their upcoming larger test was not meant to show that readers preferred filtered news. Nor did recommendation start here: the paper names Tapestry as similar earlier work. Date: 1994, Proceedings of ACM CSCW '94, pages 175–186.

sources: Resnick, Iacovou, Suchak, Bergstrom & Riedl · GroupLens: An Open Architecture for Collaborative Filtering of Netnews, CSCW '94, pp. 175–186 · author-hosted copy, including Figure 5 and the prediction example
Koren, Bell & Volinsky · Matrix Factorization Techniques for Recommender Systems, IEEE Computer 42(8), 2009 · section on recommender system strategies and Figure 1

title.zh: Okapi BM25 · 把词频和文档长度算进排序
title.en: Okapi BM25 · term frequency and document length in ranking

body.zh: 检索系统要按“和查询有多相关”给文档排序。City 大学的 Okapi 系统用 Robertson 和 Spärck Jones 的经典概率模型给词加权，到 TREC-1 时还不管词在文档里出现几次、文档有多长；作者事后发现，这种简单加权偏爱长文档。从 TREC-2 起，他们把词频和长度加进公式；1994 年的 TREC-3 上，又把 BM11 和 BM15 两个变体合成一个带参数的 BM25：词出现得越多分越高，但会饱和；文档越长，同样的词频得分越低。
body.en: A retrieval system ranks documents by how relevant they are to a query. City University's Okapi system weighted terms with Robertson and Spärck Jones's classical probabilistic model, and at TREC-1 it still ignored how often a term appeared in a document and how long the document was; the authors later found that this simple weighting favored long documents. From TREC-2 they added term frequency and document length to the formula, and at TREC-3 in 1994 they merged two variants, BM11 and BM15, into one parameterized function, BM25. More occurrences raise the score with diminishing returns, and the same count is worth less in a longer document.

detail.zh:
按论文给的公式算一下。词频部分是 (k1+1)·tf/(K+tf)，其中 K=k1·((1−b)+b·dl/avdl)，dl 是文档长度，avdl 是平均长度。取论文里常用的 k1=2、b=0.75：在平均长度的文档里 K=2，一个词出现 1 次得 1 分，出现 10 次只得 2.5 分，远不到 10 倍；同样出现 10 次，放在两倍平均长度的文档里，K 变成 3.5，只得约 2.22 分。b=1 时公式就是 BM11，b=0 时就是 BM15，论文一般取 0.75 左右，在两者之间折中。

TREC-3 的正式提交里，只用 BM25 的 citya2 在 50 个新题目上的平均精度（AveP）是 0.337；再加上段落检索和查询扩展（从初次搜索排在前面的文档里挑高权重词补进查询）的 citya1 是 0.401，50 个题目里有 35 个比 citya2 好。作者说得也实在：BM25 本身只带来小幅改进，还多了一个要猜的参数，不同参数下的结果论文里没有列出。

这个公式后来进了常用的开源搜索库。2016 年发布的 Apache Lucene 6.0 把 IndexSearcher 默认的相似度打分换成了 BM25Similarity（LUCENE-6789）。
detail.en:
Here is the paper's formula at work. The term-frequency part is (k1+1)·tf/(K+tf), where K=k1·((1−b)+b·dl/avdl), dl is the document's length, and avdl is the average length. Take k1=2 and b=0.75, values the paper often used. In a document of average length K=2, so one occurrence scores 1 and ten occurrences score only 2.5, far short of ten times as much. Ten occurrences in a document twice the average length raise K to 3.5 and score about 2.22. With b=1 the formula becomes BM11 and with b=0 it becomes BM15; the paper usually used about 0.75, a mix of the two.

Among City's official TREC-3 runs, citya2, which used BM25 alone, reached an average precision (AveP) of 0.337 on the 50 new topics. citya1 added passage retrieval and query expansion, adding high-weight terms from the top documents of a first search, and reached 0.401, beating citya2 on 35 of the 50 topics. The authors were frank that BM25 itself gave only slight improvements at the cost of another parameter to guess, and the paper does not list results for different parameter values.

The formula later went into widely used open-source search software. Apache Lucene 6.0, released in 2016, changed IndexSearcher's default similarity to BM25Similarity (LUCENE-6789).

limit.zh: BM25 只看查询词有没有出现、出现几次、文档多长，不懂同义词，也不管词的先后。它也不是一次想出来的，而是 Okapi 组在经典概率模型上连着几届 TREC 调出来的，k1 和 b 要按数据集调。TREC 上的成绩只代表 TREC 的文档和题目：1998 年 Brin 和 Page 就说，在 TREC 上好用的方法放到网页上常常效果不好。日期：TREC-3 会议在 1994 年 11 月 2–4 日举行，论文集作为 NIST SP 500-225 于 1995 年出版；这里按会议标为 1994 年。
limit.en: BM25 looks only at whether query terms occur, how often, and how long the document is; it knows nothing of synonyms or word order. Nor was it a single invention: the Okapi group tuned it over several TRECs on top of the classical probabilistic model, and k1 and b have to be set for each collection. TREC results hold for TREC's documents and topics; in 1998 Brin and Page observed that methods that work well on TREC often do poorly on the Web. Dates: TREC-3 met on November 2–4, 1994, and its proceedings appeared as NIST SP 500-225 in 1995. The entry uses 1994 for the conference.
