title.zh: Netflix Prize 与矩阵分解 · 用隐因子预测评分
title.en: Netflix Prize and matrix factorization · predicting ratings with latent factors

body.zh: 协同过滤主要有两类做法。经典的邻域方法找口味相近的用户，或评分相近的电影，再用它们的评分来推。2006 年，Netflix 公开 1 亿多条电影评分，悬赏 100 万美元，要求把它自己算法的 RMSE 降低 10%。Koren、Bell 和 Volinsky 在文章里总结比赛经验，主张另一类做法，即矩阵分解：给每个用户、每部电影各学一个 20 到 100 维的向量，内积就是预测评分，再加上偏差、隐式反馈和随时间的变化。2009 年 9 月 21 日，大奖颁给了 BellKor's Pragmatic Chaos 队。
body.en: Collaborative filtering has two main families. Classic neighborhood methods find users with similar taste, or movies that get similar ratings, and predict from their ratings. In 2006 Netflix released more than 100 million movie ratings and offered $1 million for cutting the RMSE of its own algorithm by 10%. Koren, Bell, and Volinsky distilled the contest's lessons in favor of the other family, matrix factorization: learn a vector of 20 to 100 factors for each user and each movie, take their inner product as the predicted rating, and add terms for biases, implicit feedback, and change over time. On September 21, 2009, the grand prize went to the team BellKor's Pragmatic Chaos.

detail.zh:
文章里有个算偏差的小例子：所有电影的平均分是 3.7 星；《泰坦尼克号》比一般电影高 0.5 星；Joe 是个挑剔的用户，打分平均比别人低 0.3 星。只看偏差，Joe 给《泰坦尼克号》的初步估计就是 3.7+0.5−0.3=3.9 星，剩下的部分才交给用户向量和电影向量的内积去解释。作者说，评分里很大一部分变化来自这类偏差，所以要先把它们建模好。

分解出来的维度有时看得出意思。文章画出 Netflix 数据的前两个因子：一条轴的一端是面向男性或青少年的低俗喜剧和恐怖片，另一端是严肃、女性主角突出的剧情片；另一条轴一头是独立、小众、受好评的影片，一头是主流的套路片。

比赛之前，公开的协同过滤数据比这小几个数量级；据比赛网站统计，来自 182 个国家的 4.8 万多支队伍下载了数据。作者所在的 BellKor 队 2007 年以比 Netflix 好 8.43% 拿到年度进步奖，2008 年和 BigChaos 联手以 9.46% 再拿一次。官方排行榜上，获胜提交在测试集上的 RMSE 是 0.8567，比 Netflix 好 10.06%；The Ensemble 队的成绩一模一样，只是晚交了约 20 分钟。
detail.en:
The article gives a small example of biases. Say the average rating over all movies is 3.7 stars, Titanic tends to be rated 0.5 stars above average, and Joe, a critical user, rates 0.3 stars below average. From biases alone, Joe's estimated rating of Titanic is 3.7+0.5−0.3=3.9 stars, and only what remains is left for the inner product of user and movie vectors to explain. The authors note that much of the variation in ratings comes from such biases, so modeling them well is vital.

The learned dimensions are sometimes interpretable. The article plots the first two factors of the Netflix data. One axis runs from lowbrow comedies and horror aimed at a male or adolescent audience to dramas with serious undertones and strong female leads. The other runs from independent, critically acclaimed, quirky films to mainstream formulaic ones.

Before the contest, the only public data for collaborative filtering research was orders of magnitude smaller; by the contest site's count, more than 48,000 teams from 182 countries downloaded the data. The authors' team, BellKor, won the 2007 Progress Prize at 8.43% better than Netflix, and joined BigChaos to win the 2008 Progress Prize at 9.46%. On the official leaderboard, the winning submission scored an RMSE of 0.8567 on the test set, 10.06% better than Netflix. The Ensemble had exactly the same score but submitted about 20 minutes later.

limit.zh: 比赛只比一个数：藏起来的约 300 万条评分上的 RMSE。作者说他们的获胜提交由 100 多组预测器混合而成，多数是矩阵分解的变体，并不是单独一个模型。“矩阵分解比经典最近邻更准”是在 Netflix Prize 这类评分数据上的经验，不能推成任何场景都成立；新用户、新电影评分太少的冷启动问题也还在。推荐系统更不是从 2009 年开始的，文章自己把“协同过滤”一词归给更早的 Tapestry。这里只记比赛和文章，不推断 Netflix 线上系统的做法。日期：比赛 2006 年宣布；文章发表在 2009 年 8 月的《IEEE Computer》，写作时比赛还没结束；大奖在 2009 年 9 月 21 日颁出。
limit.en: The contest measured one number: RMSE on about 3 million hidden ratings. The authors say their winning entries blended more than 100 predictor sets, most of them variants of matrix factorization, rather than a single model. That matrix factorization beat classic nearest-neighbor methods is experience from rating data like the Netflix Prize's, not a rule for every setting, and the cold-start problem of new users and new movies with few ratings remained. Recommendation did not begin in 2009 either; the article credits the term collaborative filtering to the earlier Tapestry system. This entry covers the contest and the article and does not infer how Netflix's production system worked. Dates: the contest was announced in 2006; the article appeared in IEEE Computer in August 2009, written before the contest ended; the grand prize was awarded on September 21, 2009.

sources: Koren, Bell & Volinsky · Matrix Factorization Techniques for Recommender Systems, IEEE Computer 42(8), August 2009 · DOI record
Netflix Prize · official home page, archived January 2010: grand prize awarded September 21, 2009
Netflix Prize · official leaderboard, archived January 2011

title.zh: GraphCast · 从再分析数据学中期天气预报
title.en: GraphCast · learning medium-range forecasts from reanalysis data

body.zh: 中期天气预报一直靠数值天气预报：在超级计算机上解大气方程。算力越多越准，但几十年攒下的历史数据很难直接拿来改进模型，改进主要靠专家一点点改算法。GraphCast 直接从 ECMWF 的 ERA5 再分析数据学习：输入此刻和 6 小时前的全球大气状态，用图神经网络在多尺度的二十面体网格上传递信息，预测 6 小时后的状态，再一步步滚动出 10 天。在一台 Cloud TPU v4 设备上，一次 10 天预报不到一分钟。
body.en: Medium-range forecasts have long come from numerical weather prediction, which solves the equations of the atmosphere on supercomputers. More compute brings more accuracy, but decades of historical data could not easily be used to improve the model itself; progress depended on experts refining algorithms by hand. GraphCast learns directly from ECMWF's ERA5 reanalysis. It takes the global state of the atmosphere now and six hours earlier, passes messages with a graph neural network over a multi-scale icosahedral mesh, predicts the state six hours ahead, and repeats the step to reach ten days. A ten-day forecast takes under a minute on one Cloud TPU v4 device.

detail.zh:
一次预测要处理多少数？0.25 度的经纬网格是 721×1440，约 104 万个格点。每个格点上有 5 个地面变量，再加 6 个大气变量、各在 37 个气压层上，共 227 个，整个状态约 2.36 亿个数。模型先把格点信息编码到网格节点上，最细的一层有 40962 个节点；节点之间做多轮消息传递，网格里的长边能一下连到远处；最后解码回经纬格点，作为对当前状态的增量。

论文用 1979–2017 年的 ERA5 训练，2018 年以后的数据留作测试。和 ECMWF 最好的确定性业务预报 HRES 相比，在 1380 个评测目标（变量、气压层和预报时效的组合）里，GraphCast 在 90% 上明显更准。它没有专门为极端天气训练，但把按 ECMWF 公布方法实现的气旋追踪程序用在它的预报上，2018–2021 年的路径中位误差比 HRES 小，配对比较在 18 小时到 4.75 天的时效上显著更好。训练用了 32 台 Cloud TPU v4 设备，约四周。

代码和训练好的权重在 GitHub 上公开。DeepMind 2023 年 11 月 14 日的博客说，ECMWF 正在自己的网站上对 GraphCast 的预报做在线试验。
detail.en:
How many numbers go into one step? The 0.25-degree latitude-longitude grid is 721×1440, about 1.04 million points. Each point carries 5 surface variables plus 6 atmospheric variables at each of 37 pressure levels, 227 in all, so a full state is about 236 million numbers. The model first encodes grid values onto mesh nodes, with 40,962 nodes at the finest level. Nodes then exchange several rounds of messages, and long mesh edges reach distant regions in one hop. Finally the model decodes back to the grid as an update to the current state.

The paper trains on ERA5 from 1979 to 2017 and holds out data from 2018 onward for testing. Against HRES, ECMWF's best deterministic operational forecast, GraphCast was significantly more accurate on 90% of 1,380 verification targets, combinations of variable, pressure level, and lead time. It was not trained specifically for extreme weather, yet when a cyclone tracker built from ECMWF's published protocols was run on its forecasts, its median track error over 2018–2021 was lower than HRES's, and a paired comparison found it significantly better at lead times from 18 hours to 4.75 days. Training took about four weeks on 32 Cloud TPU v4 devices.

The code and trained weights are public on GitHub. In a blog post on November 14, 2023, DeepMind said ECMWF was running a live experiment of GraphCast's forecasts on its website.

limit.zh: GraphCast 只给一个确定性预报，不像集合预报那样给出可能结果的分布；它用均方误差训练，时效越长预报越“糊”，用接近平均值的方式表达不确定性。它也离不开传统方法：训练用的 ERA5 本身就是用数值模式同化观测得来的，作者明说不能把它当成传统预报的替代品。评测在 0.25 度上进行，而 HRES 运行在 0.1 度；降水因 ERA5 的已知偏差没有计入评分。日期：arXiv 初版是 2022 年 12 月 24 日，评测口径不同（2760 个组合）；这里的数字来自 2023 年 8 月 4 日的修订版，与 DeepMind 2023 年 11 月介绍《Science》论文时给的口径一致，所以标为 2023 年。
limit.en: GraphCast produces a single deterministic forecast, not a distribution of outcomes like an ensemble system. Trained on mean squared error, its forecasts grow blurrier at longer lead times, expressing uncertainty by drifting toward the mean. It also depends on traditional methods: ERA5 is itself produced by assimilating observations with a numerical model, and the authors say their approach should not be regarded as a replacement for traditional forecasting. Evaluation was at 0.25 degrees, while HRES runs at 0.1 degrees, and precipitation was left out of the scores because of known biases in ERA5. Dates: the first arXiv version, December 24, 2022, used a different evaluation (2,760 combinations). Figures here come from the August 4, 2023 revision, which matches the numbers DeepMind gave when it announced the Science paper in November 2023, so the entry uses 2023.

sources: Lam et al. · GraphCast: Learning skillful medium-range global weather forecasting, arXiv v2, 2023-08-04 · introduction, GraphCast, verification, severe-event and discussion sections
Same paper · arXiv v1, 2022-12-24, Figure 1 and discussion
Science · DOI record of the published article, 2023

summary.zh: 这一段的几件事，当时彼此没什么关系：电站要把电稳定送进楼里，图灵在回答“什么叫可计算”，贝尔实验室在给电话网找更可靠的放大器件。战后那几年，香农把“信息”变成了可以计算的量；Robbins 和 Monro、Metropolis、Bellman 分别给出了在噪声里一步步逼近答案、靠随机抽样做估算、把决策拆成一步一步来算的办法，MIT 的 Whirlwind 则用磁芯做出了又快又可靠的内存。几十年后，计算机和机器学习同时离不开这些。
summary.en: The events here had little to do with each other at the time. A power station had to deliver steady electricity to buildings, Turing asked what it means to compute, and Bell Labs wanted a more reliable amplifier for the phone network. In the years after the war, Shannon made information something you could calculate, and Robbins and Monro, Metropolis, and Bellman gave ways to home in on an answer through noise, to estimate by random sampling, and to work out decisions one step at a time, while MIT's Whirlwind built fast, reliable memory from magnetic cores. Decades later, computers and machine learning would rely on all of these.

summary.zh: 珍珠街电站把发电和配电合成一项大家共用的服务：用户不用自己发电，接上供电线路就行。先从这里看计算之外的基础设施问题。
summary.en: Pearl Street bundled generation and distribution into a shared service: customers hooked up to a supply instead of making their own electricity. Infrastructure is a good place to start, before computing enters the story.

summary.zh: 要问机器能有多聪明，得先说清“执行一个算法”是什么意思。图灵用一个极简的机器模型，让这个问题可以严格地讨论。
summary.en: Before asking how intelligent a machine could be, we need to define what it means to execute an algorithm. Turing made that question precise with a deliberately simple machine model.

summary.zh: 电话网需要可靠的放大器件。点接触晶体管证明了半导体能放大信号；但离后来装下大量晶体管的芯片，还有很多工程工作要做。
summary.en: The telephone network needed reliable amplifiers. The point-contact transistor showed that a semiconductor could amplify a signal; packing huge numbers of transistors onto a chip took a great deal more engineering.

summary.zh: 战后的通信、实验和计算碰到同一类麻烦：信号会出错，测量带随机误差，可能的状态和决策序列多到没法一一列举。这几项工作各给出一种不靠穷举的办法：度量信息、在噪声里逐步逼近、按概率抽样、按当前状态做决定。
summary.en: Postwar communication, experiments, and computing ran into the same kind of trouble: signals get corrupted, measurements carry random error, and possible states or decision sequences are too many to list. Each of these works found a way around enumeration: measuring information, approaching an answer step by step through noise, sampling by probability, and deciding from the current state.

summary.zh: 早期高速内存靠静电存储管，维护很费劲。磁芯把每一位存成磁化方向、按坐标选中读写，Whirlwind 1953 年换装后存取更快，维护也少了。
summary.en: Early fast memory relied on electrostatic storage tubes that were hard to maintain. Core storage held each bit as a direction of magnetization selected by coordinates; after Whirlwind switched in 1953, access was faster and maintenance lighter.

title.zh: 计算机连成网络，知识写进程序

summary.zh: 计算机还是又大又贵、大家排队轮流用的机器，很多工作都在想办法让它更好用：FORTRAN 和 C 让人不必再写汇编，System/360 让不同型号跑同一套程序，RAMAC 磁盘、DRAM 和缓存把存储做大做快，ARPANET、以太网和 TCP/IP 把机器连了起来。摩尔在 1965 年估计，一块电路上最省钱的元件数大约每年翻一倍。AI 在 1956 年成了一个研究方向，主流是把知识写成规则：Logic Theory Machine 搜索证明，DENDRAL 解读质谱，MYCIN 给医疗建议，Shakey 把感知和规划接到一台会走的机器上。另一条线是感知机和 Hopfield 网络，让机器靠连接强度来学和记。
summary.en: Computers were large, expensive machines that people took turns using, and much of the work went into making them easier to use. FORTRAN and C spared people from assembly, System/360 let different models run the same programs, the RAMAC disk, DRAM and caches made storage bigger and faster, and ARPANET, Ethernet and TCP/IP connected machines. In 1965 Moore estimated that the cheapest number of components per circuit was doubling about every year. AI became a research field in 1956, and the main approach was to write knowledge down as rules: the Logic Theory Machine searched for proofs, DENDRAL interpreted mass spectra, MYCIN gave medical advice, and Shakey joined perception and planning in a machine that moved. Another line, the perceptron and the Hopfield network, let machines learn and remember through connection strengths.

title.zh: 符号 AI 与专家系统

summary.zh: 如果专家能说出自己的判断规则，能不能把规则交给机器？从证明搜索、解读质谱的 DENDRAL 到 MYCIN，这条路线尝试显式表达知识，再让程序据此推理。
summary.en: If experts can state their reasoning as rules, could a machine use them? From proof search through DENDRAL, which read mass spectra, to MYCIN, this approach represented knowledge explicitly and built programs that reasoned with it.

summary.zh: 先让两台相隔很远的主机互相通信，再解决附近许多机器怎样共用线路，最后让不同的网络也能互通。ARPANET、Ethernet 和 TCP/IP 解决的是不同层次的问题。
summary.en: Getting distant hosts to talk, letting nearby machines share one cable, and joining different networks together are separate problems. ARPANET, Ethernet, and TCP/IP each tackle a different layer.

summary.zh: FORTRAN 让科学计算按公式来写，由编译器生成够快的机器码；C 让 Unix 内核也能用高级语言写。Unix 把文件、进程和命令组织成交互式工作环境，GNU 又问：这套日常依赖的软件，能不能由使用者自由分享和修改？
summary.en: FORTRAN let scientific programs be written as formulas, with a compiler producing fast enough machine code; C let even the Unix kernel be written in a high-level language. Unix organized files, processes, and commands into an interactive working environment, and GNU then asked who should be able to share and modify the software people depended on.

summary.zh: 磁盘让大文件里的任意一条记录可以直接取用；DRAM 关心怎样把更多位放进芯片，缓存关心怎样减少处理器等待。存得多、找得到、取得快，是不同层次的改进。
summary.en: Disk storage let any record in a large file be fetched directly; DRAM packed more bits into chips; caches cut processor waits. Capacity, direct access, and speed are improvements at different levels.

summary.zh: System/360 把程序看到的指令集和各型号的硬件实现分开；Moore 估计一块电路上最省钱的元件数每年约翻一倍；4004 把 CPU 做进一颗芯片。兼容、集成度和单芯片处理器，是不同层次的问题。
summary.en: System/360 separated the instruction set programs see from each model's hardware; Moore estimated that the cheapest number of components per circuit doubled about every year; the 4004 put a CPU on one chip. Compatibility, integration density, and single-chip processors are problems at different levels.

summary.zh: 求最短路，直觉上像是把所有路线都试一遍；算 N 点傅里叶级数，直觉上要做 N² 次乘加。换个好的计算顺序，两者都能省掉大部分工作：进步可以来自算法，不一定靠更多硬件。
summary.en: Finding a shortest path sounds like trying every route, and an N-point Fourier sum sounds like N² multiply-adds. A smarter order of work skips most of that in both cases: progress can come from the algorithm, not from more hardware.

summary.zh: 共享的数据越来越多，应用却常常被数据的具体存法绑住。关系模型从数据怎么表达入手，把逻辑上的关系和物理上的访问路径分开。这里讲的还不是分布式事务。
summary.en: As shared data grew, applications often ended up tied to one particular storage layout. The relational model separated logical relationships from physical access paths. This is not yet the story of distributed transactions.

summary.zh: 写规则之外，另一种想法是让机器靠连接强度记住东西。感知机用随机连线加强化来学分类，Hopfield 网络让相互连接的单元自己落回存好的状态。两者离后来的深度网络都很远，各自的边界原文也写得清楚。
summary.en: Besides writing rules, another idea was to let machines remember through connection strengths. The perceptron learned to classify with random wiring and reinforcement; the Hopfield network let interconnected units settle back into stored states. Both are far from later deep networks, and their original papers state their limits plainly.

title.en: Robots that plan their own actions

summary.zh: 给机器人一个只说目标、不说步骤的任务，它得知道房间里有什么，自己排出动作，执行时还要应付意外。Shakey 用逻辑公式描述世界，再由规划程序和执行监控把各层动作接起来。
summary.en: Give a robot a task that names the goal but not the steps, and it must know what is in the rooms, plan its own actions, and cope with surprises along the way. Shakey described its world in logical formulas and joined its layers of action through a planner and an execution monitor.

summary.zh: 除了手写规则，越来越多的方法让程序从数据里自己调参数：反向传播训练多层网络，HMM 做语音识别，IBM 的模型从双语句对里学翻译，SVM 做分类，Q-learning 从奖励里学行动，ALVINN 让网络看着路面学转向。搜索和推荐也在成形：BM25 给文档排序，GroupLens 按口味相近的人的评分做推荐。这些方法用的数学各不相同，当时谈不上谁取代谁。同一时期，Web、Linux、Python、GPL 和 arXiv 改变了软件和论文的流通方式；1997 年深蓝赢了卡斯帕罗夫，Sojourner 在火星上自己避障。
summary.en: Beyond hand-written rules, more and more methods let programs tune their own parameters from data: backpropagation trained multilayer networks, HMMs recognized speech, IBM's models learned translation from paired sentences, SVMs classified, Q-learning learned to act from rewards, and ALVINN learned to steer by watching the road. Search and recommendation took shape too: BM25 ranked documents, and GroupLens recommended from the ratings of people with similar taste. These methods rested on different mathematics, and none replaced the others at the time. Meanwhile the Web, Linux, Python, the GPL and arXiv changed how software and papers circulated; in 1997 Deep Blue beat Kasparov, and Sojourner avoided hazards on its own on Mars.

summary.zh: 隐藏层该学什么，可以拿任务的误差倒回来调；可序列一长，信息和梯度又容易衰减。反向传播和 LSTM 分别针对这两个问题。
summary.en: The error on a task can be sent back to shape what hidden layers learn. Long sequences add another difficulty: information and useful gradients tend to fade. Backpropagation tackles the first problem, LSTM the second.

summary.zh: 统计学习不只是分类：HMM 用隐藏状态解释语音序列，IBM 的翻译模型从双语句对里学词和词怎么对应，SVM 从分类间隔和正则化入手判断新样本。它们针对不同的任务，不是后一个取代前一个。
summary.en: Statistical learning is more than classification. HMMs explain observed sequences with hidden states, IBM's translation models learn which words correspond from pairs of sentences, and SVMs use margins and regularization to classify. They tackle different tasks, and none replaced the others.

summary.zh: 有些任务没有每一步的标准答案，只有做完动作后的奖励。Q-learning 要估计的是：现在做这个动作，之后也都做较好的选择，长期下来能拿到多少回报？
summary.en: Some tasks have rewards rather than a correct label for every step. Q-learning estimates the return from an action followed by good future choices.

summary.zh: CERN 的资料散落在不同系统里，人一流动，信息更难找。Web 提案从链接文档入手，让人能沿着关系找资料，而不必事先知道它属于哪个目录。
summary.en: At CERN, information was scattered across systems and became harder to find as people moved on. The Web proposal linked documents so readers could follow connections between them instead of having to know the right directory in advance.

summary.zh: Linux 0.01 把一个可研究、可修改的内核交到其他开发者手里，它还不是完整系统，但读代码、试运行、再改进有了具体对象。同一年公开的 Python 出自系统管理的需要，被设计成可以用 C 扩展的脚本语言。
summary.en: Linux 0.01 gave developers a kernel they could inspect and modify. It was not a complete system, but it offered something concrete to read, run, and improve together. Python, released the same year, grew out of system-administration needs as a scripting language that could be extended in C.

summary.zh: 并行程序需要互相发消息、交换结果。MPI 把常用通信操作的接口统一起来，同一套程序就更容易搬到不同的机器和实现上。
summary.en: Parallel programs exchange messages and combine results. MPI standardized common communication interfaces so applications could move more readily between machines and implementations.

title.zh: 受约束的机器人自主性

summary.zh: 机器人在真实环境里行动，靠感知、控制和人的配合一起起作用。ALVINN 让神经网络从道路图像直接学转向，但只在有限条件下测过；火星车 Sojourner 需要地面给目标，再在当地感知地形、避开障碍，也不是靠强化学习独自决定任务。
summary.en: A robot acting in the real world depends on sensing, control, and people working together. ALVINN let a neural network learn steering directly from road images, though it was tested only under limited conditions. The Sojourner rover took its goals from the ground and sensed terrain and obstacles locally, rather than using reinforcement learning to choose its mission.

summary.zh: 国际象棋规则明确、局面完全可见，难点是在比赛时限内搜得够深、评得够准。Deep Blue 把搜索放进专用芯片，知识则大多由人写进开局库和评估函数。
summary.en: Chess has clear rules and a fully visible board; the difficulty is searching deep enough and evaluating accurately enough within tournament time limits. Deep Blue put search into custom chips, while most of its knowledge was written by people into the opening book and evaluation function.

summary.zh: 论文和代码怎样传出去，本身也要设计。GPL 用版权条款保证改过的程序还能继续分享；arXiv 让预印本不必再靠邮寄复印件，谁都能按需取回全文。
summary.en: How papers and code travel also has to be designed. The GPL used copyright terms to keep modified programs shareable; arXiv freed preprints from mailed photocopies, so anyone could fetch a full text on demand.

summary.zh: 统计方法要从大量真实文本里学语言，得先有标好词性和句法的语料，而纯手工标注又慢又难一致。Penn Treebank 让程序先标、人再改，把标注做到了几百万词。
summary.en: Statistical methods needed real text annotated with parts of speech and syntax, and annotating entirely by hand was slow and inconsistent. The Penn Treebank had programs annotate first and people correct, reaching millions of words.

title.en: Too much to read: ranking and filtering

summary.zh: TREC 把检索测试集从几 MB 扩大到 2GB，Usenet 每天也有上百 MB 的新帖子。一边要把相关文档排到前面，一边要替读者挑出可能喜欢的帖子；1994 年的 BM25 和 GroupLens 分别从词的统计和他人的评分入手。
summary.en: TREC grew retrieval test collections from a few megabytes to 2 gigabytes, and Usenet produced over 100 MB of new articles a day. One problem was ranking relevant documents first; another was picking out articles a reader would like. In 1994 BM25 approached the first through term statistics, and GroupLens the second through other people's ratings.

summary.zh: 互联网让数据一下子多了起来，难点变成怎么在很多台机器上算、怎么存：Google 原型、MapReduce 和 HDFS 都默认机器随时会坏，Xen 和 EC2 让服务器可以按需租用。机房成了要精打细算的地方，能耗比例性、PUE 和 fat-tree 分别从用电和网络入手。芯片这边，处理器转向多核，三栅晶体管接着缩小器件，GPU 借 CUDA 能做通用计算。学习这边，SIFT 和 LeNet-5 代表手工特征和学到的特征两条路，Netflix Prize 把推荐做成了公开竞赛，Stanley 自己开车穿过了沙漠赛道，ImageNet 开始大规模标图。到 2012 年，GPU、数据集和卷积网络碰到了一起。
summary.en: The internet made data grow fast, and the hard part became computing and storing across many machines. The Google prototype, MapReduce and HDFS all assumed machines would fail, and Xen and EC2 let people rent servers on demand. Facilities became something to plan carefully, and energy proportionality, PUE and fat-tree networks attacked power and networking. In chips, processors went multicore, tri-gate transistors kept shrinking devices, and CUDA let GPUs do general computation. In learning, SIFT and LeNet-5 stood for hand-designed and learned features, the Netflix Prize turned recommendation into a public contest, Stanley drove itself across a desert course, and ImageNet began labeling images at scale. By 2012, GPUs, datasets and convolutional networks would meet.

title.zh: 深度学习热潮之前的 CNN

summary.zh: 不必先手写一套笔画检测规则：卷积层从图像中学习局部特征，再把特征交给后续层。LeNet-5 是这条路线的代表，不是 CNN 的起点。
summary.en: Instead of hand-writing stroke detectors, convolutional layers learn local features for later layers to use. LeNet-5 is a representative example of this approach, not the beginning of CNNs.

title.zh: 网页越来越多，怎么找到有用的？
title.en: Finding useful pages on a growing web

summary.zh: 关键词匹配之外，链接关系和链接上的文字也能提供线索。但排序公式只是其中一环，还得抓到网页、建好索引，并及时返回结果。
summary.en: Links and their text offer evidence beyond keyword matches. A ranking formula is only one component: pages still need to be crawled, indexed, and returned efficiently.

summary.zh: 统计海量文档中的词频不难写，难的是把它分给很多机器，还能处理失败。MapReduce 把这些协调工作交给运行系统，写程序的人主要描述数据怎么变换就行。
summary.en: Counting words is straightforward; coordinating that count across many machines and failures is harder. MapReduce put much of that coordination in the runtime so application authors could focus on the transformation.

summary.zh: 服务器少做事时，功耗未必跟着降。能耗比例性讨论低负载效率，PUE 只问机房的电有多少到了 IT 设备，仓库级计算则把服务器、网络、供电与冷却一起考虑；三者看的是不同尺度的成本。
summary.en: A lightly loaded server may still draw substantial power. Energy proportionality addresses low-load efficiency, PUE asks only how much facility energy reaches IT equipment, and warehouse-scale computing designs servers, networking, power, and cooling together; each looks at cost at a different scale.

summary.zh: 程序怎样变成硬件能执行的工作，有不同层次的问题。LLVM 组织可复用的代码表示与优化；CUDA 让开发者更直接地表达 GPU 线程和内存操作；NumPy 结束了 Python 两个数组包的分裂，给数值计算一个公共数组。
summary.en: Turning programs into executable work involves several layers. LLVM organizes reusable code representations and transformations; CUDA exposes GPU threads and memory operations; NumPy ended a split between two Python array packages and gave numerical code one shared array. These are neighboring tools, not a claimed invention lineage.

summary.zh: 核心再多，程序也可能还在等内存。Roofline 用算力和带宽的上限来分析这个问题；AMD 的 GCN 则展示了一种组织标量和向量执行的方式。一个是性能模型，一个是硬件设计，观察的角度不同。再往下一层，晶体管本身也在变：Intel 宣布 22 纳米改用立起来的三栅晶体管。
summary.en: More cores do not help a program that is still waiting on memory. Roofline analyzes that limit through peak compute and bandwidth, while AMD's GCN shows one way to organize scalar and vector execution: a performance model and a hardware design, seen from different angles. One layer further down, the transistor itself changed shape when Intel announced upright Tri-Gate transistors for 22 nm.

summary.zh: 要比较模型是否真的更会识图，需要足够多、经过整理的图片。ImageNet 的贡献也在类别设计、采集和人工核验，不只是一个更大的下载包。
summary.en: Comparing image models required a large, organized collection of examples. ImageNet involved category design, collection, and human verification—not just a bigger file to download.

title.zh: 机房里的带宽与数据搬运
title.en: Bandwidth and data movement inside the facility

summary.zh: 机器一多，通信在两处卡住：交换机树的上层带宽不够，复制数据还要占用 CPU。fat-tree 用许多普通交换机提供多条等长路径，RDMAP 规定受保护的远端缓冲区读写；前者管网络拓扑，后者管主机上的数据搬运。
summary.en: With more machines, communication stalled in two places: upper switch tiers lacked bandwidth, and copying data consumed CPU time. Fat-tree used many commodity switches to provide multiple equal-cost paths, while RDMAP specified protected reads and writes to remote buffers; one concerns network topology, the other data movement at the hosts, and RDMAP does not cover every RDMA protocol.

title.zh: 存得下，也要经得起机器故障

summary.zh: 大文件拆到多台机器上以后，目录、块的位置和副本都得有人管。HDFS 把元数据和文件内容分开，由存储层负责故障恢复；计算任务怎样调度，是另一层的事。
summary.en: Spreading large files across machines requires namespace, block-location, and replica management. HDFS separates metadata from file contents and handles storage recovery, a different responsibility from scheduling computation.

summary.zh: 同一个物体，换个距离、角度或光线再拍，像素几乎全变了。要在两张图之间找出同一处，先得有一种不随这些变化而变的描述。SIFT 用人设计的梯度统计来做，特征不是学出来的。
summary.en: Photograph the same object from another distance, angle, or light, and nearly every pixel changes. Matching the same spot across two images first needs a description that holds steady under those changes. SIFT built one from hand-designed gradient statistics rather than learned features.

summary.zh: 统计机构要公布汇总数字，可如果谁都能随便问，汇总数字问得够多，也能反推出个人记录。差分隐私把“保护了多少”写成可以证明的条件，再按查询的敏感度决定加多少噪声。
summary.en: Statistics offices publish totals, but if anyone may ask freely, enough totals can reveal individual records. Differential privacy turns how much protection a release gives into a provable condition and sets the noise by each query's sensitivity.

summary.zh: 一台服务器同时给很多人用，难在隔离：配置不能互相打架，一个人的负载也不能拖慢别人。Xen 用改过的客户操作系统，把一台机器分成多台虚拟机；EC2 在 Xen 上做出按小时租用的服务。一个是虚拟化技术，一个是商业服务，层次不同。
summary.en: Sharing one server among many users is hard because of isolation: configurations must not collide, and one user's load must not slow the rest. Xen split a machine into virtual machines by modifying the guest operating systems, and EC2 built an hourly rental service on Xen. One is a virtualization technique and the other a commercial service, at different layers.

title.en: Driverless vehicles finish a desert course

summary.zh: 2004 年的第一届 DARPA 大挑战，没有一辆车跑完全程的 5%。难点在于高速行驶时既要看得远，又不能把传感器噪声当成障碍；2005 年获胜的 Stanley 用概率模型和从数据中学习的方法处理这些问题。
summary.en: At the first DARPA Grand Challenge in 2004, no vehicle covered 5% of the course. The difficulty was seeing far enough at speed without mistaking sensor noise for obstacles. Stanley, the 2005 winner, tackled this with probabilistic models and methods that learned from data.

summary.zh: 每个用户只给很少一部分电影打过分，评分矩阵大部分是空的。2006 年起的 Netflix Prize 公开了上亿条评分，让大家在同一份数据上比谁猜得准。
summary.en: Each user has rated only a small share of the movies, so most of the rating matrix is empty. From 2006 the Netflix Prize released more than 100 million ratings and let teams compete on the same data to predict the rest.

title.zh: 深度网络开始做成更多事
title.en: Deep networks take on more tasks

summary.zh: 2012 年，AlexNet 用两块 GPU 在 ImageNet 上把 top-5 错误率做到 15.3%，第二名是 26.2%；同一年，几个团队的语音识别也换上了深度网络。接下来几年，同样的思路用到了更多地方：word2vec 学词向量，Seq2Seq 加上 attention 做翻译，DQN 看着游戏画面学操作，Faster R-CNN 找出图里的物体，ResNet 把网络加深到 152 层。训练工具跟着变：Adam 给出了一种自适应的优化方法，参数服务器和 Spark 把计算分到集群上，TensorFlow 开源。集群调度有了 Borg 论文和 Kubernetes 1.0，HBM 把显存堆进了 GPU 封装。
summary.en: In 2012 AlexNet trained on ImageNet with two GPUs and reached 15.3% top-5 error, against 26.2% for the runner-up; the same year, several groups moved speech recognition to deep networks. Over the next few years the idea spread: word2vec learned word vectors, Seq2Seq with attention translated, DQN learned to play games from the screen, Faster R-CNN found objects in images, and ResNet went 152 layers deep. Training tools changed with it: Adam offered an adaptive optimizer, the parameter server and Spark spread computation across clusters, and TensorFlow was open-sourced. Cluster scheduling got the Borg paper and Kubernetes 1.0, and HBM stacked memory into the GPU package.

summary.zh: AlexNet 让人看到，数据、GPU 和深层卷积网络放在一起能做成什么。ResNet 接着处理另一个难题：层数一多，网络有时连训练集都更难拟合。
summary.en: AlexNet brought together data, GPUs, and deep convolutional networks. ResNet tackled another problem: adding layers could make even the training set harder to fit.

title.zh: 深度 RL 的早期实践

summary.zh: 游戏画面变化太多，列不成一张状态—动作表。DQN 用神经网络估计动作价值，把过去的交互存下来反复用于训练，把表示学习和决策学习接到了一起。
summary.en: Game screens vary too much to fit in a small state–action table. DQN estimated action values with a neural network and trained on stored past interactions, linking representation learning with decision-making.

title.en: From word vectors to sequence models

summary.zh: word2vec 拿邻近的词当训练信号，学出可以反复使用的词向量。Seq2Seq 要处理的是整句输入、长度不定的输出：先把输入编码，再一步步生成译文。怎么表示一个词，和怎么生成一串词，是两个层次的问题。
summary.en: word2vec learned reusable word vectors from neighboring words. Seq2Seq took on whole input sentences and outputs of varying length: encode the sentence, then generate the translation step by step. Representing a word and generating a sequence are problems at different levels.

summary.zh: 迭代算法要反复读同一批数据，MapReduce 式的作业却每轮都要落盘；Spark 的 RDD 把中间结果留在内存，靠记录来历来容错。参数服务器把共享的模型分片放到服务器上，让上千台机器按可调的一致性读写。在集群这一层，Google 用 Borg 管理大批作业多年，2015 年把经验写成论文；同一年，开源的 Kubernetes 发布 1.0，接手容器的放置、重启和服务发现。
summary.en: Iterative algorithms read the same data again and again, yet MapReduce-style jobs wrote to disk every round; Spark's RDDs kept intermediate results in memory and recovered from failures by recording lineage. The parameter server sharded a shared model across servers so thousands of machines could read and write it with tunable consistency. At the cluster level, Google had run large numbers of jobs on Borg for years and described it in a 2015 paper; the same year, open-source Kubernetes reached 1.0 and took over placing, restarting and discovering containers.

summary.zh: GPU 算得越来越快，数据也得喂得上。HBM 把存储叠起来，用很宽的接口接到处理器上；芯片怎么摆、怎么连，开始直接影响带宽。
summary.en: As GPUs computed more, memory had to keep them fed. HBM stacked memory and linked it to the processor through a wide interface, so how chips were placed and packaged became part of bandwidth design.

title.zh: 语音识别换上深度网络

summary.zh: 语音识别多年依靠 GMM-HMM，GMM 判断每一帧声音像哪个状态，调得很成熟。深度网络能不能接下这一块，又不推翻 HMM 和解码器？几个团队在大词汇量任务上做了对比。
summary.en: For years speech recognition relied on the GMM-HMM, with a finely tuned GMM scoring how each frame of sound fits each state. Could a deep network take over that piece while keeping the HMM and decoder? Several groups compared the two on large-vocabulary tasks.

title.zh: 物体检测：是什么，在哪里

summary.zh: 分类只回答图里是什么，检测还要把每个物体框出来。卷积网络判断候选框已经很快，提出候选框的老算法却还在 CPU 上慢慢跑，成了整个系统最慢的一步。
summary.en: Classification says what is in an image; detection must also put a box around each object. Convolutional networks could already score candidate boxes quickly, but the older algorithms that proposed those boxes still ran slowly on CPUs and became the slowest step.

summary.zh: GPU 训练已经可行，但研究者多在单机框架上做实验，Google 自己的 DistBelief 又重又难改，从工作站到集群再到手机各用一套系统。TensorFlow 尝试用一张数据流图覆盖实验、集群训练和部署。
summary.en: GPU training worked, but researchers mostly experimented with single-machine frameworks, while Google's own DistBelief was heavy and hard to modify, and workstations, clusters, and phones each needed separate systems. TensorFlow tried to cover experiments, cluster training, and deployment with one dataflow graph.

summary.zh: 小批量算出的梯度带噪声，有的很稀疏，训练目标也可能一直在变，一个全局学习率很难照顾所有参数。Adam 按每个参数自己的梯度历史调整步长。
summary.en: Gradients from small batches are noisy, some are sparse, and the objective may keep shifting, so one global learning rate rarely suits every parameter. Adam adjusts each parameter's step from that parameter's own gradient history.

title.zh: 视觉之外，几条路线同时展开

summary.zh: 深度学习从图像扩展到更多问题，路线开始分叉。AlphaGo 用神经网络帮树搜索减负，赢了李世石；Transformer 只用 attention 做翻译，ELMo 和 BERT 把预训练带进语言任务，SQuAD 和 GLUE 给了统一的评测；GNMT 和 YouTube 推荐把深度网络放进了大规模线上服务，WaveNet 一个采样点一个采样点地生成声音。图网络、强化学习和稀疏混合专家也各有进展。工具和硬件跟着分化：PyTorch、Horovod 和 TVM 出现，TPU v1 是专做推理的芯片，Volta 加了 Tensor Core，NVLink 把 GPU 连得更紧，TPU v3 开始用液冷。数据和模型该附什么说明、不交出原始数据能不能训练模型，也有了 Datasheets、Model Cards 和联邦学习这样的方案。
summary.en: Deep learning spread from images to other problems, and its paths began to branch. AlphaGo used neural networks to lighten tree search and beat Lee Sedol. Transformer translated with attention alone, ELMo and BERT brought pretraining to language tasks, and SQuAD and GLUE gave shared benchmarks. GNMT and YouTube recommendations put deep networks into large online services, and WaveNet generated sound one sample at a time. Graph networks, reinforcement learning and sparse mixture of experts each moved forward. Tools and hardware diversified too: PyTorch, Horovod and TVM appeared, TPU v1 was a chip built for inference, Volta added Tensor Cores, NVLink tied GPUs together more tightly, and TPU v3 moved to liquid cooling. Datasheets, Model Cards and federated learning proposed what should accompany data and models, and how to train without collecting raw data.

summary.zh: 像素排在规整的网格上，分子、社交关系和论文引用却没有这样的网格。GCN、GraphSAGE 和 GAT 分别从传播、采样聚合和邻居权重入手，在图上学习。
summary.en: Pixels sit on a grid; molecules, social links, and citations do not. GCN, GraphSAGE, and GAT explored propagation, sampled aggregation, and neighbor weighting for graph learning.

summary.zh: Transformer 改变了序列里各位置交换信息的方式；ELMo 让同一个词在不同句子里拿到不同的向量；BERT 把一部分词遮住让模型去猜，学到能迁移到别的任务上的表示。架构和训练目标，可以分开来改。
summary.en: Transformer changed how positions in a sequence exchange information. ELMo gave the same word a different vector in each sentence. BERT masked some words and trained the model to recover them, learning representations that transfer to other tasks. Architecture and training objective can be changed independently.

summary.zh: AlphaGo 把神经网络和搜索组合成一个下棋系统；PPO 研究策略该怎么更新，SAC 把熵奖励和数据重用结合起来。三者都和决策有关，但分工不同，并不互相替代。
summary.en: AlphaGo combined neural networks and search into a single game-playing system. PPO studied how to update a policy; SAC paired experience reuse with an entropy objective. All three are about decisions, but they play different roles.

summary.zh: 神经网络反复做矩阵乘法。TPU v1 为数据中心推理单独做了一颗芯片；Volta 的 Tensor Core 则在通用 GPU 里加了专用单元，用低精度输入和较高精度累加提高效率。
summary.en: Neural networks repeat matrix multiplication. TPU v1 was a separate chip built for datacenter inference, while Volta's Tensor Cores added dedicated units inside a general-purpose GPU, using low-precision inputs with higher-precision accumulation.

summary.zh: 拿到一份数据文件，不等于知道它适合拿来做什么。Datasheets 建议把采集、标注、用途和维护方式一并记下来，后来用的人才好判断。
summary.en: A downloaded dataset does not say what it is suitable for. Datasheets proposed documenting collection, annotation, intended uses, and maintenance alongside the data, so later users can judge.

summary.zh: 数据和模型都牵涉到具体的人。联邦学习让手机上的数据留在本地、只上传模型更新，但更新本身仍可能泄露信息；Model Cards 提醒，模型总分不错，也可能在某些人群或场景上很差，发布时要交代评估条件和使用边界。一个管训练数据放在哪，一个管发布时说清什么。
summary.en: Data and models both involve real people. Federated learning keeps phone data on the device and uploads only model updates, though updates can still leak information. Model Cards point out that a model with a good overall score may still do badly for some groups or settings, so a release should state evaluation conditions and intended uses. One concerns where training data lives, the other what a release discloses.

summary.zh: 语音合成要么拼接录音片段，要么让声码器从预测的参数合成声音，后者常常发闷。能不能跳过声码器，直接预测每秒至少 16000 个采样点的波形？WaveNet 试了这条路。
summary.en: Speech synthesis either stitched together recorded segments or had a vocoder render predicted parameters, which often sounded muffled. Could a model skip the vocoder and predict the waveform directly, at 16,000 or more samples per second? WaveNet tried that route.

title.zh: 参数更多，计算不跟着涨

summary.zh: 数据越多，大模型越有用，可每个样本都要经过全部参数，代价涨得很快。能不能每次只用网络的一小部分？稀疏门控的混合专家层在语言建模和翻译上试了这个办法。
summary.en: With more data, bigger models help more, but when every example passes through every parameter the cost climbs fast. Could each example use only a small part of the network? The sparsely-gated mixture-of-experts layer tried this on language modeling and translation.

summary.zh: 静态图框架便于优化，却难调试；多卡训练又常要大改程序，还要忍受通信开销。PyTorch 让模型回到普通的 Python 程序，Horovod 用 allreduce 和几行改动把单卡程序扩到多机。两者解决的是不同的麻烦。
summary.en: Static-graph frameworks helped optimization but made debugging hard, and multi-GPU training often meant restructuring programs and absorbing communication overhead. PyTorch made models ordinary Python programs again, and Horovod scaled single-GPU programs across machines with allreduce and a few changed lines. They address different problems.

title.zh: 深度模型接入线上服务

summary.zh: 模型进入每天有大量请求的服务后，问题就不只是论文分数：翻译要够快、能处理生僻词，推荐要在几十毫秒内从几百万个视频里挑出几百个，还要面对离线指标和线上实验对不上的情况。
summary.en: Once models serve heavy daily traffic, benchmark scores are only part of the problem. Translation has to be fast and cope with rare words; recommendation has to narrow millions of videos to a few hundred within tens of milliseconds, and offline metrics do not always agree with live experiments.

title.zh: 同一个模型，要跑在很多种硬件上
title.en: One model, many kinds of hardware

summary.zh: 框架把模型交给厂商写好的算子库，可这些库主要照顾服务器 GPU；换成手机芯片或 FPGA，就得重新手工调。TVM 把这一步当成编译问题，为每种硬件自动生成算子代码。
summary.en: Frameworks handed models to vendor operator libraries that mainly served server GPUs; moving to phone chips or FPGAs meant tuning by hand again. TVM treated this step as compilation and generated operator code for each kind of hardware automatically.

summary.zh: 预训练语言模型需要大家共用的考题来比较：SQuAD 要求从原文里找出答案片段，GLUE 把九个现成任务合成一个总分。分数涨得很快，考题自身的漏洞也跟着暴露出来。
summary.en: Pretrained language models needed shared tests for comparison: SQuAD asks for an answer span from the passage, and GLUE folds nine existing tasks into one score. Scores rose quickly, and the tests' own loopholes came to light along the way.

summary.zh: 一台服务器里的 GPU 越来越多，卡与卡之间交换数据还挤在 PCIe 上。NVLink 给 GPU 之间加了专用链路；机器与机器之间仍靠机房网络。
summary.en: Servers held more and more GPUs, yet traffic between them still crowded onto PCIe. NVLink added dedicated links between GPUs; communication between machines still relied on the facility network.

summary.zh: 训练芯片的功耗升到几百瓦，风扇开始带不走热量。TPU v3 改用液冷，代价是机柜要成组摆放，机房要配套水路。
summary.en: As training chips reached several hundred watts, fans could no longer carry the heat away. TPU v3 moved to liquid cooling, at the price of grouping racks together and adding facility plumbing.

title.zh: 更大的预训练，新的科学成果
title.en: Larger pretrained models, new scientific results

summary.zh: 这几年大家都在放大：数据、模型、算力一起往上加。缩放定律试着算出该怎么分配，GPT-3 读几条示例就能试着做新任务，Codex 把它用到了写代码上。为了训得动，Megatron-LM 和 ZeRO 把模型和训练状态拆到多张 GPU 上，Triton 让写 GPU 算子容易了一些；EUV 光刻进入量产，A100 加了新的计算精度。视觉没有收敛到一条路，ViT、CLIP 和扩散模型各走各的。AlphaFold 2 在蛋白质结构预测上进展很大，MMLU 用 57 个学科的题考模型，Hugging Face 的 Transformers 库让人能直接下载和复用预训练模型。
summary.en: Everyone was scaling up: more data, bigger models, more compute. Scaling laws tried to work out how to split the budget, GPT-3 could attempt a new task from a few examples, and Codex applied the idea to writing code. To make such models trainable, Megatron-LM and ZeRO split models and training state across GPUs, and Triton made GPU kernels easier to write; EUV lithography entered volume production, and the A100 added new number formats. Vision did not settle on one path; ViT, CLIP and diffusion models each went their own way. AlphaFold 2 made major progress on protein structure, MMLU tested models with questions from 57 subjects, and Hugging Face's Transformers library let people download and reuse pretrained models directly.

summary.zh: 给同一个 GPT-3 换上不同的指令和示例，它就能去试不同的任务，变的是上下文，权重没有跟着任务更新。缩放定律想回答另一个问题：算力一定时，模型该多大、数据该多少。
summary.en: Give the same GPT-3 different instructions and examples and it will attempt different tasks; what changes is the context, not the weights. Scaling laws asked a different question: for a fixed compute budget, how big should the model be and how much data should it see?

summary.zh: ViT 研究怎样把图像交给 Transformer；DDPM 学习从噪声生成图像；CLIP 用文字帮助学习视觉表示。一个偏结构，一个偏生成过程，一个偏监督信号。
summary.en: ViT asked how to feed images to a Transformer. DDPM learned to generate images by denoising. CLIP used text to supervise visual representations. One is about architecture, one about the generative process, one about the training signal.

summary.zh: 从氨基酸序列推出蛋白质的三维结构，是一个具体又困难的科学问题。AlphaFold 2 在 CASP14 上的结果，让这个问题有了重要进展。
summary.en: Working out a protein's three-dimensional structure from its amino-acid sequence is a concrete and hard scientific problem. AlphaFold 2's results at CASP14 marked an important advance on it.

title.zh: 让更大的模型训得起来

summary.zh: 训练要保存的不只是权重，还有梯度和优化器状态。Megatron-LM 把每层 Transformer 的矩阵乘法切到服务器内的多张卡上；ZeRO 拆分数据并行中重复保存的状态。两者处理的是不同的部分，ZeRO 论文也把它们组合起来用。
summary.en: Training stores gradients and optimizer state as well as weights. Megatron-LM split each Transformer layer's matrix multiplications across the GPUs of a server; ZeRO partitioned redundant data-parallel state. They address different parts of the problem, and the ZeRO paper combines them.

summary.zh: 在制造这一层，EUV 光刻在 2019 年进入商用芯片，最复杂的几层图形改用 13.5 纳米的光来印。在设计这一层，同样是 GPU，侧重点开始分得更清楚：RDNA 偏图形，CDNA 偏计算；A100 支持更多矩阵精度，还能把一块 GPU 切开给不同任务用。
summary.en: In manufacturing, EUV lithography reached commercial chips in 2019, printing the most intricate layers with 13.5 nm light. In design, GPUs began to specialize more clearly: RDNA leaned toward graphics and CDNA toward computation, while the A100 added more matrix formats and could be partitioned among different jobs.

summary.zh: 模型能做的事越来越多，评估也得跟着扩大范围。MMLU 用跨学科的选择题考知识；这是一个观察角度，开放式任务还得另外测。
summary.en: Broader model capabilities required broader tests. MMLU used multiple-choice questions across subjects to examine knowledge, while open-ended tasks still required separate evaluation.

summary.zh: 预训练越来越贵，能从头训练大模型的团队越来越少。共享的代码和权重成了很多人的起点，随之而来的问题是：发布一个模型时要交代什么。
summary.en: As pretraining grew more expensive, fewer teams could train large models from scratch. Shared code and weights became the starting point for many, which raised the question of what a released model should disclose.

title.zh: 库里没有的运算，也要跑得快
title.en: Fast kernels for operations the libraries lack

summary.zh: 新想法常常需要厂商库里没有的运算，手写 GPU 内核又费劲、又难移植。Triton 让人按块写计算，线程分工和共享内存交给编译器处理。
summary.en: New ideas often need operations that vendor libraries lack, and hand-written GPU kernels are laborious and hard to port. Triton lets programmers write computations on tiles and leaves thread assignment and shared memory to the compiler.

title.zh: 生成模型走向更多用户

summary.zh: 2022 年，生成模型从论文和接口变成了普通人能直接用的东西：Stable Diffusion 放出了权重和代码，LAION-5B 公开了几十亿对图文数据，ChatGPT 以研究预览的形式开放。用的人多了，问题跟着变了：回答要合人的意，于是有了 InstructGPT 和更简单的 DPO；服务要够快够便宜，于是有了 FlashAttention 和 vLLM。语音和视觉的模型也在往“不微调直接用”走，比如 Whisper 和 Segment Anything；GraphCast 用学出来的模型做中期天气预报。硬件专门照顾 Transformer 和多卡互连，机器人方向在试着把视觉语言模型接到动作上。
summary.en: In 2022 generative models went from papers and APIs to things ordinary people could use: Stable Diffusion released its weights and code, LAION-5B published billions of image–text pairs, and ChatGPT opened as a research preview. With real users, the questions changed. Answers had to match what people wanted, which led to InstructGPT and the simpler DPO; serving had to be fast and cheap, which led to FlashAttention and vLLM. Speech and vision models moved toward working without fine-tuning, as Whisper and Segment Anything did, and GraphCast used a learned model for medium-range weather forecasts. Hardware catered to Transformers and multi-GPU interconnect, and robotics tried connecting vision-language models to actions.

summary.zh: InstructGPT 展示了怎样用示范和偏好来调整回答，ChatGPT 给了一个对话入口，DPO 尝试更直接地用偏好训练。训练方法和产品体验，可以放在一起对照着看。
summary.en: InstructGPT trained on demonstrations and preferences, ChatGPT supplied a conversational interface, and DPO explored a more direct preference objective. Training methods and product experience can be read side by side.

summary.zh: Stable Diffusion 公开了权重和代码，用户可以自己运行、改造图像生成模型。能亲手用上模型，和只能看论文里的样图，不是一回事。
summary.en: Stable Diffusion released weights and code, allowing people to run and adapt an image generator rather than only inspect examples in a paper.

summary.zh: FlashAttention 减少一次 attention 计算中的数据搬运；vLLM 管理多个请求不断增长的 KV cache。前者偏算子，后者偏服务，瓶颈所在的层次不同。
summary.en: FlashAttention cut data movement inside the attention computation. vLLM managed the KV caches that keep growing across requests. One works on a single operation, the other on serving; the bottlenecks sit at different layers.

title.zh: 视觉语言模型走向动作

summary.zh: 模型看懂“把杯子拿起来”之后，还得给机器人可执行的动作。RT-2 把视觉语言数据与机器人轨迹结合，研究这些能力怎样迁移到控制。
summary.en: Understanding “pick up the cup” is not enough; the robot still needs actions it can execute. RT-2 combined vision-language data with robot trajectories to study how those abilities carry over to control.

summary.zh: H100 的重点是低精度的 Transformer 计算和 GPU 互连，MI300 则把 chiplet、HBM 和异构集成放在一起。比较这类硬件，计算、内存和系统连接都要看。
summary.en: H100 emphasized low-precision Transformer computation and GPU interconnects. MI300 combined chiplets, HBM, and heterogeneous integration. Comparing them means looking at compute, memory, and how systems are connected.

title.zh: 换个场景，不再重新训练

summary.zh: 语音识别和图像分割的模型，常常换一个数据集就要重新微调，在原数据集上的高分也带不过去。Whisper 用大量带文字稿的网络音频，SAM 用提示加上十亿级的掩码，都想让模型拿来就能用。
summary.en: Speech recognition and segmentation models often had to be fine-tuned again for each new dataset, and high scores on one dataset did not carry over. Whisper trained on large amounts of transcribed web audio, and SAM on prompts plus a billion masks, both aiming for models that work out of the box.

summary.zh: 图文模型靠几亿到几十亿对网页图文训练，这些数据大多不公开。LAION-5B 把从 Common Crawl 筛出的链接公开出来，随之而来的问题是：数据这么大，谁来检查里面有什么。
summary.en: Image–text models trained on hundreds of millions to billions of web pairs, mostly unpublished. LAION-5B released links filtered from Common Crawl, which raised a new question: at this scale, who checks what is inside?

title.zh: AI for Science · 天气预报

summary.zh: 数值天气预报靠超级计算机解方程，几十年的再分析数据却很难直接用来改进模型。GraphCast 试着直接从这些数据学会预测下一步天气，再和业务预报逐项比较。
summary.en: Numerical weather prediction solves equations on supercomputers, yet decades of reanalysis data could not easily improve the model itself. GraphCast tried to learn the next step of the weather directly from that data, then compared itself with operational forecasts target by target.

title.zh: 用 RL 改进语言模型推理

summary.zh: 预训练让模型懂很多东西，但多步推理（比如解数学题）不一定自己就会。这两年的一条路是接着用强化学习训：给回答打分，再按分数调。DeepSeekMath 提出 GRPO，用同一道题的一组回答互相比较，省掉了单独的价值模型；DeepSeek-R1 把它用在推理训练上，开源框架很快跟上。不过题目怎么选、奖励怎么写、每道题采样几次才划算，还没有通用的答案。
summary.en: Pretraining gives models a lot of knowledge, but multi-step reasoning, such as solving math problems, does not necessarily come with it. One path in these two years was more training with reinforcement learning: score the answers and adjust by the scores. DeepSeekMath introduced GRPO, which compares a group of answers to the same problem and drops the separate value model; DeepSeek-R1 applied it to reasoning training, and open-source frameworks followed quickly. How to choose problems, write rewards and decide how many samples per problem are worth it still has no general answer.

summary.zh: GRPO 的出发点很直观：同一道题做几遍，再用奖励比较这几份回答。R1 则说明，RL 更新还得和数据准备、SFT、评估一起设计。
summary.en: GRPO starts with several answers to the same problem and compares their rewards. R1 shows how those updates fit alongside data preparation, SFT, and evaluation.

summary.zh: 奖励写得准不准、题目会不会太难、多采样值不值，都会影响训练。这些问题已经积累了不少经验，但还得按任务逐一验证，所以单独列出来，标成开放问题。
summary.en: Reward quality, task difficulty, and whether extra sampling pays off all affect training. There is plenty of practical experience, but each choice still has to be checked task by task, so they are listed separately as open questions.

subtitle.zh: 供电 · 冷却 · 数据中心

description.zh: 一台机器接上电就能跑；一座机房还要解决供电容量、备用电源和散热。顺着这条线能看到，计算能做多大，不只取决于芯片。
description.en: A single machine just needs a power socket. A facility also needs enough supply capacity, backup power, and cooling. This branch follows the physical limits on how large computing systems can grow.

next.zh: 已有珍珠街电站、能耗比例性、PUE、仓库级计算和 TPU v3 液冷；交流电网、UPS、机房配电和电力采购仍需展开。
next.en: Pearl Street, energy proportionality, PUE, warehouse-scale computing and TPU v3 liquid cooling are represented. AC grids, UPS systems, facility power distribution and power procurement still need histories.

subtitle.zh: 晶体管 · CPU · GPU · 加速器

description.zh: CPU、GPU 和专用加速器，把有限的芯片面积用在不同地方。这里把 NVIDIA、AMD 等路线放在一起，看它们怎样取舍通用性、算力、功耗和数据搬运。
description.en: CPUs, GPUs, and specialized accelerators spend their silicon differently. Follow NVIDIA, AMD, and other approaches through their choices about flexibility, arithmetic, power, and data movement.

next.zh: 已有晶体管、System/360、摩尔 1965、Intel 4004、Roofline、GCN、三栅晶体管、TPU v1、EUV 量产和 NVIDIA / AMD 的几代 GPU；RISC、乱序执行、多核 CPU 和先进封装仍需展开。
next.en: The transistor, System/360, Moore's 1965 article, the Intel 4004, Roofline, GCN, tri-gate transistors, TPU v1, EUV volume production and several NVIDIA and AMD GPU generations are represented. RISC, out-of-order execution, multicore CPUs and advanced packaging still need histories.

subtitle.zh: 缓存 · DRAM · HBM · 持久化

description.zh: 处理器算得再快，也可能干等着数据。缓存、DRAM 和 HBM 各自应对距离、容量和带宽的问题；文件系统还得让数据存在多台机器上，出了故障也能读出来。内存和持久化存储，分工不同。
description.en: A fast processor can still sit waiting for data. Caches, DRAM, and HBM deal with distance, capacity, and bandwidth; file systems keep data across machines and through failures. Memory and persistent storage do different jobs.

next.zh: 已有 Whirlwind 磁芯存储、RAMAC 硬盘、单晶体管 DRAM、Model 85 缓存、HDFS 和 HBM；闪存与 SSD、对象存储、检查点系统仍需展开。
next.en: Whirlwind core memory, the RAMAC disk, single-transistor DRAM, the Model 85 cache, HDFS and HBM are represented. Flash and SSDs, object storage and checkpoint systems still need histories.

subtitle.zh: 互联网 · 集群网络 · 芯片互连

description.zh: 读网页、跨机器传文件、让多张 GPU 一起训练，都需要通信，但连接距离和要求不同。先分清互联网、机房网络和设备互连，再看各自的设计。
description.en: Reading a web page, transferring files, and training across GPUs all depend on communication, but over different distances and with different demands. This branch separates the Internet, facility networks, and device interconnects.

next.zh: 已有 ARPANET、以太网、TCP/IP、Web、RDMAP、fat-tree 和 NVLink；InfiniBand、RoCE、PCIe 和光互连仍需展开。
next.en: ARPANET, Ethernet, TCP/IP, the Web, RDMAP, fat-tree and NVLink are represented. InfiniBand, RoCE, PCIe and optical interconnects still need histories.

note.zh: Web 和互联网后来有了自己的产业和社区，并不依附于 AI 而存在。
note.en: The Web and the internet grew their own industry and communities; they do not exist for AI.

subtitle.zh: Linux · 编译器 · 运行时

description.zh: 程序到硬件之间还有很多层：操作系统分配资源，编译器转换代码，驱动和计算库调用设备。顺着 Unix、Linux、CUDA 等节点，看这些软件怎样让硬件变得好用。
description.en: Between a program and the hardware sit operating systems, compilers, drivers, and computing libraries. Unix, Linux, CUDA, and other milestones show how software makes machines usable.

next.zh: 已含 FORTRAN、C、Unix、GNU、Linux、Python、LLVM、NumPy、CUDA、TensorFlow、PyTorch 与 FlashAttention，并用 TVM 说明编译框架的后续用途；虚拟化、ROCm、Theano 与 JAX 等执行体系仍需独立展开。
next.en: FORTRAN, C, Unix, GNU, Linux, Python, LLVM, NumPy, CUDA, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and FlashAttention are represented, with TVM illustrating later compiler reuse. Virtualization, ROCm, and execution systems such as Theano and JAX still need dedicated histories.

note.zh: 从 GNU 和 Linux 长出来的自由与开源软件，有自己的社区和规则，AI 只是它的用户之一。
note.en: The free and open-source software that grew from GNU and Linux has its own communities and rules; AI is one of its users.

subtitle.zh: 并行计算 · 云 · 训练与推理

description.zh: 把工作分给很多机器之后，还得把结果收回来。通信、调度、故障恢复和服务排队，是这条线反复出现的问题；买更多机器只是开始。
description.en: Splitting work across machines is only the beginning. Results must come back, failures need recovery, and requests need scheduling. This branch follows the systems that coordinate that work.

next.zh: 已含关系模型、MPI、MapReduce、Spark RDD、参数服务器、Kubernetes、Horovod、Megatron-LM、ZeRO 与 vLLM，MADlib 也作为库内学习用例出现；SQL 与数据库执行、事务与一致性、云平台、流处理、流水线并行（如 GPipe）和 Ray 这类任务系统仍需展开。
next.en: The relational model, MPI, MapReduce, Spark RDDs, the parameter server, Kubernetes, Horovod, Megatron-LM, ZeRO, and vLLM are represented, with MADlib as an in-database learning example. SQL and database execution, transactions and consistency, cloud platforms, stream processing, pipeline parallelism such as GPipe, and task systems such as Ray remain gaps.

subtitle.zh: 计算理论 · 优化 · 搜索 · 控制

description.zh: 有些问题根本没有通用算法，有些能算却太慢。先看“能不能算”，再看怎样少走弯路：搜索、统计、优化和数值计算，都有自己的问题与方法。
description.en: Some problems have no general algorithm; others are computable but expensive. This branch moves from what can be computed to how to do it efficiently, through search, statistics, optimization, and numerical methods.

next.zh: 已有图灵机、香农信息论、随机逼近、Monte Carlo、动态规划、Dijkstra、FFT 和 Adam；凸优化、概率图模型、编码与压缩、密码学和复杂度理论仍需展开。
next.en: Turing machines, Shannon's information theory, stochastic approximation, Monte Carlo, dynamic programming, Dijkstra, the FFT and Adam are represented. Convex optimization, probabilistic graphical models, coding and compression, cryptography and complexity theory still need histories.

subtitle.zh: 采集 · 标注 · 反馈 · 基准

description.zh: 同一个模型，换一批数据，学到的东西可能很不一样。数据从哪来、谁来标注、用什么题目评估，决定了很多结果该怎样理解。
description.en: The same model can learn very different things from different data. Collection, annotation, and evaluation choices shape what a reported result actually tells us.

next.zh: 已有 Penn Treebank、ImageNet、SQuAD、GLUE、MMLU、LAION-5B 和 Datasheets；语音语料（如 TIMIT）、网页语料（如 Common Crawl）、标注劳动、数据许可与版权仍需展开。
next.en: Penn Treebank, ImageNet, SQuAD, GLUE, MMLU, LAION-5B and Datasheets are represented. Speech corpora such as TIMIT, web corpora such as Common Crawl, annotation labour, and data licensing and copyright still need histories.

subtitle.zh: 符号 · 统计 · 神经网络 · RL

description.zh: 怎样从样本、结构或反馈中学到有用的东西？视觉、语言、图学习和 RL 各有任务，也会借用彼此的方法。可以只跟着你感兴趣的一条线读。
description.en: How can a model learn something useful from examples, structure, or feedback? Vision, language, graph learning, and RL have different tasks and borrow from one another. Follow whichever branch interests you.

next.zh: 已有 LeNet-5、SIFT、Faster R-CNN、Segment Anything 等视觉节点，HMM、深度声学模型、WaveNet、Whisper 等语音节点，以及 IBM 翻译模型、ELMo、缩放定律和稀疏混合专家；其他概率图模型、推荐模型、因果与世界模型仍需展开。
next.en: Vision now includes LeNet-5, SIFT, Faster R-CNN and Segment Anything; speech includes the HMM tutorial, deep acoustic models, WaveNet and Whisper; language adds IBM's translation models, ELMo, scaling laws and sparse mixture of experts. Other graphical models, recommendation models, causality and world models still need expansion.

subtitle.zh: 科学 · 机器人 · 搜索 · 助手

description.zh: AlphaGo 要选棋步，AlphaFold 要预测结构，聊天助手要回应请求。把任务、方法和工程放回同一个案例里，才容易看清一项技术究竟做成了什么。
description.en: AlphaGo chooses moves, AlphaFold predicts structures, and an assistant responds to requests. Looking at the task, methods, and engineering together makes each achievement easier to understand.

next.zh: 已有 DENDRAL、MYCIN、Shakey、ALVINN、Sojourner、Stanley、深蓝、AlphaGo、BM25、GroupLens、Google 原型、Netflix Prize、YouTube 推荐、GNMT、AlphaFold 2、GraphCast、Copilot、ChatGPT、Stable Diffusion 和 RT-2；医疗影像、金融、工业控制和教育等部署案例仍需展开。
next.en: DENDRAL, MYCIN, Shakey, ALVINN, Sojourner, Stanley, Deep Blue, AlphaGo, BM25, GroupLens, the Google prototype, the Netflix Prize, YouTube recommendations, GNMT, AlphaFold 2, GraphCast, Copilot, ChatGPT, Stable Diffusion and RT-2 are represented. Deployments in medical imaging, finance, industrial control and education still need histories.

subtitle.zh: 研究组织 · 开源 · 标准 · 安全

description.zh: 技术也由人和协作方式塑造：谁整理数据、怎样分享代码、发布模型时要交代什么。这里关注研究组织、开源协作，以及使用技术的人。
description.en: Technology is also shaped by people and how they work together: who prepares the data, how code is shared, and what a model release should disclose. This branch follows research communities, open collaboration, and users.

next.zh: 已有 Dartmouth、GPL、arXiv、差分隐私、联邦学习、Datasheets、Model Cards 和 Hugging Face Transformers；资助机构、标注劳动、开放权重的许可和安全评估仍需展开。
next.en: Dartmouth, the GPL, arXiv, differential privacy, federated learning, Datasheets, Model Cards and Hugging Face Transformers are represented. Funding bodies, annotation labour, licensing of open weights and safety evaluation still need histories.

description.zh: 训练与评估使用 ImageNet 的 ILSVRC 子集；数据集与竞赛设置都是结果的一部分。
description.en: Training and evaluation use ILSVRC subsets of ImageNet; the dataset and competition setup are part of the result.

description.zh: 论文提供 GPU 卷积实现，并链接到 cuda-convnet。训练还受当时两块 GPU 的显存与通信限制。
description.en: The paper provides GPU convolution code through cuda-convnet. Training is also constrained by the memory and communication of its two GPUs.

description.zh: 把图像块作为序列输入 Transformer，不是说图像因此和语言完全一样。
description.en: Image patches become a Transformer sequence; this does not make image and language data identical.

description.zh: 前者交代模型的用途与表现，后者交代数据的来历与边界。原论文明确把两者作为互补文档。
description.en: One reports model uses and behavior; the other documents data provenance and limits. The Model Cards paper explicitly treats them as complementary.

description.zh: 论文描述的集群由运行 Linux 的双处理器 x86 机器组成，配本地 IDE 硬盘和普通网络。
description.en: The paper's clusters are dual-processor x86 machines running Linux, with local IDE disks and commodity networking.

description.zh: ResNet 的检测实验以 Faster R-CNN 为框架，只把 VGG-16 换成 ResNet-101，COCO 标准指标提高 6.0 个点。
description.en: ResNet's detection experiments use Faster R-CNN as the framework and only swap VGG-16 for ResNet-101, raising the standard COCO metric by 6.0 points.

description.zh: RPN 和检测网络共享的卷积层，用在 ImageNet 分类上预训练的模型初始化。
description.en: The convolutional layers shared by the RPN and the detector are initialized from models pre-trained for ImageNet classification.

description.zh: GPT-3 依据这篇的分析，训练比常见做法大得多、词元却少得多的模型；大模型的批量和学习率设置也引用了它。
description.en: Following this analysis, GPT-3 trained much larger models on far fewer tokens than was typical, and cites it for the batch sizes and learning rates of its larger models.

description.zh: 缩放规律是在 Transformer 语言模型上拟合的；论文另外和 LSTM 做了对比。
description.en: The scaling fits are measured on Transformer language models, with a separate comparison against LSTMs.

description.zh: MoE 层放在堆叠的 LSTM 层之间，每个位置调用一次，每次可能选出不同的专家组合。
description.en: The MoE layer sits between stacked LSTM layers and is called once per position, possibly choosing different experts each time.

description.zh: ELMo 的语言模型是两层双向 LSTM，词的表示取自这些层的加权组合。
description.en: ELMo's language model is a two-layer bidirectional LSTM, and word representations are weighted combinations of its layers.

description.zh: 为了不让架构改动干扰结论，Whisper 直接用现成的编码器—解码器 Transformer。
description.en: To keep architecture changes from confounding its findings, Whisper uses an off-the-shelf encoder–decoder Transformer.

description.zh: 图像编码器是经 MAE 预训练的 ViT-H，稍作改动以处理高分辨率输入，每张图只运行一次。
description.en: The image encoder is an MAE-pre-trained ViT-H, minimally adapted for high-resolution input and run once per image.

description.zh: 文字提示用 CLIP 现成的文本编码器编码；这部分在论文里还是初步尝试。
description.en: Text prompts are encoded with CLIP's off-the-shelf text encoder; the paper treats this part as exploratory.

description.zh: 深度网络替换的是 GMM：它输出 HMM 状态的后验概率，换算成似然后，仍交给 HMM 做对齐和解码。
description.en: The deep network replaces the GMM: it outputs posteriors over HMM states, which are converted to scaled likelihoods for HMM alignment and decoding.

description.zh: 日志例子从 HDFS 文件建立 RDD，迭代实验的第一轮也从 HDFS 读文本；需要复用的数据再留在内存里，可靠存储和内存复用是两层。
description.en: The log example builds an RDD from an HDFS file, and the iterative experiments read text from HDFS in their first iteration; data meant for reuse then stays in memory, so durable storage and in-memory reuse are separate layers.

description.zh: 论文说明 MapReduce 可以用 flatMap 和 groupByKey 表达，并沿用它为慢节点启动备份任务的做法；不同在于中间结果可以留在内存里复用。
description.en: The paper shows that MapReduce can be expressed with flatMap and groupByKey, and it borrows MapReduce's backup tasks for slow nodes; the difference is that intermediate results can stay in memory for reuse.

description.zh: 论文把 Li 等人的系统列为参数服务器路线中加入一致性模型、容错和弹性扩缩的一步；TensorFlow 不单设参数服务器，而让部分任务担任 PS 角色，并能运行任意计算图。
description.en: The paper places Li and colleagues' system in the parameter server line as the step that added consistency models, fault tolerance, and elastic rescaling; TensorFlow has no separate parameter server and lets some tasks play the PS role while running arbitrary graphs.

description.zh: Horovod 为 Uber 的 TensorFlow 训练而写，用包装过的优化器和广播操作，取代 TensorFlow 自带的参数服务器式分布式训练。
description.en: Horovod was written for Uber's TensorFlow training, replacing TensorFlow's built-in parameter-server style of distributed training with a wrapped optimizer and a broadcast operation.

description.zh: 用 Open MPI 这类 MPI 实现启动多份训练程序并建立进程间通信；论文的例子用 mpirun 在 4 台服务器上启动 16 个进程。
description.en: An MPI implementation such as Open MPI launches the copies of the training program and sets up communication among them; the paper's example uses mpirun to start 16 processes on four servers.

description.zh: 模型并行只靠在原生 PyTorch 里加几处通信操作实现，通信由 Python 调用 NCCL 完成，不需要新的编译器。
description.en: Model parallelism is implemented by adding a few communication operations in native PyTorch, with communication done through Python calls to NCCL and no new compiler.

description.zh: 实验用 32 台 DGX-2H、共 512 张 V100，并用混合精度训练来利用 V100 的 Tensor Core。
description.en: Experiments ran on 32 DGX-2H servers with 512 V100 GPUs in total, using mixed-precision training to take advantage of the V100's Tensor Cores.

description.zh: 切分方式依赖 Transformer 层的结构：MLP 的两次矩阵乘法先按列、再按行切，注意力按头切。
description.en: The split relies on the structure of a Transformer layer: the MLP's two matrix multiplications are split by columns and then by rows, and attention is split by heads.

description.zh: ZeRO 论文把 ZeRO 驱动的数据并行与 Megatron-LM 的模型并行组合使用，并拿 2019 年 9 月开源的 Megatron-LM 作对照。
description.en: The ZeRO paper combines ZeRO-powered data parallelism with Megatron-LM's model parallelism and uses the Megatron-LM code open-sourced in September 2019 as its baseline.

description.zh: PyTorch 提供 torch.from_numpy() 和 .numpy()，两边共用同一块内存，转换不复制数据，耗时与数组大小无关。
description.en: PyTorch provides torch.from_numpy() and .numpy(); both sides share one memory region, so conversion copies nothing and takes constant time regardless of array size.

description.zh: NumPy 是 Python 的数组库，但不在标准库里；论文提到 Python 语言多年来为它加过新特性和专门语法，让数组写法更简洁。
description.en: NumPy is Python's array library but not part of the standard library; the paper notes that Python added features and special syntax over the years to make NumPy's array notation more concise.

description.zh: C 与早期 Unix 同时发展；1973 年夏，PDP-11 上的 Unix 内核用 C 重写。
description.en: C developed alongside early Unix, and in the summer of 1973 the PDP-11 Unix kernel was rewritten in C.

description.zh: 在 Cho 等人和 Sutskever 等人的 RNN 编码器—解码器上扩展：编码器为每个词保留向量，解码器每步重新计算权重，而不是只靠一个定长向量。
description.en: Extends the RNN encoder–decoder of Cho et al. and Sutskever et al.: the encoder keeps a vector per word, and the decoder recomputes weights at each step instead of relying on one fixed-length vector.

description.zh: 编码器和解码器都是 8 层 LSTM，编码器最底层为双向。
description.en: Both encoder and decoder are eight-layer LSTMs, with a bidirectional bottom encoder layer.

description.zh: 论文写明 attention 模块与 Bahdanau 等人的类似，用一个单隐层前馈网络给原句各位置打分。
description.en: The paper states that its attention module is similar to Bahdanau et al.'s, scoring source positions with a one-hidden-layer feed-forward network.

description.zh: 受 ResNet 启发，在堆叠的 LSTM 层之间加残差连接；作者说不加时 4 层还好，6 层勉强，超过 8 层就很差。
description.en: Inspired by ResNet, it adds residual connections between stacked LSTM layers; without them, the authors report, four layers worked, six barely, and more than eight very poorly.

description.zh: 论文把 Bahdanau 等人的加性 attention 列为两种常用 attention 之一；Transformer 改用缩放点积，并且不再搭配循环网络。
description.en: The paper lists Bahdanau et al.'s additive attention as one of the two common attention functions; Transformer uses scaled dot-product attention instead and drops the recurrent network.

description.zh: 英法实验沿用 GNMT 的 32000 词片词表；GNMT 加强化学习的结果也是表 2 里的对照基线。
description.en: The English–French experiments reuse GNMT's 32,000-wordpiece vocabulary, and GNMT with RL is a baseline in Table 2.

description.zh: 视频向量的做法受连续词袋（CBOW）语言模型启发；论文引用的是 Mikolov 等人 2013 年的另一篇 Distributed Representations of Words and Phrases，而不是本树 word2vec 节点所用的 CBOW 原文。
description.en: The video embeddings were inspired by continuous bag-of-words language models; the paper cites Mikolov et al.'s companion 2013 paper, Distributed Representations of Words and Phrases, rather than the CBOW paper used by the word2vec node.

description.zh: Codex 从 GPT-3 系列模型出发，在 GitHub 代码上微调；论文说从预训练模型出发并没有提高最终效果，但收敛更快。
description.en: Codex starts from the GPT-3 model family and is fine-tuned on GitHub code; the paper reports that starting from a pretrained model did not improve final results but converged faster.

description.zh: 库里的模型都是 Transformer 结构的变体，按原论文的计算图实现，并测试能否复现原作者的结果。
description.en: The library's models are Transformer variants implemented from the original computation graphs and tested against the original authors' reported results.

description.zh: 2020 年的会议版写道：模型中心的模型页可以附一份模型卡（引用 Mitchell 等人），说明训练、数据和已知偏差。
description.en: The 2020 conference version says model pages on the hub can carry a model card (citing Mitchell et al.) covering training, data, and known biases.

description.zh: 按 GNU 一方的说法，要让 GNU 软件不被改成专有软件，就需要相应的分发条款；GPL 是他们为大多数 GNU 软件采用的 copyleft。
description.en: In the GNU project's account, keeping GNU software from being turned into proprietary software required matching distribution terms; the GPL is the copyleft used for most GNU software.

description.zh: 最初是电子邮件服务器，几个月后加了 FTP；1993 年 Mosaic 浏览器出现后不久，也成了 Web 服务器。
description.en: It began as an email server and added FTP within months; not long after the Mosaic browser appeared in 1993, it became a Web server as well.

description.zh: 发布博客写明 EC2 用 Xen 虚拟机监控程序搭建；Xen 提供隔离，按小时租用是 EC2 自己的服务设计。
description.en: The launch post states that EC2 was built on the Xen virtual machine monitor; Xen supplied isolation, while hourly rental was EC2's own service design.

description.zh: Joe Beda 回忆，Kubernetes 建立在 Google 用 Borg 验证了十年的想法上，但代码是另外写的。
description.en: Joe Beda recalls that Kubernetes built on ideas Google had proven with Borg over ten years, though the code was written anew.

description.zh: 每个 Borg 任务是一组 Linux 进程，跑在基于 cgroup 的容器里，由 Borglet 调整资源限制。
description.en: Each Borg task is a set of Linux processes in a cgroup-based container whose limits the Borglet adjusts.

description.zh: 论文把 Linux 2.4 改成能跑在 Xen 上的 XenoLinux，负责管理的 Domain0 也运行在它上面。
description.en: The paper ports Linux 2.4 to Xen as XenoLinux, which also hosts the Domain0 management software.

description.zh: 论文图 2 中，TVM 生成的低层循环程序可以交给 LLVM IR 后端，也可以输出 CUDA、Metal 或 OpenCL。
description.en: In the paper's Figure 2, TVM's low-level loop programs can go to an LLVM IR back end or be emitted as CUDA, Metal, or OpenCL.

description.zh: Triton-IR 是在 LLVM IR 上加了块级数据流和控制流扩展的中间表示，编译结果是 LLVM 位码。
description.en: Triton-IR extends LLVM IR with tile-level data-flow and control-flow constructs, and the compiler emits LLVM bitcode.

description.zh: 论文把差分隐私列为可以叠加的更强保证，也说明它要靠加噪声换取，会损失一些效用。
description.en: The paper names differential privacy as a stronger guarantee that can be layered on, at some cost in utility from added noise.

description.zh: 训练用 Adam（β1 = 0.9，β2 = 0.98，ε = 10⁻⁹），学习率先在 4000 步内线性升高，再按步数的平方根倒数下降。
description.en: Training uses Adam with β1 = 0.9, β2 = 0.98 and ε = 10⁻⁹; the learning rate rises linearly for 4,000 steps, then decays with the inverse square root of the step number.

description.zh: 论文用 GLUE 报告微调结果，摘要给出的总分是 80.5%。
description.en: The paper reports fine-tuning results on GLUE; its abstract gives a score of 80.5%.

description.zh: 论文在 SQuAD 上评估问答，摘要报告 SQuAD v1.1 测试 F1 为 93.2，SQuAD v2.0 为 83.1。
description.en: The paper evaluates question answering on SQuAD; its abstract reports a test F1 of 93.2 on SQuAD v1.1 and 83.1 on SQuAD v2.0.

description.zh: 论文把 Q-learning 称为增量式、异步的动态规划：不预先知道奖励和转移概率，而是从经验里逐步逼近动态规划要算的最优动作价值。它引用的是 Bellman 与 Dreyfus 1962 年的书，不是这篇 1954 年的文章。
description.en: The paper calls Q-learning incremental, asynchronous dynamic programming: without knowing rewards and transition probabilities in advance, it approaches from experience the optimal action values that dynamic programming would compute. It cites Bellman and Dreyfus's 1962 book rather than this 1954 article.

description.zh: 用 OpenAI 的 ViT-B/32 CLIP 计算图文相似度来筛选数据，又用 LAION 子集重新训练 CLIP，与原版比较。
description.en: Filters pairs by image–text similarity from OpenAI's ViT-B/32 CLIP, then retrains CLIP on LAION subsets for comparison with the originals.

description.zh: GLUE 的 QNLI 任务由 SQuAD 自动改造：把问题和段落里的每个句子配对，判断这句话是否包含答案。
description.en: GLUE's QNLI task is converted automatically from SQuAD: each question is paired with every sentence of its passage, and the task is to judge whether that sentence contains the answer.

description.zh: 论文用 Roofline 分析六个应用在 CPU、GPU 和 TPU 上的瓶颈，把浮点运算换成整数运算，并把运算强度改为每读一字节权重的运算次数。
description.en: The paper uses Roofline to locate bottlenecks for six applications on the CPU, GPU, and TPU, replacing floating-point with integer operations and redefining operational intensity as operations per byte of weights read.

description.zh: 第 6 节引用 Barroso 与 Hölzle 2007 年的能耗比例性主张，测量负载从 0% 到 100% 时三种芯片的功耗；TPU 在 10% 负载时仍用满载功耗的 88%。
description.en: Section 6 cites Barroso and Hölzle's 2007 case for energy proportionality and measures power for the three chips from 0% to 100% load; at 10% load the TPU still draws 88% of its full-load power.

description.zh: V100 白皮书写明 NVLink 于 2016 年随 P100 推出；V100 的第二代把每对线速从 20 提到 25 Gb/s，链路从 4 条增到 6 条。
description.en: The V100 whitepaper states that NVLink was introduced in 2016 with the P100; V100's second generation raises the per-pair rate from 20 to 25 Gb/s and the link count from four to six.

description.zh: 论文以 MapReduce 为例说明集群的瓶颈常在节点间带宽：map 阶段的输出要先大量重新分发，reduce 才能开始。fat-tree 针对的正是这类跨机器流量。
description.en: The paper cites MapReduce as an example of inter-node bandwidth becoming the bottleneck: map output must be shuffled across machines before the reduce phase can begin. Fat-tree targets this kind of cross-machine traffic.

description.zh: Model 85 是 System/360 的一个型号。Liptay 写道，缓存的装入和替换必须不靠程序参与，因为 Model 85 要与 System/360 的其他型号兼容。
description.en: The Model 85 is a System/360 model. Liptay writes that its cache had to be loaded and replaced without program assistance because the Model 85 had to remain compatible with the rest of the System/360 line.

description.zh: ALVINN 是一个三层的反向传播网络，用 1200 张模拟道路图，在 Warp 上的反向传播模拟器里训练。
description.en: ALVINN is a three-layer backpropagation network, trained on 1,200 simulated road images with a backpropagation simulator on the Warp.

description.zh: Stanley 调激光测绘参数时，用人开过的无障碍地面当“可行驶”标签，论文说这一做法与 Pomerleau 的工作思路相近；视觉找路部分也引用了 ALVINN 1991 年出版的后续论文。不同的是，Stanley 的转向来自路径规划和控制器，视觉结果只用来调速度。
description.en: To tune its laser mapper, Stanley used obstacle-free ground driven by a person as drivable labels, which the paper calls similar in spirit to Pomerleau's work; its vision-based road finding also cites the 1991 ALVINN follow-up. Unlike ALVINN, Stanley steered through a path planner and controller, and used its vision results only to set speed.
